We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.
summary_zh: 基于提议的场景预测可能缺乏跨候选轨迹的通用对象级参照。聚合规划得分也无法体现违规所关联的对象与时间。我们提出WTR-Drive（World-Task-Risk Driving），一种基于Drive-JEPA的规划器，将共享场景估计与基于提议的推理分离。提议无关的世界记忆模块在每轮细化过程中通过重新读取原始视觉特征，估计对象状态、地图结构和未来运动。提议反馈更新残差任务分支，而不回写至世界记忆。该分支通过候选特定的检索和门控视觉反馈引导细化过程。最终的任务读出提供候选条件特征用于评分。我们从现有候选评分滚动中推导结构化风险目标，无需额外调用模拟器。对于责任碰撞和碰撞时间违规，目标编码了事件存在性、共享对象槽的关联性以及首次违规时间区间。在NAVSIM navtest分割上，WTR-Drive在v1上达到了94.66 PDMS，在v2上达到了88.24 EPDMS（专家帧顺序评估）。这些得分分别比已发表的Drive-JEPA值高出0.96和0.44分。候选级分析表明，较高的最佳候选得分可能与较低的选中轨迹得分并存，揭示了候选质量与选择有效性之间的差距。
tldr: WTR-Drive introduces a Drive-JEPA-based end-to-end driving planner that decouples shared world estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning and uses structured risk supervision to improve planning scores on NAVSIM benchmarks.
tldr_zh: WTR-Drive 提出了一种基于 Drive-JEPA 的端到端驾驶规划器，将共享世界估计与提议条件推理分离，并使用结构化风险监督来提升 NAVSIM 基准上的规划得分。

title: Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models
summary: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act.
summary_zh: 基于人类视频的机器人策略预训练对于提升策略的泛化能力至关重要。该任务面临的主要挑战之一在于，此类无标注数据中缺乏显式的动作相关表征。近期研究倾向于利用3D基础模型从视频中估计3D手部运动轨迹，然而，这些方法仅保留稀疏轨迹作为监督信号，忽略了轨迹提取过程中产生的丰富细粒度信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出LSA，一种包含三个阶段（提升、感知、执行）的分层机器人策略预训练框架。具体而言，提升阶段通过自适应对齐策略浅层特征与多个3D基础模型提取的中间表征，将2D视频观测提升为稠密3D表示。在此基础上，感知阶段通过双重引导赋予策略显式的几何感知与交互感知能力：一方面引入深度图重建以帮助模型理解3D空间布局，另一方面利用手部区域线索显式监督编码器关注任务相关的交互热点区域。凭借稠密3D表示学习与精确的空间引导，我们的策略在执行阶段实现了鲁棒且精准的机器人操作。在多种仿真及真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，LSA显著优于当前最先进的方法。项目主页：https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act。
tldr: LSA proposes a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that lifts 2D human videos into dense 3D representations using 3D foundation models, then adds depth-map and hand-region guidance for better manipulation policies, outperforming SOTA in simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: LSA提出了一种层次化机器人策略预训练框架，利用3D基础模型将2D人类视频提升为稠密3D表示，并通过深度图和手部区域引导增强操作策略，在仿真和真实任务中超越当前最优方法。

title: ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations
summary: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA, $π_{0.5}$, and Fast-WAM by 23.45, 13.09, and 8.00 percentage points, respectively. In paired evaluation on all 50 tasks, it raises Fast-WAM's average success rate from 90.73% to 92.66%. On a Flexiv dual-arm robot, it raises success on a phase-ambiguous task from 0% to 36%.
summary_zh: 当预训练的机器人策略在挑战性任务中失败时，常见补救措施包括重新训练骨干网络、增加外部视觉编码器，或引入记忆模块。我们认为，错误预测并不意味着错误表征：策略可能保留了所需信息，却未能将其读出为正确动作。为验证这一观点，我们提出ReRead方法：在冻结骨干网络的情况下，一个校正器重新读取当前及前两个缓存，以预测动作残差。该校正器不接触图像，仅在所有50个RoboTwin 2.0任务的离线演示数据上训练，且仅增加4.17%的延迟。消融实验与干预测试表明，该校正依赖于骨干网络自身的表征：四种外部视觉编码器均未带来额外增益，而将其他轨迹的历史缓存替换进来会显著提高动作误差。在RoboTwin 2.0的11个最难任务中，ReRead将LingBot-VLA、π₀.₅和Fast-WAM的成功率分别提升了23.45、13.09和8.00个百分点。在全部50个任务的配对评估中，它将Fast-WAM的平均成功率从90.73%提升至92.66%。在Flexiv双臂机器人上，它将在相位模糊任务中的成功率从0%提升至36%。
tldr: ReRead proposes a frozen-backbone corrector that re-reads cached representations from a frozen robot policy to predict action residuals, improving success rates on hard RoboTwin tasks and a real dual-arm robot with minimal latency.
tldr_zh: ReRead 提出了一种冻结主干矫正器，通过重新读取冻结机器人策略的缓存表示来预测动作残差，在困难的 RoboTwin 任务和真实双臂机器人上提高了成功率，且延迟极低。

title: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.
summary_zh: 基于流式的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在机器人领域取得了优异性能，然而，利用在线策略强化学习（RL）对其进行微调仍存在局限。在基于组的强化学习方法（如组相对策略优化，GRPO）中，每次采样步骤都需要进行多步常微分方程积分，且采样器的随机性有限，导致生成的样本组方差较低。我们提出VLA-SSD，以同时解决高推理延迟和随机性不足这两个问题。具体而言，我们的方法将预训练的流匹配动作头自蒸馏为一个随机单步策略，通过将单步生成器以布朗路径为条件实现。我们通过该随机单步策略推导出条件动作密度，从而能够利用似然比强化学习算法进行高效的后训练。我们证明，从$π_0$ VLA蒸馏得到VLA-SSD后，动作头的前向传播时间缩短了7.7倍，而在LIBERO基准测试中成功率仅相对下降5.5%。然而，利用VLA-SSD在组生成过程中带来的更大样本多样性，使用GRPO对$π_{0.5}$ VLA进行后训练可带来20.6%的相对性能提升。
tldr: This paper introduces VLA-SSD, a method that self-distills a flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy to reduce inference latency and increase sample diversity for RL fine-tuning of vision-language-action models, achieving large speedups and improved post-training performance on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VLA-SSD方法，通过将流匹配动作头自蒸馏为随机一步策略，降低了视觉-语言-动作模型的推理延迟并增加了样本多样性，在LIBERO基准上实现了大幅加速和更好的后训练性能。

title: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
summary: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/.
summary_zh: 灵巧抓取策略通常是为单臂配单手进行训练的。每新增一种臂-手组合就需要重新训练策略，且策略数量会随臂和手的增加而不断增长。我们探索是否可以用单一策略控制多种臂-手组合，并将其泛化到从未见过的组合及手型上。这一目标颇具挑战性，因为不同机器人的关节数量、布局和动力学特性各不相同，导致其观测和动作缺乏统一的接口。我们提出了DexFormer 2.0，一个用于跨形态灵巧抓取的单强化学习策略。该策略将每个机器人映射到一个带有效性掩码的规范关节接口，通过由运动学树引导的注意力机制编码每个关节的形态，并利用Transformer-XL记忆从近期交互中推断与具体形态相关的动力学特性。在四种手臂和六种手组成的18种组合上训练后，该策略在已知组合上达到89%的稳定成功率，在六种未参与训练的臂-手组合上达到51%的成功率，优于GRU和DexFormer 1.0基线。无需微调，该策略还能用四种新手型完成抓取，并通过重定向适配平行夹爪。消融实验表明，记忆机制、运动学树偏置以及更广泛的组合覆盖对迁移性能均至关重要。在实体Flexiv机械臂上，蒸馏后的学生模型能够从仿真零样本迁移到两种手型（包括一种未参与训练的组合）。项目网站：https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/。
tldr: DexFormer 2.0 introduces a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping, using a canonical joint interface, kinematic-tree-biased attention, and Transformer-XL memory to transfer across unseen arm-hand pairs and hands, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: DexFormer 2.0 提出了一种用于跨具身灵巧抓取的统一强化学习策略，通过规范关节接口、运动学树偏置注意力和 Transformer-XL 记忆，实现到未见过的臂手组合和手型的迁移，并展示了零样本仿真到真实世界的迁移。

title: Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $π_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在理想环境下产生期望的机器人行为。然而，当机器人执行机构在部署时发生变化，这些模型往往会失效。例如，重新安装、机械磨损或指令延迟变化可能导致任务失败和不安全行为。为解决这一不可避免的执行机构偏移问题，我们提出ReGround，一种推理时方法，保持VLA冻结不变并重新锚定其意图运动。ReGround通过任务无关的电机随意动作学习部署机器人的动力学，随后在跟踪策略意图运动的同时，保持与策略自身计划的接近。ReGround仅在检测到偏移时激活，且无需奖励、示范或重新训练。我们通过两个VLA模型、八个LIBERO任务及五种偏移设置验证了ReGround能够恢复接近理想状态的成功率，例如在400毫秒延迟下将π₀.₅的成功率从0.16提升至0.90，同时比线性校准基线更安全。项目网站及开源代码：https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/。
tldr: ReGround is an inference-time method that freezes a VLA policy and re-grounds its intended motion under actuation shift (e.g., latency, remounting) by learning deployed dynamics from motor babbling and tracking the policy's plan, restoring near-oracle success across LIBERO tasks.
tldr_zh: ReGround 是一种推理时方法，冻结 VLA 策略并在执行偏移（如延迟、重新安装）下重新校准其预期运动，通过学习部署动力学并跟踪策略计划，在 LIBERO 任务中恢复接近最优的成功率。

title: DAPPT: Domain-Aware Policies from Procedural Trajectories for Sim-to-Real Dexterous Tool Use
summary: Sim-to-real RL has achieved impressive results in dexterous manipulation but remains limited to tasks with accurate rigid-body simulation. However, these methods cannot be applied to skills that involve deformable and particles, with which the simulation speed will become too slow for large-scale RL learning. We present DAPPT, a sim-to-real framework for end-to-end dexterous tool-use manipulation skills, e.g., sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, without simulating non-rigid materials. Our method learns a domain-aware RL policy by tracking procedural trajectories parameterized by domain parameters, and distills it into an end-to-end domain-aware sensorimotor policy. Furthermore, explicit domain represen-tation enables fast selection of domain parameters that can maximize downstream task performance. We evaluate DAPPT end-to-end on six dexterous manipulation tasks, including sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, sand scraping, mouse-wheel scrolling, dispenser pressing, and spray triggering. Our method achieves 1.5-3.8x in task metrics through the best domain parameter and transfers zero-shot to the real world.
summary_zh: 模拟到现实的强化学习在灵巧操作方面取得了显著成果，但仅限于具有精确刚体模拟的任务。然而，这些方法无法应用于涉及可变形体和颗粒物的技能，因为其模拟速度将变得过慢，难以支撑大规模强化学习训练。我们提出了DAPPT，一个用于端到端灵巧工具使用操作技能的模拟到现实框架，例如铲沙、擀黏土棒，且无需模拟非刚性材料。我们的方法通过学习由域参数参数化的程序化轨迹，训练一个领域感知的强化学习策略，并将其蒸馏为端到端的领域感知感觉运动策略。此外，显式的领域表示能够快速选择最大化下游任务性能的域参数。我们在六项灵巧操作任务上对DAPPT进行了端到端评估，包括铲沙、擀黏土棒、刮沙、滚轮滚动、按压分配器和触发喷雾。我们的方法通过最佳域参数在任务指标上实现了1.5至3.8倍的提升，并零样本迁移到现实世界。
tldr: DAPPT presents a sim-to-real RL framework for dexterous tool-use skills involving deformable/particle materials, learning domain-aware policies from procedural trajectories and distilling them into end-to-end sensorimotor policies, achieving zero-shot real-world transfer and improved task metrics.
tldr_zh: DAPPT提出了一种针对涉及可变形/颗粒材料的灵巧工具使用技能的sim-to-real强化学习框架，通过从程序化轨迹学习领域感知策略并蒸馏为端到端感知运动策略，实现了zero-shot真实世界迁移并提升了任务指标。

title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
summary: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型能够通过文本和相机控制实现探索，但直接的物体交互需要更精细的控制。手部提供了一种自然的交互界面，然而，由于手部-物体动态的复杂性以及实时计算的高要求，将连续的手部动作转化为连贯的视觉响应仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LynnReal-Hand，一种手部控制的视频世界模型，它将精确的交互建模与高效的流式生成相统一。我们整理了涵盖多样化真实与合成环境的10万段交互片段，并开发了手部感知监督以改进细粒度的手部动作和物体交互。在此基础上，我们学习了一种用于少步生成的因果流映射，并引入了区域感知分数蒸馏，结合互补的视频与图像先验，以优化交互动态和视觉外观。为进一步降低推理延迟，我们提出了Ultra-Fast-VAE，一种紧凑的视频解码器，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持较高的重建保真度。在HandBench上的广泛评估表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在手部跟踪精度和视觉质量上均表现更优。我们的全序列模型实现了181.67的FVD和93.02的MANO Dice分数，而三步因果模型保持了92.49的MANO Dice分数。在实时交互方面，在单个H200上进行540p流式生成可达18.03 FPS，延迟为741ms，优化后的峰值GPU内存占用仅为34.89GB。我们将发布数据集、模型权重以及完整的训练和推理代码，以支持手部控制视频世界模型的研究。
tldr: This paper introduces LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that enables direct object interaction in interactive video generation, featuring hand-aware supervision, causal flow maps for few-step generation, region-aware score distillation, and an efficient Ultra-Fast-VAE, achieving real-time streaming performance on a single H200.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LynnReal-Hand，一个手部控制的视频世界模型，支持在交互式视频生成中直接操作物体，通过手部感知监督、因果流映射、区域感知分数蒸馏和高效的Ultra-Fast-VAE，在单张H200上实现了实时流式生成。

title: POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $π_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.
summary_zh: 视觉标记剪枝降低了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理成本，但基于注意力的分数并不能直接衡量某个标记对预测动作的影响。我们将动作敏感性定义为当某个标记被替换为其所在摄像头的均值标记时，一阶动作变化的幅度，并通过一次反向传播对所有标记进行估计。在线计算该指标的代价较高：在完整（未剪枝）图上进行评分，每个控制步都需要额外的前向传播。而在剪枝后的前向传播上评分虽然更便宜，却会导致“评分图锁定”问题：被移除的标记在后续层中失去直接通路，往往获得更低的分数，从而使其更不易被重新选中。在回放观测中，即使使用随机条件掩码，基于剪枝图的评分仍会重新选中掩码中59%的标记，而随机期望仅为6%；注意力历史记录也显示出类似的偏差。POKE（离线探测、高效保留）方法在离线状态下计算完整图上的动作敏感性，并将其蒸馏到一个参数量不足30万的学生网络中。在推理时，该学生网络无需反向传播或依赖先前的掩码即可对当前观测进行评分，并通过分数引导的多样性选择来保留标记。在LIBERO基准上，当从512个视觉标记中保留32个时，POKE在OpenVLA-OFT上达到95.2%的成功率，在π₀.₅上达到90.8%，同时分别获得1.85倍和1.26倍的加速，优于基于注意力、多样性和蒸馏的剪枝方法，且在LIBERO-Plus上的优势更为显著。
tldr: POKE introduces action-sensitivity-based visual token pruning for VLA models, distilling offline full-graph sensitivities into a lightweight student to avoid costly online scoring and scoring-graph lock-in, achieving significant speedups on LIBERO while maintaining high success rates.
tldr_zh: POKE 提出基于动作敏感度的视觉 token 剪枝方法，将离线全图敏感度蒸馏到轻量学生网络中，避免昂贵的在线评分和评分图锁定问题，在 LIBERO 上实现显著加速同时保持高成功率。

title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.
summary_zh: 预训练视频表示为机器人操作提供了丰富的时序信息，但如何有效地将其整合到现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中仍是一个挑战。我们提出了流感知视觉残差对齐（FAVR），一个用于冻结VLA策略的流感知视觉条件化的轻量级框架。FAVR通过线性测试时训练（TTT）维护紧凑的时序视觉状态，并在基于流的动作生成过程中检索动作条件化的视觉特征。通过利用冻结动作头的仿射结构，我们明确刻画了注入的视觉特征如何影响预测的动作速度，并将流感知通道选择建模为盒约束优化问题。我们开发了一个基于FISTA的求解器用于联合门控优化，并通过对角化和重缩放推导出高效的闭式近似。仅凭1.74-2.19M的可训练参数和5,000步自适应，FAVR在多个基准上提升了预训练VLA策略的性能。在RoboTwin 2.0上，FAVR将LingBot-VLA在干净条件下的成功率从87.12%提升至90.04%，在随机条件下从86.88%提升至89.38%。在五个RoboTwin任务上的受控消融实验进一步表明，流感知门控将平均成功率从跨流步骤共享门控时的72.0%提升至82.0%，展示了在动作生成过程中自适应视觉条件化的优势。
tldr: FAVR is a lightweight framework that enhances pretrained VLA policies by injecting flow-aware visual features into frozen action heads via test-time training and optimized channel gating, improving manipulation success rates on RoboTwin benchmarks with minimal parameters.
tldr_zh: FAVR 是一种轻量级框架，通过测试时训练和优化的通道门控将流感知视觉特征注入冻结的动作头，以增强预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并在 RoboTwin 基准上以极少参数提升了操作成功率。

title: Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为自动驾驶提供了一种统一的感知、推理与控制方法，但仅凭精确的动作预测并不足以确保符合交通法规。本文提出了一种规则引导的VLA框架，将符号化交通规则反馈纳入策略优化过程。该框架结合了基于专家示范的监督微调和强化学习（RL）精化，其中强化学习使用一种奖励机制，既鼓励遵守编码规则，又惩罚偏离专家动作的行为。英国《高速公路法典》中的部分条款被形式化为可执行的一阶逻辑规则，并使用PyReason实现，涵盖速度适应、跟车距离和道路使用者优先权等方面。一个冻结的视觉-语言模型提取场景谓词，并与车辆状态信息相结合，以评估候选控制动作的预期后果。基于CARLA模拟器中采集的留出数据的离线评估，比较了三种基于分组的强化学习方法。结果表明，与监督基线相比，动作预测准确率和编码规则符合率均有所提升。表现最佳的变体将总体规则通过率从92.9%提升至97.6%，且在评估样本中，编码的道路使用者优先权检查未出现任何违规情况。这些发现支持将符号化规则反馈作为提升VLA策略与明确交通规则标准对齐的一种有效手段。
tldr: This paper introduces a rule-guided VLA framework for autonomous driving that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback via RL fine-tuning, improving both action prediction accuracy and rule compliance in CARLA simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的规则引导的 VLA 框架，通过 RL 微调引入符号交通规则反馈，在 CARLA 仿真中同时提高了动作预测准确性和规则合规性。

title: Data-Driven Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicle Racing under Varying Friction
summary: Data-driven predictive control (DPC) predicts future outputs by combining recorded input-output trajectory data such that the combined trajectory approximately matches a measured initial trajectory and tracks a provided reference. This paper investigates to what extent and under which conditions DPC using data pooled across operating conditions retains the prediction accuracy of DPC using data from the current operating condition. In autonomous vehicle racing, the tire-road friction varies between racetrack sections and tire sets. If the initial trajectory and the recorded data originate from different frictions, prediction accuracy of DPC degrades. Ensuring the frictions match requires knowing the friction during recording and estimating the current friction explicitly. Instead, we pool data recorded at different frictions. We compare the prediction accuracy of DPC using data recorded under the current friction (matched), a different friction (mismatched) and data pooled from both frictions. We evaluate in simulation and small-scale vehicle experiments in the Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab (CPM Lab). Our results show that pooled data keep the multi-step root-mean-square prediction error within 1.5 times that of matched data, whereas mismatched data increase it by a factor of 2.2 to 3.4. To assess how this prediction accuracy carries over to control, we evaluate the tracking error from the raceline in closed loop. In simulation, DPC with pooled data tracks comparably to nonlinear model predictive control (13.7 cm versus 13.3 cm) and close to DPC with matched data in the CPM Lab, differing by 0.1 cm on the low-friction tires (1.6 cm versus 1.5 cm) and by 0.2 cm on the high-friction tires (0.9 cm versus 1.1 cm). DPC thus provides partial adaptation to varying friction, without a dedicated adaptation method.
summary_zh: 数据驱动预测控制（DPC）通过将记录的输入-输出轨迹数据与实测初始轨迹近似匹配并跟踪给定参考轨迹，从而预测未来输出。本文研究了在何种程度及何种条件下，使用跨运行条件汇总的数据进行DPC，能够保持使用当前运行条件数据时DPC的预测精度。在自动驾驶赛车中，轮胎-路面摩擦系数因赛道区段和轮胎组而异。若初始轨迹与记录数据来自不同摩擦条件，DPC的预测精度会下降。确保摩擦条件匹配需在记录时知晓摩擦系数，并显式估计当前摩擦系数。本文转而采用汇总自不同摩擦条件的数据。我们比较了在当前摩擦条件下记录的数据（匹配）、不同摩擦条件下的数据（失配）以及两者混合汇总数据对DPC预测精度的影响。我们在仿真及信息物理移动实验室（CPM Lab）中的小规模车辆实验中进行了评估。结果表明，汇总数据的多步均方根预测误差保持在匹配数据误差的1.5倍以内，而失配数据则使误差增大2.2至3.4倍。为评估预测精度对控制的影响，我们在闭环中评估了偏离赛道的跟踪误差。仿真中，使用汇总数据的DPC跟踪性能与非线性模型预测控制相当（13.7 cm对比13.3 cm），在CPM Lab中与使用匹配数据的DPC接近，低摩擦轮胎上相差0.1 cm（1.6 cm对比1.5 cm），高摩擦轮胎上相差0.2 cm（0.9 cm对比1.1 cm）。因此，DPC无需专门的自适应方法即可实现对变化摩擦条件的部分自适应。
tldr: This paper studies data-driven predictive control (DPC) for autonomous vehicle racing under varying tire-road friction, showing that pooling data from different frictions maintains prediction accuracy and control performance comparable to matched data, providing partial adaptation without explicit friction estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了自动驾驶赛车在轮胎-路面摩擦变化下的数据驱动预测控制(DPC)，表明在不同摩擦条件下合并数据可保持预测精度和控制性能，无需显式摩擦估计即可实现部分自适应。

title: Safe Physical Interaction of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators via Control Barrier Functions and Variable Impedance Control
summary: All-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators are increasingly expected to operate close to tunnel walls, equipment, and other structures while retaining the force capability required for large-payload tasks. Accurate motion control alone does not address the resulting safety and interaction requirements. This paper develops a safety-aware physical-interaction architecture that combines variable impedance control (VIC) with control barrier functions (CBFs) on top of an established virtual decomposition control (VDC) framework for electromechanical linear actuator (EMLA)-driven manipulators. VIC continuously adapts the task-space stiffness and damping according to predicted proximity and contact risk, whereas a joint-velocity CBF filter enforces Cartesian workspace boundaries and the physical stroke limits induced by the closed-chain lift and tilt mechanisms. To account for nonideal realization of the filtered velocity by the inner VDC/EMLA dynamics, the CBF inequalities are tightened using a measured bound on the joint-velocity tracking error. Four configurations, namely VDC, VIC+VDC, CBF+VDC, and VIC+CBF+VDC, are evaluated under workspace, actuator-limit, and physical-interaction scenarios. VIC reduces the peak and RMS environment-interaction forces by 92.59% and 96.33%, respectively; both robust CBF configurations maintain positive workspace and EMLA safety margins, while VIC+CBF+VDC reduces the CBF intervention metric by 10.30% compared with CBF+VDC.
summary_zh: 全电动重型机器人操作器日益需要在靠近隧道壁、设备及其他结构的环境下作业，同时保持完成大载荷任务所需的能力。仅依靠精确的运动控制并不能满足由此产生的安全与人机交互需求。本文提出了一种安全感知的物理交互架构，在已有的用于机电线性执行器（EMLA）驱动操作器的虚拟分解控制（VDC）框架基础上，将可变阻抗控制（VIC）与控制屏障函数（CBF）相结合。VIC根据预测的接近距离和接触风险，持续调整任务空间中的刚度与阻尼；而关节速度CBF滤波器则用于约束笛卡尔工作空间边界以及由闭链升降和倾斜机构引起的物理行程限制。考虑到内层VDC/EMLA动力学对滤波后速度的非理想实现，利用关节速度跟踪误差的实测界对CBF不等式进行收紧处理。本文在作业空间、执行器限制和物理交互等场景下，对四种配置——即VDC、VIC+VDC、CBF+VDC及VIC+CBF+VDC——进行了评估。结果表明，VIC可将环境交互力的峰值和均方根值分别降低92.59%和96.33%；两种鲁棒CBF配置均能保持正向的作业空间和EMLA安全裕度，而VIC+CBF+VDC相比CBF+VDC，其CBF干预指标减少了10.30%。
tldr: This paper presents a safety-aware control architecture for all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators, combining variable impedance control with control barrier functions to ensure safe physical interaction near obstacles and under actuator limits, achieving significant reductions in interaction forces while maintaining safety margins.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全电动重型机器人机械臂的安全感知物理交互控制架构，结合可变阻抗控制与控制屏障函数，在保证工作空间和作动器安全边界的同时，将交互力显著降低。

title: BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control
summary: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. We evaluate a low-pass realization within model predictive control on simulated and real hardware manipulation tasks, together with frequency-sensitivity analysis on real-robot data. Compared with an LSTM encoder using the same input filter, BoBDeLaN exhibits reduced high-frequency context sensitivity, lower residual torque prediction error, and smoother motion, with less degradation under injected disturbances.
summary_zh: 基于学习的物理模型为机器人控制提供了结构支撑，但不确定的负载和未建模的动力学限制了其预测精度。上下文感知的深度拉格朗日网络通过从测量历史中推断潜在上下文实现自适应，同时在每个固定上下文下保持拉格朗日结构。然而，仅靠这种结构无法约束对测量扰动的敏感性。我们提出BoBDeLaN，它将具有收缩性、增益有界的递归均衡网络上下文编码器与稳定的线性滤波相结合，以跨频率塑造扰动敏感性。该架构保证了对递归初始化的指数遗忘，并允许对上下文扰动施加有限时域、频率加权的界，该界在上下文条件动力学模型的Lipschitz连续性假设下可推广至残余扭矩预测。我们在仿真和真实硬件操作任务中评估了模型预测控制内的低通实现，并在真实机器人数据上进行了频率敏感性分析。与使用相同输入滤波器的LSTM编码器相比，BoBDeLaN表现出更低的上下文高频敏感性、更低的残余扭矩预测误差和更平滑的运动，且在注入扰动下性能退化更小。
tldr: BoBDeLaN introduces a bounded-bandwidth context encoder for Deep Lagrangian Networks, using a contracting Recurrent Equilibrium Network and linear filtering to reduce disturbance sensitivity in robot control, demonstrating improved prediction and smoother motion on real hardware.
tldr_zh: BoBDeLaN为深度拉格朗日网络引入了一种有界带宽上下文编码器，通过收缩循环均衡网络和线性滤波降低机器人控制中的扰动敏感性，在真实硬件上展示了更优的预测和更平滑的运动。

title: ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation
summary: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.
summary_zh: 与人类协作的机器人应当能够在面临新请求时，运用此前所见的信息。同样的经验可能日后用于识别物体或将其放回原位，尽管这些用途在观察时并未预知。ReuseMem学会将单一视觉记忆用于多种后续操作目标。它记录与未来目标无关的视觉特征，针对每个请求检索互补证据，并通过轻量级动作接口将其与当前场景结合。检索过程以候选证据在不同当前状态下对专家动作预测的支持程度为监督信号，将记忆选择与其在操作中的实际用途相联系。重复出现的视觉特征仅存储一次，而在动作生成过程中保持不变的内存计算则被复用。在四项仿真任务和两项物理场景中的实验表明，同一记录可被不同请求复用。在动作适配条件一致的情况下，ReuseMem在基准任务上的联合目标完成率较均匀记忆方式提升了24.5个百分点。这些发现表明，同一记忆可在场景变化中支持多种后续操作目标。
tldr: ReuseMem introduces a robot manipulation memory system that stores visual features once and reuses them for multiple downstream goals, supervised by expert-action prediction to select relevant memory evidence and show improvements in simulation and physical scenarios.
tldr_zh: ReuseMem 提出一种机器人操作记忆系统，将视觉特征一次性存储并复用于多个下游目标，通过专家动作预测监督记忆选择，在仿真和实物场景中提升了联合目标完成率。

title: Multi-CONDOR: Learning Multistable Motion Primitives from Demonstration
summary: Dynamical-system-based motion policies provide a framework for learning reactive robot motions with stability and convergence properties. Many manipulation tasks, however, admit several distinct goals or a continuous set of acceptable outcomes, requiring motion primitives that preserve these alternatives. Accommodating both goal structures within a unified framework with continuous, autonomous dynamics remains an open challenge. We propose a CONDOR-based framework, multi-CONDOR, for learning motion primitives with either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour. The approach combines imitation learning with losses that encourage agreement between the learned task dynamics and latent reference systems encoding the desired attraction structure. We provide a Lyapunov-based analysis of the convergence properties of the learned motion dynamics. We evaluate the framework on simulated benchmarks with discrete goals, qualitative examples with continuous goal contours, and robotic grasping experiments. In simulation, multi-CONDOR reduces trajectory RMSE by approximately 72% compared with separately learned single-goal motion primitives selected by a state machine. For tasks with two and three goals, respectively, it reduces the fraction of evaluated initial states ending outside the goal tolerance from StableNODE's 0.31% and 7.29% to 0% in both settings. Experiments with a Franka Emika robot arm demonstrate successful grasping of a container by either of its two handles using motions learned from demonstrations. Together, these results show multi-CONDOR combines motion reproduction with the flexibility to converge to alternative valid outcomes.
summary_zh: 基于动力系统的运动策略为学习具有稳定性和收敛特性的反应式机器人运动提供了一个框架。然而，许多操作任务允许多个不同目标或一组连续可接受的结果，这就需要保留这些备选方案的运动原语。如何在统一框架内同时容纳这两种目标结构，并保持连续、自主的动力系统，仍是一个开放性的挑战。我们提出了一种基于CONDOR的框架，称为multi-CONDOR，用于学习具有多个离散吸引子或连续吸引目标轮廓的运动原语。该方法将模仿学习与损失函数相结合，以促进所学任务动力学与编码期望吸引结构的潜在参考系统之间的一致性。我们提供了基于Lyapunov的分析，以验证所学运动动力学的收敛特性。我们在具有离散目标的模拟基准、具有连续目标轮廓的定性示例以及机器人抓取实验中对该框架进行了评估。在仿真中，与通过状态机选择的单独学习的单目标运动原语相比，multi-CONDOR将轨迹均方根误差降低了约72%。对于分别具有两个和三个目标的任务，它将评估初始状态中落在目标容差之外的比例从StableNODE的0.31%和7.29%均降至0%。使用Franka Emika机械臂的实验表明，利用从演示中学习的运动，可以通过容器的两个把手中的任意一个成功抓取容器。综上，这些结果表明multi-CONDOR将运动复现与收敛至替代有效结果的灵活性结合了起来。
tldr: This paper introduces multi-CONDOR, a dynamical-system-based framework that learns motion primitives with multiple discrete attractors or continuous goal contours for robotic manipulation, demonstrating improved task success and accuracy in simulation and on a real Franka robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出multi-CONDOR，一种基于动态系统的运动基元学习框架，支持多个离散吸引子或连续目标轮廓，用于机器人操作，在仿真和真实Franka机器人上展示了更高的任务成功率和精度。

title: FlowRow: Learning Navigation Behaviors in Agricultural Environments with Long-Horizon Goal-Conditioned Flow Matching Policies
summary: Autonomous monitoring and intervention in semi-structured agricultural environments, such as orchards and vineyards, require mobile robots to navigate to locations across diverse field configurations. This entails performing navigation behaviors including in-row driving, row turning and skipping, and inter-row traversal. Recent learning-based approaches have enabled robust in-row navigation from onboard perception, but navigation across rows typically requires a priori knowledge of field geometry to specify and tune row-transition maneuvers, preventing arbitrary transitions between rows. We address this challenge by framing navigation in these environments as a goal-directed navigation task, where a long-horizon goal is expressed relative to the robot and a planner generates local paths based on the goal and the robot's perceptual observations. We present FlowRow, a flow-matching-based local planner which models the distribution of diverse agricultural navigation behaviors as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ paths using the long-horizon goal and depth perception. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce RowNavBench, a navigation benchmark for semi-structured agricultural environments developed in Isaac Sim, comprising 900 episodes across grape vineyards, lemon orchards, and apple orchards with varying row lengths, row and plant spacings, plant positions, and weed growth. FlowRow achieves 87% success, compared to 44% for the strongest generative behavior cloning baseline retrained on the same demonstrations. We will release our benchmark, data, and code upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 自主监测与干预半结构化农业环境（如果园和葡萄园）要求移动机器人能够穿越多种田间布局并导航至目标位置。这涉及执行一系列导航行为，包括行内行驶、行末转向与跳行，以及跨行穿行。近年来基于学习的方法已使机器人能够凭借机载感知实现稳健的行内导航，但跨行导航通常需要预先获取田间几何信息，以指定和调整行间转换操作，从而限制了机器人任意切换行间的能力。为解决这一挑战，我们将此类环境中的导航问题重构为目标导向的导航任务：长时程目标以机器人自身为参照系进行表达，规划器则基于该目标及机器人感知观测生成局部路径。我们提出FlowRow，一种基于流匹配的局部规划器，利用长时程目标与深度感知信息，将多样化的农业导航行为分布建模为$\mathrm{SE}(2)$路径。为实现系统性评估，我们引入RowNavBench——一个基于Isaac Sim构建的半结构化农业环境导航基准，涵盖葡萄园、柠檬园和苹果园共900个测试场景，并变化行距、株距、植株位置及杂草生长条件。FlowRow在测试中达到87%的成功率，而基于相同示教数据重新训练的最强生成式行为克隆基线仅为44%。我们将在论文被接收后发布基准、数据及代码。
tldr: FlowRow introduces a flow-matching-based local planner for long-horizon goal-conditioned navigation in agricultural environments, achieving significantly higher success rates than baselines in a new benchmark (RowNavBench) with 900 episodes in Isaac Sim.
tldr_zh: FlowRow提出了一种基于流匹配的局部规划器，用于农业环境中的长时程目标条件导航，在一个包含900个场景的新基准（RowNavBench）中，成功率显著高于基线。

title: ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression
summary: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.
summary_zh: 自然、连贯的全脸动态表情对于使仿人机器人具有社交亲和力至关重要，然而现有系统通常仅能实现有限的唇部运动或脚本化表情。这一局限性既源于物理层面，也源于算法层面。紧凑的头部结构难以容纳密集布置、可独立控制的驱动单元；同时，基于学习的系统通常生成虚拟形象视频、关键点或面部参数，再通过视觉重定向推断驱动指令。这种“渲染-反演”路径引入了延迟和伪影，并且无法可靠地将生成的行为迁移至实体机器人。我们提出ROSE（共享运动嵌入的机器人面部表情框架），该框架整合了仿生硬件、跨实体运动表示学习以及多模态运动生成。在硬件方面，我们构建了灵活的腱鞘传动结构，将34个驱动器集成于19.5厘米的仿生头骨中。通过将驱动器布置与面部动作点解耦，该系统能够在紧凑体积内实现协调的全脸表情。在算法方面，ROSE-VAE从人类、数字人类和机器人观测中学习与身份无关的共享面部运动潜空间。ROSE-Flow直接将文本、音频或其组合映射至该运动空间中的轨迹，而无需以视频作为生成器输入。ROSE-ACT随后将这些轨迹转换为受约束的驱动器指令。我们的系统展示了高密度仿生硬件与可执行的共享面部运动表示如何共同统一跨实体学习、多模态生成以及实体机器人表情表达。
tldr: ROSE introduces a biomimetic humanoid head with 34 actuators and a shared facial-motion latent space, enabling multimodal (text/audio) expression generation and physical robot control without video retargeting.
tldr_zh: ROSE 提出了一个包含34个执行器的仿人机器人头部和共享面部运动潜在空间，支持多模态（文本/音频）表情生成和真机控制，无需视频重定向。

title: MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation
summary: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF.
summary_zh: 自主移动机器人在动态环境中识别物体运动属性时面临重大挑战。然而，现有方法受限于边界模糊、遮挡、视角约束及训练复杂度等问题。本文提出了一种创新的端到端多视图时空融合网络，命名为MVSTF，利用序列点云生成多视图图像及特征差异，并设计多分支网络并行提取时空特征与维度特征，实现高精度的运动物体分割。首先，利用序列点云生成多视图图像及特征差异；随后，设计包含双下采样模块（DDB）、空间注意力模块（SAB）、多核卷积神经网络模块（MKCNN）、双特征融合模块（DFFB）及点融合（PF）模块的端到端多分支网络，从特征差异中提取运动特征，并从多视图图像中提取几何特征与语义特征；最后，引入辅助语义头以进一步提升算法的鲁棒性与模型的可解释性。该方法在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-Road基准上进行了验证，在SemanticKITTI MOS验证集和KITTI-Road验证集上取得了最优结果，并在隐藏的SemanticKITTI-MOS测试集上取得了具有竞争力的结果。代码已开源，见https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF。
tldr: MVSTF is an end-to-end multi-view spatio-temporal fusion network for LiDAR-based moving object segmentation, using sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and achieving state-of-the-art results on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MVSTF是一种基于激光雷达的移动物体分割的端到端多视角时空融合网络，利用连续点云生成多视角图像和特征差异，在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-Road基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: STA: A Split Temporal Adversary Method for Evaluating Robustness of Multimodal RL-based Driving Policies
summary: Multimodal reinforcement learning (MRL) offers a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by jointly leveraging complementary sensor observations to learn effective decision-making policies. However, its effectiveness critically depends on temporal alignment across modalities, making temporal inconsistency a fundamental vulnerability. Even subtle misalignment or latency can corrupt fused representations and ultimately lead to decision failures. Existing studies have explored adversarial attacks to induce cross-modal temporal inconsistencies, thereby enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of MRL policies. However, existing methods remain limited in generality, realism, and adaptivity. To address these limitations, we propose the Split Temporal Adversary (STA), which formulates multimodal temporal attacks as a unified decision process that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection under realistic policy-aware and budget-constrained settings. STA includes two mechanisms: a) a unified multimodal temporal perturbation mechanism that delays observations via historical states, removing the need for modality-specific noise; b) a split multimodal adversarial decision mechanism that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection through adaptive optimization while leveraging the victim policy's clean actions to identify sensitive decision patterns. We provide a theoretical analysis of the induced distribution shift and a modality selection principle. Experiments in the CARLA simulator show that STA more than doubles the collision rate of the strongest baseline against PPO while using 17.8\% fewer attack attempts, and that it generalizes to a VLM-based driving policy. These results reveal temporal consistency as a critical vulnerability, highlighting temporal robustness as essential for safe autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 多模态强化学习（MRL）为自动驾驶提供了一种有前景的范式，通过联合利用互补的传感器观测来学习有效的决策策略。然而，其有效性在很大程度上依赖于跨模态的时间对齐，这使得时间不一致性成为一个根本性的脆弱点。即使是细微的错位或延迟也可能破坏融合表示，并最终导致决策失败。已有研究探索了对抗性攻击以诱发跨模态时间不一致性，从而能够系统评估MRL策略的时间鲁棒性。然而，现有方法在通用性、真实性和自适应性方面仍存在局限。为解决这些不足，我们提出了分裂时间对抗器（STA），将多模态时间攻击形式化为一个统一的决策过程，在基于策略感知和预算约束的现实设置下联合优化攻击时机与模态选择。STA包含两种机制：a) 一种统一的多模态时间扰动机制，通过历史状态延迟观测，无需针对特定模态的噪声；b) 一种分裂式多模态对抗决策机制，通过自适应优化联合优化攻击时机与模态选择，同时利用受害策略的清洁动作来识别敏感的决策模式。我们对由此引发的分布偏移提供了理论分析，并提出了一种模态选择原则。在CARLA模拟器中的实验表明，STA将最强基线针对PPO的碰撞率提升了一倍以上，同时攻击尝试次数减少了17.8%，并且该方法能够泛化至基于VLM的驾驶策略。这些结果揭示了时间一致性是一个关键脆弱点，凸显了时间鲁棒性对于安全自动驾驶的必要性。
tldr: The paper introduces STA, a unified adversarial attack framework that jointly optimizes timing and modality selection to induce temporal misalignment in multimodal RL driving policies, revealing temporal consistency as a critical safety vulnerability in driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出STA，一种统一对抗攻击框架，联合优化攻击时机和模态选择以诱导多模态RL驾驶策略的时序错位，揭示时序一致性是驾驶安全的关键薄弱点。

title: Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era
summary: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.
summary_zh: 机器人奖励模型（RRMs）利用基础模型，以可复用的、任务条件化的评估方式取代逐任务奖励工程。然而，在同一个名称之下，其输出所回答的问题各不相同——从任务是否成功到哪种执行更优。本综述依据模型原生输出所回答的问题，将114种方法划分为五个语义族：结果型、绝对进展型、相对型、时间价值型和混合型。在此分类框架下，我们审视了模型设计如何决定评估器能判断什么、原始经验如何转化为监督信号，以及现有评估实践如何检验其结果。综述揭示了一个空白：与演示顺序的一致性以及下游策略增益，并不能证明奖励是否追踪了任务完成状态。因此，我们引入了RRM-Bench-1K——包含1117段闭环执行的真实机器人视频，带有任务状态和相机证据标签——以及四组对比套件，用于将受信条件与其常见线索区分开来。一项针对27个评估器的统一研究表明，最强的最终得分能够足够好地对整体执行进行排序，以支持选择和筛选。然而，密集信用分配更多遵循执行的进展过程而非其任务状态，并且当决定性视角缺失时，没有任何评估器能发出信号。因此，奖励模型需要多高的保真度取决于其驱动的决策。我们概述了从真实失败监督到将任务状态与时间顺序分离的度量指标的若干方向，并开源了RRM-Hub工具库，其中14种现有RRM可即取即用，新评估器可在相同能力维度上进行测试。
tldr: This survey organizes 114 robotic reward model (RRM) methods into five semantic families based on their output question, introduces RRM-Bench-1K, a 1,117 real-robot video benchmark with four contrast suites, and presents a unified study of 27 evaluators revealing that dense credit tracks execution chronology rather than task state, alongside the open-source RRM-Hub toolbox.
tldr_zh: 本综述将114种机器人奖励模型方法按其输出问题划分为五个语义家族，提出了包含1,117个真实机器人视频的RRM-Bench-1K基准及四个对照套件，并对27个评估器进行了统一研究，发现密集信用跟踪执行时间顺序而非任务状态，同时开源了RRM-Hub工具箱。

title: SG-ODOM: Event-Driven Proprioceptive State Estimation with Stability-Gated Contact Updates for Legged Robots
summary: Reliable proprioceptive state estimation for legged robots fuses inertial sensing with kinematic sensing from leg encoders. The latter assumes a foot is stationary during the stance phase; however, physical foot touchdown does not necessarily provide a stationary reference for odometry, particularly during impact and load transfer. Repeatedly applying kinematic corrections throughout the same contact phase can introduce redundant or unreliable information. We present SG-ODOM, a proprioceptive odometry framework that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates. Following physical touchdown, a stability gate accepts the contact for state estimation only after the foot reaches a sufficiently stable support condition. The resulting validated touchdown event triggers an estimator correction, while additional timeout updates bound the maximum duration of uninterrupted IMU propagation. The framework is evaluated on multiple legged platforms, both quadrupedal and humanoid robots, against representative state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators. Across the evaluated sequences, SG-ODOM demonstrates competitive or superior estimation accuracy, reducing Relative Pose Error (RPE) by up to 25% compared to the baseline estimator on outdoor sequences from the GrandTour dataset. Source code: https://github.com/ori-drs/SG-ODOM. Video: https://youtu.be/-583_RyuhqQ
summary_zh: 摘要：可靠的腿式机器人本体感觉状态估计融合了惯性传感与腿部编码器的运动学传感。后者假设脚在支撑阶段保持静止；然而，物理上的脚掌触地并不一定能为里程计提供静止参考，尤其在冲击和载荷转移期间。在整个接触阶段反复应用运动学修正可能会引入冗余或不可靠的信息。我们提出了SG-ODOM，一种使用稳定性门控接触选择来调度运动学更新的本体感觉里程计框架。在物理触地之后，稳定性门仅在脚达到足够稳定的支撑条件时才接受该接触用于状态估计。由此产生的经过验证的触地事件触发估计器修正，而额外的超时更新则限制了IMU连续传播的最大持续时间。该框架在多个腿式平台（包括四足机器人和人形机器人）上进行了评估，并与具有代表性的最新本体感觉估计器进行了对比。在评估的序列中，SG-ODOM展现出具有竞争力或更优的估计精度，在GrandTour数据集的室外序列中，相较于基线估计器，相对位姿误差（RPE）最多降低了25%。源代码：https://github.com/ori-drs/SG-ODOM。视频：https://youtu.be/-583_RyuhqQ
tldr: SG-ODOM presents a proprioceptive odometry framework for legged robots that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates, improving state estimation accuracy by up to 25% RPE on outdoor sequences.
tldr_zh: SG-ODOM 提出了一种针对腿式机器人的本体感觉里程计框架，通过稳定性门控接触选择来安排运动学更新，在户外序列上将相对位姿误差最多降低 25%。

title: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.
summary_zh: 长视野视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误跨子任务传播之前予以纠正。然而，基于专家轨迹训练的執行器在部署过程中会遭遇策略诱导的状态偏移，且其停止信号无法可靠地指示子任务是否完成。我们提出了面向VLN的学习与验证进度方法（LeaP-VLN），这是一种智能体式VLN系统，通过“规划—执行—验证—恢复”循环，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合。LeaP-VLN在显式层面利用进度：通过进度验证器在智能体推进前验证子任务完成情况，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复机制；在隐式层面，通过联合训练执行器的进度推理与动作预测，增强其对进度的感知能力和纠错控制能力。为使执行器适应这一闭环接口，我们提出了一种两阶段进度增强课程：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，再在演示、专家动作修正和进度推理监督上联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器同时暴露于子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移，从而使训练与闭环执行中遇到的偏差保持一致。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，LeaP-VLN取得了最优的成功率；同时，真实世界实验进一步验证了LeaP-VLN在长视野导航中的有效性。
tldr: LeaP-VLN introduces a closed-loop agentic system for long-horizon vision-language navigation that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: LeaP-VLN 提出了一种用于长时程视觉语言导航的闭环智能体系统，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了最先进的成功率。

title: Stability Principle Inherent in Wheel Gait of Planar X-shaped Walker Generated Using Constant Torque Drive and Mechanical Stoppers
summary: Since the late 19th century when the first walking toys were developed, it has been known that mechanical stoppers at the hip joint are crucial for generating stable passive dynamic walking. Recent research on passive-dynamic and limit-cycle walkers has also confirmed that mechanical stoppers at the hip and knee joints are effective for generating stable walking motion, but theoretical research on how this mechanical constraint enhances the overall gait stability remains insufficient. This paper introduces a planar X-shaped walker equipped with mechanical stoppers at the hip joint, and investigates the effect of the mechanical constraint on the stability of the wheel gait generated by constant torque drive on a downslope. By simply falling forward while using the stoppers to constrain itself to the target impact posture, the robot can generate a highly stable wheel gait. We divide the motion of one step into four phases, derive approximate analytical solutions for the state error transition function matrix in each phase using a linearized model, and analyze the increase or decrease in the state error norm using metrics such as its maximum singular value. Numerical simulations demonstrate that while two phases are unstable in terms of the increase in the state error norm, the remaining two phases are stable, resulting in overall asymptotic stability.
summary_zh: 自19世纪末首批步行玩具问世以来，人们便已知髋关节处的机械限位装置对于产生稳定的被动动态行走至关重要。近期关于被动动态行走器及极限环行走器的研究也证实，髋关节和膝关节处的机械限位装置能有效产生稳定的行走运动，然而关于这种机械约束如何增强整体步态稳定性的理论研究仍显不足。本文介绍了一种平面X形行走器，其髋关节处装有机械限位装置，并研究了该机械约束对在斜坡上由恒定力矩驱动所产生的轮式步态稳定性的影响。通过仅向前倾倒并利用限位装置将自身约束至目标撞击姿态，该机器人能够产生高度稳定的轮式步态。我们将一步运动划分为四个阶段，利用线性化模型推导各阶段状态误差转移函数矩阵的近似解析解，并通过最大奇异值等指标分析状态误差范数的增减情况。数值仿真表明，尽管其中两个阶段在状态误差范数增长方面是不稳定的，但其余两个阶段是稳定的，从而整体上实现了渐近稳定性。
tldr: This paper analyzes the stability of a planar X-shaped walker with hip mechanical stoppers under constant torque drive, deriving approximate analytical error transition functions and demonstrating overall asymptotic stability through numerical simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了一种带有髋部机械限位器的平面X形步行器在恒定扭矩驱动下的稳定性，推导了近似解析误差传递函数，并通过数值模拟证明了整体的渐近稳定性。

title: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
summary_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解析自然语言指令，并在非结构化环境中导航至用户指定的目标。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与经典的建图和导航机器人流水线相结合仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。本研究提出了一套完整的基于ROS2的系统，该系统结合了基于前沿的探索、使用Grounding DINO的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的3D定位以及语义建图，从而在仿真环境中实现端到端的视觉-语言接地导航。该系统能够接受诸如“前往黄色箱子”之类的自然语言指令，利用文本提示从RGB图像中检测候选目标，估计其世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由Nav2导航栈执行的导航目标。在基于Gazebo的室内环境中使用TurtleBot3机器人，该系统自主探索了房间，检测到了五个目标物体中的三个，并成功执行了所测试的两条自然语言导航指令，且无需针对特定任务进行训练。结果表明，开放词汇接地模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，尽管性能受到检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差以及探索覆盖不完整的限制。这些发现既凸显了在轻量级、仅CPU架构上部署视觉-语言接地导航系统的可行性，也指出了其当前的局限性。
tldr: The paper presents a ROS2-based system integrating open-vocabulary object detection (Grounding DINO) with frontier-based exploration and Nav2 navigation to enable natural language grounded navigation for a mobile robot in Gazebo simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个基于ROS2的系统，结合开放词汇目标检测（Grounding DINO）、前沿探索和Nav2导航，在Gazebo仿真中实现移动机器人的自然语言接地导航。

title: XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute
summary: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. It learns with a horizon of one second and without a critic. On four H100 GPUs, XMimic learns to track all 40 LAFAN1 clips with the Unitree G1 in 0.86 minutes, 3.7 times faster than BlinkMimic on one GPU. XSoma reaches the tracking target that Holosoma's tests set for FastSAC in 0.77 minutes, 12.3 times faster than FastSAC on one GPU, while needing only an eighth of its environment steps.
summary_zh: 我们提出了XMimic和XSoma，二者能够在不到一分钟的训练时间内学会人形运动跟踪及复杂地形上的行走。两者均遵循SuperMimic的方法，即学习机器人的世界模型，并通过在该模型中进行的短滚动预测，利用解析梯度对策略进行优化。该方法的现有实现未能充分利用更大规模的GPU，因为每次训练迭代都是由一系列串行执行的小型GPU操作组成的长链。为此，XMimic和XSoma缩短了这一链条，并最多在四块GPU上同时执行每次迭代的步骤。我们使用JAX编译了完整的训练循环，包括MuJoCo Warp模拟器。在行走任务中，XSoma仅将机器人的动力学部分交给世界模型处理，而其余所有计算均精确完成，包括脚下地形高度。它以一秒的预测时域进行学习，且无需评论员网络。在四块H100 GPU上，XMimic在0.86分钟内学会了Unitree G1跟踪全部40个LAFAN1片段，比在单块GPU上的BlinkMimic快3.7倍。XSoma在0.77分钟内达到了Holosoma测试为FastSAC设定的跟踪目标，比单块GPU上的FastSAC快12.3倍，同时仅需其八分之一的环境交互步数。
tldr: This paper introduces XMimic and XSoma, which accelerate humanoid motion tracking and locomotion learning by parallelizing training across multiple GPUs and using a world model, achieving training times under a minute.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了XMimic和XSoma，通过多GPU并行训练和使用世界模型，实现不到一分钟的人形机器人运动跟踪和 locomotion 学习。

title: High-Speed Forward and Reverse Tractor-Trailer Driving with Learned Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Tractor-trailer systems are difficult to control, especially unstable during reverse motion, and their dynamics depend on difficult-to-measure factors, including road friction and suspension coefficients. We introduce a learned dynamics model for tractor-trailer control and compare it with a reduced-order dynamics model with Fiala tire forces as an analytic baseline. Specifically, we compare a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller that uses the learned dynamics model to an MPPI controller that uses the analytic model, as well as to three additional baseline controllers. In the main closed-loop tracking experiments across four simulated environments, MPPI with learned dynamics achieves mean speeds closer to the target magnitudes and lower root-mean-square (RMS) hitch angles than MPPI with the analytic model at every tested setpoint, with higher completion rates in seven of eight reverse configurations.
summary_zh: 拖拉机-拖车系统控制难度大，尤其在倒车运动中稳定性差，且其动力学特性依赖于难以测量的因素，如道路摩擦系数和悬架系数。我们引入了一种用于拖拉机-拖车控制的学习动力学模型，并将其与基于Fiala轮胎力的降阶动力学模型作为解析基线进行比较。具体而言，我们将使用学习动力学模型的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器与使用解析模型的MPPI控制器，以及另外三种基线控制器进行了对比。在四个模拟环境中的主要闭环跟踪实验中，使用学习动力学模型的MPPI在每个测试设定点均实现了更接近目标速度的平均速度，并且相比使用解析模型的MPPI，具有更低的均方根（RMS）挂接角；在八种倒车构型中，有七种的完成率更高。
tldr: This paper introduces a learned vehicle dynamics model for high-speed forward and reverse tractor-trailer control, integrated with an MPPI controller, and demonstrates superior tracking performance over an analytic Fiala tire model baseline in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于高速前进和倒车的牵引车-挂车控制的学习型车辆动力学模型，并将其与MPPI控制器集成，在仿真中展示了优于基于Fiala轮胎解析模型的基线控制器的跟踪性能。

title: RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning
summary: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了RoboKit，一个面向机器人学中并行可微分优化的高性能通用工具包，其构建基于三项原则：（i）性能与灵活性：GPU并行的多种子求解器将采样与多功能优化器相结合，在七项任务上比任务特定基线快2-60倍；（ii）几何、渲染与物理：混合及由粗到细的表示方法加速了碰撞检测、可微分渲染与仿真，在2.97秒内优化4096个抓取动作；（iii）与学习的集成：成本函数可微分且仿真并行，因此RoboKit既能将优化结果蒸馏为策略，也能训练强化学习模型；蒸馏后的策略在相当精度下运行速度快9-240倍，而强化学习在同一仿真器上达到GPU基线分数所需时间最多缩短2.1倍。
tldr: RoboKit is a high-performance GPU-parallel differentiable optimization toolkit for robotics, enabling fast multi-seed solvers, differentiable geometry/rendering/simulation, and seamless integration with learning to distill policies or train RL agents, with demonstrated speedups across seven tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboKit 是一个用于机器人的高性能 GPU 并行可微优化工具包，支持快速多种子求解器、可微几何/渲染/仿真，并可无缝集成学习（策略蒸馏和强化学习），在七项任务中展示加速效果。

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
summary: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.
summary_zh: 持久的空间理解对于具身智能体在反复遇到的環境中可靠运行至关重要。这要求智能体能够在视角变化的情况下识别重新到访的地点，将其与外观相似的房间区分开来，并在环境变化时更新记忆。然而，现有的评估往往将跨多次访问的物理地点身份视为隐含前提。我们提出了ReSpaceBench基准，包含涵盖590个合成及真实家庭场景的3,244个问题，组织为9项任务，涵盖房间关联、持久状态跟踪和下游推理。受控漫游通过物理房间进入来定义访问，并有意加入同类型房间干扰项以及跨会话物体变化。我们对32个模型和3个智能体视频理解框架的评估揭示了显著的局限性：表现最强的零样本模型总体准确率为50.5%，在450个问题的子集上为52.2%，而人类标注者达到90.1%。所评估的智能体框架相较于使用相同基础模型的直接推理并未带来总体提升。对智能体执行轨迹的分析揭示了证据遗漏和错误的跨访问房间关联是主要的失败模式，表明仅靠迭代式证据搜寻并不能确保一致的空间记忆。进一步的分析暴露了识别熟悉房间与确定正确到访房间之间的差距，而标注引导的采样则强调了保留中间访问和过渡的重要性。我们还提供了RS-30K，这是一个独立的训练数据集，来源于合成数据，与基准测试在模板、场景、路线或视频上均无重叠。对Qwen3-VL-8B进行微调后，总体准确率从35.5%提升至60.4%，其中关联任务提升最为显著，且改进延伸到了真实生活场景。
tldr: ReSpaceBench is a benchmark for evaluating persistent spatial memory in embodied agents across revisits, showing that current video understanding models and agentic frameworks struggle with room association and memory updating, while fine-tuning on a synthetic dataset improves accuracy.
tldr_zh: ReSpaceBench 是一个用于评估具身智能体在重复访问中持久空间记忆的基准，结果显示当前视频理解模型和智能体框架在房间关联和记忆更新方面存在困难，而微调可提升准确率。

title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.
summary_zh: 前馈式4D驾驶场景重建能够高效建模动态自动驾驶场景，但现有方法存在两种互补的失败模式：交通参与者语义泄漏至静态表示，以及高斯位置跨视角的几何漂移。为此，我们提出\textbf{IGRecon4D}，一种前馈式动态场景重建框架，通过训练阶段的实例先验蒸馏和基于LiDAR锚定的高斯定位来克服上述问题。具体而言，实例级语义分支提供潜在的动态参与者先验，并通过实例-动态一致性约束蒸馏至动态掩膜学习中，以促进对易发生动态-静态泄漏的交通参与者区域的高召回率定位。与此同时，稀疏LiDAR测量指导密集深度估计，所得深度被反投影以锚定高斯位置，从而提升多视角几何一致性。在Waymo开放数据集上的实验以及在nuScenes上的零样本评估表明，本方法在主基准上实现了更优的全图像重建，并在跨数据集评估中展现了更强的交通参与者区域重建能力。
tldr: IGRecon4D is a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework for dynamic driving scenes that uses instance-prior distillation to prevent semantic leakage of traffic participants and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning to reduce geometric drift across viewpoints, improving reconstruction on Waymo and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: IGRecon4D 是一种用于动态驾驶场景的前馈4D重建框架，通过实例先验蒸馏防止交通参与者的语义泄漏，并利用LiDAR锚定的高斯定位减少跨视角几何漂移，在Waymo和nuScenes上提升了重建效果。

title: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
summary: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的手部运动为灵巧操作和视觉-语言-动作预训练提供了物理运动监督。要可靠地利用这一监督，需要在度量世界空间中进行精确且时间连贯的四维手部重建。现有方法通常将在弱透视下产生的逐帧估计提升至世界坐标。通过忽略近距离下与关节相关的深度变化，这一近似将平移、方向和关节运动的误差耦合在一起，这些误差在世界坐标提升后仍然存在，并在遮挡情况下进一步恶化。我们提出了MetricHand，一种用于度量世界空间中四维手部重建的几何感知流匹配框架。MetricHand将来自手-物交互区域的深度先验编码为与关节相关的表示，从而保留局部空间结构和度量尺度。与视觉特征融合后，该几何信息引导粗略度量估计，并调节时间生成的每一步。该模型联合恢复世界空间平移、全局方向、MANO关节运动和形状，同时结构先验和时间上下文支持部分遮挡下的估计。与HaWoR相比，MetricHand在相机空间MPJPE上分别降低了49.3%和52.9%，在绝对世界空间MPJPE上分别降低了28.7%和21.7%，手腕定位误差分别降低了48.5%和37.9%。世界空间加速度误差分别降低了44.2%和64.3%，表明在更准确的绝对定位基础上，时间保真度也得到了改善。
tldr: MetricHand is a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space, specifically designed to provide accurate and temporally coherent egocentric hand motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and VLA pretraining. It incorporates depth priors from hand-object interactions into joint-associated representations, improving world-space localization and temporal fidelity.
tldr_zh: MetricHand 是一个几何感知的流匹配框架，用于在度量世界空间中进行 4D 手部重建，专为灵巧操作和 VLA 预训练提供准确且时间连贯的自我中心手部运动监督而设计。它利用手-物交互区域的深度先验，增强了世界空间定位和时间保真度。

title: UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection
summary: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.
summary_zh: 本报告总结了团队arnav007（提交ID 1054222）在IEEE BigData Cup 2026城市双生Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（V2X-Real赛道）中的工作。主要目标是仅使用合成路侧激光雷达数据训练用于车辆、行人和卡车的3D检测器，并生成与真实数据难以区分的逼真合成扫描数据。我们开发了一套基于CARLA的流程，并将其校准至固定传感器站点，基于未标注的真实开发扫描数据，精确建模距离图像，包括无返回光束的情况。此外，我们提出了一种组合推理检测器，使用多个仅基于合成数据训练的3D检测器（VoxelNeXt、PV-RCNN和SECOND）。每个扫描均与合成地面平面对齐，并在多个地面高度下通过检测器进行处理。最终生成的边界框通过鸟瞰图聚类进行融合，随后进行类别特定的后处理以优化航向角、框尺寸，并过滤低置信度检测结果。最终提交的综合得分为0.8947。消融研究表明，逐扫描地面水平化使真实扫描的平均精度提升了一倍以上，而跨不同高度和模型融合边界框进一步提升了性能。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline for training 3D detectors using only synthetic CARLA LiDAR data calibrated to a real roadside sensor site, and proposes a multi-detector fusion approach that achieves high performance on the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅使用针对真实路边传感器站点校准的CARLA合成LiDAR数据训练3D检测器的流程，并提出了多检测器融合方法，在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛中取得了高性能。

title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize
summary_zh: 自动驾驶的摄像头录制内容中包含人脸和车牌，在标注、共享或训练之前应对其进行匿名化处理。专用检测器可能漏检小型车牌以及车辆玻璃后的人脸。我们提出了FM-Anonymize，一种无需训练的匿名化流程，结合了可提示分割、3D人体网格恢复和生成式替换。SAM 3定位人员、人脸和车辆，并在放大的车辆裁剪图中搜索车牌、乘员和车窗。SAM 3D Body根据头部朝向评估人脸可见性，并投射头部区域进行模糊处理。可选的扩散模型修复以合成人脸替换符合条件且已模糊的头部，并由估计的姿态和关键点引导。在PP4AV数据集上，模糊流程保护了97.8%的人脸和95.5%的车牌，在默认设置下，其隐私召回率在所有对比方法中最高。在我们自己的录制数据（设定定位阈值的数据）上，它保护了97.1%的人脸和93.4%的车牌，而UrbanAnonymizer为93.7%/73.0%，EgoBlur为42.7%/40.7%，deface保护了96.6%的人脸。在我们的录制数据上，合成替换将全身关键点的平均精度从模糊处理的54.1%提升至79.6%，在PP4AV上则从39.9%提升至68.3%。代码和配置见https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize。
tldr: This paper introduces FM-Anonymize, a training-free pipeline that combines promptable segmentation (SAM) and 3D human mesh recovery to anonymize faces and license plates in driving data, achieving high privacy recall and improving downstream keypoint detection through optional generative face inpainting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FM-Anonymize，一种无需训练的匿名化流水线，结合可提示分割和3D人体网格恢复，用于自动驾驶数据中的人脸和车牌匿名化，实现了高隐私召回率，并通过生成式人脸修复提升下游关键点检测性能。

title: Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation
summary: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. Furthermore, a fuzzy critic based on a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy inference system is proposed to alleviate value extrapolation errors during the transition between imitation-guided learning and autonomous exploration, thereby improving continual training stability.
