Experimental results on sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method effectively unifies continual learning capability and policy explainability within a single reinforcement learning framework, achieving stable knowledge retention and meaningful behavioral explanation.
summary_zh: 持续机器人导航要求强化学习策略在保留已有知识的同时，不断适应新环境。与此同时，可解释强化学习旨在通过策略交互学习具有意义的行为表征。然而，这两个目标本质上存在冲突，因为持续学习强调策略稳定性，而可解释行为学习则要求自适应探索。现有方法很少同时兼顾两者。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种模糊可解释持续分层强化学习方法（FECHRL）。引入两阶段行为克隆策略，通过从强模仿引导逐步过渡到自主强化学习，平衡策略快速适应与可解释行为演化之间的关系。此外，提出了一种基于Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理系统的模糊评论家网络，以缓解模仿引导学习与自主探索过渡期间的价值外推误差，从而提升持续训练的稳定性。在连续多场景导航任务上的实验结果表明，所提方法能够在统一的强化学习框架内有效统一持续学习能力与策略可解释性，实现稳定的知识保持和有意义的行为解释。
tldr: This paper introduces a fuzzy explainable continual hierarchical reinforcement learning method that balances policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution for robotic navigation, addressing the conflict between continual learning and explainability in sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模糊可解释的持续分层强化学习方法，用于机器人导航，在顺序多场景导航任务中平衡策略适应性与可解释的行为演化，解决了持续学习与可解释性之间的冲突。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.
summary_zh: 事件相机能够在传统相机模糊或饱和的场景中持续捕捉结构信息，这使其在快速运动或光照不足场景下的三维感知中具有吸引力。然而，带有稠密三维真值的事件数据集在规模和多样性上远不及用于前馈三维重建模型的图像数据集。我们提出Déjà-Events，一种仅使用事件数据的模型，能够在单次前向传播中从多视角预测深度、相机位姿和点图。我们不依赖稀缺的三维标注，而是从Déjà View中蒸馏该模型——Déjà View是一种前馈RGB模型，通过重复应用一个共享Transformer块来优化其令牌。在成对的RGB和事件记录上，事件学生模型学习复现冻结教师模型的最终令牌，这一过程不需要深度或位姿真值，且仅训练约1%的参数。由于事件在边缘和运动纹理处密集，而在无纹理区域几乎缺失，我们进一步引入了稀疏感知自适应门控，该机制将共享块的门控适配到事件数据，并根据事件密度对每个补丁进行调整，从而在增加细化步骤时保持精度。仅使用模拟数据训练的Déjà-Events，在我们评估的基于事件的方法中，在EventScape数据集上取得了最低的点图误差，并在真实的MVSEC和DSEC数据集上实现了零样本泛化。在DSEC上，它将其误差减半于最强基线（0.15对比0.30 AbsRel），同时参数量仅为后者的十分之一左右。此外，它在EventScape和DSEC上取得了最低的深度误差，在EventScape上取得了最低的轨迹误差。
tldr: Déjà-Events distills a feed-forward RGB multi-view 3D reconstruction model (Déjà View) into an event-only student that predicts depth, pose, and pointmaps from multiple event camera views, introducing sparsity-aware adaptive gating to handle event sparsity and achieve state-of-the-art results on EventScape, MVSEC, and DSEC.
tldr_zh: Déjà-Events 将前馈 RGB 多视图 3D 重建模型（Déjà View）蒸馏为仅使用事件相机的学生模型，通过稀疏感知自适应门控处理事件稀疏性，在 EventScape、MVSEC 和 DSEC 上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Inverse Kinematics in Endoscopic Scenarios using MoveIt
summary: Inverse kinematics are critical in many robotic applications, yet standard MoveIt-based solvers struggle in confined scenarios. This paper provides a benchmark of the available solvers and compares multiple practical modifications for improving the performance of the solvers. Splitting the IK problem into two parts results in the best performance, leading to a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.
summary_zh: 逆运动学在许多机器人应用中至关重要，然而基于MoveIt的标准求解器在受限场景中表现不佳。本文对现有求解器进行了基准测试，并比较了多种提升求解器性能的实用改进方法。将逆运动学问题分解为两部分能获得最佳性能，在内镜水箱场景下，100毫秒内成功率可达100%。
tldr: This paper benchmarks inverse kinematics solvers in confined endoscopic scenarios and proposes splitting the IK problem into two parts, achieving a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.
tldr_zh: 本文在受限内窥镜场景下对标定了多种逆运动学求解器，并提出将IK问题分解为两部分的方法，在腔内水箱场景中实现了100%的成功率且耗时低于100毫秒。

title: TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation
summary: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.
summary_zh: 机器人的动作会改变其下一次交互的热条件：释放后残留的热量、随物体携带的热量或储存在表面下的热量，即便当前温度相似，也可能改变后续接触的结果。训练轨迹必须捕捉这些效应如何将早期动作与后续观测及任务结果联系起来。我们提出TRR，一种\emph{热机器人渲染器}（Thermal Robot Renderer），它将空间分辨率和深度分辨率的热状态同时附着于两个接触对象，通过接触、搬运和分离更新局部热交换，并在同一执行时钟上生成同步的RGB-热（RGBT）观测和事件局部任务检查。受控干预实验展示了残留热量、空间搬运和内部存储为何对后续接触结果至关重要。从相同状态出发，TRR生成一个配对的六任务基准，包含2,224对静态-动态样本，即4,448条轨迹，并附带同步的双视角观测、状态和动作。可见的热历史将专用学习语料上的安全接触点选择率从75.0\%提升至91.7\%；在共享反馈执行的新加热程序下，基于动态历史的训练将模拟转移完成率提高了50个百分点。我们在MuJoCo和Isaac Sim上展示了RGBT观测适配器，报告了包含十个预配置机器人配置和六个演示相机视角的工程清单，并描述了一个将现有机器人场景转换为导出RGBT记录的开发者工作流程。第6节所述的基准、工作流程和平台资源构成了计划中公开发布的首批内容。演示和资源更新可在项目页面上获取。
tldr: TRR introduces a Thermal Robot Renderer that generates synchronized RGB-thermal data for robot simulation by modeling heat retention, transport, and exchange, enabling a six-task benchmark and showing that thermal history improves contact-site selection and transfer completion in robotic control.
tldr_zh: TRR 提出了一种热机器人渲染器，通过模拟热量保留、传输和交换，为机器人仿真生成同步的 RGB-热数据，并构建了六个任务的基准，证明热历史能提高接触点选择和任务完成率。

title: Non-Imaging Optical Tactile Sensors for Robotics: Transduction Principles, System Integration, and Robotic Applications
summary: Non-imaging optical tactile sensors encode contact through changes in optical intensity, wavelength, spectra, or photon counts, offering diverse architectures for robotic touch. Their usefulness depends on whether contact variables can be reliably distinguished from coupled mechanical and environmental effects, and whether the resulting information can be delivered in time to guide action. This review develops a unified framework linking mechanical load transmission, optical encoding, readout, and tactile inference to robotic task requirements. It examines reflective and waveguide-based devices, micro/nanofibers, fiber gratings, interferometric and resonant structures, and mechanoluminescent composites. Three considerations emerge across these approaches. First, high optical sensitivity supports accurate tactile estimation only when target variables remain identifiable under the relevant contact and calibration conditions. Second, spatial coverage and feedback timing must be assessed at the system level, accounting for multiplexing, acquisition, demodulation, and inference. Third, device characterization, offline recognition, and closed-loop robotic performance provide distinct levels of evidence and require different evaluation criteria. Representative studies illustrate how these considerations shape force estimation, contact localization, slip correction and distributed interaction. This review concludes with priorities for calibration transfer, reliable interfaces, scalable readout, and task-based validation, providing a basis for selecting and developing non-imaging optical tactile architectures for robotics.
summary_zh: 非成像光学触觉传感器通过光强度、波长、光谱或光子计数的变化来编码接触信息，为机器人触觉提供了多种架构选择。其效用取决于接触变量能否与耦合的机械及环境效应可靠区分，以及所获取的信息能否及时传递以指导动作执行。本综述建立了一个统一框架，将机械载荷传递、光学编码、信号读取及触觉推断与机器人任务需求相衔接。研究涵盖了反射式及波导式器件、微纳光纤、光纤光栅、干涉与谐振结构，以及力致发光复合材料。在这些技术路径中，有三个关键考量因素浮现出来。第一，高光学灵敏度仅在相关接触与标定条件下目标变量保持可辨识时，才能支撑精确的触觉估计。第二，空间覆盖范围与反馈时序需在系统层面进行综合评估，须考虑多路复用、采集、解调及推断各环节。第三，器件表征、离线识别与闭环机器人性能分别提供不同层次的证据，需要采用不同的评价标准。代表性研究说明了这些考量因素如何影响力估计、接触定位、滑移校正及分布式交互。本综述最后提出了标定迁移、可靠接口、可扩展读取及基于任务的验证方面的优先事项，为机器人领域非成像光学触觉架构的选择与开发提供了基础。
tldr: This review provides a unified framework for non-imaging optical tactile sensors, analyzing transduction principles, system integration, and robotic applications with emphasis on calibration, readout, and task-based validation.
tldr_zh: 本综述为非成像光学触觉传感器提供了统一框架，分析了传感原理、系统集成和机器人应用，并强调校准、读出和基于任务的验证。

title: Design of the Secure Smart Scooter with Automatic Lane Detection
summary: The authors present a prototype of an electric scooter that uses computer vision to determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. Scooters steer on sidewalks, bike paths, or car lanes. The government imposes speed limits on the lanes in which electric scooters drive. Featuring computer vision, electric scooters can determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. However, such systems' safety is still a concern, and research into such vehicle systems' safety and security aspects is proceeding. First, we will present our vehicular setup. Then, we will present our implemented scooter with safety constraints. Finally, we present our security prototype for such an electric scooter.
summary_zh: 作者展示了一款电动滑板车的原型，该滑板车利用计算机视觉来确定行驶车道，并自动调整车辆配置。电动滑板车在人行道、自行车道或机动车道上行驶。政府对这些电动滑板车行驶的车道设有速度限制。借助计算机视觉，电动滑板车能够识别行驶车道并自动调整车辆配置。然而，此类系统的安全性仍令人担忧，针对这类车辆系统安全与安保方面的研究正在进行中。首先，我们将介绍我们的车辆配置。接着，我们将展示我们实现的带有安全约束的滑板车。最后，我们将介绍为此类电动滑板车设计的安全防护原型。
tldr: The paper presents a smart electric scooter prototype that uses computer vision for automatic lane detection and configuration adjustment, focusing on safety and security constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种智能电动滑板车原型，利用计算机视觉自动检测车道并调整配置，重点关注安全性和安全性约束。

title: JEPTERA: A Platform Agnostic JEPA-Assisted Model Predictive Planner for Urban UAV Navigation
summary: Urban navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) requires planning that accounts for environmental geometry, vehicle dynamics, and moving obstacles. This paper presents JEPTERA, a navigation architecture that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Model Predictive Control (MPC), PID control, and a safety layer. JEPA predicts the UAV's motion response to candidate commands for MPC action selection, while the safety layer checks trajectories against occupied space and predicted obstacle motion. Simulator adapters and platform-specific YAML configurations separate the planning core from simulator interfaces. An ablation study evaluated six configurations across three gym scenarios, totaling 180 runs. The complete architecture achieved the highest aggregate success rate, completing 28 of 30 runs. Additional tests completed one route across three city maps without collisions. Separate integration tests demonstrated operation in Gazebo/ROS 2, MuJoCo, and CARLA without modifying the core planning logic. These results support the feasibility of the integrated architecture for simulated urban UAV navigation and its portability across simulator interfaces.
summary_zh: 摘要：无人机（UAV）的城市导航需要综合考虑环境几何、飞行器动力学及动态障碍物的规划方案。本文提出了一种名为JEPTERA的导航架构，该架构融合了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）、模型预测控制（MPC）、PID控制及安全层。JEPA用于预测无人机对候选指令的机动响应，以辅助MPC进行动作选择，而安全层则根据占用空间及预测的障碍物运动对轨迹进行校验。模拟器适配器及平台特定的YAML配置将规划核心与模拟器接口相分离。消融研究在三个健身房场景中评估了六种配置，总计运行180次。完整架构取得了最高的总体成功率，30次运行中完成28次。额外测试在三个城市地图中完成了一条路线且无碰撞。单独的集成测试表明，在不修改核心规划逻辑的情况下，该架构可运行于Gazebo/ROS 2、MuJoCo及CARLA环境。这些结果支持了集成架构在模拟城市无人机导航中的可行性及其在不同模拟器接口间的可移植性。
tldr: JEPTERA integrates a JEPA-based predictor with MPC, PID, and a safety layer for urban UAV navigation, demonstrating portability across Gazebo, MuJoCo, and CARLA simulators via an ablation study.
tldr_zh: JEPTERA 将基于 JEPA 的预测器与 MPC、PID 和安全层集成，用于城市无人机导航，并通过消融研究展示了其在 Gazebo、MuJoCo 和 CARLA 模拟器之间的可移植性。

title: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
summary: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
summary_zh: 摘要：LiDAR位置识别为同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）提供回环检测。从Z轴视角看，重力对齐的扫描是场景的正射投影图，从不同位置和航向再次访问时，该图在平面内发生刚性移动，这种运动被极坐标傅里叶频谱忽略，却能被相位相关恢复。在垂直方向上，回波高度描述结构特征，但观测到哪些高度取决于距离，因为传感器的垂直视场会截断近处结构的低部；因此高度信息在全局关键词中具有误导性，但一旦两个扫描对齐并在重叠区域逐单元比较时，高度信息则具有决定性作用。我们提出\method方法，这是一种基于单一原理的无训练方法：两个LiDAR扫描只能通过从两个扫描中相同的几何表面计算出的特征进行比较。\method通过鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移和旋转不变极坐标频谱检索候选，每个关键帧仅占1.9KB，并通过相位相关估计平面位姿来验证每个候选，使用\emph{点锚定高度列}进行评分：每个BEV单元保留其自身回波高度的16位掩码；在同一会话内，得分根据两个扫描传感范围的重叠程度进行加权，该重叠程度由其距离计算得出。我们证明这种垂直关联在验证中效果显著，但在检索中却有害，因为高度切片所包含的内容取决于到结构的距离。对于单机器人，\method在KITTI开发序列上无需3D配准的无训练方法中具有最高的AP；跨机器人场景下，在所有多机器人序列中，它以1/350的描述符大小达到或超过RING++的性能，并在所有测试中比学习的BEVPlace++闭合更多的机器人间回环。
tldr: OrthoMark is a training-free LiDAR place recognition method that uses a polar spectrum of bird's-eye views for candidate retrieval and point-anchored height columns for verification, achieving high accuracy on KITTI and multi-robot sequences with a compact descriptor.
tldr_zh: OrthoMark 是一种无需训练的 LiDAR 位置识别方法，利用鸟瞰图的极坐标频谱进行候选检索，并使用点锚定高度列进行验证，在 KITTI 和多机器人序列上以紧凑描述符实现了高精度。

title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的三维占用预测为自动驾驶和具身感知提供了场景的密集语义表示，但仍然容易受到遮挡、深度模糊和投影误差的影响，这些因素会导致体素特征在空间上具有可变可靠性。现有方法通常将体素表示直接映射为语义预测，而没有显式建模这种由观测引起的特征变化。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了VoxSAOR，一种通过特征空间代理来建模偶然不确定性的语义感知占用鲁棒化框架。该框架首先量化局部语义一致性（LSC），以推导逐体素的结构稳定性先验，并利用跨视图语义一致性过滤不可靠的语义对应关系。在每个语义类别内，空间匹配的稳定体素与模糊体素形成稳定到模糊的特征迁移，并通过类条件对角高斯分布进行建模，从而捕获特征位移和离散程度。在这些代理分布的引导下，偶然机制集成学习（AREL）使用逐步增大尺度的特征扰动训练独立参数化的预测头，扰动强度由结构可靠性调制。在推理阶段，代理建模和采样被禁用，所有预测头处理相同的观测特征；随后将其输出概率进行平均，以产生确定性共识预测，无需采样。在多个数据集和占用骨干网络上的实验证明了VoxSAOR在提升语义占用预测、长尾识别和预测校准方面的有效性。源代码将在https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR公开提供。
tldr: VoxSAOR enhances vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by modeling aleatoric uncertainty via feature-space proxies and ensemble learning, improving accuracy, long-tail recognition, and calibration.
tldr_zh: VoxSAOR 通过特征空间代理建模偶然不确定性和集成学习，增强了用于自动驾驶的基于视觉的 3D 语义占用预测，提高了准确性、长尾识别和校准。

title: Making Koopman Control Guarantees Hold on Robots
summary: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. The learned model propagates predictions in latent space, while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes the measured physical state. We show that nominal closed-loop stability transfers to the nonlinear plant when the learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target. We derive a robustness margin for approximate matching and show that a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. We introduce Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching to this estimate. TIK recovers the fitted LQR gain at the target, while a bilinear predictor captures state-dependent actuation during large maneuvers. Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Standard Koopman controllers have stable latent closed loops, but their deployed nonlinear systems are locally unstable. In contrast, all 40 TIK controllers locally stabilize their respective nonlinear plants. An offline stability test using empirical curvature estimates identifies stable TIK controllers on two cart-pole systems, but is inconclusive under high noise. Under explicit model-error and curvature bounds, an invariant terminal set guarantees constraint satisfaction after entry under local feedback. TIK achieves 88\% constrained cart-pole swing-up success with a 0.25 ms planning budget and controls simulated seven-joint arms within 1-5 ms per step.
summary_zh: 一种Koopman控制器能够稳定其学习得到的潜在线性模型，却可能无法稳定非线性被控对象。学习到的模型在潜空间中进行预测传播，而部署的控制器则反复对测量的物理状态进行重新编码。我们证明，当学习到的闭环动力学与真实闭环动力学在目标点处嵌入切空间上达到一阶一致时，标称闭环稳定性可传递至非线性被控对象。我们推导了近似匹配的鲁棒裕度，并表明稳定的开环潜模型无法精确匹配不稳定的平衡点。我们提出了切变不变的Koopman（TIK）方法，该方法从离线转换中估计局部被控对象线性化，并对该估计强制实施一阶匹配。TIK在目标点处恢复拟合的LQR增益，同时双线性预测器捕捉大机动过程中与状态相关的执行作用。在四个模拟的不稳定基准测试中，所有40个标准Koopman控制器均具有稳定的潜闭环，但其所部署的非线性系统在局部是不稳定的。相比之下，所有40个TIK控制器均能局部稳定各自对应的非线性被控对象。一种利用经验曲率估计的离线稳定性测试，能够在两个车摆系统上识别出稳定的TIK控制器，但在高噪声下该测试结果不确定。在显式的模型误差和曲率界限下，不变终端集保证了进入后局部反馈下的约束满足性。TIK在0.25毫秒的规划预算下实现了88%的约束车摆摆动上升成功率，并以每步1-5毫秒的速度控制模拟的七关节机械臂。
tldr: This paper introduces Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), a method that enforces first-order matching between the learned latent linear dynamics and the true nonlinear plant to ensure that Koopman-based controllers stabilize real robots, demonstrating success on simulated unstable benchmarks and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了切不变Koopman（TIK）方法，通过强制学习到的潜在线性动态与真实非线性系统的一阶匹配，确保基于Koopman的控制器在实际机器人上稳定，并在模拟不稳定基准和操作任务中验证了有效性。

title: Course-Referenced Lateral Control of Trail-Following Convoys: String Stability and Adaptive Feedforward under Load Uncertainty
summary: Vehicles in a convoy can steer along the GNSS trails of the vehicles ahead when lane markings are unavailable, as on snow covered roads. Since each vehicle's tracking error enters the reference of the next, lateral errors can grow along the convoy. This paper presents a course referenced formulation of trail following in arc length, in which each follower takes the direction of its fitted trail as its heading reference. Error propagation then reduces to a single transfer function. We derive a condition under which combining the trails of the leader and the predecessor keeps the errors bounded for any convoy length, and show that following the predecessor alone lets the errors accumulate without bound, even without amplification, on roads that end turned or shifted sideways. Passenger and cargo loads and tire stiffness vary in practice, and we show that they enter the curvature feedforward through a single coefficient, whose mismatch leaves steady offsets on curves. We propose an adaptive law that estimates this coefficient on curves and removes the offsets. Simulations of an eleven vehicle convoy confirm the analysis.
summary_zh: 车辆在队列中行驶时，若车道标线不可用（如积雪覆盖的道路），可沿前方车辆的GNSS轨迹进行转向引导。由于每辆车的跟踪误差会进入下一辆车的参考轨迹，横向误差可能沿队列累积增长。本文提出了一种基于弧长的曲线参考轨迹跟踪方法，其中每辆跟随车辆将其拟合轨迹的方向作为航向参考。由此，误差传播简化为单一传递函数。我们推导出一个条件，在该条件下，结合领航车与前车的轨迹可确保任意长度的队列误差有界，并证明仅跟随前车轨迹时，即使不存在放大效应，在道路末端转弯或侧向偏移的路况下，误差仍会无界累积。实际中，乘客与货物载荷以及轮胎刚度会发生变化，我们证明这些因素通过单一系数进入曲率前馈项，该系数的不匹配会导致弯道上的稳态偏差。我们提出一种自适应律，用于在弯道上估计该系数并消除偏差。对十一辆车队列的仿真验证了上述分析。
tldr: This paper presents a course-referenced lateral control method for convoy trail-following, analyzing string stability and proposing an adaptive feedforward algorithm to handle load uncertainty, verified in simulations of an 11-vehicle convoy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于航向参考的队列轨迹跟随横向控制方法，分析了串稳定性，并提出了一种自适应前馈算法来处理载荷不确定性，通过11辆车队列的仿真验证了分析。

title: Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflict. Once three robots interact, the safe set of pairwise barriers contains states from which a collision is unavoidable, and such states persist in larger teams under any fixed capability reduction. In a simulated warehouse where humans ignore the robots, a filter written for the design classes violates safety in 89-100 % of the episodes with unseen classes. In all scenarios, including one with 32 robots, OntoCBF violates safety in 20-70 % of the episodes, each time after a conflict, with a median deepest intrusion of 10-17 % of the keep-out distance. A multi-agent PPO policy trained with the filter in the loop lowers the rate of infeasible quadratic programs, nearly all of them conflicts, by 18-41 %.
summary_zh: 异构机器人团队的安全过滤器因缺少约束、高估制动能力以及各可满足约束之间的冲突而失效。我们提出OntoCBF，它将领域本体（包含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理及各机器人类的动力学配置）编译为控制障碍函数过滤器，每个智能体对应一个二次规划问题。描述逻辑蕴含关系在线提供任意团队的约束，包括由关系链及依据机器人所载物定义的类所推导出的约束，因此现有安全公理可覆盖新的机器人类、载荷类及其组合。我们证明，当子类能够产生父类的所有速度时，其可复用父类的制动能力，该性质独立于包含关系。对于箱式有界双积分器，该性质亦为必要条件，且任何安全性丧失均始于冲突。当三个机器人交互时，成对障碍物的安全集合包含无法避免碰撞的状态，且在任意固定能力缩减下，此类状态在更大规模的团队中持续存在。在模拟仓库中，人类无视机器人，为设计类别编写的过滤器在含未见类别的测试中于89-100%的回合内违反安全性。在所有场景中（包括含32个机器人的场景），OntoCBF在20-70%的回合中违反安全性，每次均在冲突之后，中位最大侵入深度为隔离距离的10-17%。在过滤器参与闭环训练的多智能体PPO策略，将不可行二次规划（几乎均为冲突）的发生率降低了18-41%。
tldr: This paper introduces OntoCBF, a method that compiles domain ontologies into control barrier functions for heterogeneous robot teams, dynamically generating safety constraints and addressing conflicts to improve safety in multi-robot systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了OntoCBF，一种将领域本体编译为异构机器人团队的控制屏障函数的方法，动态生成安全约束并解决冲突，以提高多机器人系统的安全性。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的轨道导航系统几乎完全依赖合成图像进行训练，因为现实中很少存在带有标注的在轨航天器图像。SPEED+等基准正是针对这一情况而构建：训练集来自仿真器，测试集则是在两种光照条件下拍摄的卫星模型真实图像。该仿真器近似模拟了光线在聚酯薄膜和铝材表面的反射，但与其他科学仿真器一样，其模型存在设定偏差。其误差属于辐射度量层面，因为它未能捕捉真实图像中常见的镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和现象。我们以一个刻意简化的单目姿态估计器为工具，深入探究由此产生的合成到真实域的迁移差距——这是此类系统的核心风险。在一项关于主干网络适配与光度增强的2×2研究中，模型在合成图像上训练，并在两个真实硬件在环域上测试，我们发现三点结论。(1) 模型并未意识到自身失效：在合成数据上经过保形校准达到90%置信度的区域，在日光灯域仅覆盖旋转误差的9-15%，在灯箱域仅覆盖21-38%，这意味着错误的姿态携带了与正确姿态相当的置信度。(2) 迁移具有不对称性：扩大数据量和特征规模使合成域旋转误差从1.65弧度降至1.03弧度，但对光照严苛的日光灯域仅改善0.05弧度，不足其种子标准差的二倍；而适配主干网络的最后一个阶段，则将其额外的合成域增益的63-83%传递到了两个真实域。(3) 一旦主干网络完成适配，数据增强仅在其所建模的方向上发挥作用：我们的光度增强策略在每次种子运行中均将漫光照明的灯箱域误差从1.17弧度降至0.99弧度，但对日光灯域的影响不超过种子间差异；而当主干网络冻结时，该增强策略对日光灯域的帮助反而更大。所有评审后的实验均已预先注册，代码、逐图像预测结果及预注册记录见 https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation。
tldr: This paper analyzes the sim-to-real gap in vision-based spacecraft pose estimation under simulator misspecification, showing that conformal calibration on synthetic data overestimates confidence on real domains and that backbone adaptation transfers better than augmentation or data scaling.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了模拟器规格错误下基于视觉的航天器姿态估计的仿真到真实差距，表明合成数据上的保形校准高估了现实领域的置信度，并且骨干适应比增强或数据缩放更为有效。

title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
summary: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.
summary_zh: 随着视频生成模型准确描绘科学现象的能力日益受到关注，判断这些模型是否真正理解背后的原理仍是一项关键挑战。现有基准通常孤立地评估视频样本，难以暴露仅拟合表面视觉先验的模型。在科学实验中，即使其余设置保持不变，某一条件的微小变化也会导致显著不同的结果。利用这一敏感性，我们提出了SciWorldBench，一个包含成对科学实验的基准。每对实验在固定设置中仅改变一个条件，产生两个互斥的预期结果。每个生成提示指定条件但不包含预期结果。我们使用一个独立的视觉-语言模型（VLM）评估十种文本到视频（TI2V）模型，该模型在无法获取条件文本或用于标识正确结果的标签的情况下对每个视频进行评分。仅当两个视频均描绘各自科学上正确的结果时，该对才被判为正确。在全部十种模型中，我们发现实验对中的两个视频即便在条件要求不同结果的情况下，也经常描绘出相同结果。这种反复出现的失败表明，当前视频世界模型在生成过程中难以可靠地应用底层科学原理。我们将公开发布该基准数据集，并开源评估代码。
tldr: SciWorldBench introduces a paired-experiment benchmark to evaluate whether video world models truly understand scientific principles, revealing that current TI2V models often fail to produce distinct outcomes when a single condition changes.
tldr_zh: SciWorldBench 提出了一个成对实验基准，用于评估视频世界模型是否真正理解科学原理，结果发现当前的 TI2V 模型在单一条件改变时通常无法生成不同的结果。

title: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
summary: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.
summary_zh: 连续且准确地估计人类手部运动学，不仅对于直观的人机交互至关重要，而且对于捕捉精细的人类操作演示也具有重要意义，这些演示可为具身智能数据集和灵巧机器人学习提供动作监督。然而，在变化的操作条件下，单一感知模态可能不足以实现可靠的估计。我们提出了一种无需佩戴手指设备的多模态框架，用于从第一人称视角RGB图像和128通道前臂高密度表面肌电信号（HD-sEMG）中连续回归20个手部关节角度。该框架结合了基于Vision Transformer的视觉编码器、基于Transformer的肌电编码器，以及一个自由度（DoF）查询Transformer融合解码器。为了适应视觉和肌电线索在不同关节自由度及输入条件下信息量的变化，解码器为每个自由度分配一个独立可学习的查询，从而实现两个模态在特定自由度上的上下文自适应融合。该框架在来自10名参与者的同步多模态数据上进行了评估。在参与者间取平均，所提出的融合模型实现了平均决定系数（\(R^2\)）为0.88，平均绝对误差（MAE）为2.80°，相比之下，仅视觉模型为0.82和3.21°，仅肌电模型为0.68和5.13°。该模型还优于所评估的代表性单模态基线和备选融合设计。按自由度逐项分析显示，对于视觉上模糊的关节和观察条件，融合增益更大，而合成视觉遮挡情况下的估计鲁棒性也优于仅视觉估计。这些结果突显了第一人称视角视觉与前臂HD-sEMG在捕捉精细手部运动学方面的互补价值，并有望应用于人类示范采集与灵巧机器人学习。
tldr: Presents a multimodal framework that fuses egocentric RGB and forearm HD-sEMG via a DoF-query transformer for continuous hand kinematics regression, demonstrating improved accuracy over unimodal baselines and potential for dexterous robot learning from human demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种利用自由度查询变换器融合自我中心视觉和前臂高密度肌电信号的多模态框架，用于连续手部运动学回归，在精度上优于单模态基线，并有望用于灵巧机器人学习的人类演示采集。

title: Hybrid Optimization-Generative Motion Planning for Multiagent Affine Formations
summary: Formation maneuver control enables a multiagent system to cooperatively navigate through constrained environments in collective motion. While various formation controllers exist, they rely heavily on high-quality and dynamically feasible reference trajectories provided a priori, making formation motion planning (FMP) essential. To address the computational challenges for high-dimensional joint trajectories faced by conventional constrained optimization-based solutions, this paper introduces a hybrid optimization-generative framework with a focus on affine formations, which provide the necessary spatial flexibility. By formulating the planning task as a constrained Maximum-a-Posteriori estimation, we decouple multiagent objectives to leverage pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors for dynamic feasibility, obstacle avoidance, and smoothness. We then interleave the generative process with projected gradient descent (PGD) to strictly enforce affine geometric constraints with safety guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that our framework generates highly smooth, collision-free plans that are readily trackable by common distributed controllers and outperforms state-of-the-art planners in various metrics.
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid optimization-generative framework for multiagent affine formation motion planning, using pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors interleaved with projected gradient descent to enforce formation constraints and generate smooth, collision-free trajectories.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合优化-生成框架，用于多智能体仿射编队运动规划，利用预训练的单智能体扩散先验与投影梯度下降交替执行，以强制编队约束并生成平滑、无碰撞的轨迹。

title: Transferable Neural CBFs via Generalized Closure
summary: Classical control barrier functions (CBFs) provide safety constraints for controllers, but designing them by hand is difficult for underactuated vehicles and the resulting safe sets can be overly conservative. Neural CBFs can learn more informative barriers from data, yet a learned barrier is usually verified only for one fixed obstacle configuration. We study whether one neural barrier can be reused across environments by expressing the state relative to each obstacle. The key gap is that these relative coordinates may discard information needed to predict their own evolution. We give a generalized closure condition that represents this missing information as a residual and a lifting theorem that transfers a verified relative-coordinate barrier to every obstacle in a family. A rank test also identifies when symmetry alone cannot justify the transfer. We validate the conditions on a double integrator, a planar aircraft, and a 12-state quadrotor. Coordinates that fail the test lead to obstacle penetration or to a barrier condition that fails near hover, whereas body-frame coordinates close exactly for the quadrotor. The resulting barrier transfers to new maps without retraining and is effective in the reported deployment and fast-start experiments.
tldr: This paper proposes a generalized closure condition and lifting theorem that allow a single neural control barrier function (CBF) verified in relative coordinates to be transferred to arbitrary obstacle configurations for underactuated vehicles, validated on simulations of a double integrator, planar aircraft, and 12-state quadrotor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种广义闭包条件和提升定理，使得在相对坐标中验证的单个神经控制屏障函数能够迁移到任意障碍物配置，并在双积分器、平面飞行器和12状态四旋翼的仿真中进行了验证。

title: Selective Sensor Acquisition for Multimodal Place Recognition
summary: Multimodal Place Recognition (PR) can improve robustness, but most systems rigidly read and process every sensor for every query, even when the primary sensor is sufficient, with implications for energy consumption, second sensor update rate, and domain-specific considerations such as passive stealth. We introduce selective, controllable sensor acquisition, where a user specifies a desired second sensor usage rate and the system acquires the additional sensor only when the primary sensor's estimated performance is sufficiently poor. An online threshold adjustment achieves the requested usage rate by adapting to recent primary sensor performance, directing additional sensing towards queries where fusion is most likely to help without calibration specific to sensor modality, PR method, or environment. The approach requires only a PR method that produces a match score and applies to both single-frame and sequence-based PR. Our system, across multiple datasets, PR descriptors, and sensor combinations, recovers 55% of the available PR performance gain while using the second sensor on only 25% of queries, and 81% while using it on 50%. We further analyse alternative acquisition decision mechanisms and usage-rate control methods, and examine performance when the second sensor is stronger than, comparable to, or weaker than the primary sensor.
tldr: This paper introduces selective sensor acquisition for multimodal place recognition, where a user-specified second sensor usage rate is maintained by only acquiring the additional sensor when the primary sensor's performance is estimated to be poor, recovering a large fraction of the fusion gain with significantly reduced sensor usage.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多模态地点识别的选择性传感器采集方法，通过仅在主要传感器性能估计不佳时获取辅助传感器，并在线调整阈值以用户指定的使用频率，在仅使用25%或50%查询的辅助传感器时，恢复了55%或81%的融合性能提升。

title: Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation
summary: Self-driving laboratories must learn to control a process from tens to hundreds of expensive experiments, too few for deep reinforcement learning (RL). We learn the Q-function directly with a Gaussian process (GP), which avoids learning the dynamics, and show that the GP posterior supplies the learning rate of Q-learning. If each Bellman target is treated as a noisy measurement of the Q-function, the learning rate that minimises the mean squared error is the Kalman gain, and applying it to every observed transition is equivalent to GP regression. Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ) sets the noise variance of each target with a heteroscedastic GP, which learns how unreliable the targets are across the states and inputs. Targets from noisy operating conditions, or from regions where the value function has large gradients, then move the estimate less than targets from low-noise regions, so HGPQ learns quickly where the data are reliable without being misled where they are not. For kernel value iteration with per-target variances that are assigned when a target is collected, we prove a high-probability bound on the error of the value estimate, uniform over the explored region. Pooled over five simulated benchmarks, which include a chemical reactor and a bioprocess, HGPQ approaches the best return found by any method in fewer episodes than GP, kernel and deep RL baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ), a sample-efficient RL method for self-driving laboratories that uses a GP to directly model the Q-function and per-target noise variances for robust and fast learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ），一种用于自驱动实验室的样本高效强化学习方法，通过GP直接建模Q函数，并利用每个目标的不确定性实现快速鲁棒学习。

title: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
summary: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.
tldr: Polygraph presents an online, map-free multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline using pose graphs, local clustering, learned image retrieval, and two-tier consensus gating, evaluated on various robotic and wearable platforms.
tldr_zh: Polygraph 提出了一种在线、无地图的多会话轨迹优化流程，利用位姿图、局部聚类、学习式图像检索和两层共识门控，并在多种机器人和可穿戴平台上进行了评估。

title: AVD: A Multi-Sensor Teleoperated Wheelchair Platform with Safety-Aware Control
summary: Electric wheelchairs predominantly rely on manual joystick interfaces, which present critical barriers to independent mobility for individuals with severe motor and visual impairments. This paper presents AVD (Autonomous Vehicle Drive), a dependable teleoperation architecture for assistive mobility that unifies perception, communication, embedded control, and remote supervision in a single low-cost platform built entirely from commercially available hardware. The central engineering contribution is a safety-oriented design framework: control authority follows a static hierarchy, a manual emergency stop and the occupant's joystick pre-empt remote commands, and the on-board sensing layer has stop-only authority. The compute design partitions primary and safety functions and specifies a heartbeat-driven safe-state transition for the fault cases considered. The sensing stack this framework depends on is characterized against measured data: per-channel acquisition latency, a 2,025-scan LiDAR degradation campaign spanning five target configurations and a control under water mist, airborne dust, and direct aperture occlusion, and attitude measurements across static inclines to 47 degrees. The lowest pooled environmental-condition mean retained 76.6% of the clear-baseline forward-sector yield, and no scan lost the sector completely. A logged vibration-induced inertial dropout occurred while LiDAR and camera logging continued, illustrating complementary channel behavior. The result is a documented prototype and an explicit validation path for a deployable wheelchair implementation.
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost, teleoperated wheelchair platform that unifies perception, communication, and safety-aware control with a static control hierarchy and hardware-based fault-safe states, validated with extensive sensor degradation analysis under various environmental conditions.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种低成本、远程操作的轮椅平台，通过静态控制层级和基于硬件的故障安全状态统一感知、通信和安全控制，并在多种环境条件下验证了传感器退化。

title: sqrtVINS-Based 360 Visual-Inertial SLAM Systems: Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 Entry
summary: This report describes our submission to the 2026 Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge. The system is a 360-camera visual-inertial pipeline that uses only the provided dual-fisheye image streams and IMU measurements. First, raw images are preprocessed with low-light enhancement and static/dynamic masking, and then fed into a $\sqrt{\text{VINS}}$ frontend as the local odometry, with deep learning-based SuperPoint features, ELSED line segments, and LightGlue matching. The resulting trajectory is refined using a GTSAM-based backend that performs tightly-coupled factor graph optimization with SALAD global descriptor and visual bundle adjustment (BA). The backend performs local-to-global structureless BA, tightly regularized intrinsic and extrinsic refinement, and global scale adjustment supported by the known inter-camera baseline and cross-view constraints. The design targets long indoor sequences with dark regions, repetitive corridors, dynamic objects, and limited geometric parallax, while keeping the pipeline reproducible in the provided ROS2 workspace. Fig. 1 demonstrates that our proposed method aligns well with the floorplan across several indoor sequences.
tldr: This paper presents a 360 visual-inertial SLAM system for the Hilti-Trimble Challenge, using dual-fisheye cameras and IMU with deep learning features and factor graph optimization to achieve robust localization in indoor environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了用于Hilti-Trimble挑战赛的360度视觉惯性SLAM系统，利用双鱼眼相机和IMU，结合深度学习特征与因子图优化，在室内环境中实现鲁棒定位。

title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
summary: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.
tldr: This paper introduces MomentPnP, a learning-free method for camera pose estimation from unlabeled 2D-3D point correspondences by matching permutation-invariant image moments, significantly outperforming learned baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 MomentPnP，一种无需学习的方法，通过匹配置换不变的图像矩来从无对应关系的2D-3D点集中估计相机位姿，显著优于学习基线。

title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
summary: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.
tldr: This paper theoretically studies transformers for in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction of parametric ODEs, constructing a transformer that performs approximate maximum likelihood via coarse search followed by gradient descent, with nonasymptotic guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文从理论上研究了变换器对参数化常微分方程进行上下文参数估计和轨迹预测的能力，构造了一个通过粗搜索后梯度下降实现近似最大似然估计的变换器，并给出了非渐近保证。

title: Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response
summary: Forecasting models that read the price and promotion plan explain each forecast as a baseline, what would sell with nothing planned, plus the lift the plan adds, and merchants order stock and plan promotions on that lift. We show that an explanation can pass the checks used to trust it and still be wrong enough to cost money. We define eight checks for any forecaster that states a plan lift, six with a pass rule fixed before any result, and run them on a world model and on LightGBM. In generated store data with known effects, the world model passes the checks of construction, stability, price direction and agreement with sales and with LightGBM, yet when merchants plan into high-demand weeks it states 1.33 to 1.40 times the true lift, and 1.23 to 1.42 times in eight variants of that world; LightGBM overstates it too (1.26, and 1.16 to 1.35). Both still pick the right weeks to promote, but stock ordered to the world model's lift is off by 0.44 to 0.48 of the true lift. The world model's stated response to a lasting regular-price change is 4.7 to 6.5 times the true -0.5, an error in kind that only a measured cause finds. Sanity checks for explanations test whether an explanation depends on the model; a decision needs to know whether it is right about the world, and these results show the first does not give the second. For the final tuned world models of our companion paper on nine data sets, baseline and lift add up under each model's own plan on every window, but a deeper price cut lowers the forecast in 29% to 83% of item-week steps on Dominick's. Across 703 configurations from the settings searches, checks passed were not related to accuracy (Spearman 0.02, 95% interval -0.02 to 0.05). A noisy benchmark of price episodes in Dominick's data is reported as a check of direction only.
tldr: This paper audits explanation faithfulness of world models in retail forecasting, showing that passing sanity checks does not guarantee economic accuracy of stated lift, and proposes eight checks to evaluate such models.
tldr_zh: 本文审计了零售预测中世界模型的解释忠实度，表明通过健全性检查并不能保证所陈述的提升量具有经济准确性，并提出了八项检查来评估此类模型。

title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
summary: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.
tldr: This paper investigates the use of uncertainty estimation via ensembles for deep learning quality control models trained on synthetic data, finding that performance drops in sim-to-real transfer are driven by systematic bias rather than ensemble disagreement.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了在合成数据上训练的深度学习质量控制模型中，基于集成的预测不确定性是否能够反映sim-to-real域差距，发现性能下降主要由系统性偏差而非集成分歧导致。

title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
summary: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at https://github.com/mz24cn/agents.
tldr: This paper presents Linglong Agent Service, a runtime for centralized agent reasoning and distributed execution that separates inference orchestration from execution sites, with an online debugger for process-scale execution-site separation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了灵龙代理服务，一种用于集中式代理推理和分布式执行的运行时，将推理编排与执行站点分离，并提供了在线调试器用于进程级执行站点分离。

title: A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution
summary: Galactic Chemical Evolution (GCE) models connect stellar nucleosynthesis to observed abundance patterns, but their interpretation requires simultaneous parameter inference and comparison between competing stellar yield prescriptions. This remains challenging due to intractable likelihoods and growing dataset complexity. Using compass, a novel simulation-based inference framework, we perform, for the first time, amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for GCE models with intractable likelihoods within a unified architecture. Compass employs a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture to learn both the posterior and likelihood directly from forward simulations, enabling efficient inference and likelihood-based ranking of competing nucleosynthetic yield sets. In controlled tests, compass identifies the generating yield set and recovers ground-truth parameters with accuracy comparable to existing simulation-based inference (SBI) methods, while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude. Applied to Milky Way data, the framework favors a hybrid NuGrid + IllustrisTNG yield prescription, confirmed by an independent classifier, and infers an initial mass function slope of $α_{\rm IMF} = -2.65 \pm 0.02$ and a SN$_{\rm Ia}$ normalization of $\log(N_{\rm Ia}) = -2.81 \pm 0.02$, with a systematic spread of $\approx 0.3$ in $α_{\rm IMF}$ between the best-ranked yield sets, consistent with independent constraints. The attention mechanism confirms that the inferred parameters are driven by physically meaningful abundance signatures. By unifying amortized parameter inference, Bayesian model comparison, and interpretability in a single probabilistic framework, compass provides a scalable approach for precision chemical evolution studies with current and forthcoming spectroscopic surveys.

title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection
summary: Malware detection needs scores calibrated at a fixed false positive rate (FPR) and decisions an analyst can read: feature-based detectors give the first, large language models (LLMs) on decompiled code the second, through generated text of uncalibrated confidence. System One decision models answer a typed question about a text with a probability over its declared answers in one forward pass. We present the first evaluation of these models for Windows Portable Executable malware detection, analyze how they decide, and propose S1Mal, an ensemble on the typed answers and the embedding of CLM-8B. In an isolated virtual machine, Ghidra and capa decompose each binary, and the host renders the records into a canonical textual state, a digest of headers, imports, MITRE ATT&CK capabilities and strings, optionally with decompiled functions, without class shortcuts. Three readouts score each model on the state: A0, the probability of one verdict question; A1, 32 atomic behavioral questions weighed by gradient-boosted trees; A2, heads on the model's state embedding. S1Mal feeds gradient-boosted trees with the atomic answers and the A2 score of CLM-8B. We evaluate CLM-8B, ten open decision models and two LLMs read through logits on BODMAS temporal splits, SOREL-20M out-of-distribution malware and 14,534 matched benign files. On BODMAS, A0 wastes the static evidence: its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) spans 0.4025-0.8590 across 13 models. A1 recovers it, raising every model's AUROC by +54.61% on average; A2 lifts CLM-8B by +0.2749 to 0.9943, above a combiner on digest facts (0.9901), and reaches 0.9853-0.9948 on nine open models. S1Mal reaches 0.9946 and detects 93.47% of the malware at a realized FPR of 1.45%, and 59.15% at 0.1% FPR on the test ROC curve, against 46.59% with A2. S1Mal gives analysts calibrated decisions, each with the atomic answers behind it.

title: A Gaussian Primitive Data Management Framework for Efficient 3DGS Trajectory Rendering
summary: Trajectory rendering, which renders novel views of a reconstructed 3D scene along a camera path, is a core operation in digital twins and autonomous inspection. Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders a single view in real time by decoding sparse anchors into Gaussians on demand, but it renders a trajectory view by view: every view projects all anchors to select them, re-decodes anchors already requested by neighboring views, and runs all steps on the GPU while the CPU idles. We treat this as a spatial data management problem, where anchors are spatial objects, views are range queries, and decoded Gaussians are shared derived data, and propose GDM-GS, which removes redundancy at three levels. Within a view, an anchor index and an occluder index answer each view as a holed-frustum range query, so out-of-view and provably hidden anchors are never decoded. Across views, shared materialization decodes each requested anchor once per group of consecutive views while preserving each view's selection. Across processors, a hybrid pipeline balances selections between the CPU and the GPU before grouped decoding under bounded memory. Experiments on large-scale public scenes show that GDM-GS substantially reduces trajectory rendering latency while preserving image quality.

title: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
summary: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.

title: A Matrix with Steps: An Episodic and Procedural Memory Method for Tool-Using Agents and Robots
summary: Agents that call tools and robots that execute tasks are challenged by two shortcomings: they repeat what failed before, and they learn from runs that they only believe succeeded. We describe the construction of a memory that addresses both, built for a production agent platform. Every run is recorded as an episode, and only an outcome confirmed by an external check, a test, a tool result or a person counts; the agent's own claim never does. What is learned from episodes is kept in a memory with two parts: an associative matrix, written with the delta rule, which finds the procedure that applies to a situation; and a section of ordered, addressable step records that answers what comes after a given step, where a step is a goal of the agent, not a motion. Because the matrix sums its associations, it keeps no order and cannot return or delete a single one; it serves as the finder, and order, outcome counts and deletion live in the records. We describe how execution outcomes are stored, how episodes are recalled and used for solving tasks, and the file format that stores the memory. In simulation, a robot that judged its own success and stopped when it believed it was done reported $96\%$ of its tasks as done and solved $35\%$; with external verification it solved $79%$. In a store of $100000$ synthetic episodes ($457$MB on disk), the oldest episode was still found first, no episode from another person's memory was returned, and a success vouched for only by the model was never recalled; a lookup took $16$ms on a laptop and $40$ms on a server node (median). Task outcomes were measured up to about $10000$ confirmed records, where the exact records solved every revisit at the first attempt.

title: A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
summary: In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total. Rather than searching for a single best-fit theory, our method is designed to discover a diverse set of high-quality theory hypotheses. We test the method in a complex phenomenological environment comprising 132 observables across several sectors of particle physics, including 24 measurements that deviate from their SM predictions by more than $1.5σ$. We show that the learned RL policy efficiently constructs multi-operator theories that substantially improve the global fit. Comparisons with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches demonstrate the ability of the RL policy to navigate this large combinatorial space. Our results establish RL as a systematic framework for exploring diverse patterns of new physics (NP) interactions within SMEFT.

title: A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
summary: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.

title: A Seismic Foundation Model for Dense Feature Extraction
summary: Deep-learning-based seismic interpretation is constrained by scarce high-quality annotations, and most existing models are trained separately for individual tasks. We present SeisDFE, a 7B-parameter seismic foundation model for dense feature extraction, pretrained on 5.34 million 2D images derived from more than 500 seismic volumes. A three-stage pretraining strategy, combining discriminative self-supervised learning, Gram feature anchoring, and multi-resolution adaptation, improves feature discriminability while preserving spatial coherence. With its encoder frozen, SeisDFE supports seismic facies classification, salt detection, fault detection, and relative geologic time estimation. It outperforms existing seismic foundation models on all four tasks and a natural-image-pretrained model on all but fault detection, with the largest gains under scarce supervision: using only two annotated sections of the F3 dataset, it improves whole-volume mIoU by 12-19 percentage points over the baselines. The learned features remain effective with task-specific decoders and extend to synthetic-to-field transfer and sparse 3D geobody interpretation. These results show that large-scale seismic pretraining organizes geological information into dense representations that are directly reusable across interpretation tasks.

title: A Structural Framework for Succession: Continuation, Recognition, and Realization
summary: Succession asks whether an entity encountered later is the same entity that entered an arrangement earlier. For an artificial system that is fine-tuned, distilled, or copied, it has to be answered. We look for a mathematical structure weak enough to cover any such case and strong enough to support general theorems, so that results follow from the structure's conditions rather than from a particular pipeline or criterion. Succession is modeled on state/modification graphs with relational lifts that compose along paths. Within this framework we separate four questions that are often conflated: which continuations a representation admits, which descendants are compatible with a modification, which are recognized as continuing the identity, and which are realized. The framework allows one to address systematically questions of symmetry, computational complexity, recoverability, and robustness to partial realization, and we establish what the structure settles in each case before any particular criterion of identity is chosen.

title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
summary: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.

title: A Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-Head Attention Model: A Surrogate for Parallel DEVS Semiconductor Fab Simulation
summary: Semiconductor factories process many kinds of wafers organized into lots of various sizes and configurations. Different kinds of machines, each with its own operations, process wafers for hours to days, and the wafers undergo many incremental fabrication steps (with re-entry) and flows spanning days to weeks across connected machines. Fast and accurate predictions of throughput ($TH$) and turnaround time ($TA$) dynamics for individual machines and their combinations are essential for factory operations. To use machine learning methods for this purpose, this paper presents a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) architecture. It uses simulated datasets from a benchmark Parallel DEVS (PDEVS) semiconductor fabrication factory model. The factory processes configurable wafer lots with uniform and sinusoidal wafer arrival profiles and may undergo preventive maintenance. The wafer lot size, arrival profile, and factory maintenance policy are used as static covariates. TCNA is applied to a selected set of simulated discrete-event throughput and turnaround time trajectories. The $TH$ and $TA$ time series predicted by TCNA, evaluated with the common $MAPE$, $MSE$, and $R^2$ measures, show comparable or higher accuracy relative to other model architectures, with similar parameter counts and epoch times; the TCNA model size and execution time are similar to those of other architectures such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer. Although time series predictions are less accurate than high-resolution simulations, they can be deployed at a much lower computational cost. The TCNA achieves orders-of-magnitude speedup over PDEVS simulation with an acceptable loss of accuracy, enabling frequent product scheduling, capacity planning, and maintenance planning.

title: A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling
summary: Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. In autoregressive rollout, these errors evolved modestly to about 0.21 m and 0.09 m/s after 110 iterations, while greatly improving computational efficiency by more than 50 times.

title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
summary: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.

title: AFRNet: Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for Image Deraining
summary: Image deraining aims to recover rain-free images from rain-degraded observations. Recent frequency-aware deraining methods have demonstrated promising performance by removing rain artifacts in the spectral domain. However, since rain artifacts and background textures often appear in several correlated subbands, prior frequency-domain deraining models still enhance frequency subbands separately. Such band-wise processing limits information exchange across subbands. Without context from other subbands, rain and clean content that appear together in one subband cannot be separated. This leads to either residual rain streaks or over-smoothing of fine details. To address this limitation, we propose AFRNet, an Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for image deraining. First, we introduce an Adaptive Frequency Recombination Module (AFRM) that performs cross-band modulation among wavelet subbands, enabling information interaction and adaptive recombination of degraded frequency components. We then develop a Subband Compensation Block (SCB) that compensates for decoder subband degradation by leveraging encoder subband features through inter-subband attention in the wavelet domain, alleviating detail loss during reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFRNet achieves competitive performance and consistent results across diverse deraining benchmarks.

title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.
