In this work, we introduce PriDex, a framework that transforms human-video Priors into executable robot Dexterous manipulation demonstrations through reinforcement learning in simulation. PriDex preserves task-relevant interaction structure while allowing embodiment-specific behavior to be regenerated for the robot. Human-object interactions provide affordance cues for selecting task-relevant, robot-specific grasps from geometry-based candidates. For motion refinement, object trajectories provide a task-level reference, while relative bimanual wrist trajectories offer complementary guidance for coordinated motion. Since object-motion estimates can become unreliable under occlusion or visual ambiguity, PriDex uses object-motion confidence to adaptively balance these two priors, emphasizing object-level guidance when confidence is high and increasing the contribution of wrist-level guidance as confidence decreases. Reinforcement learning refines these video-derived priors under the robot's kinematic and physical constraints, and the resulting policies are rolled out to generate robot demonstrations for training a vision-based diffusion policy. We evaluate PriDex on four bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, including pouring, sweeping into a dustpan, bottle-cap unscrewing, and plate cleaning, assessing both simulation-based robot data generation and downstream visuomotor policy learning.
summary_zh: 摘要：收集双手灵巧操作的示范数据成本高昂，因此促使研究者利用人类视频作为机器人训练数据的来源。然而，视频中估计的运动存在不确定性，且人类与机器人本体之间的差异使得直接迁移运动变得具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了PriDex框架，该框架通过仿真中的强化学习，将人类视频先验转化为可执行的机器人灵巧操作示范。PriDex保留了任务相关的交互结构，同时允许为机器人重新生成适合其本体特性的行为。人-物交互提供了可供性线索，用于从基于几何的候选中选择与任务相关且适合机器人的抓取方式。在运动细化方面，物体轨迹提供了任务级参考，而双手腕部的相对轨迹则为协调运动提供了补充指导。由于在遮挡或视觉模糊情况下物体运动估计可能变得不可靠，PriDex利用物体运动的置信度自适应地平衡这两种先验：在置信度高时强调物体级指导，在置信度降低时增加腕部级指导的贡献。强化学习在机器人的运动学与物理约束下细化这些视频-derived先验，并将所得策略展开以生成机器人示范，用于训练基于视觉的扩散策略。我们在四项双手灵巧操作任务上评估了PriDex，包括倒水、扫入簸箕、拧开瓶盖和清洁盘子，评估了基于仿真的机器人数据生成以及下游视觉运动策略学习。
tldr: PriDex transforms human videos into bimanual dexterous robot demonstrations via confidence-guided reinforcement learning, balancing object-motion and wrist-trajectory priors to generate data for visuomotor policy learning.
tldr_zh: PriDex通过置信度引导的强化学习将人类视频转化为双臂灵巧操作演示，平衡物体运动与手腕轨迹先验，以生成用于视觉运动策略学习的数据。

title: Lazy-MOSAIC: Accelerating Skill-Centric Manipulation Planning with Learned Skill-Effect World Models
summary: Long-horizon manipulation tasks require a robot to perform a sequence of physical interactions with its environment, typically combining several different skills. Planning such behaviors efficiently is challenging: given a library of parameterized skills, solutions lie in a vast hybrid space of skill sequences and their parameters, and evaluating each candidate skill's feasibility and effect with a high-fidelity world model such as a physics simulator is computationally expensive. MOSAIC, a recent skill-centric approach, lets the skills guide a non-sequential search toward the regions of this space where they are likely to succeed; however, it pays the full cost of simulation for every parameterized skill it considers. In this work, we introduce Lazy-MOSAIC, a lazy planning framework that instead searches over hypothesized skill outcomes. A cheap learned skill-effect world model predicts, in a fraction of a millisecond, a skill's feasibility and the world state it produces. Lazy-MOSAIC then uses these predictions to focus expensive simulation on promising candidate skills and, when a hypothesis is invalidated, repairs only the affected part of the search, while ensuring that every skill in a returned plan is validated in simulation. We evaluate Lazy-MOSAIC on cluttered-shelf retrieval tasks of increasing difficulty and demonstrate it on a physical robot, showing that it plans substantially faster than baselines with fewer simulator queries, while matching or exceeding their success rate in every setting. Visit skill-mosaic.github.io.
summary_zh: 长期操控任务要求机器人与其环境进行一系列物理交互，通常需要组合多种不同的技能。高效规划此类行为颇具挑战性：给定参数化技能库，解决方案存在于技能序列及其参数的巨大混合空间中，而使用高保真世界模型（如物理模拟器）评估每个候选技能的可行性和效果，计算成本高昂。近期提出的以技能为中心的MOSAIC方法，让技能引导非顺序搜索趋向于其可能成功的空间区域；然而，它仍需为所考虑的每个参数化技能承担完整的模拟成本。在本研究中，我们提出Lazy-MOSAIC，一种惰性规划框架，转而搜索假设的技能结果。一个廉价的、经过学习的技能效果世界模型能在不到一毫秒内预测技能的可行性及其产生的世界状态。Lazy-MOSAIC利用这些预测，将昂贵的模拟聚焦于有前景的候选技能，并在假设被证伪时，仅修复搜索中受影响的部分，同时确保返回计划中的每个技能都经过模拟验证。我们在难度递增的杂乱货架取物任务上评估了Lazy-MOSAIC，并在实体机器人上进行了演示，结果表明，其规划速度显著快于基线方法，且所需模拟器查询次数更少，在每种设置下成功率均达到或超过基线水平。访问skill-mosaic.github.io。
tldr: Lazy-MOSAIC accelerates skill-centric manipulation planning by using a learned skill-effect world model to cheaply predict skill outcomes, focusing expensive simulation only on promising candidates, and repairing invalidated hypotheses locally; it demonstrates faster planning and fewer simulator queries on cluttered-shelf retrieval tasks and a physical robot.
tldr_zh: Lazy-MOSAIC 通过学习技能效果世界模型，廉价预测技能结果，仅对候选技能进行昂贵的仿真验证，并在假设失效时局部修复搜索，从而加速技能为中心的操作规划；在杂乱货架检索任务和物理机器人上展示了更快的规划和更少的仿真查询。

title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.
summary_zh: 近期，在将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界建模相结合方面取得的进展，显著推动了端到端自动驾驶的发展，使系统能够对想象中的未来进行推理，而不仅仅是对当前观测做出反应。然而，大多数世界VLA模型在像素级别生成未来帧，包含大量密集的视觉标记。尽管这类生成的未来帧在视觉上看似合理，但它们保留了诸多与驾驶无关的外观细节，即只有一小部分标记直接编码了与规划相关的关键因素，如智能体几何属性、运动动态和交互关系。这引入了显著的性能瓶颈。因此，一个重要的问题随之而来：世界VLA模型应当对何种世界状态进行推理，才能超越像素级预测以支持规划？我们认为，面向规划的世界建模应聚焦于一种紧凑且结构化的以智能体为中心的潜在状态，该状态能够捕捉驾驶场景中物体随时间的交互关系。为此，我们提出了AgentWorld，一种以智能体为中心的VLA世界模型，其将离散的智能体标记同时用于推理和轨迹规划。每个标记动态地锚定到周围的一个智能体，并关联该物体的状态，包括语义身份、三维几何、运动及交互上下文。AgentWorld通过三个关键过程学习这些标记：显式几何锚定、面向推理的有监督微调以及面向智能体的强化学习。在多种驾驶场景下的大量开环和闭环实验表明，AgentWorld增强了规划能力，充分发掘了视觉证据与智能体动态的利用潜力，并生成了可解释的以智能体为中心的世界状态。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentWorld, an agent-centric vision-language-action world model for autonomous driving that reasons over compact latent states representing surrounding agents, improving planning over pixel-level predictions in open-loop and closed-loop experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AgentWorld，一种面向自动驾驶的智能体中心视觉-语言-动作世界模型，通过在紧凑的隐状态中推理周围智能体，超越像素级预测，提升了开环和闭环规划性能。

title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）能够通过环境交互优化期望任务回报，从而实现对基于流形的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的后训练。然而，这一优化过程带来了两大挑战：策略更新可能改变用于随机转移中得分近似所依赖的速度场几何结构，而稀疏的多任务回放则可能导致不同任务及优势符号之间的学习信号不均衡。为此，我们提出了一种结合结果平衡近端策略优化（PPO）与策略诱导流校正的强化学习框架。结果平衡PPO利用任务成功率估计对正优势进行重新加权，并在保留优势符号的前提下对正负优势进行重新缩放。策略诱导流校正则定期将线性桥式流拟合至当前策略生成的常微分方程端点对上，从而刷新后续随机优化中所使用的表示。我们在模拟操控基准上对该框架进行了评估，并在真实到模拟再到真实（Real2Sim2Real）任务中进一步研究了一种组件组合，考察了任务性能、优化行为及流一致性。实验结果表明，所提出的框架在模拟基准上相较于评估基线显著提升了任务成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces an RL framework for flow-based VLA policies, combining Outcome-Balanced PPO to handle sparse multi-task learning signals and policy-induced flow rectification to refresh the representation during optimization, improving success rates on simulated manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文针对基于流的VLA策略提出了一种强化学习框架，结合了结果平衡PPO和策略诱导流矫正，以应对稀疏多任务学习信号并刷新表示，在模拟操作基准上提高了成功率。

title: SpikWM: Efficient End-to-End Spiking World Modeling for Visual Planning
summary: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM.
summary_zh: 基于图像观测与目标的目標条件规划，要求预测能够区分视觉状态与动作后果。脉冲神经网络提供稀疏计算，但单步脉冲可能模糊运动线索，并将物理结果不同的动作混淆。我们提出脉冲潜在世界模型（SpikWM），一种端到端联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），每个图像执行一次仿真步骤，每个潜位置执行一次神经更新。脉冲区域编码通过区域池化保留空间线索。双脉冲动作编码结合正负二元响应，而因果膜预测利用学习的分组时间常数，在潜历史中传递阈下证据。编码器与预测器在无奖励的图像-动作轨迹上联合训练，采用下一嵌入预测与SIGReg。在共享规划器下，SpikWM在Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher和OGBench-Cube上分别达到$88.67\%$、$97.33\%$、$99.33\%$和$86.67\%$的平均成功率，优于两种脉冲基线。Push-T消融实验验证了各模块的有效性，受控回放用于探究外观与物理状态变化的响应。在匹配的规划预算下，SpikWM相对LeWM将估算算术能耗降低$75.6\%$。代码将在https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM 发布。
tldr: SpikWM proposes an end-to-end spiking latent world model with causal membrane prediction and action encoding for efficient visual planning, achieving high success rates on manipulation and navigation tasks with reduced energy consumption.
tldr_zh: SpikWM 提出了一种端到端的脉冲潜世界模型，结合因果膜预测和动作编码，在操作和导航任务中实现了高成功率并降低了能耗。

title: RefCloth: Transferable Adversarial Tablecloths for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Closed-loop vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely continuously on multi-view cameras, yet existing visual attacks typically hijack sensor streams with 2D patches or alter target object meshes that require retraining when manipulation objects change. We introduce RefCloth, a framework that optimizes one persistent adversarial tablecloth on a frozen source policy and deploys it zero-shot across unseen tasks and target models without modifying task objects or cameras. Throughout manipulation, static third-person and moving wrist views observe this shared world-bound texture under evolving occlusions. To generalize across shifting surface views while bridging the gap between differentiable and native renderers, RefCloth combines bounded texture parameterization with shared surface UV transformations and a same-path clean reference that removes static rendering offsets at initialization. Across four LIBERO suites in native simulation, one frozen texture transfers from OpenVLA-OFT to $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$, reducing success relative to an unoptimized cloth by 62.50 and 43.75 percentage points on average and far exceeding amplitude- and variation-matched random controls. Dual-view audits and target closed-loop camera interventions show that moving wrist exposure drives over twice the standalone drop of the main view with strong synergy, while ablations confirm the roles of UV diversification and path calibration.
summary_zh: 闭环视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略持续依赖多视角摄像头，然而现有的视觉攻击通常利用二维补丁劫持传感器流，或修改目标物体网格，后者在操作对象变化时需要重新训练。我们提出RefCloth框架，该框架在冻结的源策略上优化一个持久性的对抗性桌布，并以零样本方式部署到未见任务和目标模型中，无需修改任务对象或摄像头。在操作过程中，静态的第三人称视角和移动的腕部视角在渐变的遮挡条件下观察这一共享的世界坐标系纹理。为在变化的表面视角间实现泛化，同时弥合可微渲染器与原生渲染器之间的差距，RefCloth结合了有界纹理参数化、共享表面UV变换，以及同路径清洁参考（该参考在初始化时消除静态渲染偏移）。在原生仿真的四套LIBERO基准中，单一冻结纹理从OpenVLA-OFT迁移至$π_0$和$π_{0.5}$，相较于未优化的桌布，平均成功率分别降低62.50和43.75个百分点，远超幅度与变化匹配的随机对照组。双视角审计与目标闭环摄像头干预实验表明，移动腕部暴露带来的独立性能下降是主视角的两倍以上，且二者具有强协同效应；消融实验进一步证实了UV多样化与路径校准的作用。
tldr: RefCloth optimizes a single adversarial tablecloth texture on a frozen source VLA policy, demonstrating zero-shot attack transfer across unseen tasks and target VLA models in simulation by exploiting shared world-bound visual observations.
tldr_zh: RefCloth 在冻结的源 VLA 策略上优化一块对抗性桌布纹理，在仿真中实现了对未见任务和目标 VLA 模型的零样本攻击迁移，利用了共享世界坐标系的视觉观测。

title: Beyond the Camera: A Tri-Modal Driving World Model for Future RGB, Thermal, and LiDAR Forecasting in Adverse Weather
summary: Driving world models forecast what a vehicle's sensors will record next. Most forecast camera video and some add LiDAR, but thermal cameras, which still see in darkness and some adverse weather, are rarely a forecast target, and to our knowledge no world model forecasts all three sensors. We study joint forecasting of RGB, thermal, and LiDAR on real adverse-weather sequences of the DSERT-RoLL dataset. We post-train a pretrained video world model for each sensor and represent LiDAR as a depth video aligned with the RGB camera, with densification and encoding chosen by what the model's video tokenizer can reconstruct. A tri-sensor model sees all three sensors as one video. We score LiDAR in meters against measured returns and compare against persistence baselines passed through the same tokenizer as the model. With this matching, an apparent loss of the thermal model to persistence in fog disappears. On all 58 validation sequences in six weather conditions, post-trained RGB and thermal forecasts beat compression-matched persistence. Joint training lowers the LiDAR error at 2s by 2.1m at a small cost in camera fidelity, and only the tri-sensor model's LiDAR forecasts beat persistence in mean error. Blanking one sensor degrades the forecasts of the others more in snow than in fog.
summary_zh: 驾驶世界模型预测车辆传感器接下来将记录的内容。多数模型预测摄像头视频，部分模型额外预测激光雷达，但热成像摄像头——这类在黑暗中及部分恶劣天气下仍能感知的设备——却鲜少成为预测目标，且据我们所知，尚无任何一种世界模型能够同时预测全部三种传感器。本研究在DSERT-RoLL数据集真实恶劣天气序列上，探讨RGB、热成像与激光雷达的联合预测。我们针对每种传感器对预训练视频世界模型进行后训练，并将激光雷达表示为与RGB摄像头对齐的深度视频，其致密化与编码方式依据模型视频分词器可重建的程度选定。三传感器模型将三种传感器视为单一视频进行处理。我们以米为单位，将激光雷达预测结果与实测回波进行比对，并与通过相同分词器处理的持续状态基线进行比较。在匹配此条件后，热成像模型在雾天中看似逊于持续状态基线的表现即告消失。在六种天气条件下全部58个验证序列中，后训练的RGB与热成像预测均优于压缩匹配的持续状态基线。联合训练使激光雷达在2秒处的误差降低2.1米，代价是摄像头保真度略有下降，且仅三传感器模型的激光雷达预测在平均误差上优于持续状态基线。屏蔽某一传感器对其它传感器预测的损害，在雪天比在雾天更为显著。
tldr: This paper introduces a tri-modal driving world model that jointly forecasts RGB, thermal, and LiDAR data in adverse weather, using a pretrained video world model post-trained on the DSERT-RoLL dataset. Joint training improves LiDAR forecasting accuracy, with ablation showing sensor interdependencies vary by weather condition.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种三模态驾驶世界模型，可在恶劣天气下联合预测RGB、热成像和LiDAR数据，基于DSERT-RoLL数据集对预训练视频世界模型进行后训练。联合训练提高了LiDAR预测精度，消融实验显示不同天气条件下传感器间的依赖关系不同。

title: Inertial Video World Models
summary: The physical world has inertia: it evolves from what already exists rather than being recreated at every instant. However, many existing video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, leaving the continuity of motion and structure implicit in video prediction. During autoregressive rollouts, repeated reconstruction can accumulate errors and destabilize the predicted dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce InertialWorld, an Inertial Video World Model that makes inertia a structural prior for autoregressive prediction: existing scene evidence is carried across time rather than reconstructed at every step. Central to this formulation is Inertial Memory, which turns memory from passive predictive context into an evolving video state with two complementary views: a dense Eulerian grid preserves scene-aligned evidence, while persistent Lagrangian carriers bind local content to learned canonical coordinates. At each step, the model transports the carrier content according to action-conditioned motion, predicts the complete next video state from the transported carriers and dense grid, and uses a learned gate to combine transported and newly predicted content into the memory for the next step. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that InertialWorld achieves competitive autoregressive prediction performance against strong video world model baselines. Codes link: https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/InertialWorld
summary_zh: 物理世界具有惯性：它从已有状态中演化而来，而非在每个时刻被重新生成。然而，现有的许多视频世界模型缺乏对惯性状态演化的显式机制，使得运动和结构的连续性在视频预测中仅以隐式方式体现。在自回归生成过程中，重复重建会累积误差并破坏预测动力学的稳定性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了InertialWorld——一种惯性视频世界模型，将惯性作为自回归预测的结构性先验：已有的场景证据随时间传递，而非在每个步骤中被重建。该框架的核心是惯性记忆（Inertial Memory），它将记忆从被动的预测上下文转变为一种演化的视频状态，包含两种互补视图：稠密欧拉网格保持与场景对齐的证据，而持久拉格朗日载体将局部内容绑定至学习到的规范坐标。在每个步骤中，模型根据动作条件运动传输载体内容，由传输后的载体和稠密网格预测完整的下一视频状态，并通过学习门控将传输内容与新预测内容融合为下一步的记忆。在多个领域的广泛实验中，包括机器人操控、三维游戏模拟和开放世界导航，InertialWorld在自回归预测性能上与强视频世界模型基线方法相比展现出竞争力。代码链接：https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/InertialWorld
tldr: InertialWorld introduces an Inertial Video World Model with an Inertial Memory mechanism that carries scene evidence across time, using dense Eulerian grids and Lagrangian carriers for action-conditioned autoregressive prediction. It demonstrates competitive performance in robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation.
tldr_zh: InertialWorld 提出了一种惯性视频世界模型，通过惯性记忆机制在时间上携带场景证据，利用欧拉网格和拉格朗日载体进行动作条件下的自回归预测，并在机器人操作、3D游戏模拟和开放世界导航中展示了竞争性能。

title: GridDriver: On-Board BEV-Based Language Planning and Reasoning
summary: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. We present GridDriver, an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework combining trajectory prediction, structured driving indicators, natural-language navigation, driving explanations, and scene question answering. Lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception and spatially structured tokens provide scene context to a shared LLM, while frame-wise scheduling interleaves trajectory prediction with asynchronous language generation. GridDriver achieves competitive performance on public benchmarks, reaching 87.9% PDMS on NAVSIM and 57.6% accuracy on nuScenes-QA with a shared planning and QA checkpoint. Spatial representation analyses demonstrate improved geometric information retention and trajectory prediction compared with Q-Former compression. The system achieves 32.7 ms standalone planning latency and 9.4 plans/s in an onboard ROS 2 pipeline. We further evaluate planning on our own data recordings and demonstrate open-loop onboard operation on a research vehicle. Across public benchmarks and real-world evaluations, we identify strengths and limitations of the BEV-based approach.
summary_zh: 鸟瞰视角（BEV）条件大型语言模型（LLMs）能够实现语言交互式驾驶，但车载部署需要在自回归语言生成的同时，具备高效的感知与连续规划能力。我们提出了GridDriver，一种高效的BEV条件LLM框架，融合了轨迹预测、结构化驾驶指标、自然语言导航、驾驶解释以及场景问答功能。轻量级时空BEV感知与空间结构化令牌为共享LLM提供场景上下文，而逐帧调度将轨迹预测与异步语言生成交错执行。GridDriver在公开基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能，在NAVSIM上达到87.9%的PDMS，在nuScenes-QA上达到57.6%的准确率，并采用共享的规划与问答检查点。空间表示分析表明，与Q-Former压缩相比，其在几何信息保留和轨迹预测方面均有显著提升。该系统在车载ROS 2流水线中实现了32.7毫秒的独立规划延迟以及每秒9.4次规划。我们进一步在自有数据记录上评估规划性能，并在研究车辆上展示了开环车载运行。通过公开基准与实际评估，我们识别了基于BEV方法的优势与局限性。
tldr: GridDriver is an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework for autonomous driving that integrates trajectory prediction, language planning, and QA, with onboard deployment demonstrated on a research vehicle.
tldr_zh: GridDriver 是一个高效的基于 BEV 的 LLM 自动驾驶框架，集成了轨迹预测、语言规划和问答，并在研究车辆上进行了车载部署验证。

title: Every Camera Grows Up: Camera-Height Regression in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型可作为具身智能体的模拟器：从起始图像和动作轨迹出发，它们生成智能体将观察到的视角。起始图像固定了相机的高度，例如地面机器人设为0.15米，俯视相机设为2.2米，而一个忠实的模拟器必须在相机移动时保持该高度。我们表明，六个最新的开放权重模型未能做到这一点：当运动用生成内容替换起始视图时，它们会将相机移向人眼高度，我们将这一失败称为相机高度回归。我们的基准测试EyeHeight将六个渲染高度（0.15米至2.2米）与四个经过校准的真实世界设备高度配对，并采用无尺度多视角高度估计。所有六个模型在180度转身行走的 rollout 过程中均丧失初始高度：当推断出的视点收敛到1.1米至1.5米的人类身高范围时，以0.15米初始化时，仅有0–20%的片段在起始高度的1.3倍范围内结束，而真实渲染则保持在百分之几的误差内。在Matrix-Game模型中，单应性跟踪的地面运动在旋转过程中与恒定高度保持一致，即使新外绘的房间几何结构导致重建视点升高。回归随旋转角度增大而加剧，在起始帧仍处于上下文范围内时便开始发生，并且当SANA-WM中360度旋转恢复初始视图时，回归在很大程度上被逆转。我们将这种吸引力追溯到以人为中心的视频先验，其中地面水平视图几乎不存在：在SANA-WM中，文本高度提示和密集地面视差图无法阻止该现象，而去噪前半段的无分类器文本引导则强化了它。将无引导采样与高度平衡微调相结合，能恢复更多的高度保持能力，但代价是损失5个MUSIQ分数，且该损失同样发生在那些早期步骤中。仅视点漂移就会改变视觉导航策略预测的路径。
tldr: This paper identifies and quantifies 'camera-height regression' in interactive video world models, where models default to human-eye-level viewpoints instead of preserving the specified camera height, and proposes a benchmark (EyeHeight) and mitigation analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并量化了交互式视频世界模型中的“相机高度回归”问题，即模型在生成过程中倾向于将视点恢复到人类眼高而非保持指定的相机高度，并提出了基准（EyeHeight）和缓解分析。

title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
summary: Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. Same-memory counterfactuals show that, in most settings, EKR pushes plans away from visited states, in navigation, often at a higher base cost; stuck episodes and revisits drop accordingly. In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute. Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from 44.7% to 100.0% and from 21.0% to 32.0% on long-horizon PointMaze and Push-T.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过最小化预测潜变量与目标潜变量之间的距离来规划朝向目标图像的路径。然而，这一距离并非测地线距离：它存在局部极小值、潜变量陷阱——位于墙壁后方、拐角处及死胡同中，而无记忆的滚动时域重规划会使智能体陷入其中，反复访问远离目标的状态。我们提出**情节核排斥（Episodic Kernel Repulsion, EKR）**，一种无需训练的代价项，通过将候选计划与智能体实际访问过的潜变量新颖性门控记忆进行top-$k$高斯核惩罚，并按当前基础代价重新缩放，从而使其强度在不同模型间具有可比性。在两种JEPA世界模型及四个基准测试中，EKR在相同模型、规划器和预算下，将平均成功率从31.8%提升至46.7%（LeWM），从54.7%提升至64.0%（H-JEPA）。同记忆反事实实验表明，在大多数设置中，EKR将计划推离已访问状态，在导航任务中通常以更高基础代价实现；卡死情节与重复访问相应减少。在八项设置中的七项中，EKR以$0.8$--$1.5\times$的计算量达到或超过$4\times$样本采样的性能。无需调参，EKR即可迁移至DINO-WM结合CEM：在官方及更长目标Wall任务上分别提升$+6.7$和$+19.3$个百分点，在长时程PointMaze和Push-T任务上分别从44.7%提升至100.0%、从21.0%提升至32.0%。
tldr: Proposes Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that uses a novelty-gated memory of visited latents and top-k Gaussian kernels to penalize replanning into local minima ('latent traps') during latent world-model planning, improving success rates across JEPA and DINO-WM world models on navigation and manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出了情景核排斥（EKR），一种无需训练的成本项，利用新门控的访问过潜在状态记忆和 top-k 高斯核来惩罚重新规划进入局部最小值（“潜在陷阱”），在 JEPA 和 DINO-WM 世界模型上的导航和操作基准中提高了成功率。

title: Similar Is Not Useful: Selecting In-Context Demonstrations by Closed-Loop Utility
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $π_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. Utility beats similarity by 10.8 points ($p=3.2\times10^{-6}$; positive on 15 of 18 untied tasks), including on 12 tasks the policy was never primed on, and similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10; across tasks, similarity separates tasks whose scenes differ and falls to chance when two tasks share a scene. The gain comes from on-task closed-loop evidence: best-of-ten direct search over pools recovers two-thirds of it with 100 rollouts. Against the shipped 20-demonstration pool, utility-curated pools of five lead by 7.0 points over 560 paired episodes from two evaluation runs ($p=0.006$), and utility-ordered retrieval inside the full pool leads by 4.5 points ($p=0.055$).
summary_zh: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在冻结的DINOv2嵌入下，将帧外观与当前观察最相似的演示填入其上下文中。我们探究视觉相似性是否选择了能使策略成功的演示。对于冻结的检索增强VLA（在$π_0$-FAST、LIBERO上的RICL），我们使演示池在运行时可交换，并通过将60个固定大小池的闭环成功率对其成员进行回归来对每个演示的效用进行评分。在与评分所用初始状态不相交的初始状态上，效用得分最高的五个演示池在19个任务的760个配对情节中成功率为66.4%，最相似的五个演示池成功率为55.7%，随机池成功率为55.5%。效用比相似性高出10.8个百分点（$p=3.2\times10^{-6}$；在18个未平局任务中有15个为正），包括在策略从未被引导过的12个任务上，而相似性选择的池与随机池相比并无更好表现（$+0.1$个百分点）。在任务内部，池与测试场景的视觉相似性对其成功率的Spearman相关系数为0.10；跨任务时，相似性可区分场景不同的任务，当两个任务共享场景时则降至随机水平。增益来源于任务内的闭环证据：在池上的前十直接搜索通过100次回放恢复了其中三分之二的增益。与出厂自带的20个演示池相比，效用筛选的五个演示池在两次评估运行的560个配对情节中领先7.0个百分点（$p=0.006$），而在完整池内进行效用排序检索则领先4.5个百分点（$p=0.055$）。
tldr: This paper investigates whether visual similarity-based retrieval of in-context demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies is effective, proposing a closed-loop utility-based selection that outperforms similarity-based and random selection on multi-task robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于视觉相似性的上下文演示检索对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略是否有效，提出一种基于闭环效用的选择方法，在多项机器人操作任务上优于相似性和随机选择。

title: WM-Quant: Rollout-Aware Post-Training Quantization for JEPA-Style World Models
summary: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Although world models typically feature relatively few parameters, action planning algorithms often require thousands of inferences, which can quickly become computationally expensive. PTQ is a natural way to reduce this cost. However, we show that in world models using autoregressive model predictive control (MPC) rollouts, quantization error can compound with each predictor step, resulting in action rankings from the quantized model becoming near-random. WM-Quant addresses this with three components that build on existing PTQ methods: early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling. Early-encoder precision protects accurate latent state and goal information to mitigate long-term error propagation. Control-path preservation allows the world model predictor to distinguish between fine-grained actions, significantly improving action rankings and execution. Rollout-aware scaling jointly calibrates encoder and per-step predictor activation ranges with respect to an entire rollout rather than a single prediction, reducing the cumulative rollout error. Across multiple world models, environments, and PTQ methods, WM-Quant substantially improves planning success at low bit-widths, approaching full-precision performance at W4A4.
summary_zh: 我们提出了WM-Quant，据我们所知，这是首个专门针对JEPA风格世界模型设计的训练后量化（PTQ）框架。尽管世界模型通常参数量相对较少，但动作规划算法往往需要数千次推理，这很快就会导致计算成本高昂。训练后量化是降低这一成本的自然途径。然而，我们表明，在使用自回归模型预测控制（MPC）展开的世界模型中，量化误差会随着每一步预测而累积，导致量化模型的动作排序变得近乎随机。WM-Quant通过三个基于现有PTQ方法的组件来解决这一问题：早期编码器精度、控制路径保留和展开感知缩放。早期编码器精度保护准确的潜在状态和目标信息，以减轻长期误差传播。控制路径保留使得世界模型预测器能够区分细粒度的动作，显著改善动作排序和执行效果。展开感知缩放联合校准编码器和每步预测器的激活范围，其依据是整个展开过程而非单次预测，从而减少累积展开误差。在多种世界模型、环境和PTQ方法下，WM-Quant在低比特宽度下显著提升了规划成功率，在W4A4时接近全精度性能。
tldr: WM-Quant proposes the first post-training quantization framework for JEPA-style world models, addressing error accumulation in autoregressive MPC rollouts via early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling, achieving full-precision performance at W4A4.
tldr_zh: WM-Quant 提出了首个针对 JEPA 风格世界模型的训练后量化框架，通过早期编码器精度、控制路径保留和滚动感知缩放解决自回归 MPC 滚动中的误差累积问题，在 W4A4 下达到全精度性能。

title: PAIR: Bringing Household Robots into the Smart Home
summary: Household robots often need to operate appliances, and smart appliances offer both control panels and device APIs. Existing embodied AI simulation environments, however, model appliances solely as physical objects. We introduce PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol~\footnote{https://csa-iot.org/all-solutions/matter/}, the industry standard for smart-home devices. PAIR provides 84 smart-device assets whose functional control panels and APIs act on a shared device state, with ambient conditions that evolve in response to both. From a survey of 1,443 requests, we construct a benchmark of 40 tasks that all require object manipulation yet remain solvable without API access, with 340 human demonstrations for policy training. Whether run alone, with a high-level planner, or with an API-enabled planner, two fine-tuned VLA policies complete none of the 120 evaluation episodes. Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door. With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan. When choosing between pressing a button and calling an API, several planners go by whether they can read the panel, not by API latency.\footnote{We will release our code and data upon publication.}
summary_zh: 家用机器人通常需要操作电器，而智能电器既提供控制面板，也提供设备API。然而，现有的具身AI仿真环境仅将电器建模为物理对象。我们引入了PAIR，一个基于Matter协议\footnote{https://csa-iot.org/all-solutions/matter/}（智能家居设备的行业标准）构建的智能家居仿真环境。PAIR提供了84个智能设备资产，其功能性控制面板和API作用于共享的设备状态，环境条件则随两者的交互而动态变化。基于对1,443个请求的调查，我们构建了一个包含40个任务的基准测试，所有任务都要求物体操作，但在不使用API的情况下仍可完成，并提供了340个人类演示用于策略训练。无论是单独运行、搭配高层规划器运行，还是搭配支持API的规划器运行，两个微调后的VLA策略在120个评估回合中均未完成任何一项任务。机器人很少能走远到足以使用API的地步：即使拥有理想规划器和API访问权限，超过90%的失败回合也卡在导航、抓取或操作门的过程中。若用完美的理想模型替代机器人的实体操作，最佳规划器也只能完成其规划的57.3%。在按下按钮与调用API之间做选择时，多个规划器依据能否读取面板来决定，而非考虑API延迟。\footnote{我们将在发表后发布代码和数据。}
tldr: This paper introduces PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol, with 84 smart-device assets, a 40-task benchmark, and 340 human demonstrations, and shows that current VLA policies fail on these tasks due to difficulties in navigation, grasping, and door operation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PAIR，一个基于Matter协议的智能家居仿真环境，包含84个智能设备资产、40个任务基准和340个人类演示，并表明当前的VLA策略由于导航、抓取和开门等困难而无法完成这些任务。

title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
summary: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶领域，世界模型用于提供未来场景预测以评估候选轨迹，但固定的选择规则可能无法捕捉依赖于场景的权衡。我们提出了一种基于残差引导的强化学习（RL）框架，用于轻量级轨迹选择，该框架结合了冻结的世界模型和固定的候选轨迹库。该框架采用近端策略优化（PPO）对候选选择和有界轨迹残差的联合策略进行微调。通过评估所选轨迹的局部扰动所获得的反馈，上下文条件排序网络学习候选轨迹的偏好。在推理阶段，选择器使用固定权重结合学习到的偏好和预测的风险排序，并直接返回所选候选轨迹而不进行修改。微调更新了演员网络和评论家网络中的16，106个参数，而部署的选择器仅保留11，725参数的排序网络，残差分支和评论家网络仅在训练期间使用。在nuScenes验证集上的开环评估中，与未使用基于RL选择的RiskWorld模型基线相比，该方法将平均欧氏轨迹误差（L2）降低了3.99%。在匹配反馈访问和演员更新的预算条件下，与未使用残差训练的分类PPO变体相比，残差探索使L2降低了0.83%。此外，当风险特征被移除或打乱时，该方法仍能保持比RiskWorld更低的L2误差。
tldr: This paper proposes a residual-guided reinforcement learning framework for trajectory selection in automated driving, using a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The method fine-tunes a lightweight policy to select trajectories, reducing L2 error on nuScenes by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld baseline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种残差引导的强化学习框架，用于自动驾驶中的轨迹选择，利用冻结的世界模型和固定候选库。该方法微调轻量级策略以选择轨迹，在nuScenes上相较于RiskWorld基线将L2误差降低了3.99%。

title: Sim2CBF: From Forward Simulations to Implicit Control Barrier Function Safety Filtering without Model Derivatives
summary: Failure avoidance in complex robot-environment interactions is challenging because the underlying dynamics are difficult to model accurately, and available predictive models may not provide reliable derivatives. We present Sim2CBF, a failure-avoidance framework that solves the Control Barrier Function (CBF)-Safety Filter (SF) optimization problem using only forward-model evaluations, thereby avoiding differentiation of the predictive model. Specifically, we approximate the CBF constraint using finite differences and local linear interpolation over sampled control inputs while preserving failure-avoidance guarantees. The underlying CBF is implicit and constructed from backup-policy rollouts, enabling the use of expressive predictive models such as physics-based simulators and learned world models. Compared with purely sampling-based SFs, our formulation requires fewer control samples and yields less conservative behavior than direct nominal-backup blending. We evaluate Sim2CBF in simulation, hardware box-toppling, and vision-based control tasks, demonstrating its applicability to contact-rich and learned dynamics, as well as its adaptability to changes in the predictive model.
summary_zh: 在复杂的机器人-环境交互中避免失败极具挑战性，因为其底层动态难以精确建模，且现有的预测模型可能无法提供可靠的导数。我们提出Sim2CBF，一种仅利用前向模型评估来求解控制障碍函数（CBF）-安全滤波器（SF）优化问题的失败避免框架，从而避免对预测模型进行微分。具体而言，我们通过有限差分和对采样控制输入的局部线性插值来近似CBF约束，同时保留失败避免保证。底层CBF是隐式的，并通过备份策略滚动构建，从而能够使用表达能力强的预测模型，如基于物理的模拟器和学习到的世界模型。与纯基于采样的SF相比，我们的公式所需的控制样本更少，并且相比直接的名义备份混合方法，产生的行为更为保守性低。我们在仿真、硬件翻箱任务以及基于视觉的控制任务中评估了Sim2CBF，展示了其对接触丰富和学习的动态的适用性，以及其对预测模型变化的适应性。
tldr: Sim2CBF presents a safety-filtering framework that uses only forward simulations to enforce Control Barrier Function constraints, avoiding model derivatives and enabling use with learned world models and contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: Sim2CBF 提出了一种仅使用前向仿真来实施控制障碍函数约束的安全过滤框架，避免了对模型求导，适用于接触丰富任务和学习的世界模型。

title: Sideslip-Conditioned Drift Trajectory Planning with Flow Matching and Control Barrier Functions
summary: Drifting, the deliberate control of a vehicle at large sideslip angles, is relevant to both motorsport and recovery from unexpected oversteer. Existing autonomous drifting methods typically determine drift intensity through predefined reference trajectories, optimization objectives, or learned policy rewards, rather than accepting a desired sideslip angle as an explicit input. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first generative drift trajectory planner explicitly conditioned on a requested peak sideslip angle. A conditional flow matching model is trained on demonstrated drift laps with hindsight-derived sideslip labels and refined through reinforcement fine-tuning. A control barrier function (CBF) correction is then applied to satisfy model-based road, tire friction, and actuator constraints at the planning waypoints. In closed-loop experiments in the racing simulator Assetto Corsa, a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks the generated plans for six requested sideslip angles from 20 deg to 45 deg, with 30 laps (approximately 75 km) per request. The median peak sideslip angle measured across drift-corner passes follows the requested angle, with a mean absolute error of 1.2 deg across the six conditions. Ablation experiments show that reinforcement fine-tuning improves conditioning accuracy, while CBF correction substantially reduces off-road and spin events.
summary_zh: 漂移，即在大的侧偏角下对车辆进行有意控制，既与赛车运动相关，也涉及对突发过度转向的恢复。现有的自主漂移方法通常通过预定义的参考轨迹、优化目标或学习到的策略奖励来确定漂移强度，而不是将期望的侧偏角作为显式输入。我们提出了，据我们所知，首个以请求的峰值侧偏角为显式条件生成的漂移轨迹规划器。一个条件流匹配模型在带有事后推导侧偏标签的演示漂移圈上训练，并通过强化学习微调进行优化。随后应用控制屏障函数（CBF）校正，以在规划路径点上满足基于模型的道路、轮胎摩擦及执行器约束。在赛车模拟器《Assetto Corsa》中的闭环实验中，一个非线性模型预测控制器跟踪所生成的计划，对应六个请求的侧偏角（从20度到45度），每个请求执行30圈（约75公里）。跨漂移弯道通过测得的峰值侧偏角中位数跟随请求角度，六种条件下的平均绝对误差为1.2度。消融实验表明，强化学习微调提高了条件化精度，而CBF校正显著减少了偏离道路和旋转失控事件。
tldr: This paper presents a generative drift trajectory planner conditioned on a requested peak sideslip angle, using conditional flow matching with reinforcement fine-tuning and CBF-based correction, validated in the Assetto Corsa racing simulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种以需求峰值侧偏角为条件的生成式漂移轨迹规划器，采用条件流匹配与强化微调，并通过控制障碍函数修正，在赛车模拟器Assetto Corsa中验证。

title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
summary: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. We build the accelerator on the insights of the rich line of bit-level sparsity accelerators and design it and the planner tightly coupled as a single co-design: the planner increases sparsity and exposes structure for hardware scheduling, and the bit-exact hardware effectively uses the sparsity that the planner creates. On three JEPA world models, our co-design is 1.28-1.80x faster than a dense accelerator and uses 38-52% less energy, and it is 1.22-1.58x faster than prior bit-sparse design and uses 16-36% less energy, with the same area. To our knowledge, our planner is the first planner that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity across its candidates and exposes its structure for hardware scheduling, and our co-design is the first algorithm-hardware co-design for JEPA-style world-model planning.
summary_zh: JEPA风格的潜在世界模型使具身智能体能够通过模型预测控制规划新目标，但其速度对于现实生活中的具身控制而言仍然过慢：基于采样的MPC每个规划需重复执行数万次预测器推断，即便在高端GPU上，单步规划也可能耗时数十秒。我们观察到这一重复推断工作负载中存在显著的潜在局部性：预测器将相近的动作映射到相近的潜在表示，且在量化预测器内部，这种相近性表现为硬件可利用的差分位级稀疏性。与输入流不同——其时间相似性是给定的——规划器自身决定将哪些候选样本放在一起评估，因此规划器可以选择自己的参考点，并通过参考森林采样制造更多稀疏性：它将每组采样动作序列耦合到一个共享根上，同时保持竞争性的规划质量。我们基于丰富的位级稀疏性加速器研究构建该加速器，并将其与规划器紧密耦合为单一协同设计：规划器提升稀疏性并为硬件调度暴露结构，而位精确的硬件则有效利用规划器所生成的稀疏性。在三个JEPA世界模型上，我们的协同设计比稠密加速器快1.28-1.80倍，能耗降低38-52%；相比先前的位稀疏设计快1.22-1.58倍，能耗降低16-36%，且面积相同。据我们所知，我们的规划器是首个在其候选样本间制造差分位级稀疏性并为其硬件调度暴露结构的规划器，而我们的协同设计则是首个面向JEPA风格世界模型规划的算法-硬件协同设计。
tldr: This paper presents a planner-hardware co-design that manufactures differential bit-level sparsity in JEPA-style latent world models to accelerate sampling-based MPC for embodied agents, achieving significant speedup and energy reduction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种规划器-硬件协同设计方案，通过制造差分比特级稀疏性来加速基于JEPA潜在世界模型的采样MPC，实现了显著的加速和能耗降低。

title: VoxelSBFL: Voxel-Level Spectrum-Based Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation to control robots. Testing these systems produces trajectories and task outcomes, but existing approaches provide limited guidance on using these recorded trajectories to assess subsequent executions or inform policy repair. We conjecture that, for a given policy and task, traversing certain workspace regions is associated with a higher likelihood of failure. To investigate this conjecture, we propose VoxelSBFL, a black-box adaptation of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) in which workspace voxels replace program elements as units of analysis. Recorded tool-center-point (TCP) trajectories provide binary voxel coverage, which is combined with execution outcomes to construct suspiciousness maps using established SBFL formulas. These maps identify failure-associated regions and score unseen trajectories without requiring internal model access. We evaluate 34 spectrum-based techniques across four VLA models using 96,000 Pick-Up trajectories in simulation and compare the leading techniques against eight action- and trajectory-based metrics. VoxelSBFL obtains an overall macro ROC-AUC of 0.704, significantly outperforming state-of-the art baselines. Sensitivity analyses show that performance varies with spatial granularity and training-set size. These findings support spatial spectra for VLA execution assessment and motivate future research on runtime monitoring, self-healing and targeted policy improvement.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过整合视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成来实现对机器人的控制。对此类系统的测试会产生轨迹与任务结果，但现有方法在利用这些记录轨迹来评估后续执行或指导策略修复方面，所提供的指导十分有限。我们推测，对于给定的策略与任务，穿越某些工作空间区域与较高的失败概率相关联。为验证这一推测，我们提出VoxelSBFL方法，这是一种基于频谱的故障定位（SBFL）的黑盒适配方法，其中以工作空间体素替代程序元素作为分析单元。记录的工具中心点（TCP）轨迹提供二值体素覆盖信息，该信息与执行结果相结合，并利用既有的SBFL公式构建可疑度图谱。这些图谱能够识别与失败相关的区域，并在无需访问模型内部机制的情况下对未见轨迹进行评分。我们在仿真环境中基于96,000条拾取轨迹，对四种VLA模型上的34种频谱技术进行了评估，并将表现领先的技术与八种基于动作和轨迹的指标进行了比较。VoxelSBFL的整体宏平均ROC-AUC达到0.704，显著优于现有最先进基线方法。敏感性分析表明，性能随空间粒度和训练集规模的变化而有所不同。上述发现支持将空间频谱用于VLA执行评估，并为运行时监控、自修复及针对性策略改进的未来研究提供了动力。
tldr: This paper introduces VoxelSBFL, a black-box method that applies spectrum-based fault localization to voxelized workspace trajectories for predicting failures in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot policies, outperforming existing baselines in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VoxelSBFL，一种黑盒方法，将基于频谱的故障定位应用于体素化工作空间轨迹，以预测视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人策略的失败，在模拟中优于现有基线。

title: Hidden Variables Behind Real-Robot Data Quality: Lessons from Hundreds of Thousands of Hours
summary: As real-robot data collection scales, collection-system design shapes both operator efficiency and the behaviors learned by robot policies. Workspace limitations, control-interface friction, and latency can introduce pauses, detours, and corrective motions into otherwise successful demonstrations. We investigate these effects across embodiment, teleoperation control, and data consistency, combining a kinematic study of 25 dual-arm robots, controlled teleoperation experiments, and real-robot evaluation of fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policies. The embodiment study shows that positional reachability overstates orientation-aware task coverage and that modest shoulder motion can substantially expand the effective workspace. Teleoperation experiments show that parallelizing body-part control reduces task completion time by 43-53%, while compliant control improves success and reduces peak contact forces on constrained and contact-rich tasks. Policy-learning experiments show that demonstrations must capture the visual information underlying action choices: active-search demonstrations improve arm-selection accuracy from chance (50%) to 100%. Calibration experiments reveal that mixed-calibration training data remain usable in our tested configurations when an inference-aligned subset is retained, whereas inference-time miscalibration causes all 30 trials to fail. Policies also retain approximately 90% of the extra path length in detour-contaminated demonstrations, showing how inefficient operator motions persist in learned behavior. Together, these findings connect collection-system design to demonstration quality and downstream policy execution. They motivate evaluating effective workspace, control efficiency, observation completeness, calibration alignment, and motion quality before scaling collection, and addressing system-induced compensations at their source.
summary_zh: 随着真实机器人数据采集规模的扩大，采集系统的设计同时影响着操作员效率以及机器人策略所学习到的行为。工作空间限制、控制界面的摩擦以及延迟，可能会在原本成功的示范中引入停顿、绕行和纠正性动作。我们结合对25台双臂机器人的运动学研究、受控遥操作实验，以及对微调后的$π_{0.5}$策略的真实机器人评估，跨具身形态、遥操作控制和数据一致性对这些效应进行了研究。具身形态研究表明，位置可达性高估了面向姿态的任务覆盖率，而适度的肩部运动可以显著扩大有效工作空间。遥操作实验表明，并行化身体部位控制可将任务完成时间减少43-53%，而柔顺控制在受约束和接触密集的任务中提高了成功率并降低了峰值接触力。策略学习实验表明，示范必须捕捉动作选择背后的视觉信息：主动搜索示范将手臂选择的准确率从随机水平（50%）提升至100%。校准实验揭示，在保留与推理对齐的子集时，混合校准的训练数据在我们测试的配置中仍然可用，而推理时的校准失配导致全部30次试验失败。策略在含绕行污染的示范中保留了约90%的额外路径长度，显示出低效操作员动作如何在所学行为中持续存在。综合来看，这些发现将采集系统的设计与示范质量及下游策略执行联系起来，促使在扩大采集规模之前评估有效工作空间、控制效率、观测完整性、校准对齐和运动质量，并在源头解决系统引发的补偿行为。
tldr: This paper investigates how real-robot data collection system design—including workspace constraints, teleoperation interfaces, and calibration—affects demonstration quality and downstream policy performance, offering guidelines for data-efficient policy learning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了真实机器人数据采集系统设计（包括工作空间限制、遥操作接口和校准）如何影响示范质量和下游策略性能，并为高效策略学习提供了指导。

title: DGV-DLIVO: Degeneracy-Guided Visual Fusion for Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry in Degenerate Tunnel Environments
summary: Reliable localization in long underground infrastructures remains a major challenge for autonomous inspection robots. In hydropower spillway tunnels and drainage galleries, repetitive geometric structures provide insufficient constraints along the tunnel axis, while weak texture and illumination variations further degrade visual estimation. Under this coupled degradation, existing LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial odometry systems may lose the ability to recover continuous longitudinal motion. This paper presents DGV-DLIVO, a degeneracy-guided visual fusion for direct LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry for extreme tunnel environments. Instead of treating vision as a general complementary sensor, the proposed method exploits the LiDAR-degenerate direction as an active guidance signal to determine informative visual regions, establish LiDAR-anchored visual associations, and perform subspace-selective fusion. The visual constraints are introduced only into the deficient motion subspace, while unreliable LiDAR information in the same direction is adaptively suppressed and reliable geometric constraints are preserved. Real-world experiments in hydropower tunnels demonstrate that representative state-of-the-art LIO, LIVO, and VIO methods suffer from stagnation, oscillation, severe under-travel, curved drift, or divergence, whereas DGV-DLIVO maintains continuous and directionally consistent tunnel-axis motion estimation under both cart-mounted and handheld acquisition. It achieves a 91.4% progress ratio over the 40m tunnel sequence and significantly improves longitudinal recovery and trajectory stability. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of degeneracy-guided adaptive fusion for robotic inspection in severely degraded underground environments. The source code and a supplementary video are publicly available at https://github.com/0RayZhang0/DGV-DLIVO.
summary_zh: 在长距离地下基础设施中实现可靠定位，仍是自主巡检机器人面临的一项重大挑战。在水电泄洪隧洞和排水廊道中，重复的几何结构沿隧道轴向提供的约束不足，而弱纹理和光照变化进一步削弱了视觉估计的稳定性。在这种耦合退化条件下，现有的LiDAR-惯性及视觉-惯性里程计系统可能丧失恢复连续纵向运动的能力。本文提出了DGV-DLIVO，一种面向极端隧道环境的退化引导式视觉融合直接LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计算法。该方法并非将视觉视为通用互补传感器，而是利用LiDAR退化方向作为主动引导信号，以确定信息丰富的视觉区域、建立以LiDAR为锚点的视觉关联，并执行子空间选择性融合。视觉约束仅被引入到存在缺陷的运动子空间中，同时在该方向上不可靠的LiDAR信息被自适应抑制，而可靠的几何约束得以保留。在水电隧洞中的实际实验中，代表性的最新LIO、LIVO和VIO方法分别出现了停滞、振荡、严重欠行程、弯曲漂移或发散等问题，而DGV-DLIVO在车载和手持采集两种条件下均能保持连续且方向一致的隧洞轴向运动估计。在40米隧洞序列中，该方法实现了91.4%的推进率，并显著改善了纵向恢复能力和轨迹稳定性。上述结果表明，在严重退化的地下环境中，退化引导的自适应融合方法对机器人巡检具有有效性。源代码和补充视频已在https://github.com/0RayZhang0/DGV-DLIVO公开提供。
tldr: DGV-DLIVO is a LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry system that uses the LiDAR-degenerate direction to guide selective visual fusion, enabling reliable longitudinal motion estimation in severely degraded tunnel environments for autonomous inspection robots.
tldr_zh: DGV-DLIVO 是一种激光-惯性-视觉里程计系统，利用激光退化方向引导选择性视觉融合，在严重退化的隧道环境中为自主巡检机器人提供可靠的纵向运动估计。

title: Seeing What Still Holds: How Waiting Control Changes Cooperative Recovery
summary: Changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods. We introduce AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework that independently varies holding references and waiting duration while keeping recovery executors frozen. A 960-execution factorial on 20 initialization seeds compares CAD-feedback and landmark-based recovery from identical post-wait physical states within each holding and waiting condition. Protected completion requires successful recovery under the declared execution constraints. At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding. Trajectory analysis localizes the main separation to grasp formation: small observation-time target residuals precede large tracking errors. Joint diagnostics and controlled interventions characterize persistent tracking constraints. On fresh seeds, gradual position reanchoring improves CAD recovery's long-wait completion by 42.5 percentage points and reduces mean complete recovery time by 6.06 s relative to registered holding. Additional evaluations with pretrained policies, handover, and a mass-matched geometry characterize holding-reference sensitivity across executors and physical regimes. These findings establish holding reference as an explicit evaluation condition for comparing visual recovery performance.
summary_zh: 在固定时长等待期间改变握持参考会逆转视觉恢复方法的排名。我们引入AuditEmbodied，一个配对的执行与轨迹评估框架，该框架在保持恢复执行器不变的同时，独立改变握持参考和等待时长。基于20个初始化种子的960次执行析因实验，在每种握持与等待条件下，从相同的等待后物理状态出发，比较基于CAD反馈的恢复与基于地标的恢复。受保护完成要求在声明的执行约束下成功完成恢复。在1秒等待且使用注册腕部参考的情况下，其受保护完成次数从注册握持下的6/40对19/40变化为仅位置握持下的34/40对22/40。轨迹分析将主要差异定位到抓取形成阶段：较小的观测时间目标残差先于较大的跟踪误差出现。联合诊断与受控干预刻画了持续存在的跟踪约束。在新种子上，渐进式位置重新锚定使CAD恢复的长等待完成率提高42.5个百分点，并将平均完整恢复时间相对于注册握持缩短6.06秒。使用预训练策略、交接任务以及质量匹配几何体的额外评估，刻画了握持参考在不同执行器与物理状态下的敏感性。这些发现确立了握持参考作为比较视觉恢复性能的显式评估条件。
tldr: This paper introduces AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework, demonstrating that changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 AuditEmbodied，一个成对执行与轨迹评估框架，证明在固定时长等待中改变保持参考会颠倒视觉恢复方法的排名。

title: FailureGen: Scalable Robot Failure Data Generation with World Models
summary: Robot failures are difficult to collect at scale, limiting the range of failure scenarios represented in robot learning datasets. We present FailureGen, a method for generating synthetic videos with temporal event annotations by reusing action trajectories from recorded failures. The method comprises four stages: (1) fine-tuning an action-conditioned Cosmos world model on successful and failed real executions; (2) annotating source recordings to identify failure-associated donor segments and compatible successful hosts; (3) transferring donor motion into host contexts, with optional spatial offsets, to generate continuous video rollouts; and (4) annotating and filtering the generated samples according to observed events and visual quality. We study two implementations with different tasks and robot configurations, with visual failure detection serving as one downstream application. In a preliminary comparison, a detector trained on real and generated data achieves an average precision of 0.51, compared with 0.41 using real data alone, and detects 33 of 36 failure intervals, compared with 28 of 36. By reusing observed failures in additional contexts, FailureGen expands the data available for studying robot failures and developing downstream learning methods.
summary_zh: 机器人的失败案例难以大规模收集，这限制了机器人学习数据集中所能涵盖的失败场景范围。我们提出了FailureGen，一种通过复用已记录失败中的动作轨迹来生成带有时间事件标注的合成视频的方法。该方法包括四个阶段：（1）在真实执行的成功与失败数据上对动作条件的Cosmos世界模型进行微调；（2）对源记录进行标注，以识别与失败相关的供体片段和兼容的成功宿主；（3）将供体运动迁移到宿主情境中，并可选择性地加入空间偏移，以生成连续的视频展开；（4）根据观察到的事件和视觉质量对生成的样本进行标注和筛选。我们针对不同任务和机器人配置研究了两种实现方式，并将视觉失败检测作为下游应用之一。在一项初步对比中，使用真实与生成数据训练的检测器达到了0.51的平均精度，而仅使用真实数据时为0.41；在36个失败区间中检测到33个，而仅用真实数据时检测到28个。通过在更多情境中复用观察到的失败案例，FailureGen扩展了可用于研究机器人失败以及开发下游学习方法的数据集。
tldr: FailureGen generates synthetic robot failure videos with temporal annotations by fine-tuning an action-conditioned world model on real failure data and reusing failure motion in new contexts, improving downstream visual failure detection.
tldr_zh: FailureGen通过在世界模型上微调真实失败数据并在新情境中复用失败运动来生成带时间注释的合成机器人失败视频，从而提升下游视觉故障检测。

title: Beyond Episodic Recall: Experience-to-Knowledge Evolution for Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Lifelong embodied navigation requires agents to accumulate experience through continuous interaction and reuse it for subsequent goal searches. Existing memory-enhanced methods typically retain historical observations or construct structured scene representations. However, storing observations or high-dimensional semantic embeddings incurs growing storage costs. Meanwhile, structured representations support retrieval and semantic reasoning but do not explicitly evolve accumulated experience into environment-specific knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose Experience-Evolving Memory (EvoNav), a novel two-timescale memory framework. It organizes semantic observations, spatial relations, and task-feedback cues into sparse experience atoms. During online operation, experience atoms continually consolidate repeated observations and form dynamic links based on transitions. At the slower timescale, EvoNav distills accumulated category co-occurrences and feedback signals into environment-specific structural knowledge without relying on predefined object--room relations. For each new goal, EvoNav combines direct goal evidence from experience atoms with learned structural knowledge to guide goal-directed search on the current traversability map. Experiments on single-goal, sequential multi-floor, and multimodal navigation demonstrate effective experience reuse and improved path efficiency with compact persistent memory, together with successful transfer to a real robot.
summary_zh: 终身具身导航要求智能体通过持续交互积累经验，并将其复用于后续的目标搜索。现有的记忆增强方法通常保留历史观测或构建结构化的场景表示。然而，存储观测或高维语义嵌入会带来不断增长的存储开销。同时，结构化表示虽支持检索和语义推理，但并未将积累的经验显式演化为针对特定环境的知识。为解决上述局限，我们提出了经验演化记忆（EvoNav），一种新颖的双时间尺度记忆框架。该框架将语义观测、空间关系和任务反馈线索组织为稀疏的经验原子。在线运行过程中，经验原子不断整合重复出现的观测，并基于状态转移形成动态链接。在较慢的时间尺度上，EvoNav 将积累的类别共现信息和反馈信号蒸馏为针对特定环境的结构化知识，无需依赖预定义的物体–房间关系。对于每个新目标，EvoNav 结合来自经验原子的直接目标证据与学得的结构化知识，引导在当前可通行地图上进行目标导向搜索。在单目标、顺序多层及多模态导航任务上的实验表明，该方法在紧凑的持久记忆条件下实现了有效的经验复用和路径效率提升，并成功迁移至真实机器人平台。
tldr: The paper proposes EvoNav, a two-timescale memory framework that evolves sparse experience atoms into environment-specific structural knowledge for lifelong embodied navigation, leading to compact memory and improved path efficiency with real-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出EvoNav，一个双时间尺度记忆框架，将稀疏的经验原子演化为环境特定的结构化知识，用于终身具身导航，实现紧凑记忆和路径效率提升，并成功迁移到真实机器人。

title: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
summary: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.
summary_zh: 物理智能体在失去视野或接触后，必须利用先前看到或触碰到的信息。它们的行为改变了这些记忆事实的含义。我们引入了可执行感知记忆（EPM），这是一种世界模型框架，在想象过程中将显式感知状态与神经潜在动态并行推进。其不断演化的读取结果用于信息奖励预测、价值估计和策略学习。我们将奖励输入与产生这些奖励的转移对齐，并在记录动作的开环 rollout 上监督奖励头。在 Memory Maze \(13\times13\) 中，EPM 在 100 万次交互时达到 30.37 的回报，而相同演化读取结果仅用于共同感知前端上的策略和价值时为 23.37：增益为 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]。完整方法还改善了 \(9\times9\) 和 MiniWorld 中的控制。对记忆中的、视野外到达的探测显示，两种视觉实现中奖励预期均更强。集中注意力、触觉恢复和真实触觉帧展示了记忆事实在想象策略训练、运动依赖决策和感觉内容保留中的互补作用。EPM 将持久感知与物理 AI 世界模型的预测后果和学习信号连接起来。
tldr: This paper introduces executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that maintains explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics, improving reward prediction and policy learning in Memory Maze and MiniWorld benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出可执行感知记忆（EPM），一种世界模型框架，在神经潜动态之外维护显式感知状态，从而改进奖励预测和策略学习，在Memory Maze和MiniWorld基准上取得提升。

title: When the World Is the Test Suite: Agentic Intelligence for the Physical World
summary: Coding agents built to repair software now write, test, and repair programs for robots, laboratories, and industrial controllers. Unlike in software engineering, no test suite comes with the code. Whether a program works must be established by running it on a robot, in a physics simulator, or through the policies it helps to train, and such evidence is costly to obtain and can itself be wrong. As these agents take on more physical tasks, how their programs are judged matters as much as how they are written. This paper examines this emerging area, agentic intelligence for the physical world, by treating the world as the program's test suite. We organize the discussion around three questions: how agents write programs for the physical world, how these programs are tested, and how agents learn from the results. We first trace how language models for robots and software engineering agents came together, ask which software testing practices carry over to physical tests, and describe each program by where it sits relative to the actuator and by what judges it. For writing, we cover programs that act as robot policies and programs that support policy learning by producing rewards, tasks, and training worlds. For testing, we examine what physical trials cost, what traces, learned judges, simulators, and formal checks can establish in their place, and what safety requires beyond task success. For learning, we discuss how tested programs are retained as experience, in skill libraries and in model weights. Finally, we turn to benchmarks and evaluation practice and outline open challenges. Writing programs is becoming cheap, while trustworthy evidence about what they do remains costly. Progress will therefore depend on a physical counterpart of continuous integration: verification cheap enough to run often, reliable enough to trust under search, and maintained alongside the experience it validates.
summary_zh: 专为软件修复而构建的编码智能体，如今已能编写、测试并修复用于机器人、实验室及工业控制器的程序。与软件工程不同，这些代码并不附带测试套件。程序能否正常运行，必须通过在机器人上运行、在物理模拟器中测试，或通过其协助训练的策略来加以验证，而这类证据的获取成本高昂，且其本身也可能存在错误。随着这些智能体承担越来越多的物理任务，其程序的评判方式与编写方式同等重要。本文通过将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，审视了这一新兴领域——面向物理世界的智能体智能。我们围绕三个问题组织讨论：智能体如何为物理世界编写程序，这些程序如何被测试，以及智能体如何从结果中学习。我们首先追溯了面向机器人的语言模型与软件工程智能体是如何融合的，探讨了哪些软件测试实践可迁移至物理测试，并根据程序相对于执行器的位置及其评判者，对每类程序进行了描述。在编写方面，我们涵盖了充当机器人策略的程序，以及通过生成奖励、任务和训练环境来支持策略学习的程序。在测试方面，我们考察了物理试验的成本，以及轨迹数据、学习型评判者、模拟器和形式化检查能替代物理试验确立何种结论，并探讨了安全要求超越任务成功之外的方面。在学习方面，我们讨论了经过测试的程序如何作为经验被保留，存储于技能库和模型权重之中。最后，我们转向基准测试与评估实践，并概述了尚待解决的挑战。编写程序正变得日益廉价，而关于程序行为之可信证据的获取依然代价高昂。因此，进展将依赖于物理世界对应物般的持续集成机制：一种廉价到足以频繁运行、可靠到足以在搜索中信任，并与其所验证的经验同步维护的验证方式。
tldr: This paper surveys the emerging area of agentic intelligence for the physical world, where AI agents write programs for robots and physical systems, and proposes treating the world as the test suite, examining how these programs are written, tested, and learned from, ultimately advocating for a physical counterpart to continuous integration for verification.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了物理世界代理智能这一新兴领域，其中AI代理为机器人和物理系统编写程序，并提议将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，探讨了程序的编写、测试和学习方式，最终倡导建立一种物理世界的持续集成验证方法。

title: ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline
summary: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.
summary_zh: 全身运动追踪技术已实现了人形机器人舞蹈、运动动作及远程操作，为能力展示与操作数据采集奠定了基础。然而，现有追踪策略缺乏对附近人类的感知和主动避让能力，而动作替代与基于局部约束的修正方式可能损害参考动作的完整性和追踪连续性。我们提出了ALERT，一种通用的轻量级流水线，用于将运动追踪扩展至人机共享环境。通过轻量化适配，该框架将人类感知与主动避让整合进预训练追踪策略中，在避让需求与参考动作追踪之间实现平衡，同时保留现有运动能力。跨追踪骨干网络的仿真与真实世界实验表明，该方法通过局部化的人类避让实现了可靠的免碰撞执行，保持了全身协调性，并能快速恢复参考动作追踪，同时保留了预训练策略追踪未见动作的能力。
tldr: ALERT introduces a lightweight, general pipeline that equips pretrained humanoid whole-body tracking policies with human perception and proactive avoidance for collision-free operation in shared spaces, preserving tracking performance across diverse backbones.
tldr_zh: ALERT 提出了一种轻量级通用管线，为人形全身跟踪策略添加人类感知与主动避让能力，实现在人机共享空间中的无碰撞执行，并保持原有跟踪性能。

title: DailyBrick: Language-Guided Synthesis of Brick Assembly Instructions
summary: Generating a LEGO model from a user request is more than a plausible 3D shape generation. LEGO models require physical support per brick, and each brick should be placed unblocked. Current methods address this issue by training an expert large language model. We reduce the problem of generating extremely long context on all brick connections to that of writing a program that builds LEGO models like a human, considering each intermediate step could be executed. We introduce DailyBrick , a multi-stage agentic system that produces a LEGO model together with a brick-by-brick assembly instruction for human building and robot assembly. We design a multi-stage harness with roles to help LLMs generate more effectively. A versioned construction SDK compiles multi-level decisions, from semantic subparts to individual bricks, into canonical operations. An external Meta-Reviewer agent replays and inspects the generated package, verifies the model and its construction process, identifies failures, traces them to the responsible stage, and routes them to bounded repairs or to editable candidates for later skill or tool updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DailyBrick generates LEGO models based on simple user requests better than recent agentic systems, and show its utility in downstream applications such as robot manipulations on model assembly from instructions and brick sets (https://SpatialAgent.github.io/DailyBrick/).
summary_zh: 根据用户请求生成乐高模型不仅仅是生成一个合理的3D形状。乐高模型要求每块积木都能获得物理支撑，并且每块积木都应无遮挡地放置。现有方法通过训练专家级大语言模型来解决这一问题。我们将生成所有积木连接关系的超长上下文问题，简化为编写一个像人类一样构建乐高模型的程序，并考虑每个中间步骤都可执行。我们提出了DailyBrick，一个多阶段智能体系统，它能够生成乐高模型，同时提供逐块拼装的装配说明，供人类搭建和机器人组装使用。我们设计了一个多阶段框架并赋予各阶段不同角色，以帮助大语言模型更高效地生成内容。一个版本化的构建SDK将多级决策——从语义子部件到单个积木——编译为规范化操作。一个外部元评审智能体对整个生成包进行回放和检查，验证模型及其构建过程，识别故障，追踪故障来源至相应阶段，并将其引导至有界修复或可供后续技能/工具更新的可编辑候选项。大量实验表明，DailyBrick在基于简单用户请求生成乐高模型方面优于近期智能体系统，并展示了其在从说明和积木套装中进行模型组装的机器人操控等下游应用中的实用性（https://SpatialAgent.github.io/DailyBrick/）。
tldr: DailyBrick is a multi-stage agentic system that uses LLMs to generate LEGO models with brick-by-brick assembly instructions, verified by a Meta-Reviewer agent, and demonstrates utility in robot manipulation for assembly.
tldr_zh: DailyBrick 是一个多阶段智能体系统，利用 LLM 生成 LEGO 模型及逐步组装说明，并通过 Meta-Reviewer 代理验证，展示了在机器人操纵组装中的实用性。

title: Low-speed Limit Cycle Walking of Planar X-shaped Bipedal Robot with Special Properties
summary: This paper proposes a novel planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot in which the center of mass of each leg link is at the same position as the hip joint, and discusses a method for generating a stable limit cycle gait on level ground. First, we outline the assumptions of the robot model with four degrees of freedom, and develop the mathematical equations of motion and collision. Second, we set the relative hip-joint angle as a control output and design a control system to follow it to the desired trajectory specified as a fifth-order function of time. Third, we mathematically show that there are special properties: the angular velocity of the swing leg does not change before and after the collision, and the time-integral of the control input becomes zero in a steady gait. We also mathematically show that the model has the feature that approximate linearization is effective and the antigravity effect of semicircular feet can be utilized. Through numerical simulations, we verify the validity of the theoretical results, and analyze some fundamental gait properties such as convergence speed and mechanical energy restoration.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的平面半圆足X型双足机器人，其每条腿连杆的质心与髋关节位于同一位置，并探讨了在水平地面上生成稳定极限环步态的方法。首先，我们概述了具有四个自由度的机器人模型的假设，并建立了运动方程和碰撞方程的数学表达式。其次，我们将相对髋关节角设定为控制输出，并设计了一个控制系统，使其跟踪一条以时间为自变量的五次函数形式的目标轨迹。第三，我们从数学上证明了若干特殊性质：摆动腿在碰撞前后的角速度不变，且在稳定步态中控制输入的时间积分为零。我们还从数学上证明了该模型具有近似线性化有效的特性，并能利用半圆足的抗重力效应。通过数值仿真，我们验证了理论结果的有效性，并分析了收敛速度、机械能恢复等基本步态特性。
tldr: This paper presents a planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot with special mass distribution, and shows how to generate a stable limit cycle gait with a designed controller, proving several unique properties such as unchanged swing-leg angular velocity at collision and zero time-integral control input in steady gait, verified by numerical simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种具有特殊质量分布的平面半圆足X形双足机器人，并展示了通过设计的控制器生成稳定极限环步态的方法，证明了碰撞前后摆动腿角速度不变及稳态步态中控制输入时间积分为零等特殊性质，并通过数值仿真验证了理论结果。

title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
summary: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.
summary_zh: 车辆尺寸和动力系统信息可以丰富用于交通分析和仿真的轨迹数据。我们提出了VTT，一个用于从未见过的汽车模型中通过运动信号和控制器区域网络（CAN）信号识别这些属性的数据集和基准。该数据集包含来自1,431辆汽车和174种车型的9,062次行驶记录，总计约3,950小时。它提供了三种基于足迹的尺寸类别、动力系统标签，并评估了在未见车型和未见驾驶员上的表现。使用60秒窗口，我们比较了四种序列架构、统计特征以及由大型语言模型提出的物理特征。通过辅助物理目标训练、数据增强和任务特定加权，纯电动汽车与燃油车的驾驶级宏F1分数提升至92.6-93.0%，尺寸分类的宏F1分数从62.9%提升至67.1%。在来自额外4,061名驾驶员的公开日志上，全输入模型在88种车型中正确识别了86种车型的动力系统；尺寸分类准确率为63.2%，接近内部车型级结果63.5%。物理特征分析将动力系统识别与减速行为相关联，将尺寸识别与转向响应相关联。尺寸类别边界附近的误差以及更长观测时间带来的有限增益，凸显了标签分辨率和训练车队覆盖范围对跨车型泛化的重要性。
tldr: The paper introduces VTT, a dataset and benchmark for classifying vehicle size and powertrain type from motion and CAN signals across unseen car models, achieving high accuracy for powertrain classification and providing insights into cross-model generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了VTT，一个从运动轨迹和CAN信号中跨未见车型分类车辆尺寸和动力总成类型的数据集和基准，在动力总成分类上取得了高准确率，并探讨了跨模型泛化问题。

title: SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping
summary: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了SE(3)-LIVOM系统，该系统在IROS 2026 COMFORT挑战赛中荣获总冠军。该挑战要求生成GrandTour数据集中腿式机器人的轨迹，场景包括坍塌建筑、施工场地和雪地。SE(3)-LIVOM利用两个激光雷达、一个相机和一个惯性测量单元实时运行。其前端将SE(3)-LIO扩展至多激光雷达和相机配置，自适应降采样使得各场景内及跨场景的单次扫描处理时间保持在约35毫秒。在线后端通过子地图平面光束法平差和增量位姿图校正漂移。系统在统一配置下，于六个测试场景中达到了平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）1.40厘米的精度。代码已开源，见https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort。
tldr: SE(3)-LIVOM presents an adaptive multi-LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry and mapping system that won the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026, achieving centimeter-level trajectory accuracy on a legged robot in diverse challenging environments.
tldr_zh: SE(3)-LIVOM 提出了一种自适应多激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计与建图系统，在 IROS 2026 的 COMFORT 挑战赛中获得冠军，在多种复杂环境中为腿式机器人实现了厘米级的轨迹精度。

title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor
summary: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. Both models read the network and analysed the closed loop with control theory correctly, and Fable's repair without simulation succeeded only occasionally. With simulated feedback, both models repaired the trained network in single sessions and wrote a working controller from zero weights, whereas from zero the evolution strategy found none. The controllers written from zero were sparse and in a classical cascaded structure; one model edited the trained network while the other replaced it. Gradient descent reached higher accuracy with far more simulation, and all language model controllers steered the real tractor without intervention, with errors of the same order as pure pursuit. Language models can program the weights of a neural controller directly, much as control engineers design one. We call this Weight-Space Engineering.
summary_zh: 权重空间编程是一种过程，其中大型语言模型直接读取和写入神经网络的权重，根据自然语言规范进行引导，无需优化器或梯度下降。本研究将其应用于自动拖拉机导航，其中包含253个参数的神经网络沿直线和弧线路径转向，并需在机器变化时进行调整，例如转向执行器变慢的情况。GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1（以及5.2）利用少量模拟评估预算，为我们的研究拖拉机编辑网络，修复为另一台拖拉机训练的网络，并将控制器写入权重为零的网络中。我们将它们与进化策略、梯度下降和纯追踪在仿真及真实拖拉机上进行了比较。两个模型均正确读取了网络，并用控制理论分析了闭环，而Fable在无模拟情况下的修复仅偶尔成功。借助模拟反馈，两个模型均在单次会话中修复了训练好的网络，并从零权重编写了可工作的控制器，而进化策略从零开始则未能找到任何控制器。从零编写的控制器结构稀疏，采用经典级联结构；一个模型编辑了训练好的网络，而另一个模型则替换了它。梯度下降以多得多的模拟达到了更高的精度，且所有语言模型控制器均无需干预即可操控真实拖拉机，误差与纯追踪处于同一量级。语言模型可以直接编程神经控制器的权重，如同控制工程师设计控制器一样。我们称此为“权重空间工程”。
tldr: This paper introduces weight-space programming, where LLMs directly edit neural network weights for a tractor guidance controller, achieving real-world steering without gradient descent.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了权重空间编程，让大语言模型直接修改拖拉机导航控制器的神经网络权重，无需梯度下降即可实现真实世界的转向控制。

title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
summary: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.
summary_zh: 通过模仿训练的机器人策略，在训练环境与物体之外的情境中泛化能力较差。已发表的数据扩展研究表明，泛化能力随训练环境和物体多样性的增加而提升，而非依赖于每个环境中的更多演示次数。跨多个环境收集机器人数据成本高昂，而在现实世界中大规模记录以自我为中心的人类视频则是可行的；然而，现有以自我为中心的视频大多展示日常生活中的活动，较少包含真实工作场景中的熟练操作。我们提出了HubEgo-100K，一个为多样性而构建的数据集。本版本论文涵盖首次发布v1.0：包含10,124小时的1080p自我中心视频，以及来自单台头戴式手机摄像头的同步100 Hz惯性测量单元数据。在v1.0中，12,227名贡献者记录了他们在15,548个环境中的即兴工作（每个贡献者拥有自己所属的一类环境，如厨房或车间），覆盖11种环境类型、30个工作类别、56种任务类型和35种动作族，其中83%的时长为工作场景视频。该数据集包含72,754个片段，附有机器生成的动作和语言标注，以LeRobot和MCAP格式提供，并遵循CC BY 4.0许可协议。我们沿各维度衡量了多样性，表明在v1.0中，即使片段为随机顺序，新的贡献者和词汇仍不断出现，并将这些测量结果与已发表的关于六种与策略性能相关的数据属性的证据进行了关联，包括手部可见性和惯性感知。我们还记录了数据收集、整理、隐私保护措施和数据格式，并提供了数据表。后续版本的论文将添加基准测试，并逐步扩展至100,000小时的数据发布。
tldr: HubEgo-100K is a large-scale egocentric video dataset of skilled work in real workplaces, designed to improve the diversity of robot learning data and support imitation learning generalization.
