summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）会预测场景将如何演变，并依据这一预测到的未来来调整其动作。将其部署在机器人的机载计算机上，需要4比特的权重、激活值和键值缓存（W4A4KV4）。现有的面向WAMs的4比特量化器能保留生成的动作，并逐步（每去噪一步）估计敏感性。然而，它们未能保留所预测未来的保真度：一旦动作通路得到保护，剩余的动作误差便主要经由一个退化的未来进入系统，而现有方法均未主动保护这一未来。为此，我们提出LAQ，一种潜在感知的量化框架，在未来的写入、存储和读取之处均保持其保真度。具体而言，我们引入了一个阅读器度量，通过未来误差对动作的影响来衡量未来误差，以及一个读取次数度量，将每个舍入误差按其被读取的去噪步数进行加权。二者共同为激活值和缓存上的精度分配提供了闭式解。我们进一步开发了注视引导的精化机制，使动作所关注的令牌在去噪循环和缓存中获得第二次4比特处理。所有权重保持4比特，无高精度分支，无需逐任务重新校准。在LIBERO-Plus基准上，LAQ在Fast-WAM和Cosmos-Policy上分别达到76.4%和83.3%的平均成功率，与16比特模型相差在1.2个百分点以内，且均高于使用16比特KV缓存的基线方法。其将模型压缩3.8倍，将整个策略的峰值GPU内存降低2.3倍，运行速度比16比特模型快1.66倍。在真实的AgileX PiPER机械臂上，其在三个任务中达到47.0%的平均成功率，而16比特模型为52.0%，且比QuaRot高出30.0个百分点。
tldr: This paper introduces LAQ, a latent-aware quantization framework for world action models that preserves the predicted future by using a reader metric and read count to allocate precision, achieving near-16-bit performance on the LIBERO-Plus benchmark and a real robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LAQ，一种针对世界动作模型的潜在感知量化框架，通过读者度量和读取计数来保留预测的未来，在LIBERO-Plus基准和真实机器人手臂上实现了接近16位性能。

title: Bradley-Terry Training Can Distort Outcome Probabilities of Initially Accurate Language World Models
summary: Comparative feedback, in which a judge says which of two candidate outcomes is closer to what happened, is a practical way to train language world models that assign probabilities to an action's outcomes. We show that, fitted with a Bradley-Terry objective, it need not teach the true outcome probabilities and can distort accurate ones. On a simulated robot push with enumerated outcome distributions, this objective takes a model that is accurate on unseen layouts (hazard error 2.4 percentage points, pp) and moves 33 to 43 pp of its probability onto outcomes that none of a condition's enumerated branches produces. The cause is the objective, not the comparisons: its optimum, computed before training, predicts where the model ends up, and a likelihood that knows the judge's rule learns from the same comparisons without the shift. The shift is robust: it recurs on unseen conditions, under five candidate laws and a three-fold denser enumeration, and about 29 pp remain without the physically impossible events. Its cost is conditional: with those events it inflates hazard probabilities, and a threshold inherited from the pre-feedback model costs about 3 pp of utility per decision on trained and 1 to 2 pp on unseen conditions, through false rejects; without them the utility loss averages below 1 pp over six seeds, though a small regret in action choice remains. Audits of readout, response and decision trace the effect from probabilities to actions.
summary_zh: 比较反馈是一种实用的语言世界模型训练方式，在该模型中，评判者会指出两个候选结果中哪一个更接近实际发生的情况，从而使模型能够为行动的结果分配概率。我们证明，若采用布拉德利-特里目标函数，这一方法未必能教会模型真实的结果概率，甚至可能扭曲原本准确的概率。在一项基于枚举结果分布的模拟机器人推操作任务中，该目标函数使一个在未见布局上表现准确的模型（危险误差为2.4个百分点）将其33至43个百分点的概率转移至某一条件所枚举分支均不会产生的结果上。问题的根源在于目标函数本身，而非比较数据：其最优解在训练前即可计算得出，并能预测模型的最终状态；而一个知晓评判者规则的似然函数则能从相同的比较数据中学习，却不会发生概率偏移。该偏移具有稳健性：它在未见条件、五种候选法则以及三倍密集的枚举设置下反复出现，即便排除物理上不可能的事件后，仍约有29个百分点的偏移残留。其代价是条件性的：当存在这些不可能事件时，它会抬高危险概率；而源自反馈前模型的阈值在训练条件下每决策造成约3个百分点的效用损失，在未见条件下造成约1至2个百分点的损失，主要体现为错误拒绝；若排除这些事件，则在六个随机种子下效用损失平均低于1个百分点，尽管在行动选择上仍存在较小的遗憾。对读数、响应和决策的审计揭示了从概率到行动的效应传导路径。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that Bradley-Terry training on comparative feedback can distort the outcome probabilities of language world models, moving significant probability mass away from true outcomes, even when the initial model is accurate. The distortion is traced to the training objective and can degrade downstream decisions in a simulated robot push task.
tldr_zh: 本文表明，在成对比较反馈上使用 Bradley-Terry 目标训练语言世界模型，会扭曲其输出概率，即使初始模型准确，也会将大量概率质量从真实结果移开。该失真源于训练目标，并会在模拟机器人推操作任务中损害下游决策。

title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
summary: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.
summary_zh: 规则决定了玩家行为如何改变交互式世界。在相似的场景与动作空间中，不同的规则会营造出截然不同的游戏体验。为了实现可定制的游戏玩法，生成式世界模型必须遵循用户自定义的规则，而不仅仅局限于真实世界的行为。然而，实现用户自定义规则面临两大挑战：规则-状态持久化（Rule-State Persistence）与规则到视觉的实现（Rule-to-Visual Realization）。前者要求在保存与加载过程中保留规则定义、依赖关系及世界状态，使得恢复后的世界仍遵循既定规则。后者则要求在指定对象和属性上准确实现规则引发的变更，尤其是在受影响对象尚未可见的情况下。本文提出WorldRuler，它通过可执行的3D规则图组织规则定义、依赖关系及对象状态，并将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈连接成闭环。该规则图支持规则与世界状态的联合保存与恢复，同时，动态对象绑定将规则指定的实体锚定到视觉实例中，并利用存储的状态从其首次出现起便约束生成过程。我们进一步引入对象属性状态替换与反事实重建训练，在实现对属性精确控制的同时，生成兼容的外观与运动变化，并尽量减少对无关内容的干扰。我们利用GTA-V和Habitat构建了自动化数据采集与标注流程，创建了RuleVerse数据集，其中包含带有详细状态与事件标注的规则驱动交互样本，并涵盖了规则在受影响对象可见之前便已生效的情形。大量实验证明了WorldRuler在保存与加载过程中保持规则与状态一致性，以及在指定对象和属性上准确实现规则结果方面的有效性。
tldr: WorldRuler introduces an executable 3D rule graph and closed-loop rule execution with video generation, enabling world models to follow user-defined rules across saving/loading and accurately apply state changes to designated objects, even when unseen. They construct the RuleVerse dataset and demonstrate effectiveness in preserving rule-state consistency and realizing rule outcomes.
tldr_zh: WorldRuler通过可执行的3D规则图和规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈的闭环，使世界模型能遵循用户自定义规则，在保存/加载时保持规则与状态一致性，并准确将规则效果应用到指定对象（即使未见）。作者构建了RuleVerse数据集并验证了其有效性。

title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
summary: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.
summary_zh: 最近，视频世界模型推进了交互式生成的发展，其中大型模型提供更高质量，而小型模型则实现更快的推理速度。现有的投机方法通过快速草稿生成和基于解码帧奖励的选择性目标再生成，结合了二者的优势。然而，验证仅覆盖外部评分器的评估维度，并增加了解码和评分成本。此外，这些分数不提供修正功能，对于被拒绝的草稿需要进行昂贵的目标再生成。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了投机世界模型（Speculative World Model，SpecWM），一个统一的、无需训练的流式世界模型推理框架。该方法利用目标的潜在速度场对草稿块进行验证。验证过程还会产生可复用的修正信息；两个阈值分别选择接受（Accept）、精炼（Refine）或拒绝（Reject）。具体而言，单步精炼复用该信息以提升感知质量，而三步精炼则增强相机跟随和轨迹一致性。这些发现促使我们提出过渡感知的精炼策略。在WBench导航基准上，SpecWM以1.63倍于目标模型的速度提升了视觉质量，并将导航分数（NavScore）从草稿模型的75.99提升至85.63，实现了质量-速度-控制的最佳权衡。此外，我们提出的LongSpecBench基准表明，在长序列多轮生成中，模型能保持持续的质量和控制能力；同时，在Hy-Nomas上的实验验证了SpecWM在不同骨干网络和去噪预算下的有效性。
tldr: SpecWM is a training-free inference framework that accelerates streaming world models by using the target model's latent velocity field to verify draft chunks, converting verification signals into corrections for refinement, achieving better quality-speed trade-offs in navigation generation.
tldr_zh: SpecWM 提出了一种无需训练的推理框架，通过利用目标模型的潜在速度场验证草稿块，并将验证信号转化为修正用于细化，从而在导航生成中实现更好的质量-速度权衡。

title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
summary: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.
summary_zh: 摘要：路侧激光雷达探测器在真实标签上训练成本高昂，而数字孪生有望替代这些标签，但在孪生环境中训练的探测器在真实场景中会遇到不同的传感器、不同的物体以及不同的标注规范。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（IEEE BigData 2026杯，综合得分0.5541）LUMPI赛道中排名第一、在其V2X-Real赛道中排名第五（得分0.8102）的处理流程。每个探测器均为CenterPoint模型，仅使用合成数据训练，运行在单块8 GB笔记本GPU上。大部分增益来自于修正孪生环境与真实场景之间的差异，而非探测器本身。我们将孪生环境的坐标、点密度和框标注规范与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生环境缺失的行人和骑行人员，并将街道杂乱物作为未标注负样本加入，同时按真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生物体。一种无需学习的重采样方法，将未标注真实帧的逐单元点密度对齐后，将LUMPI真实感得分从0.589提升至0.947，而真实帧之间的得分为0.949。随后，无需标签的后处理利用了固定路侧传感器所具有的特性：静态结构在每帧中重复出现，真实物体具有特征性的点统计特征。通过并排报告每个组件在验证集和测试集上的增益，我们发现对系统性的仿真到真实差异的修正能够迁移到测试集，通常保留其验证增益的四分之一至四分之三，而针对验证集中少量物体所做的选择则无法迁移。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline for sim-to-real roadside LiDAR detection using only synthetic digital-twin data, winning the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge. It focuses on correcting systematic differences between the digital twin and real sensor (coordinate alignment, point density, box conventions, generating missing object classes) rather than improving the detector, and shows that component gains validated on a small set transfer to the test set when they address systematic sim-to-real gaps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种仅使用合成数字孪生数据进行路边LiDAR检测的仿真到真实管道，并在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛中赢得LUMPI赛道。其核心在于修正数字孪生与真实传感器之间的系统性差异（如坐标对齐、点密度、框约定、生成缺失目标类别），而非改进检测器，并证明针对系统性差异的组件在验证集上的增益能有效迁移到测试集。

title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
summary: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.
summary_zh: 当风暴可能向北或向南移动时，预测其中间路径在均方误差下可能比任一台理路径得分更高。这一悖论同样出现在视频生成器作为世界模型进行测试时：更少的去噪步骤可以提升物理学评分，即使视频变得模糊或过早停止运动。原因何在？Physics-IQ将每个生成视频与一段真实记录进行比较，尽管一个场景可能存在多种有效的未来走向。精确分解表明，该评分可能奖励生成未来之间变异性的减少，即使其分布变得不那么准确。我们引入核Physics-IQ，以在期望意义上消除这一激励，仅需每种条件下的两个独立样本。两步采样在所有五种图像到视频模型中均降低了核Physics-IQ。对于CogVideoX，官方评分上升了0.055，而我们的评分则下降了0.131。改变采样调度方案揭示了官方评分所遗漏的进一步差异。在结果概率已知的受控物理系统中，我们的指标倾向于真实分布而非坍缩预测。简而言之，世界模型的评判标准不应仅在于某个视频与实际发生情况的匹配程度，还在于其预测忠实呈现可能发生的多种情况的能力。
tldr: This paper analyzes why fewer denoising steps can inflate physics benchmark scores for video-based world models, showing that the official Physics-IQ metric rewards reduced variation in generated futures. It introduces Kernel Physics-IQ, which requires two independent samples per condition to remove this incentive, and demonstrates that it favors accurate distributions over collapsed predictions across several image-to-video models.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了为什么在视频世界模型的物理基准测试中，较少的去噪步骤可能提高分数，表明官方Physics-IQ指标奖励生成未来的减少变异性。提出了Kernel Physics-IQ，每个条件仅需两个独立样本即可消除这一激励，并在多个图像到视频模型中证明了它倾向于准确的分布而非坍缩的预测。

title: Physical Laws without Physics Loss? Probing Learned Dynamics in Video World Models through Forced Response
summary: Do video world models learn physical laws without a physics loss, or merely imitate motion? Overall motion and appearance scores cannot settle it. We investigate this through nonlinear forced response: an excitation shakes the support of a suspended object. We introduce dual visual-numeric conditioning and adapt six image-to-video backbones to predict this motion using only the flow-matching loss. Wan predicts motion accurately and generalizes to unseen excitations, objects, poses, and scenes. Counterfactual tests suggest capabilities beyond replaying training videos. But what laws have they learned? We design three tiers of tests using Taylor expansions of the dynamics and geometry. All six reproduce the linear response, including resonance; five capture higher-order dynamics, including nonlinear softening. Remarkably, softening is barely present in training: only 0.74% of the swing's squared displacement. Extensions to a double pendulum and a rocking block show sustained dynamics are learned more faithfully than brief impacts. Yet learned dynamics may fail to appear when state estimation or propagation goes wrong. We turn these tests and findings into strategies to improve video training and generation.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型能否在不借助物理损失函数的情况下学习物理规律，抑或仅仅是在模仿运动？整体运动与外观评分无法回答这一问题。我们通过非线性受迫响应对此展开研究：一种激励扰动悬挂物体的支撑结构。我们引入了视觉-数值双重条件化机制，并改造了六种图像到视频的基础模型，仅使用流匹配损失来预测该运动。Wan模型能够准确预测运动，并泛化至未见过的激励、物体、姿态及场景。反事实测试表明，其能力超越了简单地回放训练视频。但模型究竟学到了何种规律？我们依据动力学与几何的泰勒展开设计了三层测试。全部六种模型均能再现线性响应，包括共振现象；其中五种能够捕捉高阶动力学，包括非线性软化效应。值得注意的是，软化效应在训练数据中几乎不存在：其仅占摆锤平方位移的0.74%。将实验扩展至双摆及摇摆块后发现，持续动力学比瞬时冲击能被更忠实地学习。然而，当状态估计或传播出现错误时，已习得的动力学可能无法显现。我们将这些测试与发现转化为改进视频训练与生成的策略。
tldr: This paper probes whether video world models learn physical laws by testing their forced response to nonlinear excitations, introducing dual visual-numeric conditioning and finding that models like Wan can generalize and exhibit nonlinear dynamics, though failures in state estimation remain.
tldr_zh: 本文通过非线性受迫响应测试视频世界模型是否学习物理规律，引入双视觉-数值条件化，发现如Wan等模型能泛化并表现出非线性动力学，但状态估计错误仍会导致失败。

title: PRIO: Pre-trained Representation for Interactive Objects in 4D Worlds
summary: 3D worlds can now be captured, reconstructed, and generated at scale, yet the objects in them stay still: a pressed pillow does not compress, and a pulled door does not swing. Bringing these objects into interactive 4D world models requires a representation of how they can move, deform, and respond physically to user actions in real time. We present PRIO, a pre-trained representation for interactive objects. Given static geometry, PRIO predicts an object-specific configuration space in a single forward pass. This space provides generalized coordinates for Lagrangian mechanics, allowing physical laws and user actions to govern motion. Configurations are linear in these coordinates, allowing the quantities needed by the dynamics to be precomputed. Dynamics then run at interactive rates without further network inference. Pre-trained on diverse 4D trajectories, PRIO learns priors over object configurations that generalize to unseen shapes. It supports meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians, bringing objects in reconstructed and generated scenes into interaction. We demonstrate its use in real-to-sim workflows and robot manipulation. In addition, compared with existing 4D generation methods, PRIO generates dynamics faster and follows user actions more faithfully.
summary_zh: 3D世界如今已能够大规模捕获、重建和生成，但其中的物体却静止不动：按压的枕头不会变形，拉动的门也不会摆动。要让这些物体进入交互式4D世界模型，需要一种能够表示它们如何移动、变形并实时对用户操作做出物理响应的机制。我们提出了PRIO——一种面向交互式物体的预训练表示方法。给定静态几何体，PRIO能在单次前向传递中预测出物体特有的构型空间。该空间为拉格朗日力学提供了广义坐标，使得物理规律和用户操作能够支配物体的运动。构型在这些坐标下呈线性关系，因此动力学所需的量可以预先计算。随后，动力学过程无需进一步的网络推理即可实现交互速率的实时运行。PRIO在多样化的4D轨迹上进行了预训练，学习到物体构型的先验知识，并能泛化到未见过的形状。它支持网格、点云和3D高斯表示，使重建和生成场景中的物体具备交互能力。我们展示了其在真实到仿真工作流以及机器人操控中的应用。此外，与现有的4D生成方法相比，PRIO生成的动态效果更快，且能更忠实于用户操作。
tldr: PRIO is a pre-trained representation that predicts object-specific configuration spaces from static geometry, enabling real-time physical interaction and dynamic simulation for objects in 3D/4D worlds, with applications to robot manipulation and real-to-sim workflows.
tldr_zh: PRIO是一种预训练表示，能从静态几何预测物体特定的配置空间，实现实时物理交互和动态模拟，应用于机器人操作和真实到仿真工作流。

title: Search or Scoring? Diagnosing Why Visual World-Model Planners Fail
summary: Visual world models such as DINO-WM and JEPA-WM plan with an optimizer that searches for actions whose predicted outcome has the lowest cost, its distance to a goal image. A plan can thus fail in two ways: the optimizer never tries a good action that the cost would prefer (a search failure), or the cost, computed on predictions, ranks a bad action first (a scoring failure). The two need different remedies, more search or a better model, but a planner does not record which one occurred. We tell them apart by executing the optimizer's candidates, scoring a known solution with the planner's own cost, and comparing costs on predicted and real outcomes. An error model explains when each arises and so how to use retrieved demonstration windows (DemoProp): start the search from them (a warm start) when prediction errors are small, and average them without the model when large errors make the optimizer pick overrated actions. Across four simulated environments and three world models, on short tasks whose goals the planner can represent, PushT and Wall fail mostly by search, while Metaworld and RoboCasa fail by scoring because the cost, sound on real outcomes (AUROC 0.94 on Metaworld), is at chance on predictions (0.54). The diagnosis tells which remedy pays off: a four times larger search lowers the real-outcome cost only where failures come from search (clearly for DINO-WM), and where they come from scoring, averaging the windows without the model solves 127 of 168 new Metaworld tasks, against at most 87 when the model chooses among them. Within PushT, degrading only the model flips which use is better, and our rule, frozen in advance, follows the flip and solves 678 of 960 new episodes, against 530 for the best fixed use.
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型（如DINO-WM和JEPA-WM）通过优化器进行规划，该优化器搜索预测结果成本最低的动作，即其与目标图像的距离。因此，规划可能以两种方式失败：优化器从未尝试成本函数本应偏好的良好动作（搜索失败），或者基于预测计算出的成本将不良动作排在了首位（评分失败）。这两种失败需要不同的补救措施——要么增加搜索，要么改进模型——但规划器并不会记录具体发生了哪一种。我们通过执行优化器的候选动作、用规划器自身的成本函数对已知解进行评分，并比较预测结果与实际结果上的成本来区分这两种失败。一个误差模型解释了每种失败何时出现，以及由此如何利用检索到的演示窗口（DemoProp）：当预测误差较小时，从这些窗口开始搜索（热启动）；当误差较大导致优化器选择被高估的动作时，则直接对窗口取平均而不依赖模型。在四个模拟环境和三种世界模型上，对于规划器能够表示目标的短任务，PushT和Wall主要因搜索失败，而Metaworld和RoboCasa则因评分失败——因为成本函数在实际结果上表现良好（Metaworld上AUROC为0.94），但在预测结果上仅相当于随机水平（0.54）。这一诊断指明了哪种补救措施有效：将搜索规模扩大四倍仅在失败源于搜索时（对DINO-WM尤为明显）才能降低实际结果成本；而在失败源于评分的情况下，不依赖模型直接对窗口取平均可解决168个新Metaworld任务中的127个，而让模型在窗口间进行选择最多只能解决87个。在PushT中，仅劣化模型就会翻转哪种使用方式更优，而我们预先固定的规则能跟随这一翻转，在960个新回合中解决678个，而最佳固定使用方式只能解决530个。
tldr: This paper diagnoses whether failures in visual world-model planners stem from search or scoring, and proposes a rule (DemoProp) to choose between warm-starting search from demonstrations or averaging them without the model, improving planning performance across several simulated environments.
tldr_zh: 本文诊断视觉世界模型规划器的失败源于搜索还是评分，并提出规则（DemoProp）决定是使用演示进行热启动搜索还是直接平均演示，以提高多个模拟环境中的规划性能。

title: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal World Modeling with Content-Adaptive Spatial Addressing
summary: Long-horizon world modeling in partially observable environments requires compact memories that preserve spatial structure despite accumulated localization drift. Inspired by hippocampal episodic and spatial memory and the multi-periodic coding of entorhinal grid cells, we propose HiSTFormer, a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model, which adopts a layer-wise organization of local temporal RoPE and multi-periodic spatial RoPE, together with content-conditioned address offsets, to capture recent temporal context and long-range spatial structure. A fixed-capacity memory keeps KV storage and per-step attention cost bounded as the sequence grows. On MemoryMaze and HM3D, HiSTFormer outperforms strong world-model baselines within the training sequence length and generalizes substantially better to prediction horizons far beyond those seen during training, while using a compact model. The hierarchical spatiotemporal design remains effective across deeper Transformer stacks, with consistent gains as depth increases. These results show that hierarchical spatiotemporal organization and content-adaptive spatial addressing provide effective inductive biases for efficient long-horizon world modeling.
summary_zh: 部分可观测环境中的长时程世界建模需要紧凑的记忆表示，以在累积定位漂移的情况下仍保持空间结构。受海马体情景记忆与空间记忆以及内嗅网格细胞多周期编码的启发，我们提出了HiSTFormer——一种层次化时空世界模型。该模型采用局部时间RoPE与多周期空间RoPE的分层组织方式，并结合内容条件地址偏移，从而捕捉近期时间上下文与远距离空间结构。固定容量的记忆机制确保随着序列增长，键值存储量和每步注意力计算成本保持有界。在MemoryMaze和HM3D数据集上，HiSTFormer在训练序列长度内优于强世界模型基线，并且对远超训练时所见预测视界的泛化能力显著更强，同时模型保持紧凑。层次化时空设计在更深的Transformer堆叠中依然有效，随着深度增加持续带来性能提升。这些结果表明，层次化时空组织与内容自适应空间寻址为高效的长时程世界建模提供了有效的归纳偏置。
tldr: HiSTFormer proposes a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model with content-adaptive spatial addressing, using multi-periodic spatial RoPE and local temporal RoPE for long-horizon prediction in partially observable environments, outperforming baselines on MemoryMaze and HM3D while maintaining bounded memory.
tldr_zh: HiSTFormer 提出了一种具有内容自适应空间寻址的层次化时空世界模型，利用多周期空间 RoPE 和局部时间 RoPE 在部分可观测环境中进行长时程预测，在 MemoryMaze 和 HM3D 上优于基线，同时保持内存有界。

title: PUPPET: Physical-Unified Platform for Presence, Embodiment, and Teleoperation
summary: Remote access to robotics hardware does not by itself guarantee usable experimental data. A teleoperated trial can complete the task and still produce an incomplete or inconsistent record. PUPPET aims to solve this problem by presenting a cyber-physical framework that opens a physical robotics laboratory through a continuously synchronized VR replica of the robot, stranding environment, and task objects. In addition, PUPPET integrates a trial validation pipeline built into the experimental workflow. We evaluated PUPPET in a within-subject study with 30 participants, who performed the same table-to-shelf object-transfer task in person, through 2D teleoperation, and through PUPPET. VR reduced post-learning completion time by 27.7% over 2D (68.7,s vs. 95.0,s), statistically indistinguishable from in-person execution (72.1,s). It also produced more validation-ready (85.6% vs. 66.0%) and intervention-free (89.7% vs. 67.2%) trials. With PUPPET we show that modality shapes the remote task performance and the reusability of the resulting experimental record.
summary_zh: 远程访问机器人硬件本身并不能保证实验数据的可用性。即便遥操作试验成功完成了任务，仍可能产生不完整或不一致的记录。PUPPET旨在解决这一问题，通过构建一个网络物理框架，借助机器人的连续同步虚拟现实（VR）副本，开放物理机器人实验室，涵盖机器人本体、周边环境及任务对象。此外，PUPPET在实验流程中集成了试验验证管道。我们通过一项受试者内研究对PUPPET进行了评估，30名参与者分别以现场操作、2D遥操作和PUPPET三种方式执行相同的“桌面到货架”物体搬运任务。结果显示，与2D遥操作相比，VR将学习后的完成时间降低了27.7%（68.7秒对95.0秒），且在统计上与现场操作（72.1秒）无显著差异。同时，VR还生成了更多达到验证标准的试验（85.6%对66.0%）及无需干预的试验（89.7%对67.2%）。通过PUPPET，我们证明了操作模态对远程任务表现及所得实验记录的可复用性具有显著影响。
tldr: PUPPET presents a cyber-physical framework with a synchronized VR replica of a robot and a trial validation pipeline to improve teleoperated data collection, showing VR reduces completion time and increases validation-ready trials compared to 2D teleoperation.
tldr_zh: PUPPET提出了一种结合同步VR机器人副本和试验验证流程的网络物理框架，以改善遥操作数据收集，实验表明VR相比2D遥操作减少了完成时间并提高了可用于验证的试验比例。

title: Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion
summary: Multi-Robot Motion Planning (MRMP) requires trajectories that avoid environmental obstacles and collisions between robots in a shared workspace. Diffusion-based planners often address obstacle avoidance through sampling-time guidance, while some conditioned approaches aggregate map geometry into a global representation. We present Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion (SCTD), a map-conditioned trajectory generator for multi-robot planning. SCTD retains multiple position-aware occupancy tokens accessed through cross-attention throughout a temporal U-Net, with hard endpoint inpainting enforcing start and goal states. One model trained on single-robot demonstrations across procedural environments generates obstacle-aware trajectories without sampling-time obstacle-cost guidance. High-level Conflict-Based Search (CBS) coordinates these trajectories through constrained replanning, retaining inter-agent guidance during sampling and reusing the model across workspace layouts and team sizes. Experiments assess single-robot success and trajectory quality, generalization to unfamiliar layouts with added obstacles, and coordinated multi-robot planning. On 15,000 held-out tasks, SCTD achieves higher success than the evaluated guided diffusion baseline, with the largest gains on hard-detour tasks, while trajectory-quality comparisons show smoother trajectories. Conditioning ablations show higher success with spatial tokens than with a global map embedding, and map-replacement tests demonstrate dependence on the supplied geometry. The resulting multi-robot system achieves higher team success than the compared diffusion baselines, with experiments covering teams of up to 15 robots.
summary_zh: 多机器人运动规划（MRMP）需要在共享工作空间中生成既能避开环境障碍物又能避免机器人之间碰撞的轨迹。基于扩散的规划器通常通过采样时引导来处理避障问题，而一些条件化方法则将地图几何信息聚合为全局表示。我们提出了一种用于多机器人规划的地图条件轨迹扩散生成器——空间条件轨迹扩散（SCTD）。SCTD在时间U-Net中通过交叉注意力保留多个位置感知的占据令牌，并通过硬端点修补强制执行起始状态和目标状态。该模型仅在程序化生成环境中使用单机器人示教数据进行训练，即可生成避障轨迹，无需采样时的障碍代价引导。高层冲突搜索（CBS）通过约束重规划协调这些轨迹，在采样过程中保留智能体间引导，并可将模型复用于不同的工作空间布局和编队规模。实验评估了单机器人的成功率与轨迹质量、对新增障碍物的陌生布局的泛化能力，以及多机器人协同规划性能。在15，000个留出任务上，SCTD的成功率高于所评估的引导扩散基线，在困难绕行任务上提升最为显著，同时轨迹质量对比显示其生成的轨迹更加平滑。条件消融实验表明，空间令牌相比全局地图嵌入能获得更高的成功率，而地图替换测试则显示模型对给定几何信息的依赖。最终形成的多机器人系统在团队成功率上优于所对比的扩散基线，实验覆盖了最多15个机器人的编队规模。
tldr: This paper introduces Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion (SCTD), a diffusion-based multi-robot motion planner that uses cross-attention to position-aware occupancy tokens for map conditioning, enabling obstacle avoidance without sampling-time guidance and scaling to teams of up to 15 robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出空间条件轨迹扩散（SCTD），一种基于扩散的多机器人运动规划器，通过交叉注意力利用位置感知占用令牌进行地图条件化，无需采样时引导即可避开障碍物，并可扩展到多达15个机器人的团队。

title: Agentic Scaling of Embodied Tasks in Simulation for Synthetic Data Collection and Policy Evaluation
summary: Scaling embodied interaction data requires a broad collection of usable tasks, yet specifying and validating each task instance remains costly. We present AgenticTask, an agent-based framework that expands existing task collections under human intent. Its central representation links interaction requirements to object and part bindings, scene and robot configurations, initial conditions, and completion criteria. A task-generation agent reuses interaction structure to construct supported variations and revises incompatible configurations using validation feedback. A task-execution agent uses the same bindings and geometric records to select robot-supported skills and check completion against the original task criteria. On RoboCasa, the framework builds the AgenticTask collection, saving 16,450 task instances from 20,323 construction attempts at a throughput of 166.97 saved instances per elapsed hour, with 62.26% of construction attempts passing the configured physical checks. The execution agent completes approximately 38% of evaluated tasks, with successful cases spanning object placement, articulated manipulation, and sequential arrangement. Diagnostic analysis identifies improvement priorities in construction reliability, action selection, task-robot compatibility, and runtime integration. Together, these results demonstrate task-collection expansion with measured construction productivity and concrete execution evidence, providing a foundation for subsequent interaction-data collection for embodied AI.
summary_zh: 扩展具身交互数据需要大量可用的任务集合，然而对每个任务实例进行具体定义和验证仍然成本高昂。我们提出AgenticTask，一种基于智能体的框架，可在人类意图指导下扩展现有任务集合。其核心表示将交互需求与物体及部件绑定、场景和机器人配置、初始条件以及完成标准相连接。任务生成智能体复用交互结构以构建受支持的变体，并利用验证反馈修正不兼容的配置。任务执行智能体利用相同的绑定和几何记录来选取机器人支持的技能，并根据原始任务标准检查完成情况。在RoboCasa上，该框架构建了AgenticTask集合，从20,323次构建尝试中保存了16,450个任务实例，吞吐量达到每小时保存166.97个实例，其中62.26%的构建尝试通过了配置的物理检查。执行智能体成功完成了约38%的评估任务，成功案例涵盖物体放置、关节操作和顺序排列。诊断分析识别出构建可靠性、动作选择、任务-机器人兼容性及运行时集成方面的改进优先级。综合来看，这些结果证明了任务集合扩展具备了可度量的构建生产率和具体的执行证据，为后续具身AI交互数据收集奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper introduces AgenticTask, an agent-based framework for automatically expanding embodied task collections in simulation and evaluating policies, demonstrated on RoboCasa with 16,450 saved task instances and 38% execution success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AgenticTask，一种基于代理的框架，用于在仿真中自动扩展具身任务集合并评估策略，在RoboCasa上展示了16,450个保存的任务实例和38%的执行成功率。

title: Design and Validation of a Telescopic Chassis-Assisted Stair-Climbing Mechanism for Powered Wheelchairs
summary: We propose a simple stair traversal mechanism that augments a four-wheel wheelchair with an auxiliary telescopic chassis actuator. The proposed mechanism provides the following key contributions during stair ascent: (A) enhanced safety by ensuring that either the front or rear wheels remain stationary at all times; (B) primary reliance of the required force and mechanical work on the telescopic chassis rather than the wheels; (C) insensitivity of the required force and mechanical work to stair inclination; and (D) reduced risk of wheel slip on steeper stairs. In addition, the telescopic chassis is expected to improve level-ground mobility by enabling tight turning with the shortest wheelbase and enhancing stability with the longest wheelbase.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种简单的楼梯攀爬机构，该机构通过辅助伸缩底盘执行器增强了四轮轮椅的功能。所提出的机构在爬楼梯过程中提供了以下关键贡献：(A) 增强安全性，确保前轮或后轮始终至少有一组保持静止；(B) 所需力和机械功主要依赖于伸缩底盘，而非车轮；(C) 所需力和机械功对楼梯倾角不敏感；(D) 降低在较陡楼梯上车轮打滑的风险。此外，伸缩底盘预计将通过最短轴距实现紧凑转弯，并通过最长轴距增强稳定性，从而改善平地行驶的机动性。
tldr: This paper proposes a telescopic chassis mechanism for powered wheelchairs to assist stair climbing, enhancing safety and reducing wheel slip while improving level-ground mobility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于电动轮椅的伸缩底盘机构，以协助爬楼梯，提高安全性并减少车轮打滑，同时改善平地机动性。

title: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSEPose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerancedilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.
summary_zh: 类别级6D姿态估计将未见实例的部分RGB-D观测关联到类别共享的规范坐标系中。物体感知重建有助于自适应关键点保留可见表面的几何信息。常见的重建目标根据观测点到已注册实例表面的距离来选择观测点。我们提出MORSEPose方法，直接从标准姿态和度量尺寸标注中推导该支撑集。我们将观测到的3D点映射到归一化物体坐标，并保留位于容差膨胀后的姿态-尺寸包络内的点。该构造在不同相机坐标系和度量尺度下保持一致。当标注范围约束物体表面时，该包络保守地包含传统表面距离选择器的支撑集。我们将该目标与多层级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点及可学习类别上下文相集成。在REAL275和HouseCat6D上的实验表明，该包络在点级和任务级均与基于表面的监督紧密匹配，在边界扰动和视角变化下保持稳定，并在多个基准上支持具有竞争力的类别级姿态精度。
tldr: MORSEPose introduces a mesh-free support selection for category-level 6D object pose estimation, using pose-and-size envelopes to construct reconstruction targets without needing mesh models. It achieves competitive accuracy on REAL275 and HouseCat6D benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MORSEPose 提出了一种无需网格模型的支持点选择方法，通过位姿和尺寸包络构建重建目标，用于类别级6D物体姿态估计，并在 REAL275 和 HouseCat6D 基准上取得了有竞争力的精度。

title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
summary: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
summary_zh: 残余强化学习利用有限的环境交互预算来修正基于模仿训练的基础策略。在包含多个阶段的任务中，该预算需在各阶段之间进行分配，而基础策略失效的阶段并不一定是修正最能提升任务完成率的阶段。我们通过“完成增益”这一概念形式化了这一区别：即在单一阶段内，当状态反馈控制器替代基础策略动作的选定组成部分时，全任务完成概率的变化量。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率与从该阶段起始处完成任务的条件改进量，并通过配对回合进行估计。正向估计值决定了残余策略修正哪些动作组成部分，以及训练回合如何在各阶段之间分配。在随机质点对接实验中，大多数失败发生在最终对接阶段，而最大的完成增益出现在前一通道阶段；基于增益的分配相比按失败计数比例分配在完成率上有所提升，并且在具有较长接近路径的变体中，在预算的一半情况下优于均匀分配。在模拟双臂机器人装配中，完成增益估计仅在插入和释放阶段为正，尽管释放阶段发生的失败很少；在第二种装配配置中，在释放阶段训练的残余策略将起始释放阶段保留状态的完成率提升了16.9%。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to allocate residual reinforcement learning budgets across phases of multi-phase tasks by estimating the completion gain of correcting each phase, improving task completion over failure-based allocation in docking and bimanual assembly simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种方法，通过估计各阶段修正的完成增益，在多阶段任务中分配剩余强化学习预算，在对接和双臂装配模拟中优于基于失败次数的分配。

title: Plan your Self-Adaptation! Ontology-Mediated Task and Architecture Co-adaptation Planning for Robots
summary: Autonomous robots may need to adapt both their task plans and architectural configurations as operating conditions change. These decisions are interdependent: architectural configurations determine which actions a robot can perform, while task plans determine which capabilities are required. This paper presents PLANTA, an ontology-mediated approach to task and architecture co-adaptation that considers these dependencies during mission planning. PLANTA uses an ontology expressed in the Web Ontology Language to represent architectural alternatives and their associated functional and quality requirements, while the Planning Domain Definition Language defines task actions and mission goals. By automatically translating and integrating these models, PLANTA enables joint planning of task and reconfiguration actions. The approach uses satisficing planning and replans when changes during execution invalidate the current plan. PLANTA is evaluated in two robotic scenarios involving underwater inspection and ground navigation. The results support the feasibility of runtime co-adaptation and show lower planning time and memory consumption compared with optimal-policy generation in the evaluated navigation scenario, while producing plans of similar quality.
summary_zh: 自主机器人在运行条件变化时，可能需要同时调整其任务计划与架构配置。这两类决策相互依存：架构配置决定了机器人能够执行哪些动作，而任务计划则规定了需要哪些能力。本文提出了PLANTA，一种基于本体的任务与架构协同自适应方法，在任务规划过程中充分考虑这些依赖关系。PLANTA使用以Web本体语言表达的本体来表示架构备选方案及其相关的功能与质量需求，同时使用规划领域定义语言定义任务动作与任务目标。通过自动翻译并整合这些模型，PLANTA实现了任务动作与重构动作的联合规划。该方法采用满意度规划，并在执行过程中出现变化使当前计划失效时进行重新规划。PLANTA在两个机器人场景中进行了评估，涵盖水下巡检与地面导航。实验结果表明，运行时协同自适应具有可行性，并且在所评估的导航场景中，与最优策略生成方法相比，PLANTA的规划时间和内存消耗更低，同时生成的计划质量相近。
tldr: PLANTA is an ontology-mediated approach for jointly planning task and architectural reconfiguration in autonomous robots, evaluated in underwater inspection and ground navigation scenarios.
tldr_zh: PLANTA 是一种本体介导的方法，用于在自主机器人中联合规划任务和架构重新配置，并在水下检查和地面导航场景中进行了评估。

title: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
summary: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. Across a variety of controlled synthetic and real-world tasks, Infer3D demonstrates superior OOD reconstruction accuracy compared to feedforward networks trained on equal or larger datasets. Furthermore, mirroring how human perception requires more time to process confusing stimuli, we introduce an adaptive inference strategy that expends more test-time compute on ambiguous OOD examples while efficiently routing in-distribution inputs. Project website: https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/
summary_zh: 人类即便面对极其陌生或极端的视角，也能理解场景的3D结构。认知科学表明，这种泛化能力源于自上而下的生成式推理策略。相比之下，当前最先进的3D重建神经网络通常依赖于摊销式的前馈推理。尽管这种方式速度较快，但面对训练中未曾出现的分布外（OOD）场景条件时，这种模式匹配方法的表现会显著下降。受人类视觉生成特性的启发，我们提出了Infer3D——一种逆生成建模框架，通过恢复生成模型的潜变量，以最佳匹配单目输入。为防止退化的平面输出，我们将生成式图像先验与冻结的3D提升网络相结合，将优化空间约束在有效且多视角一致的3D流形上。在多种受控的合成任务和真实世界任务中，Infer3D相较于在同等或更大数据集上训练的前馈网络，展现出了更优的OOD重建精度。此外，仿照人类感知在处理令人困惑的刺激时需要更多时间的特性，我们引入了一种自适应推理策略，该策略在模糊的OOD样本上投入更多测试时计算资源，同时高效处理分布内输入。项目网站：https://amanikiruga.github.io/infer3d-site/
tldr: Infer3D proposes an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers latent variables of a generative model to perform monocular 3D reconstruction, showing improved robustness to out-of-distribution viewpoints by coupling a generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network.
tldr_zh: Infer3D 提出了一种逆生成建模框架，通过恢复生成模型的潜变量进行单目三维重建，并结合生成图像先验与冻结的3D提升网络，在分布外视角下表现出更好的鲁棒性。

title: Teleoperated Haircutting with Delay Compensation and Passivity-Based Control for Unilateral Internet Teleoperation under Real Communication Uncertainties
summary: Robotic haircutting requires accurate motion execution and reliable communication to safely reproduce the operator's commands. Internet-based teleoperation is a key enabling technology to remotely perform precise manipulation tasks such as haircutting. However, communication uncertainties, including variable transmission delays and packet jitter, degrade synchronization between the master and slave systems and affect tracking performance. This paper presents a unilateral Internet teleoperation framework for robotic haircutting that takes into account experimentally measured communication uncertainties. Three delay-compensation techniques, namely Zero-Order Hold (ZOH), First-Order Hold (FOH), and Low-Pass Filtering (LPF), are evaluated together with a classical proportional-derivative (PD) controller and a passivity-based synchronization controller. Unlike conventional studies based on synthetic delay models, the proposed framework is validated using communication data acquired from a real cloud-based teleoperation platform, where both packet delay and effective delay are characterized. The results demonstrate that combining delay-compensation techniques with passivity-based synchronization improves the robustness of unilateral Internet teleoperation under realistic communication uncertainties, providing a reliable control framework for robotic haircutting applications.
summary_zh: 机器人理发需要在运动执行与通信可靠性两方面具备高精度，以安全复现操作者的指令。基于互联网的遥操作是实现远程执行诸如理发等精细操作任务的关键技术。然而，通信不确定性，包括可变传输延迟和数据包抖动，会降低主从系统之间的同步性，并影响跟踪性能。本文提出了一种面向机器人理发的单边互联网遥操作框架，该框架考虑了实验测得的通信不确定性。研究评估了三种延迟补偿技术，即零阶保持（ZOH）、一阶保持（FOH）和低通滤波（LPF），并将其与经典比例-微分（PD）控制器及基于无源性的同步控制器相结合。与基于合成延迟模型的传统研究不同，所提出的框架使用从真实云遥操作平台采集的通信数据进行验证，该平台对数据包延迟和有效延迟均进行了表征。结果表明，将延迟补偿技术与基于无源性的同步相结合，能够在实际通信不确定性下提高单边互联网遥操作的鲁棒性，为机器人理发应用提供了一种可靠的控制框架。
tldr: This paper presents a unilateral Internet teleoperation framework for robotic haircutting, evaluating delay-compensation techniques and passivity-based control using real communication data to improve tracking performance under variable delays and packet jitter.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人理发的单边互联网遥操作框架，利用实际通信数据评估延迟补偿技术和基于无源性的控制，以提高在可变延迟和抖动下的跟踪性能。

title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: https://rainzor.github.io/contextrenderer/
summary_zh: 交互式游戏世界模型将可执行的虚拟世界演化与视觉生成分离开来，利用视频模型将引擎提供的场景表征渲染为精细的观测结果。然而，在持续的游戏过程中，现有的生成式渲染器难以在跟随变化条件的同时，在不同代理表征和目标风格之间保持视觉连续性。为此，我们提出了ContextRenderer——一个面向动态条件控制与跨代理泛化的自回归视频扩散框架。该框架将动态上下文学习（DCL）与循环历史压缩（RHC）相结合，前者用于块级交互监督，后者用于在有限令牌预算内跟随条件更新并保持视觉连续性。在跨代理表征方面，跨表征流对齐（CRFA）通过共享的高保真重建，将代理重建与外观及交互变化联系起来。我们构建的以交互为中心的WorldPrism数据集，涵盖代理构建的世界、AAA级游戏过程及开源视频，为上述学习任务提供了对应的渲染结果和块级标注。在GWM-Bench和Solar-Bench上的实验表明，重建质量和视觉质量均得到提升，定性结果则展示了在动态变化的提示和主体参考下长达一分钟的交互式渲染。项目主页：https://rainzor.github.io/contextrenderer/
tldr: ContextRenderer introduces an autoregressive video diffusion framework with Dynamic-Context Learning and Recurrent History Compression to enable interactive game world renderers that follow changing conditions while maintaining visual continuity across proxy representations, validated on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench.
tldr_zh: ContextRenderer 提出了一种自回归视频扩散框架，通过动态上下文学习和循环历史压缩，使交互式游戏世界渲染器能够在不同代理表示下遵循条件变化并保持视觉连续性，并在 GWM-Bench 和 Solar-Bench 上得到验证。

title: GeoPillars: A Large-Kernel Pillar Detector for Single-Sweep LiDAR Under Point Sparsity, and a Decomposition of Its Gain
summary: GeoPillars is a pillar-based 3D detector for single-sweep LiDAR under a hard budget of eight points per 0.4 m pillar, a budget that discards 46.6% of in-range points. It adds geometric pillar features, grouped vector attention within each pillar, a learned absolute positional prior on the bird's-eye-view (BEV) grid, a large-kernel backbone, auxiliary surface-normal supervision and a full-resolution detection head. Trained on 123k synthetic CARLA scans and evaluated on cars, it reaches 81.33 BEV AP@0.7, 13.76 points above CenterPoint at the same input budget and 1.91 points above CenterPoint at its native, denser budget. These are in-distribution figures, because the validation split is per-frame rather than scene-disjoint. A rung-by-rung decomposition shows that the new components explain little of the gain. Raising the detection-head resolution alone recovers 10.19 of the 13.76 points, the joint change of encoder, backbone, neck and positional prior adds 3.37, and the normal-supervision branch adds 0.20, which is within run-to-run variation. With heading reversals folded out, orientation error is similar for all seven models, although GeoPillars reverses headings about half as often as a resolution-matched baseline. It is also the slowest of the seven models. Evaluated zero-shot on 6,743 real nuScenes keyframes, no model transfers, and each retains 3.7% to 12.2% of its CARLA accuracy. A collection defect left LiDAR intensity constant, so every model learned from geometry alone. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.
summary_zh: GeoPillars是一种基于柱体的三维检测器，用于在每0.4米柱体仅允许八个点的严格预算下处理单次扫描LiDAR数据，该预算会丢弃46.6%的范围内点。它引入了几何柱体特征、柱体内分组向量注意力、鸟瞰图（BEV）网格上的可学习绝对位置先验、大核骨干网络、辅助表面法线监督以及全分辨率检测头。模型在123k帧合成CARLA扫描数据上训练，并在车辆类别上评估，达到了81.33的BEV AP@0.7，在相同输入预算下比CenterPoint高出13.76个百分点，在其原生更密集的预算下也高出1.91个百分点。这些属于分布内指标，因为验证集是按帧划分而非按场景不重叠划分。逐级分解表明，新组件对性能提升的贡献很小。仅提高检测头分辨率就恢复了13.76个百分点中的10.19个，编码器、骨干网络、颈部模块和位置先验的联合改动贡献了3.37个百分点，而法线监督分支仅贡献了0.20个百分点，这在多次运行的随机波动范围内。在去除航向反转的情况下，七个模型的方向误差相近，尽管GeoPillars的航向反转频率约为分辨率匹配基线模型的一半。它也是七个模型中最慢的一个。在6,743帧真实nuScenes关键帧上进行零样本评估时，所有模型均未能迁移，各模型仅保留了其在CARLA上精度的3.7%至12.2%。由于数据采集缺陷导致LiDAR强度值恒定，所有模型仅从几何信息中学习。代码和检查点均已公开。
tldr: GeoPillars proposes a pillar-based LiDAR 3D detector with several geometric and architectural enhancements for sparse single-sweep point clouds, but a decomposition shows that most gains come from a full-resolution detection head, and it fails to transfer to real data.
tldr_zh: GeoPillars 提出了一种基于柱的 LiDAR 3D 检测器，针对稀疏单扫描点云加入了多项几何与架构改进，但分解实验表明主要收益来自全分辨率检测头，且无法迁移到真实数据。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
summary_zh: 三维视觉定位（3D-VG）是一项连接自然语言与三维空间的任务，是具身智能与人机交互的基础能力。尽管近年来3D-VG智能体已摆脱对预处理三维点云的依赖，但其本质上仍采用单向、流水线式的工具调用架构。该架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。针对这一缺陷，本文提出双锚协作智能体（Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent, DACA），将3D-VG重新诠释为语义-几何双锚协作推理范式。DACA由两个互补的专用工具组成：语义锚工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，通过光流和视觉语言模型（VLM）局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚工具持有目标的三维空间几何特征，通过体素化和多关键点投影实现全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化的工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决策下一步感知-行动，形成闭环优化。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的实验表明，零样本DACA在ScanRefer上达到了73.6\%的整体Acc@0.25，在Nr3D上达到了70.4\%的整体准确率，大幅超越了最新的零样本3D-VG方法。代码和模型已开源至 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
tldr: DACA introduces a dual-anchor collaborative agent that reinterprets zero-shot 3D visual grounding as a semantic-geometric reasoning loop, achieving state-of-the-art results on ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DACA提出了双锚点协作智能体，将零样本3D视觉定位重新解释为语义-几何推理循环，在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: SpecFlow: Flow Matching in the Acceleration Spectrum for Multi-Agent Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Multimodal trajectory forecasting must cover diverse future behaviors without sacrificing dynamical coherence. Most generative forecasters evolve frame-wise positions directly, leaving the relationships among position, velocity, and acceleration implicit. We present SpecFlow, a conditional flow-matching framework that treats the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients of future accelerations as its generative state. SpecFlow learns a transport from Gaussian noise to acceleration spectra and reconstructs velocity and position through fixed analytical integration initialized by the last observed state. A joint phase-space objective supervises all three kinematic levels. To represent destination uncertainty without future information, an endpoint predictor produces candidate destinations and confidence scores solely from observed context, and the highest-confidence candidate conditions the spectral denoiser. Alternating attention over trajectory hypotheses and agents captures multimodality and interaction. Under best-of-20 evaluation, SpecFlow achieves average minADE/minFDE of 0.15/0.22 on ETH/UCY, 0.69/0.86 at four seconds on NBA, and 7.38/11.57 on SDD. It establishes state-of-the-art results across all five ETH/UCY scenes and achieves the lowest four-second ADE on NBA with a tied-best FDE, while remaining competitive on SDD. Together, these results demonstrate that acceleration-spectrum flow matching provides an effective structured generative state across smooth pedestrian motion, coordinated multi-agent sports dynamics, and heterogeneous outdoor trajectories. Code will be made publicly available.
tldr: SpecFlow introduces a flow-matching framework that generates future trajectories via DCT coefficients of accelerations, achieving state-of-the-art multi-agent trajectory forecasting on ETH/UCY, NBA, and SDD datasets.
tldr_zh: SpecFlow 提出了一种基于加速度离散余弦变换系数的流匹配框架用于多智能体轨迹预测，在 ETH/UCY、NBA 和 SDD 数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: AGE-Capture: Autonomous, General, and Efficient UAV Capture for High-Fidelity Scene Reconstruction
summary: High-fidelity scene reconstruction with an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) requires more than identifying valuable viewpoints: the system must autonomously acquire informative observations and determine task completion under different sensing configurations and limited flight resources. We present AGE-Capture, an autonomous, sensor-adaptive, and efficient active-capture framework for real UAVs. Building on renderability, the framework uses a lightweight online state to evaluate the utility of candidate views, assess task progress, and guide flight execution. By decoupling geometric exploration from reconstruction observations and establishing a unified camera-ray interface, the framework allows different range sensors and RGB camera models to share a reconstruction-driven acquisition pipeline. Reconstruction-frontier viewpoints characterize residual acquisition value for region screening and autonomous termination; dynamics-aware hierarchical planning combined with asynchronous event-driven capture reduces unnecessary inter-region motion, time spent waiting for plans, and repeated observations. Across ten indoor and outdoor simulation scenes, AGE-Capture achieves a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) $3.30$--$3.53\,\mathrm{dB}$ higher than that of the online baselines while using $58.2\%$ of the common mission-time budget on average. Its mean peak GPU memory usage is $91.0\%$--$93.3\%$ lower than that of the same baselines. Experiments with different sensor configurations validate the adaptability of the shared acquisition pipeline, while flights in nine real-world scenes further demonstrate onboard closed-loop operation under practical computational and motion constraints.
tldr: AGE-Capture is an autonomous UAV active-capture framework for high-fidelity 3D scene reconstruction, using a lightweight online state and reconstruction-frontier viewpoints to plan efficient, sensor-adaptive flights with onboard closed-loop operation.
tldr_zh: AGE-Capture 是一个用于高保真三维场景重建的自主无人机主动采集框架，利用轻量级在线状态和重建前沿视点来规划高效、传感器自适应的飞行，并在机载闭环运行。

title: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
summary: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
tldr: This paper introduces EAGLE, an explicit spatial-belief agent for active geo-localization, which uses vision-language distillation to train a context-free student that predicts aerial-feature embeddings and uncertainty without a VLM at inference, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出EAGLE，一种用于主动地理定位的显式空间信念智能体，通过视觉-语言蒸馏训练一个无上下文的学生模型，在推理时无需VLM即可预测航空特征嵌入和不确定性，在多个基准上取得了最先进的成功率。

title: Differentiable Hydrodynamics for Whole-Body MPC of Underwater Robots
summary: Underwater vehicle-manipulator systems distribute actuation across thrusters and joint motors. Whole-body model predictive control (MPC), rather than separate vehicle and arm controllers, can coordinate both to extend the workspace and exploit the system's full kinematic capability. Doing so, however, requires a hydrodynamic model and derivatives throughout the prediction horizon. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) captures geometry-dependent forces and moments for such a model, but is too expensive to evaluate online. We present a differentiable analytical hydrodynamic model combining smooth spherical-harmonic force and moment fields with a coupled added-inertia matrix identified from CFD. It compactly represents velocity and acceleration-dependent loads and provides their derivatives in closed form. These derivatives are propagated through free-floating vehicle--manipulator dynamics for whole-body trajectory optimization and receding-horizon control, jointly optimizing thruster forces and joint torques for reaching and continuous tracking. Held-out CFD tests validate the principal translational-force and rotational-moment fields and the added-inertia response. The analytical Jacobians evaluate faster and avoid the step-size sensitivity of central finite differences. Closed-loop Stonefish experiments demonstrate whole-body MPC in an independent marine simulator. By making geometry-dependent hydrodynamics directly available to gradient-based control, the model incorporates water forces and their sensitivities into motion allocation between the vehicle and arm, rather than treating them only as disturbances.
tldr: This paper introduces a differentiable analytical hydrodynamic model for underwater vehicle-manipulator systems, enabling whole-body MPC with closed-form derivatives for trajectory optimization and control, validated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个用于水下车辆-机械臂系统的可微解析流体动力学模型，为全身模型预测控制提供闭式导数，并在仿真中验证。

title: Communications-free Collective Intelligence Via Allocentric Belief
summary: A team of skilled card players share no information amongst each other, and yet still are able to coordinate their play by watching the same players and reading the same tells. Autonomous systems have failed to exploit this logic, relying instead on explicit communication or complex state estimation schemes that can fail when it matters most. Without it, decentralized agents diverge in their world beliefs, and coordination collapses. Here we show that anchoring all agents to a single shared external actor, a common witness whose reactions encode team state, produces spontaneous, communication-free coordination. An allocentric belief network trained on witness behavior allows each agent to independently reconstruct full team state, keeping group beliefs consistent with no inter-agent exchange. Across five competitive environments allocentric belief alignment outperforms egocentric approaches in collective performance, and even scales to sixty-agent teams where standard methods fail. These results establish a new principle for collective intelligence: in the absence of communication, a shared gaze replaces a shared channel.
tldr: This paper introduces an allocentric belief network that anchors decentralized agents to a shared external witness to achieve communication-free coordination, outperforming egocentric approaches in collective performance and scaling to 60-agent teams.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种以外部共享见证者为锚点的异中心信念网络，使分散智能体无需通信即可协调行动，在集体表现上优于以自我为中心的方法，并扩展到60个智能体的团队。

title: AeroBelief: Budgeted First-Action Verification for Evidence-Guided Aerial Sensing
summary: Aerial sensing must combine uncertain overhead context with current observations while budgeting prediction, movement and image processing. AeroBelief uses the next executable action as the unit of verification against reference scores. It groups candidate views by first action, scans them with an inexpensive proposer, and selectively queries a structured world model (WM). Calibrated group bounds support strict commitment; a six-query controller connects selective prediction with belief updates, acceptance checks and scheduled sensing. Across four layout families, 40 worlds and 960 closed-loop executions, the AeroBelief controller completes 75.42% of tasks, compared with 73.33% for exhaustive WM scoring and 65.83% for line-of-sight geometry, using 91.81% fewer reference-candidate evaluations than exhaustive scoring. In fixed-reference replay with a six-query cap, proposer-scaled anchored bounds raised first-action certificate availability from 36.25% to 54.69% and reduced mean queries per state by 13.54% relative to unit-scale anchored bounds. A complete ground-hosted pipeline processes 2,685 self-collected 20-megapixel unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images from seven DJI Mavic 3M routes. Context-guided admission and feedback retain all eight independently supported target confirmations with 76.05% fewer processed images and 70.02% less accumulated active processing service than uncapped all-frame processing; feedback saves another 5.17% of images relative to static context. The studies connect budgeted action selection with evidence-driven processing of recorded flight imagery.
tldr: AeroBelief presents a budgeted first-action verification framework for aerial sensing that uses lightweight proposers, structured world models, and calibrated group bounds to reduce computational cost while maintaining task completion in closed-loop UAV deployments.
tldr_zh: AeroBelief 提出了一种用于航空感知的预算化首动作验证框架，通过轻量级提议器、结构化世界模型和校准的组边界，在无人机闭环部署中降低计算成本的同时保持任务完成率。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
summary: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.
tldr: This paper proposes a domain-aware conformal prediction method that calibrates on synthetic images translated to real-image appearance, restoring coverage guarantees for spacecraft pose estimation under sim-to-real shift and reducing silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3%.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种领域感知的共形预测方法，通过在转换到真实图像外观的合成图像上校准，恢复了航天器位姿估计在仿真到真实域偏移下的覆盖保证，并将静默失败从高达43.5%降低至最多3.3%。

title: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.
tldr: This paper introduces a deep reinforcement learning approach for exposure-aware informative path planning, enabling mobile sensing agents to map unknown scalar fields while minimizing exposure to high-intensity areas, and demonstrates improved reconstruction accuracy and reduced exposure across radar, plume, and wildfire scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的暴露感知信息路径规划方法，使移动传感代理在绘制未知标量场的同时最小化暴露于高强度区域，并在雷达、羽流和野火场景中展示了更高的重建精度和更低的暴露。

title: Reference-Twist-Based Velocity-Domain Spatiotemporal Calibration for mmWave Radar, Event Camera, and IMU
summary: Multi-sensor navigation requires a common spatial and temporal basis, but geometric calibration relies on targets, features, point clouds, or pose associations that are difficult to establish across mmWave radars, event cameras, and inertial measurement units (IMUs). These sensors nevertheless share rigid-body motion. This paper formulates reference-conditioned velocity-domain spatiotemporal calibration for a rigid suite of two mmWave radars, one event camera, and two IMUs. Given a trusted reference body twist, radar Doppler, event normal flow, and inertial measurements are regressed against the same motion to estimate relative rotations, lever arms, time offsets, and sensor-specific bias and scale without artificial targets, structure from motion, or cross-modal point-cloud registration. The reference is treated as a conditioning input rather than a sensor to be calibrated. We compare joint and reference- conditioned estimation, derive conditional identifiability and CRLB-level covariance and bias bounds, and state the operating conditions under which conditioning is informative. Indoor and forest recordings with axis-separated motion evaluate initial- ization, temporal alignment, motion degeneracy, reference-input sensitivity, and residual consistency. Because the reference does not add physical observability, the estimates remain conditional on reference accuracy, synchronization, motion excitation, and projection diversity.
tldr: This paper introduces a reference-twist-based velocity-domain approach for spatiotemporally calibrating mmWave radar, event camera, and IMU, using rigid-body motion as a shared constraint without artificial targets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于参考扭计的速度域时空标定方法，利用刚体运动作为共同约束，无需人工靶标即可对毫米波雷达、事件相机和惯性测量单元进行标定。

title: Multiple-Camera Tracking of Rigid Objects
summary: In this paper we describe a method for tracking rigid objects using one or several cameras. The tracking process consists of aligning a 3-D model representation of an object with image contours by measuring and minimizing the image error between predicted model points and image contours. The tracker behaves like a visual servo loop where the internal and external camera parameters are updated at each new image acquisition. We study in detail the Jacobian matrix associated with this minimization process in the presence of both point-to-point and point-to-contour matches. We establish the minimal number of matches that are needed as well as the singular configurations leading to a rank-defficient Jacobian matrix. We find a mathematical link between the point-to-point and point-to-contour cases. Based on this link we show that the latter has the same kind of singularities than the former. Moreover, we study multiple camera configurations which optimize the robustness of the method in the presence of single-camera singularities, bad, noisy, or missing data. Extensive experiments done with a complex ship part and with up to three cameras validate the method. In particular we show that the tracker may well be used as a camera calibration procedure.
tldr: The paper presents a multiple-camera tracking method for rigid objects by aligning a 3D model with image contours, and analyzes Jacobian singularities and multi-camera configurations for robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用多个摄像机跟踪刚体物体的方法，通过将3D模型与图像轮廓对齐，并分析了雅可比矩阵的奇异性及多摄像机配置对鲁棒性的影响。

title: Learning-Based System Identification for DVL-Constrained AUV Localization
summary: Nowadays, most AUVs utilize Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to achieve satisfactory dead-reckoning results. However, the DVL bottom lock may not be available in some scenarios, such as moving over a soft bottom or traveling further away from the seafloor beyond the DVL's range. As a result, the localization system solely reliant on the IMU data will experience significant drift. The relatively high cost of DVLs also inhibits multirobot or swarm operations. In this article, we present the results of using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict vehicle velocity (surge, sway, and heave) for AUV localization. Approximation functions for the vehicle velocities are derived based on the generalized six degree-of-freedom dynamic equation and kinematics, proving that they are suitable for feedforward neural networks with measurable inputs. The neural networks are trained using field data collected using an AUV. An ablation study was conducted to investigate the impacts of hyperparameters, and the most effective models were selected using the Akaike information criterion. The selected neural network models are tested on three new sets of mission data collected on two different days. The quantitative results show that localization using vehicle velocities predicted by neural networks yields lower averaged root-mean-square distance errors and standard deviation compared to the DVL-aided dead-reckoning method. However, the extent of this improvement was found to depend on ocean current conditions. The promising results show that lightweight fully connected feedforward neural networks offer an attractive approach for inertial-based underwater localization when DVLs or their measurements are not available.
tldr: This paper proposes using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict AUV velocity for inertial-based underwater localization when DVL measurements are unavailable, achieving lower localization errors than DVL-aided dead-reckoning in field tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出使用全连接前馈神经网络预测AUV速度，以在DVL测量不可用时实现惯性水下定位，现场测试表明其定位误差低于DVL辅助的航位推算。

title: Communication-Aware UAV Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning in Complex Urban Environments
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in low-altitude urban airspace for delivery, emergency response, and other applications. However, UAV mobility across spatially heterogeneous urban communication environments can lead to time-varying communication outages, disrupting mission execution and compromising flight safety. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning (ST-RCP) framework that leverages delivery UAVs as opportunistic communication relays for disconnected UAVs without requiring additional communication infrastructure. The framework predicts communication blind-spot events over a finite planning horizon, constructs a helper-event compatibility graph, and jointly optimizes relay selection, obstacle-aware trajectory replanning, and communication-aware scheduling. Multiple planners are evaluated to investigate the trade-offs among communication coverage, computational cost, and energy consumption. Experiments based on real-world traffic scenarios compare the performance of ST-RCP against baseline methods. In the peak scenario, ST-RCP improves descent-phase communication coverage by 29.93% compared with the base-station baseline and by 27.38%, 22.02%, and 15.20% compared with configurations using one, two, and three dedicated relay UAVs, respectively. Process flexibility analysis demonstrates that predictive task-aware relaying expands the pool of feasible relay resources and improves communication continuity while maintaining the feasibility of delivery missions. These findings demonstrate the potential of trajectory-enabled UAV coordination to enhance the safety and resilience of urban aerial operations.
tldr: This paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning (ST-RCP) framework for UAVs in urban environments, using delivery UAVs as opportunistic communication relays to improve communication coverage and mission feasibility.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向城市环境的无人机时空中继协作与规划（ST-RCP）框架，利用配送无人机作为机会通信中继，以提高通信覆盖率和任务可行性。

title: A Synthetic Multi-Modal Testbed for Security Stress Testing of Agentic Counter-UAS Systems
summary: Agentic cyber-physical systems rely on perception and state estimation to support autonomous decisions. Degraded, inconsistent, or manipulated sensor observations can therefore propagate through an autonomous pipeline and create security-relevant failures. This work presents a synthetic Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) testbed developed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for repeatable stress testing of perception and tracking algorithms supporting agentic decision-making. A simplified quadrotor follows scripted trajectories while co-located virtual sensors generate synchronized RGB, RTX LiDAR, and illustrative IR-like observations. The testbed varies target range, motion, clutter, occlusion, and sensor availability, with future stress cases including sensor dropout, temporal misalignment, cross-modal disagreement, and false observations. As an initial exemplar, a nonlinear coordinated-turn Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is evaluated over a 20-s maneuvering trajectory using LiDAR target-centroid measurements. Position error and uncertainty are compared as LiDAR observations degrade and are lost. The framework provides a reproducible environment for studying how sensing degradation affects downstream autonomous estimation and resilience in agentic C-UAS systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a synthetic C-UAS testbed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for security stress testing of perception and tracking algorithms, demonstrating initial evaluation with an EKF under LiDAR degradation. It focuses on reproducible sensing degradation effects for agentic decision-making in counter-UAS systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中构建了一个合成反无人机系统（C-UAS）测试平台，用于对感知和跟踪算法进行安全压力测试，并通过EKF在LiDAR退化下的初步评估展示了可复现的传感退化对自主决策的影响。

title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
summary: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.
tldr: This paper introduces Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework for long-horizon human-scene interaction that enhances spatial control and quantitative feedback, and builds a benchmark of 75 household tasks demonstrating high task completion rates with various LLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Inhabitant，一种无需训练的长时程人-场景交互智能体框架，通过空间控制和定量反馈提升任务完成能力，并构建了包含75个家务任务的基准，在多种LLM下取得了较高完成率。

title: Closing the Analyze-to-Design Gap: An Authorization-Bounded Agent for Self-Driving Laboratories
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly integrated into self-driving laboratories (SDLs) to plan experiments and interpret results. However, analytical reasoning alone does not make a laboratory autonomous: autonomy in an SDL is achievable only when the agent can be trusted to act on physical hardware unsupervised and knows when to defer to a human. Here, we present an architecture that integrates an agent at the Analyze-Design interface of the Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycle, enabling agent-driven measurement selection and data interpretation while ensuring that state-changing operations are authorized, validated, and auditable. We demonstrate this architecture on a liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) instrument in an oxidant-screening campaign for synthesizing an organic dye. Within human-defined campaign limits, the agent submitted measurement jobs, interpreted mass spectrometry (MS) and diode-array detection (DAD) data, flagged failed experiments, and produced an oxidant ranking. This ranking matched that obtained from scripted peak integration, and organic chemists confirmed the agent's spectral interpretations and failure assignments. In a simulated environment that replays the archived LC-MS data, where the agent chose which wells to inject under varying injection limits, it measured the highest-yielding condition at about its seventh injection, against 14.5 on average for a random order, and identified it in every campaign with a limit of eight or more injections.
