tldr_zh: PushMimic 通过采样轨迹优化将单一参考动作扩展为动态可行的数据集，并蒸馏为单一策略，使仿人机器人能够自适应不同重量和坡度的推箱任务，显著提高成功率并降低手臂成本。

title: Spiking World-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how the world responds to actions and offer a promising path toward general embodied intelligence, but they are large and run the network many times per plan, so they are hard to deploy on robots. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) compute with sparse binary spikes and use additions instead of multiplications, which saves power. However, existing WAMs use dense videos as the world state, so a spiking version would spend most of its computation on the background. We therefore introduce SpikingWAM, the first spiking WAM, which uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state. Inspired by biological motor control, which attends only to the key positions of a task, the Task Skeleton State (TSS) keeps the keypoints of the arm and the task objects, and a small spiking front end estimates the object keypoints from images. Body Frame Spike Coding (BFSC) and Grid Coincidence Attention (GCA) keep millimetre precision, and the Persistent Single Step Readout (PSR) runs the network once per plan. On the simulated benchmarks LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, SpikingWAM achieves competitive success rates with far less energy than ANN methods and surpasses all compared methods on LIBERO-Plus. Real robot experiments further confirm its effectiveness. These results show that a task skeleton lets spiking networks implement WAMs at very low energy, offering a new solution for low power embodied intelligence. Project page: https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测世界对动作的响应，为通用具身智能提供了一条有前景的路径，但这类模型规模庞大，且每次规划需多次运行网络，因此难以部署于机器人上。脉冲神经网络（SNNs）以稀疏二值脉冲进行计算，用加法替代乘法，从而节省功耗。然而，现有WAMs以稠密视频作为世界状态，若采用脉冲版本，其大部分计算将耗费在背景处理上。为此，我们提出了SpikingWAM——首个脉冲WAM，它以稀疏任务骨架作为世界状态。受生物运动控制机制（仅关注任务关键位置）的启发，任务骨架状态（TSS）保留手臂及任务物体的关键点，并通过一个小型脉冲前端从图像中估计物体关键点。体帧脉冲编码（BFSC）与网格重合注意力（GCA）保证了毫米级精度，而持久单步读出（PSR）机制使每次规划仅需运行网络一次。在模拟基准LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及RoboTwin 2.0上，SpikingWAM以远低于ANN方法的能耗取得了具有竞争力的成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus上超越了所有对比方法。真实机器人实验进一步验证了其有效性。上述结果表明，任务骨架使脉冲网络能够以极低能耗实现WAMs，为低功耗具身智能提供了一种新方案。项目页面：https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/
tldr: SpikingWAM introduces the first spiking world-action model for robotic manipulation, using sparse task skeleton states and energy-efficient spiking neural networks to achieve competitive success rates and significantly lower energy consumption on simulation and real-robot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SpikingWAM 提出了首个用于机器人操作的脉冲世界动作模型，利用稀疏任务骨架状态和脉冲神经网络，在仿真和真实机器人基准上实现了有竞争力的成功率并大幅降低能耗。

title: FlexWAM: Learning Flexible Visual Routing for World Action Models
summary: Humans dynamically adjust their reliance on sensory modalities across manipulation stages. Although existing World Action Models (WAMs) fuse multi-camera observations, they struggle to adapt their reliance on individual views based on the current observations. This raises a central question: how can the action expert integrate complementary visual evidence while prioritizing the views most relevant to the current action? FlexWAM addresses this challenge through three modules. First, we alternate within-view and cross-view attention to capture view-specific dynamics and complementary cues. For action prediction, View-Routed Action Attention uses an observation-conditioned router to prioritize relevant views. To calibrate routing, we train a critic using counterfactual view credit, estimated from action loss sensitivity upon suppressing each view's contribution to action attention. We evaluate FlexWAM with two video backbones on five challenging real-world manipulation tasks across two robot platforms. The two variants improve mean task success by 16.4 and 23.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline. Project website: https://flexwam.github.io/.
summary_zh: 人类在操作的不同阶段会动态调整对不同感官模态的依赖。尽管现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）融合了多摄像头观测信息，但它们难以根据当前观测自适应地调整对各视角的依赖程度。这引出了一个核心问题：动作专家如何在优先关注与当前动作最相关的视角的同时，整合互补的视觉证据？FlexWAM通过三个模块解决了这一挑战。首先，我们交替进行视角内与跨视角注意力计算，以捕捉各视角特有的动态信息及互补线索。在动作预测方面，视角路由动作注意力采用基于观测条件的路由器来优先选择相关视角。为校准路由机制，我们训练了一个评论器，利用反事实视角贡献度——通过抑制各视角对动作注意力的贡献时所引起的动作损失敏感性来估计。我们在两个机器人平台的五项具有挑战性的真实世界操作任务上，使用两种视频骨干网络对FlexWAM进行了评估。两种变体在平均任务成功率上分别比最强基线提升了16.4和23.0个百分点。项目网站：https://flexwam.github.io/。
tldr: FlexWAM introduces a view-routing mechanism for World Action Models that dynamically prioritizes relevant camera views through counterfactual credit assignment, improving multi-view robotic manipulation success on five real-world tasks across two platforms.
tldr_zh: FlexWAM 为世界动作模型引入视图路由机制，通过反事实信用分配动态优先相关相机视图，在两个平台五项真实操作任务中提升成功率。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.
summary_zh: 残差世界模型通过时间变化来预测驾驶场景，因此随时间保持恒定的特征组件会从残差路径中消失。我们探讨了时间变化较弱的证据（例如等待中的行人或停驻的车辆）能否更有效地用于规划，并提出了MOVER——一种互补事件路由机制。在训练阶段，教师模型衡量每个空间锚定事件查询在从共享历史中移除过去帧时的响应变化，并将该敏感性与事件的汇集时间残差进行对比，从而优先处理依赖历史但残差证据较弱的事件。学生模型从未受扰动的历史中预测由此产生的优先级，因此教师模型不增加推理成本。在固定总路由质量下，一个分布对低秩未来鸟瞰图更新进行缩放，并影响轨迹条件化事件读取。在nuScenes数据集上，MOVER将ResWorld的UniAD风格平均L2误差从0.65米降至0.55米，碰撞率从0.23%降至0.12%（结合直接规划器自车状态时为0.50米和0.09%），每帧仅增加4.1毫秒计算时间。配对对照实验表明，互补教师模型优于任一单独信号，且该分配主要在训练阶段发挥作用。当适配至BridgeDrive-LEAD后，MOVER在220条路线的Bench2Drive闭环基准测试中，基于三个随机种子达到96.52±0.65的驾驶评分，在每个配对种子中均以种子内变异范围内的优势超过匹配对照组。
tldr: MOVER introduces a complementary event-routing mechanism that improves residual world models for autonomous driving planning by prioritizing events with weak temporal change, reducing errors and collision rates on nuScenes and improving closed-loop driving scores on Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: MOVER提出了一种互补事件路由机制，通过优先处理时间变化较弱的驾驶事件，改进残差世界模型的规划性能，在nuScenes上降低误差和碰撞率，并在Bench2Drive闭环基准上提升驾驶分数。

title: MoMa-NMP: Scene-Scale Neural Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Mobile manipulators operating in homes and other complex environments must coordinate their base and arm over long horizons, navigating around obstacles, through narrow passages, and between constrained workspaces. Neural motion planners can provide fast closed-loop planning from partial observations, but scaling them to room-sized environments is difficult because generating high-quality training trajectories is itself a challenging motion-planning problem. To address this, we introduce MoMa-DemoSmith, a demonstration-generation pipeline that separates the problem into global path discovery for large complex scenes and local motion refinement for collision avoidance. This key separation enables the generation of millions of challenging whole-body trajectories across our procedurally generated scenes. We train MoMa-NMP on these demonstrations through behavior cloning (BC) followed by privileged on-policy distillation, achieving 87.0% success on our simulation benchmark and 77.5% across 80 trials in unseen real-world scenes. See video results at https://adamhkan.com/moma-nmp/.
summary_zh: 在家庭及其他复杂环境中运行的移动操作机器人，必须长期协调其基座与机械臂，在躲避障碍物、穿越狭窄通道以及在受限工作空间之间导航。神经运动规划器能够根据部分观测提供快速的闭环规划，但将其扩展到房间大小的环境中较为困难，因为生成高质量的训练轨迹本身就是一个具有挑战性的运动规划问题。为解决这一问题，我们引入了MoMa-DemoSmith，一种演示生成流水线，它将问题分解为大型复杂场景下的全局路径发现和用于避碰的局部运动细化。这种关键分离使得我们能够在程序化生成的场景中生成数百万个具有挑战性的全身轨迹。我们通过行为克隆（BC）及随后的特权在策略蒸馏，在生成的这些演示上训练了MoMa-NMP，在我们的仿真基准测试中达到了87.0%的成功率，并在未见过的真实世界场景的80次试验中达到了77.5%的成功率。视频结果见 https://adamhkan.com/moma-nmp/。
tldr: MoMa-NMP introduces a demonstration-generation pipeline that separates global path discovery from local motion refinement to create millions of whole-body trajectories, then trains a neural motion planner via behavior cloning and privileged on-policy distillation for mobile manipulators, achieving high success in simulation and real-world scenes.
tldr_zh: MoMa-NMP 提出了一种将全局路径发现与局部运动细化分离的演示生成流程，生成数百万个全身轨迹，并通过行为克隆和特权在线蒸馏训练移动操作器的神经运动规划器，在仿真和真实场景中均取得高成功率。

title: UnderGrasp: Envelopment-Oriented Grasp Refinement for an Underactuated Gripper
summary: Underactuated grippers can form enveloping grasps through passive compliance, while the terminal pose and single width predicted by generic grasp generators do not fully capture the approach-closure process. Conventional collision filtering also struggles to distinguish harmful interference from acceptable contact. We present UnderGrasp, a post-hoc grasp refinement and evaluation framework for an underactuated gripper that reuses grasp candidates and quality priors from a frozen generator. The model jointly encodes the target, local environment, support surface, and approach-path geometry to propose diverse combinations of insertion depth, pre-grasp width, and target closing width for each candidate. These actions are ranked by combining separately predicted envelopment and interaction quality with upstream priors, balancing grasp feasibility, envelopment, and scene disturbance rather than rejecting all environmental contact. The back end is trained solely on configuration and interaction labels generated by gripper-specific simulations, without real-robot grasp labels. Real-robot experiments with an underactuated gripper show that UnderGrasp improves the overall success rate (SR) and the envelopment rate (ER) among successful grasps from 0.55/0.12 to 0.82/0.55 with AnyGrasp, and from 0.42/0.08 to 0.65/0.36 with GraspNet. In contrast, increasing the fixed insertion depth to 40 mm improves ER to 0.35 but reduces SR to 0.52, supporting the value of adaptive refinement. For trials involving target or environmental contact during approach, the conditional success rates increase from 0.36 to 0.89 and from 0.25 to 0.86, respectively, demonstrating more reliable execution under contact. Project page: https://dishenliu2004-hub.github.io/undergrasp-site/
summary_zh: 欠驱动抓取器能够通过被动顺应性形成包覆抓取，而通用抓取生成器预测的末端位姿和单一宽度并未完全捕捉接近-闭合过程。传统的碰撞过滤也难以区分有害干涉与可接受的接触。我们提出了UnderGrasp，一个针对欠驱动抓取器的后置抓取优化与评估框架，该框架复用冻结生成器中的抓取候选和质量先验。该模型联合编码目标物体、局部环境、支撑表面以及接近路径几何结构，为每个候选生成插入深度、预抓取宽度和目标闭合宽度的多样化组合。这些动作通过将分别预测的包覆质量和交互质量与上游先验相结合进行排序，在抓取可行性、包覆程度和场景扰动之间取得平衡，而非拒绝所有环境接触。后端仅在由特定抓取器仿真生成的配置和交互标签上训练，无需真实机器人抓取标签。使用欠驱动抓取器的真实机器人实验表明，UnderGrasp将总体成功率（SR）和成功抓取中的包覆率（ER）从AnyGrasp的0.55/0.12提升至0.82/0.55，从GraspNet的0.42/0.08提升至0.65/0.36。相比之下，将固定插入深度增加至40 mm可将ER提升至0.35，但SR降至0.52，这验证了自适应优化的价值。对于接近过程中涉及目标或环境接触的试验，条件成功率分别从0.36提升至0.89、从0.25提升至0.86，表明在接触条件下的执行更加可靠。项目页面：https://dishenliu2004-hub.github.io/undergrasp-site/
tldr: UnderGrasp is a post-hoc grasp refinement and evaluation framework for underactuated grippers that adaptively proposes insertion depth and closing widths, and ranks candidates by predicted envelopment and interaction quality, improving real-robot grasp success and envelopment rates versus generic grasp generators.
tldr_zh: UnderGrasp 是一个针对欠驱动抓手的后置抓取优化与评估框架，自适应提出插入深度和闭合宽度，并根据预测的包络和交互质量对候选排序，在真实机器人上提升了抓取成功率和包络率。

title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
summary: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. We present Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based root-body diffusion architecture that integrates local attention, resumable recurrent states, and persistent content memory (PCM) for long-horizon controllable motion generation. PCM transforms compressed motion history from Mamba recurrent states, together with state changes and text-conditioned features, into dynamically updated content slots accessible to local attention. To enable efficient inference, we further develop an execution scheme tailored to this architecture, combining CUDA Graph replay, fused kernels, and execution-flow simplification while preserving the canonical history update. Evaluations on retargeted HiPHI demonstrate accurate terminal control over rollouts of up to 39.52 s, while short-horizon comparisons on BONES Seed and retargeted HumanML3D show that the model also retains strong spatial control and text-motion matching. On an RTX 4090, the optimized execution reduces median complete-window latency from 1685.35 to 276.14 ms, achieving a median paired speedup of 6.138$\times$ while preserving identical outputs and committed states in the tested rollouts. Moreover, we conduct extensive real-world evaluation on the Unitree G1, demonstrating sequential text-guided action composition, expressive motion, and interactive locomotion through keyboard and mouse control.
summary_zh: 长视野、实时可控的运动生成对于交互式动画和人形机器人至关重要，在此类应用中，智能体必须在移动过程中响应不断变化的指令和空间目标。现有的自回归扩散方法能够增量生成运动，但有界注意力缓存限制了对远距离历史的访问，而重复去噪则带来了大量推理开销。我们提出Motion Mamba 2.0，一种基于Mamba的根节点-身体扩散架构，集成了局部注意力、可恢复的循环状态和持久内容记忆（PCM），用于长视野可控运动生成。PCM将Mamba循环状态中的压缩运动历史、状态变化以及文本条件特征转换为动态更新的内容槽，供局部注意力访问。为实现高效推理，我们进一步开发了一种针对该架构定制的执行方案，结合CUDA Graph重放、融合内核和执行流简化，同时保留规范的历史更新。在重定向后的HiPHI上的评估表明，该方法在长达39.52秒的推演中实现了精确的终端控制，而在BONES Seed和重定向后的HumanML3D上的短视野比较显示，该模型还保持了强大的空间控制和文本-运动匹配能力。在RTX 4090上，优化后的执行将中位完整窗口延迟从1685.35毫秒降至276.14毫秒，实现了6.138倍的中位配对加速，同时在测试推演中保持完全相同的输出和已提交状态。此外，我们在Unitree G1上进行了广泛的真实世界评估，展示了通过键盘和鼠标控制实现的顺序文本引导动作组合、表现力丰富的运动以及交互式移动。
tldr: This paper introduces Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based diffusion architecture with persistent content memory and optimized inference for long-horizon, text-conditioned humanoid control, validated on both simulation and real-world Unitree G1 robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Motion Mamba 2.0，一种基于Mamba的扩散架构，具有持久内容记忆和优化推理，用于长时程、文本条件的人形控制，并在仿真和真实宇树G1机器人上验证。

title: ProMix: Efficient Data Mixture Optimization for Robotic Imitation via Proxy-Reference DRO
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in open-world manipulation, yet their performance often saturates when training data are naively pooled across heterogeneous robots, tasks, and environments. Distributionally robust data mixture optimization, exemplified by Re-Mix, can recover much of this performance, but its weight search requires training full-scale policies twice on the entire corpus, placing it out of reach for most laboratories. We present ProMix, a compute-efficient instantiation of the proxy-reference DRO recipe for robotic imitation learning: a 15M-parameter proxy learns per-domain sampling weights by minimizing worst-case excess loss against a frozen reference model, and the learned weights transfer, without re-tuning, to VLA backbones up to 7B parameters. We further provide, to our knowledge, the first controlled analysis of the reference model's role in robotic DRO, showing that removing it induces over-pessimism toward noisy, low-quality domains (-3.8% average and -14.3% worst-domain success rate), and that entropy regularization is needed to prevent weight collapse. Evaluated on 9500 real-world episodes from the Open-X Embodiment dataset, ProMix improves the average success rate over uniform mixing from 68.4% to 76.2%, matching Re-Mix within evaluation noise while reducing mixture-optimization cost to a backbone-independent 11 GPU-hours - versus 16 GPU-hours at the 50M comparison scale and 192 GPU-hours at 7B for full-scale searches - with a +17.1% absolute gain on the worst-case domain.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在开放世界操控任务中表现出色，然而，当训练数据被简单混合自异构机器人、任务和环境时，其性能往往趋于饱和。以Re-Mix为代表的分布鲁棒数据混合优化方法能够显著恢复部分性能损失，但其权重搜索需要对整个语料库进行两轮全规模策略训练，这使得大多数实验室难以负担。我们提出ProMix，一种面向机器人模仿学习的代理-参考分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架的高效计算实现：一个1500万参数的代理模型通过最小化相对于冻结参考模型的最坏情况超额损失来学习各领域采样权重，且学习到的权重无需重新调整即可迁移至参数规模高达70亿的VLA骨干网络。此外，我们首次对参考模型在机器人DRO中的作用进行了受控分析，结果表明，移除参考模型会导致对噪声大、质量低的领域产生过度悲观估计（平均成功率下降3.8%，最差领域下降14.3%），且需要熵正则化以防止权重崩塌。在来自Open-X Embodiment数据集的9500条真实世界轨迹上进行的评估显示，ProMix将平均成功率从均匀混合的68.4%提升至76.2%，在评估噪声范围内与Re-Mix持平，同时将混合优化成本降低至与骨干网络无关的11 GPU小时——相比之下，在5000万参数比较尺度上全规模搜索需16 GPU小时，在70亿参数尺度上需192 GPU小时——并且在最差领域上实现了+17.1%的绝对提升。
tldr: ProMix introduces a compute-efficient proxy-reference DRO method for optimizing data mixtures in robotic imitation learning, using a small proxy model to learn domain sampling weights that transfer to large VLA models, achieving Re-Mix-level performance at a fraction of the cost.
tldr_zh: ProMix提出了一种计算高效的代理参考分布鲁棒优化方法，用于机器人模仿学习中的数据混合优化，通过小型代理模型学习领域采样权重并迁移至大型VLA模型，以极低的计算成本达到与Re-Mix相当的性能。

title: Arcadian: Open-Source Humanoid Ecosystem for Accessible and Customizable Research and Education
summary: Reproducing and modifying a meter-scale humanoid remains challenging for research and teaching groups with limited fabrication resources and engineering support. This paper presents Arcadian, an open-source humanoid ecosystem that offers accessible and customizable humanoid hardware and software with community support. Arcadian aims to strike a balance among cost-effectiveness, structural durability, and full customizability, lowering the barrier to entry for research and education. Specifically, this meter-scale humanoid adopts metal-embedded 3D printing to achieve a high strength-to-cost ratio, eliminating the need for computer numerical control (CNC) machining while retaining design flexibility. Extensive simulation and hardware tests validate the design: a reinforcement-learning (RL) locomotion policy trained in simulation transfers to the hardware, and a virtual reality (VR) teleoperation interface drives both arms for simple manipulation tasks. The robot is around one meter tall and costs approximately $6,800 to build. All computer-aided design (CAD) models, the bill of materials, assembly documentation, and training and deployment code are publicly released, distributed through Tnkr.ai and MakerWorld and supported by a Discord server and a project forum through which community feedback informs design updates. The ecosystem resources are available at https://anonymous-humanoid.gitbook.io/docs.
summary_zh: 再现和改造米级人形机器人，对于制造资源与工程支持有限的研究和教学团队而言，仍是一大挑战。本文介绍了Arcadian，一个开源人形机器人生态系统，提供可获取且可定制的人形机器人硬件与软件，并配有社区支持。Arcadian旨在实现成本效益、结构耐用性和全面可定制性之间的平衡，降低研究和教育领域的入门门槛。具体而言，这款米级人形机器人采用金属嵌入式3D打印技术，实现了高强度与成本比的优化，无需计算机数控（CNC）加工，同时保留了设计灵活性。大量仿真与硬件测试验证了该设计：在仿真中训练的强化学习（RL）运动策略可成功迁移至硬件，虚拟现实（VR）遥操作界面可驱动双臂完成简单操作任务。该机器人身高约一米，制造成本约为6,800美元。所有计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型、物料清单、装配文档以及训练和部署代码均已公开，通过Tnkr.ai和MakerWorld平台分发，并配有Discord服务器和项目论坛，社区反馈可指导设计更新。生态系统资源可在https://anonymous-humanoid.gitbook.io/docs获取。
tldr: This paper presents Arcadian, an open-source, meter-scale humanoid robot ecosystem with metal-embedded 3D printing for cost-effective and customizable hardware, validated by RL locomotion and VR teleoperation, targeting accessible research and education.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Arcadian，一个开源、米级人形机器人生态系统，采用金属嵌入3D打印实现高性价比和可定制硬件，并通过RL运动与VR遥操作验证，旨在降低研究与教育门槛。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.
summary_zh: 因果视频世界模型会从自身之前的输出出发，逐块生成内容。早期块中的微小误差会作为历史信息被反馈回来，并不断累积，直到场景和机器人崩溃。教师强迫（Teacher Forcing）在干净的、基于真实值的历史数据上进行训练，因此模型从未见过它实际将依赖的历史信息，并且还会找到一条捷径：复制前一帧而不是预测场景的变化。我们提出了动态强迫（Dynamics Forcing）训练方案，该方案保持真实视频作为唯一的监督信号，并重新调整了历史信息的呈现方式。历史信息通过三种方式被扰动：随机加噪、模型自身的自我重采样，以及联合去噪——在预测下一块时，最近的块仍部分带有噪声。在此基础上，我们将历史引导和首帧锚定引导从推理阶段移至训练阶段，从而促使模型利用其历史信息和参考帧，而不是忽略它们。动态强迫（Dynamics Forcing）不需要教师模型，不需要蒸馏，推理时也无需额外模型。我们将该方法应用于一个50亿参数的视频模型，使用LoRA在单块GPU上对77小时的操作视频进行训练，实验结果表明，该方法能更好地匹配未见过的真实后续帧，并减少误差累积。
tldr: This paper proposes Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme for causal video world models that perturbs history via random noising, self-resampling, and joint denoising, and incorporates history and first-frame guidance into training. Applied to a 5B video model on manipulation videos, it reduces error accumulation and better matches real continuations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出动力学强迫（Dynamics Forcing），一种针对因果视频世界模型的训练方案，通过随机噪声、自身重采样和联合去噪来扰动历史，并在训练中加入历史引导和首帧锚定引导。应用于操作视频的5B模型，减少了误差累积并更接近真实连续结果。

title: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
summary: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.
summary_zh: 安全关键场景在实际记录的驾驶数据中极为罕见，因此必须生成此类场景，以测试和训练自动驾驶汽车的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型都需要其各自的加权目标，并与有效性检查相互独立。当攻击者与受测车辆被联合优化时，受测车辆可能抵消攻击，亦可能将攻击引向自身。我们将每个场景表述为一种信号时序逻辑规范，其中子句按角色类型化。每个子句指明其可修改的主体以及其可读取的主体，且受测车辆仅从攻击开始时刻起读取攻击者的信息。大型语言模型根据描述草拟规范，并由类型检查器予以接受。编译器推导出优化过程：它通过满足规范的最小改动来编辑扩散模型的样本，每个子句仅移动其所属主体，攻击者在受测车辆未作出反应之前即被求解，而同一规范的监控器决定是否接受生成结果。在nuScenes和CommonRoad数据集上，独立于规范进行评判时，一组参数生成的有效场景比例比针对每种场景类型单独调优的加权目标高出0.14；在公共数据可表达的16种预碰撞类型中，描述方法为其中11种生成了至少一个有效场景。学习型规划器在生成的场景上的失败率高于其在种子场景上的失败率。基于这些场景进行微调可降低规划器在关键场景中的失败率，而收益的大小由标签中某一子句所需的时间车头时距决定，而非生成器本身。
tldr: This paper presents a method to generate safety-critical driving scenarios by using large language models to draft role-typed signal temporal logic specifications, which are then compiled into guided diffusion sample edits for adversarial testing of motion planners.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型起草角色类型信号时序逻辑规范，并编译为引导扩散样本编辑以生成安全关键驾驶场景的方法，用于对抗性测试运动规划器。

title: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
summary: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.
summary_zh: 近期在基于物理的人形机器人控制领域取得的进展，使得不同规模的人形机器人团队能够协调其运动并合作搬运共享物体。然而，将学到的协作行为适应于未见过的环境约束仍然具有挑战性，特别是当障碍物要求协调绕行和改变团队配置时。我们提出了CarlHOI，一种基于反事实锚定关系潜在世界模型（CarlWM）的反事实预测想象框架，用于人-物交互（HOI），使多人形机器人团队能够在无需重新训练其底层协作控制策略的情况下适应未见过的环境约束。CarlHOI将共享物体、个体人形机器人和环境障碍物显式表示为相互交互的实体。通过使用反事实模拟器轨迹进行离线训练，该模型在不同共享路径点命令下想象替代性的集体未来，预测耦合的人形机器人团队及物体将如何响应。通过预测的进展、失败和接触风险以及长时程价值估计来评估这些想象结果，CarlHOI在保持预训练协作控制器的同时选择自适应引导命令。我们引入了一个包含三个具有挑战性的障碍约束搬运任务的基准测试，以评估适应性和泛化能力。尽管仅使用四个人形机器人进行训练，我们的模型无需重新训练即可泛化到两到十个人形机器人的团队、未见过的障碍物几何形状和位置、未见过的物体以及环境约束的新颖组合。大量实验表明，在不同配置下，相较于评估的基线方法，协作搬运成功率有所提高。结果凸显了反事实预测想象在将预训练的多人形机器人协作技能扩展到其原始训练条件之外方面的潜力。
tldr: CarlHOI introduces a counterfactual predictive imagination framework with a latent world model, enabling multi-humanoid teams to cooperatively transport shared objects under unseen environmental constraints without retraining their pretrained cooperative policies. The model generalizes to varying team sizes, obstacle configurations, and object types.
tldr_zh: CarlHOI提出了一个基于反事实预测想象和潜在世界模型的框架，使多个人形机器人团队能够在未见过的环境约束下协作搬运共享物体，而无需重新训练其预训练协作策略。该模型可泛化到不同团队规模、障碍物配置和物体类型。

title: SparQ4D: Learning to Act through Sparse 4D Queries
summary: Successful manipulation requires a policy to understand where things are and how they will move, yet action demonstrations leave this spatiotemporal structure implicit. While explicit 4D supervision has proven effective, reducing the cost of dense 4D prediction remains challenging. This paper introduces SparQ4D, a lightweight yet expressive decoder that efficiently injects holistic 4D scene understanding into policies and improves success rates. At its core is a query-based decoder attached to a pretrained policy, which casts many spatialtemporal tasks into one unified interface (e.g. depth, 2D/3D point motion, multi-view correspondence, and hand-eye relations). This design enables efficient training and inference without sacrificing expressivity: the policy learns rich 4D structure from a small number of sampled queries during training, while the decoder can be removed at inference with zero additional overhead. Across multiple backbones, simulated environments, and real-world settings, SparQ4D achieves state-of-the-art manipulation performance, outperforming competing methods while training up to $5\times$ faster. Probing analyses further reveal that this 4D structure is recoverable from the policy.
summary_zh: 成功的操控需要一个策略来理解物体的位置及其运动方式，然而动作演示并未明确呈现这种时空结构。尽管显式的4D监督已被证明有效，但降低密集4D预测的成本仍具挑战性。本文提出SparQ4D，一种轻量且富有表现力的解码器，能够高效地将整体4D场景理解注入策略中，并提升任务成功率。其核心是一个基于查询的解码器，附加在预训练策略之上，将多种时空任务统一到同一接口中（例如深度、2D/3D点运动、多视图对应关系以及手眼关系）。该设计在不牺牲表现力的前提下实现了高效的训练与推理：策略在训练期间从少量采样的查询中学习丰富的4D结构，而解码器在推理时可完全移除，不增加任何额外开销。在多种骨干网络、模拟环境及真实世界场景中，SparQ4D均取得了最先进的操控性能，在超越竞争方法的同时，训练速度提升高达5倍。进一步的分析实验表明，这种4D结构可从策略中恢复。
tldr: SparQ4D introduces a lightweight query-based decoder that injects sparse 4D scene understanding (depth, motion, correspondence) into pretrained robot policies, improving manipulation success rates with faster training and zero inference overhead.
tldr_zh: SparQ4D 提出一种轻量级基于查询的解码器，将稀疏4D场景理解（深度、运动、对应关系）注入预训练机器人策略，提升操作成功率并实现更快训练和零推理开销。

title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
summary: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 学习预测接触丰富的操作技能的效果，需要能够表征不同结果模式而非单一预期结果的模型。即便是推、抓取和放置这类基础技能，接触条件或物体几何形状的微小变化，也可能在几乎相同的状态和动作下，导致物体运动产生质的差异。确定性模型和高斯模型往往会对这些可能性进行平均处理，或将其表示为单一的宽泛分布，从而掩盖了滑动、倾倒和旋转等不同的模式。我们研究了概率技能效果模型，该模型能够在给定部分点云和动作的情况下，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布。我们通过三种具有代表性的模型类别来实现这一抽象：混合密度网络、状态标记化和流匹配，每一种都结合了潜在动力学进行下一步预测。在多样化的物体和技能上，显式的多模态模型在预测实际发生的结果方面比确定性和高斯基线模型更为准确。在规划方面，流匹配在每项技能上的任务成功率均显著优于确定性基线，并且在每一个多步骤序列上都取得了最高的成功率。在真实机器人上，概率模型在抓取任务中的成功率约为确定性基线的两倍，这为概率技能效果在不确定性条件下进行推理和规划提供了实用抽象的有力证据。
tldr: This paper introduces probabilistic skill-effect models for contact-rich manipulation that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes, and demonstrates that explicitly multimodal models (especially flow matching) outperform deterministic and Gaussian baselines in planning and real-robot pick tasks, reducing floating and interpenetration artifacts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用于接触丰富操作的概率技能效应模型，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布，并证明显式多模态模型（尤其是流匹配）在规划和真实机器人拾取任务中优于确定性和高斯基线，减少了浮动和穿透伪影。

title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
summary: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.
summary_zh: 流匹配策略从一个固定的、与观测无关的高斯源整合速度场。然而，由于该源是单峰的且在所有任务间相同，高斯分布的有限表示能力限制了策略随任务多样性增长而扩展的程度。此外，该源在时间步和控制维度上因子化，丢弃了操作所需的协调性。我们提出了Boltz-Flow，用更强大的、以观测和指令为条件的玻尔兹曼源替代高斯初始化，同时保持基础VLA不变。Boltz-Flow使用条件玻尔兹曼机对该源进行参数化，为每个二值源状态分配一个能量值。一个完全由离线示范监督的列表级目标，将该能量与冻结流整合后生成的动作质量对齐。在推理时，该能量定义了一个Ising实例，其解在单次标准整合前被解码为连续噪声。我们在训练期间使用物理相干Ising机。实验表明，Boltz-Flow在三个基准上提升了$π_{0.5}$，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上优于所比较的强策略基线和竞争性噪声优化方法，在LIBERO-Plus上仅次于LEAP排名第二。额外实验显示，在噪声自适应微调、动作到动作的热启动以及SmolVLA骨干上的增益。
tldr: Boltz-Flow replaces the Gaussian noise source in flow-matching VLA policies with a conditional Boltzmann machine that is trained to sample task-specific, high-quality action-initializing noise, improving manipulation performance across benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Boltz-Flow用条件玻尔兹曼机替代流匹配VLA策略中的高斯噪声源，通过训练使其采样任务相关的高质量动作初始化噪声，在多个操纵基准上提升性能。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. Experiments across LIBERO, DROID, and BEHAVIOR demonstrate improved visual prediction fidelity and more accurate action-induced motion prediction over existing world models. Further evaluations on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the utility of ActField in improving downstream policy planning through VLM-guided action selection.
summary_zh: 学习动作如何改变视觉状态，对于具身任务中的预测和决策至关重要。现有的基于动作条件的JEPA世界模型通常仅在离散的观测间隔上预测未来表征，动作效果的时间演化过程隐含其中，未被显式建模。我们提出了ActField，一种连续时间的JEPA世界模型，通过整合物理时间上的动作条件向量场，显式地建模潜在状态的演化过程。ActField将动作无关的演化与动作引起的变化相分离，后者由潜在上下文调制。参考条件化表示和多步动力学损失进一步支持准确的长时程预测。这些组件共同为预测动作条件下的视觉动力学提供了一种结构化且时间连续的公式化框架。在LIBERO、DROID和BEHAVIOR上的实验表明，与现有世界模型相比，ActField在视觉预测保真度和动作引起运动的预测准确性方面均有提升。在仿真和真实世界操作任务上的进一步评估表明，ActField通过VLM引导的动作选择，在改进下游策略规划方面具有实用价值。
tldr: This paper introduces ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field, improving visual prediction fidelity and downstream policy planning for manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ActField，一种连续时间JEPA世界模型，通过动作条件向量场显式建模潜在状态演化，提高了视觉预测保真度和下游操作任务的策略规划能力。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.
summary_zh: 我们提出了视听重排（Audio-Visual Rearrangement, AVR）任务，在该任务中，智能体听到一段语音请求，检索到合适的目标物体，并将其递送给提出请求的用户或指令指定的目的地。AVR要求智能体理解语音请求，并通过声学方式定位说话者以完成递送任务。为支持该任务，我们构建了一个涵盖三种查询类型的数据集：显式目标指定、基于说话者相对空间指代以及隐含用户意图，共包含八种子类型，涉及多样的物体选择与递送需求。此外，我们提出了一种框架，将运动感知空间音频模块集成到视听大语言模型中，用以编码语音请求中的空间线索，并在智能体移动过程中对其进行动态更新。我们进一步通过多任务指令微调，引入针对语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉定位的辅助监督，以提升动作预测性能。实验在已知和未知环境中均建立了基准性能，为具身智能与人机交互的未来研究奠定了基础。相关代码将很快公开。
tldr: This paper introduces Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a task where an embodied agent hears a spoken request, retrieves an object, and delivers it to the speaker or a specified destination, and proposes a framework integrating a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model with multitask instruction tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了音频-视觉重排（AVR）任务，智能体需理解口头指令、检索物体并递送给说话者或指定位置，并提出了将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音频-视觉大语言模型中的框架，通过多任务指令调优提升动作预测。

title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
summary_zh: 4D占用预测旨在预测驾驶场景未来数秒的三维语义占用情况。在数秒时间内，场景变化甚微而车辆持续移动，因此前方大部分空间此前已被观测到。将未来空间划分为不变区域、变化区域及未观测区域后，我们发现当前基于相机的方法在不变区域的预测上存在明显不足：它们未能保持对已观测内容的记忆，而非未能预测将要发生的变化。为此，我们将模型已观测到的内容作为其状态。PersistWorld方法将相机帧流式输入至以场景为锚定的持久化三维世界状态中，每帧仅写入一次，而无需基于历史帧重建状态。该状态与预测过程端到端联合学习，并通过一个演化器在自车轨迹上的任意查询时刻预测该状态。在Occ3D-nuScenes基准上，PersistWorld将最佳基于相机方法的IoU在1-3秒时提升19个百分点，在长达8秒时提升18至24个百分点，同时运行速度提升两倍以上。代码和模型：https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld。项目主页：https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld
tldr: PersistWorld improves 4D occupancy forecasting for autonomous driving by streaming camera frames into a persistent 3D world state, which is learned end-to-end and evolved along the ego trajectory, achieving large IoU gains over existing camera-based world models.
tldr_zh: PersistWorld 通过将相机帧流式传输到持久化的 3D 世界状态中，并沿自我轨迹进行演化，从而改进自动驾驶的 4D 占用预测，相较于现有基于相机的方法取得了显著的 IoU 提升。

title: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.
summary_zh: 对抗性物体攻击对自动驾驶中基于BEV的3D物体检测器构成威胁。现有攻击通常针对单一模态，在当前时间戳协调相机和激光雷达观测，或主要在相机流中建模时间持续性。由于缺乏对当前和历史观测的统一构建，攻击可能无法完全抑制检测器累积证据的一部分，从而限制其有效性。本文提出AdvMTO，一种用于抑制持续性对抗物体检测的2D高斯泼溅（2DGS）框架。其定向曲面体（surfel）将外观、几何和不透明度编码在单一物体状态中，由此生成相机图像和扫描线激光雷达返回值。AdvMTO随后通过检测器原生处理构建当前和历史输入，为融合检测器在每个原生数据源扫描中重新生成激光雷达返回值。我们针对每个检测器优化有界外观扰动，并通过历史BEV存储器传播梯度以用于时间相机检测器。对于融合检测器，沿局部法线的有界几何细化进一步扰动两种感知模态。在nuScenes上的实验表明，该方法能有效抑制三种BEV检测器对交通锥的检测。时间消融实验进一步凸显了检测器原生历史建模在攻击构建和优化中的重要性。
tldr: AdvMTO proposes a 2D Gaussian Splatting framework to generate adversarial objects that suppress BEV-based 3D object detection in autonomous driving by modeling current and historical multi-modal sensor inputs.
tldr_zh: AdvMTO提出一种基于2D高斯泼溅的框架，通过建模当前与历史多模态传感器输入，生成对抗物体以抑制自动驾驶中基于BEV的3D目标检测。

title: EvoMisty: Building, Optimizing, and Evolving Capabilities on a Social Robot
summary: Social robots face diverse and changing tasks in companionship and education. LLM-based methods can generate task programs, but they still rely on manually developed control interfaces and predefined capabilities. They also lack a general mechanism to optimize completed tasks based on user-specified metrics and reuse performance improvements across tasks.We present EvoMisty, a plugin-based framework that enables coding agents to build and continually improve robot capabilities. EvoMisty builds a control program from official documentation and verifies candidate capabilities on a physical robot. Verified capabilities are stored in an atomic capability library and combined with existing skills to solve tasks. After task completion, EvoMisty can collect execution data, measure user-specified metrics, and iteratively improve task programs. It then distills reusable skills from final solutions into a skill library for future tasks.We evaluate EvoMisty on a physical Misty II robot using Claude Code and Codex. The two agents construct 109 and 107 verified atomic capabilities, respectively. Both complete all 28 AutoMisty benchmark tasks and seven additional tasks beyond AutoMisty's capabilities. Optimization improves all seven evaluated metrics across five tasks. For example, dialogue response latency decreases by 52% and 71%, respectively. Reusing skills from one optimized dialogue task reduces latency by 33% to 72% in three other dialogue tasks without further optimization. All code and experimental videos will be publicly released through the webpage: https://wangxiaoshawn.github.io/projects/evomisty/index.html
summary_zh: 社交机器人在陪伴和教育场景中面临多样且不断变化的任务。基于大语言模型的方法能够生成任务程序，但仍依赖人工开发的控制接口和预定义能力，且缺乏一种通用机制来根据用户指定的指标优化已完成的任 务，并将性能改进跨任务复用。我们提出EvoMisty，一个基于插件的框架，使编码智能体能够构建并持续改进机器人能力。EvoMisty从官方文档构建控制程序，并在物理机器人上验证候选能力。验证通过的能力被存储在原子能力库中，并与现有技能组合以解决任务。任务完成后，EvoMisty能够收集执行数据，衡量用户指定的指标，并迭代改进任务程序。随后，它从最终解决方案中提炼可复用技能，并将其存入技能库以供未来任务使用。我们使用Claude Code和Codex在物理Misty II机器人上对EvoMisty进行评估。两个智能体分别构建了109个和107个经过验证的原子能力，均完成了AutoMisty基准测试中的全部28个任务，以及超出AutoMisty能力的7个额外任务。优化使五个任务中的全部七项评估指标均得到改善。例如，对话响应延迟分别降低了52%和71%。从一个优化的对话任务中复用的技能，在另外三个对话任务中将延迟降低了33%至72%，且无需进一步优化。所有代码和实验视频将通过网页公开：https://wangxiaoshawn.github.io/projects/evomisty/index.html
tldr: EvoMisty is a plugin-based framework enabling coding agents to build, verify, and iteratively optimize robot capabilities on a physical social robot, while distilling reusable skills and improving performance metrics such as dialogue latency.
tldr_zh: EvoMisty 是一个基于插件的框架，使编码代理能够在实体社交机器人上构建、验证并迭代优化能力，同时提炼可复用技能并改进对话延迟等性能指标。

title: SurgeCount: A Protocol-Guided Composition Harness for Bimanual Surgical Sponge Counting
summary: We present SurgeCount, a system for auditable robotic surgical sponge counting that composes learned skills under a written procedural protocol. Retained sponges cause preventable harm, and surgical teams count every sponge before closure to reduce that risk. The robot repeatedly isolates one deformable sponge from a tangled pile and places it in the next numbered counting-tray slot, requiring handling of occluded grasp threads while preserving step order. We train one subtask-conditioned policy on eleven short skills and learn when each skill ends. At each learned boundary, a stateful vision-language model selects the next skill from an operator-authored specification of step order, visual verification, and recovery. This creates temporal commitment to each subtask and enables failures to be recovered by recomposing existing skills rather than using a dedicated recovery policy. We evaluate five methods across 100 real-robot trials using 20 matched layouts. SurgeCount fills 47 of 60 ordered slots and completes 12 of 20 procedures, compared with 27 of 60 and 3 of 20 for the strongest of four end-to-end policies trained on the same data. Replacing the detailed protocol prompt with a minimal prompt reduces performance to 29 of 60 slots and 5 of 20 completed procedures. These results show that long-horizon performance depends not only on visuomotor capacity, but also on how learned skills are committed, verified, and composed. This tabletop proof of concept motivates further evaluation of protocol-guided robotic sponge counting in clinically representative settings.
summary_zh: 我们提出了SurgeCount系统，用于可审计的机器人手术海绵计数，该系统在书面程序协议下组合已学习的技能。遗留海绵会造成可预防的伤害，手术团队在关腹前需逐一清点海绵以降低该风险。机器人反复从缠绕成堆的海绵中分离出一块可变形海绵，并将其放入下一个编号的计数托盘槽位中，这需要在保持步骤顺序的同时处理被遮挡的抓取线。我们在十一个短技能上训练了一个子任务条件策略，并学习每个技能的结束时机。在每个学习到的边界处，一个有状态的视觉-语言模型根据操作者编写的步骤顺序、视觉验证和恢复规范来选择下一个技能。这实现了对每个子任务的时间承诺，并使得失败能够通过重新组合现有技能而非使用专门的恢复策略来恢复。我们使用20种匹配布局，在100次真实机器人试验中评估了五种方法。SurgeCount填满了60个有序槽位中的47个，并完成了20个流程中的12个，而同样数据上训练的四种端到端策略中最强者仅填满60个槽位中的27个、完成20个流程中的3个。将详细协议提示替换为最小提示后，性能下降至60个槽位中的29个和20个完成流程中的5个。这些结果表明，长时程性能不仅取决于视觉运动能力，还取决于已学习技能如何被承诺、验证和组合。这一桌面级概念验证为在临床代表性环境中进一步评估协议引导的机器人海绵计数提供了动力。
tldr: SurgeCount is a protocol-guided robot system for bimanual surgical sponge counting that composes learned skills using a VLM to select and verify skills under a written procedural protocol, improving long-horizon performance over end-to-end policies.
tldr_zh: SurgeCount 是一个协议引导的机器人系统，用于双手外科海绵计数，通过 VLM 在书面程序协议下选择和验证技能，从而组合学习技能，提高了长时程任务的表现。

title: Personalization of a Commercial Powered Knee Prosthesis Under Clinically Realistic Conditions via Reinforcement Learning: A Feasibility Study
summary: Personalization of powered prosthesis control to individual user needs remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, policy iteration with constraint embedded (PICE), a reinforcement learning (RL) tuning approach, has been developed and validated. This feasibility study investigated whether the developed approach can personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis under clinically realistic conditions. To reduce the time for personalization, tuning was initialized with a policy learned offline from one non-disabled participant walking on a treadmill and was then applied to three other non-disabled participants walking with the knee through a bypass adapter on a 5-meter walkway. All participants reached the goal within 8-18 tuning steps (1.7-4.2 minutes of walking), reducing the knee-kinematic feature error by 64-90% on average. These results support the feasibility of implementing the RL-based tuning approach in clinically realistic conditions with space and equipment constraints.
summary_zh: 摘要：动力假肢控制针对个体用户需求的个性化仍是一项重大挑战。为应对这一挑战，已开发并验证了一种嵌入约束的策略迭代（PICE）方法，即一种强化学习（RL）调参方法。本可行性研究探讨了该方法能否在临床现实条件下对商用动力膝关节假肢进行个性化调整。为缩短个性化时间，调参过程以离线状态下从一名非残疾受试者在跑步机上行走所学习到的策略作为初始化，随后将该策略应用于另外三名非残疾受试者，他们通过旁路适配器在5米步行道上佩戴该膝关节行走。所有受试者均在8至18个调参步数内（对应1.7至4.2分钟的步行时间）达到目标，膝关节运动学特征误差平均降低64%至90%。这些结果支持了在存在空间和设备限制的临床现实条件下实施基于强化学习的调参方法的可行性。
tldr: This paper demonstrates the feasibility of using a reinforcement learning-based tuning approach (PICE) to personalize a commercial powered knee prosthesis in clinically realistic conditions, achieving significant error reduction in few tuning steps.
tldr_zh: 本文证明了在临床现实条件下，使用基于强化学习的调整方法（PICE）个性化商用动力膝关节假肢的可行性，在少量调整步骤中显著减少了误差。

title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Surprisingly Effective In-Context Robot Learners
summary: Can foundation models pretrained for generic numerical prediction serve as in-context robot learners? We investigate this question through tabular foundation models (TFMs), which are pretrained to infer input-output relationships from labeled examples in context. We introduce TabAct, which casts visual imitation as numerical prediction: frozen visual features and robot proprioception form the inputs, future action chunks form the targets, and each demonstration time step provides one labeled example that conditions a frozen TFM for closed-loop control. The predictor receives no robot-specific training or target-task fine-tuning. With one target-task demonstration available to each method, TabAct with TabICLv2 achieves the highest average success among all evaluated methods on both LIBERO and Meta-World, exceeding the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 5.8 percentage points, respectively. Additional demonstrations improve control without updating model weights: with five demonstrations, success reaches 94.2% on LIBERO-Object. These results demonstrate that generic numerical pretraining can provide an effective foundation for in-context robot learning.
summary_zh: 能否将用于通用数值预测的预训练基础模型作为上下文机器人学习器？我们通过表格基础模型（TFMs）来探讨这一问题，这类模型经过预训练，能够根据上下文中的标注示例推断输入-输出关系。我们提出了TabAct方法，将视觉模仿转化为数值预测：冻结的视觉特征与机器人本体感觉构成输入，未来动作片段构成目标，每个演示时间步提供一个标注示例，用于条件化冻结的TFM以实现闭环控制。该预测器无需针对机器人的特定训练或目标任务微调。在每种方法仅获得一个目标任务演示的条件下，采用TabICLv2的TabAct在LIBERO和Meta-World两个基准上均取得了所有评估方法中最高的平均成功率，分别超出最强基线20.9和5.8个百分点。额外的演示无需更新模型权重即可提升控制性能：在提供五个演示时，LIBERO-Object上的成功率达到了94.2%。这些结果表明，通用数值预训练能够为上下文机器人学习提供有效的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces TabAct, which applies frozen tabular foundation models to visual imitation by casting it as numerical prediction, achieving strong closed-loop control performance on LIBERO and Meta-World without robot-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TabAct，将视觉模仿转化为数值预测，使用冻结的表格基础模型进行上下文学习，在LIBERO和Meta-World上无需机器人特定训练即实现了强闭环控制性能。

title: Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
summary: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and redundant roadmaps amplify both safe-interval reasoning and multi-agent interaction handling. To bridge this gap, we formalize AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant of MAPF$_R$ with precomputed continuous-time conflicts that enables the reuse of MAPF$_R$ solvers for AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes. We then revisit continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS), identifying the boundary conditions required by its safe interval path planning (SIPP) low-level planner under priority-induced constraints and enabling earlier solution detection. As a central contribution, we analyze the structure of the priority search space, clarifying which agents are affected by each priority refinement and when replanning can be avoided. Building on this analysis, we introduce a novel algorithm, Lazy-CPBS, which materializes high-level nodes lazily: a child's plans are computed only when it is expanded, so siblings that are never expanded cost no low-level search. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks and on industrial AGV roadmaps imported from a proprietary digital-twin simulator show that CPBS-based solvers remain effective well beyond the agent counts reachable by optimal MAPF$_R$ solvers, while Lazy-CPBS substantially reduces CPBS overhead and offers the most consistent robustness/runtime trade-off across industrial layouts.
summary_zh: 连续时间多智能体路径规划在道路图上的问题（MAPF$_R$）为带有几何碰撞避免的车队协调提供了一种原则性方法，然而其在工业自动导引车（AGV）基础设施上的部署仍然具有挑战性，因为高度连通且冗余的道路图同时放大了安全间隔推理和多智能体交互处理的复杂度。为弥合这一差距，我们形式化了AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC，这是MAPF$_R$的一种构型空间变体，带有预计算的连续时间冲突，使得MAPF$_R$求解器能够在最小改动下复用于AGV车队协调。随后，我们重新审视连续时间优先级搜索（CPBS），识别其在优先级诱导约束下安全间隔路径规划（SIPP）底层规划器所需的边界条件，并实现更早的解决方案检测。作为核心贡献，我们分析了优先级搜索空间的结构，阐明了每次优先级细化影响哪些智能体以及何时可以避免重新规划。基于这一分析，我们提出了一种新颖算法Lazy-CPBS，该算法惰性化地物化高层节点：仅在子节点被扩展时才计算其规划，因此从未被扩展的兄弟节点不产生任何底层搜索开销。在标准MAPF基准测试以及从专有数字孪生模拟器导入的工业AGV道路图上的实验表明，基于CPBS的求解器在远超最优MAPF$_R$求解器可处理的智能体数量范围内仍然有效，而Lazy-CPBS大幅降低了CPBS的开销，并在多种工业布局中提供了最一致的鲁棒性/运行时间权衡。
tldr: This paper bridges continuous-time multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF_R) and industrial AGV fleet coordination by formalizing a configuration-space variant with precomputed conflicts and introducing Lazy-CPBS, an algorithm that reduces computational overhead through lazy high-level node expansion. Experiments on benchmarks and industrial AGV roadmaps demonstrate improved scalability and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文通过形式化具有预计算冲突的构型空间变体，并引入Lazy-CPBS算法（延迟高层节点扩展以减少计算开销），弥合了连续时间多智能体路径规划（MAPF_R）与工业AGV车队协调之间的鸿沟。在基准测试和工业AGV路网上的实验证明了其可扩展性和鲁棒性的提升。

title: Beyond Domain Randomization: Real-World Policy Adaptation in Learned Dynamics for Legged Robots
summary: Reinforcement learning policies are often trained with static domain randomization for real-world deployment. However, real-world environments often exhibit unmodeled dynamic variations, such as payload changes or friction shifts, that lie outside the randomization distribution, leading to performance degradation upon deployment. We propose a framework that moves beyond static domain randomization by adapting a learned dynamics model to the deployed target conditions, with a concurrent teacher-student paradigm applied to both the policy and dynamics model. This framework integrates the dynamics model into an on-policy reinforcement learning pipeline, letting the performance of the policy align with the empirical target dynamics. Experimental validations on bipedal locomotion tasks demonstrate competitive adaptability under extreme physical variations, including a payload reaching 80% of self-weight and an oil-lubricated low-friction surface.
summary_zh: 强化学习策略在面向实际部署时，通常采用静态域随机化进行训练。然而，现实环境往往表现出未建模的动态变化，例如载荷变化或摩擦力偏移，这些变化超出随机化分布范围，导致部署后性能下降。我们提出了一种超越静态域随机化的框架，通过将学习到的动力学模型适应于部署目标条件，并采用师生并行范式同时应用于策略和动力学模型。该框架将动力学模型集成到在线策略强化学习流程中，使策略性能与实际目标动力学保持一致。在双足行走任务上的实验验证表明，该框架在极端物理变化下展现出竞争性适应能力，包括高达自身体重80%的载荷以及润滑油润滑的低摩擦表面。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework that adapts a learned dynamics model to real-world target conditions via a concurrent teacher-student paradigm for policy and dynamics, improving bipedal locomotion under extreme payload and friction variations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过策略和动力学模型的并行师生范式，将学习到的动力学模型适应真实世界目标条件的框架，在双足运动的极端载荷和摩擦变化下提升了适应性。

title: Object Count Generalization Is an Interface Problem: Warping a Frozen Skill Instead of Retraining It
summary: Reinforcement learning policies for robot manipulation degrade when the number of objects N in the scene grows beyond the training range. This is a covariate shift that also changes the dimension of the state. We propose WAVE (Warping Actions and Views of an Expert), which extends a pretrained single-object skill to many objects without updating its weights. WAVE has three parts. First, a selection policy picks the one object the robot works on next. Second, a warping policy reads a local view of the scene around that object, whose size does not depend on N. It emits a multiplier and an offset for every quantity the skill reads and every action it outputs. Third, the skill acts under this affine warp. It is shown a scene that holds a single object, while the warp steers it around the objects it is not shown and edits the actions that are sent to the robot. Both the selection and warping policies are trained with PPO on the multi-object reward and use the skill as a black box, so WAVE is task-general and skill-agnostic. It requires only that the skill was trained on the same embodiment and that every object has a goal pose. We also bound the number of attempts needed to place all N objects, assuming positive expected net progress per attempt, and measure this progress for each object count. We evaluate WAVE on cube arrangement tasks with a gantry robot and with a Franka Panda arm. Trained with at most nine cubes, it generalizes zero-shot to several times its training count, on the gantry to scenes of up to thirty cubes. Published methods that learn multi-object manipulation show count generalization up to six objects. Fine-tuning the skill, learning from the same local view without it, and an entity transformer, even when distilled from the pretrained skill, all collapse within their training counts under the same training budget.
summary_zh: 强化学习策略在机器人操作任务中的表现，会随着场景中物体数量N超出训练范围而下降。这是一种协变量偏移，同时也改变了状态的维度。我们提出了WAVE（专家动作与视角的仿射变换），该方法在不更新预训练单物体技能权重的前提下，将其扩展至多物体场景。WAVE包含三个部分。首先，一个选择策略决定机器人接下来处理哪一个物体。其次，一个仿射变换策略读取该物体周围的局部场景视图，该视图的大小不依赖于N。它对技能所读取的每一个量以及所输出的每一个动作，生成一个乘数和一个偏移量。第三，技能在该仿射变换下执行操作。此时技能所见的场景仅包含单个物体，而变换则引导其在未被显示的物体之间进行导航，并修改发送给机器人的动作。选择策略和仿射变换策略均使用PPO在多物体奖励上训练，并将技能视为黑箱，因此WAVE具有任务通用性和技能无关性。其唯一的要求是：技能必须在相同的机器人本体上训练，且每个物体都有目标位姿。我们还假设每次尝试的期望净进展为正，给出了放置全部N个物体所需尝试次数的上界，并针对每种物体数量度量该进展。我们在龙门机器人和Franka Panda机械臂上对立方体排列任务进行了WAVE评估。该方法在最多九个立方体上训练，即可零样本泛化至训练数量的数倍，在龙门机器人上甚至可泛化至多达三十个立方体的场景。已发表的多物体操作学习方法最多仅能泛化至六个物体。在相同的训练预算下，对技能进行微调、不使用该变换而仅从相同局部视图学习，以及使用实体Transformer（即便从预训练技能中进行蒸馏）等方法，均会在其训练数量范围内失效。
tldr: WAVE extends a frozen single-object manipulation skill to scenes with many objects by learning a selection policy and a warping policy that rescales the skill's observations and actions, enabling zero-shot count generalization without retraining the skill.
tldr_zh: WAVE通过学习选择策略和扭曲策略，对冻结的单物体操作技能的观察和动作进行缩放，使其无需重新训练即可泛化到多物体场景，实现零样本数量泛化。

title: ABI: Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations for Zero-Shot Test-Time Guidance
summary: Behavior-cloning policies show strong ability in sequential control by generating coherent multi-step action chunks, yet their purely imitative objective limits zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks. While offline reinforcement learning offers principled policy improvement, existing methods either require task-specific reward supervision or remain tied to a specific actor during critic training or policy deployment, inflating training cost and restricting cross-policy generalization. We observe that evaluating actions under the data-collecting behavior largely preserves their relative value ordering across target policies, offering a way around actor coupling. Combining this property with reward-free successor prediction, we propose Actor-Free Behavior-Induced Representations (ABI) to learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations from unlabeled trajectories without reward supervision or actor training. At test time, pairing the frozen representation with lightweight task readouts forms a chunk critic that guides target policies without parameter updates and transfers directly across distinct unseen policies. Our analysis establishes when the value ordering is preserved across policies and when selecting among proposed chunks improves closed-loop return. Across 65 locomotion, navigation, and manipulation tasks, ABI's chunk critic guides weak imitation policies to match or surpass zero-shot RL baselines with high sample efficiency, outperforms existing zero-shot critics on identical proposals, and improves externally trained RL actors without retraining. From raw pixels, ABI delivers substantial guidance gains and surpasses prior zero-shot RL baselines on visual manipulation, highlighting its potential for visuomotor control.
summary_zh: 行为克隆策略通过生成连贯的多步动作块，在序列控制中展现出强大能力，但其纯模仿目标限制了其对未见任务的零样本泛化。尽管离线强化学习提供了原则性的策略改进途径，现有方法要么需要特定于任务的真实验收监督，要么在评论员训练或策略部署期间仍受限于特定行动者，从而增加了训练成本并限制了跨策略泛化。我们观察到，在数据采集行为下评估动作能够大致保持其在不同目标策略间的相对价值排序，这为绕开行动者耦合提供了一条途径。将该性质与免奖励的继任预测相结合，我们提出了行动者无关的行为诱导表示（ABI），用于从无标注轨迹中学习多时间跨度的动作块表示，而无需真实验收监督或行动者训练。在测试阶段，将冻结的表示与轻量级任务读取头配对，可形成一种块评论员，该评论员无需参数更新即可引导目标策略，并可直接迁移至多种未见过的不同策略。我们的分析阐明了何时价值排序能在策略间得以保持，以及何时在候选动作块中进行选择能够提升闭环回报。在65个运动、导航和操作任务中，ABI的块评论员能够引导弱模仿策略达到或超越零样本强化学习基线，且具备高样本效率，在相同候选上优于现有零样本评论员，并能在不重新训练的情况下改进外部训练好的强化学习行动者。在原始像素输入下，ABI在视觉操作任务中带来了显著的引导增益，并超越了先前的零样本强化学习基线，凸显了其在视觉运动控制中的潜力。
tldr: ABI proposes a reward-free, actor-free method to learn multi-horizon action-chunk representations from unlabeled trajectories, enabling a frozen chunk critic that can guide arbitrary target policies at test time without retraining, showing strong zero-shot generalization across locomotion, navigation, and visual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: ABI 提出一种无需奖励和演员的方法，从无标签轨迹中学习多时间步动作块表示，使冻结的块评论器能够在测试时指导任意目标策略而无需重新训练，在运动、导航和视觉操作任务中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

title: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
summary: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 摘要：本报告介绍了一套用于物理AI自动驾驶赛道端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型开发的完整流程。该框架涵盖数据整理、高清地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习以及基于模拟器的强化学习。为确保闭环场景下的安全性，我们提出了一种基于筛选的端到端规划方法，利用目标检测和鸟瞰图（BEV）分割来过滤可能导致碰撞或偏离道路的轨迹候选。该方法在NVIDIA NuRec和NVIDIA PAI-AV数据集上训练，对固定轨迹候选集进行碰撞风险、可行驶区域合规性及从模拟推演中学到的行进进度评分，并选出通过筛选的最佳候选轨迹。该设计充分展示了端到端规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，在安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶中的有效性。
tldr: This technical report presents an end-to-end autonomous driving pipeline for the Physical AI AV Track, combining data curation, HD map auto-labeling, imitation learning, and simulator-based RL with a selection-based E2E planning approach that uses perception outputs to filter trajectory candidates for safety in closed-loop settings.
tldr_zh: 本技术报告介绍了一个用于物理AI自动驾驶挑战赛的端到端驾驶流水线，结合数据整理、高清地图自动标注、模仿学习和基于模拟器的强化学习，并采用基于感知的轨迹候选过滤机制来确保闭环安全性。

title: One Policy, Many Bodies: Cooperative Human-Object Interaction with Heterogeneous Teams
summary: Physics-based human-object interaction (HOI) has enabled multiple characters to cooperatively transport objects, but existing cooperative controllers largely assume homogeneous embodiments and predefined interaction tasks. We ask whether a single physics-based policy can enable cooperation across diverse embodiments, team compositions, and interaction skills. We present MorphHOI, a decentralised framework built on a key insight: effective heterogeneous cooperation requires a unified representation across embodiments while accounting for differences in their physical capabilities. To realise this insight, we introduce a canonical body interface that unifies observation and action spaces, together with an embodiment-conditioned transformer that adapts cooperative decisions to the physical capabilities of each agent and its teammates. To extend cooperation to new interaction skills, we reuse the learned cooperative policy through task-specific tokens and lightweight adaptation, preserving its original capabilities. Our framework achieves success rates of up to 96.7\% on seen embodiments, 95.6\% on unseen embodiments, and 91.4\% on novel payloads. Furthermore, the learned cooperation extends to diverse interaction skills with high success rates, including box carrying, transport on stairs, and waypoint following, while preserving previously acquired cooperative capabilities.
summary_zh: 基于物理的人-物交互（HOI）技术已使多个角色能够协作搬运物体，但现有的协作控制器大多假设同质化的身体形态和预定义的交互任务。我们探讨一个核心问题：单一基于物理的策略能否支持跨不同身体形态、团队组成和交互技能的协作？为此，我们提出MorphHOI，一种去中心化框架，其关键洞察在于：有效的异质协作需要在跨身体形态的统一表示基础上，同时考虑各主体物理能力的差异。为实现这一洞察，我们引入了一种规范身体接口（canonical body interface），统一了观测空间和动作空间，并配以基于身体形态条件的Transformer，使协作决策能够适应每个智能体及其队友的物理能力。为将协作扩展到新的交互技能，我们通过任务特定令牌和轻量级适配复用已学习的协作策略，同时保留其原有能力。我们的框架在已见身体形态上实现了高达96.7%的成功率，在未见身体形态上达到95.6%，在新负载上达到91.4%。此外，学习到的协作能力可扩展至多种交互技能并保持高成功率，包括搬运箱子、在楼梯上运输以及航点跟踪，同时保留先前习得的协作能力。
tldr: MorphHOI introduces a decentralized framework with a canonical body interface and an embodiment-conditioned transformer that enables a single physics-based policy for heterogeneous human-object interaction, achieving high success rates on cooperative transport across embodiments and novel skills.
tldr_zh: MorphHOI 提出了一种去中心化框架，通过规范身体接口和基于具身条件的 Transformer，使单一物理策略能够支持异构人机交互，在跨具身与新型技能的合作运输中取得了高成功率。

title: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
summary: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.
summary_zh: 多机器人具身系统通常通过协调动作、共享轨迹或学习联合策略来实现协作。我们提出一个互补性问题：协作能否在决策之前发生，即首先构建对环境的共享理解？我们引入共享环境理解（Shared Environmental Understanding），这是一种与策略无关的表征，将来自多个机器人的局部自我中心观察聚合为共享的潜在世界模型。这将协作从策略空间转移到表征空间，使得在共享环境上下文中实现去中心化决策成为可能。为此，我们提出共享环境编码与检索（SEER）框架，该框架将多机器人观察组织为共享记忆，通过时空相似性检索相关上下文，并使用预测性潜在世界模型进行编码。所得表征作为令牌注入下游导航智能体。实验结果表明，SEER捕捉了与动作相关的环境结构，并在专业VLN智能体和通用视觉语言模型智能体上持续提升导航性能，同时保持单智能体能力不退化。
tldr: This paper introduces SEER, a policy-agnostic shared environmental understanding framework that aggregates multi-robot observations into a latent world model, improving navigation performance for VLN agents and general VLM agents via injected tokens.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SEER，一种策略无关的共享环境理解框架，将多机器人观测聚合到潜在世界模型中，通过注入标记提升VLN智能体和通用VLM智能体的导航性能。

title: Counterfactual Velocity Steering for World Action Models
summary: Flow-based robot policies generate actions by repeatedly evaluating a conditional velocity field, so test-time bias correction seems simple: query the action expert under a task-agnostic condition and subtract that velocity from the task-conditioned prediction. We show this is often wrong. On Fast-WAM across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, mean-instruction predictions align strongly with task-conditioned velocities (cosine approximately 0.94-0.95). Averaging eight completed-state references barely cancels this direction: their mean norm is 98.3% of the mean individual norm. References thus contain a large shared transport component, not only harmful bias, and aggressive subtraction damages generation. We propose a same-state diagnostic and shrinkage analysis showing that the optimal correction scale depends on reference signal-to-noise. This motivates geometry-calibrated action debiasing, which removes only the component orthogonal to the task velocity and predicts a small task-dependent scale from instruction geometry. In controlled RoboTwin experiments, corrupting instructions still permits 25.1% success (50 tasks, 20 episodes), whereas dynamic visual corruption nearly eliminates success. A fixed centered orthogonal correction reaches 92.7% versus a 92.1% baseline in one randomized 1000-trial sweep, but gains are non-monotonic and within run-to-run variation. An angular scale pilot has an offline oracle-gated bound of 94.5%; its best learned online realization reaches 92.5%. These results identify shared flow and train-serve mismatch as central obstacles and provide a reproducible foundation for conditional correction.
summary_zh: 基于流策略的机器人行动通过反复评估条件速度场来生成，因此测试时的偏差校正看似简单：在任务无关条件下查询行动专家，并从任务条件预测中减去该速度。我们表明这往往是错误的。在覆盖50个RoboTwin 2.0任务的Fast-WAM上，平均指令预测与任务条件速度高度一致（余弦相似度约为0.94-0.95）。对八个完成态参考取平均几乎无法抵消该方向：其平均范数为个体平均范数的98.3%。因此，参考中包含大量共享的输运分量，而不仅仅是有害偏差，激进地减去会损害生成效果。我们提出了一种同状态诊断和收缩分析，表明最优校正尺度取决于参考信噪比。这促使我们提出几何校准的行动去偏方法，该方法仅移除与任务速度正交的分量，并根据指令几何预测一个小的任务相关尺度。在受控的RoboTwin实验中，损坏指令仍可实现25.1%的成功率（50个任务，20个回合），而动态视觉损坏几乎完全消除了成功率。在一次随机1000次试验扫描中，固定的中心化正交校正达到92.7%，而基线为92.1%，但增益非单调且处于运行间波动范围内。一个角度尺度试验的离线神谕门控上限为94.5%；其最佳学习在线实现达到92.5%。这些结果识别出共享流和训练-服务不匹配是核心障碍，并为条件校正提供了可复现的基础。
tldr: The paper analyzes flow-based World Action Model (WAM) policies and shows that naive counterfactual velocity subtraction is flawed due to shared transport components; it proposes geometry-calibrated action debiasing that removes only task-orthogonal components, improving robustness to instruction corruption in RoboTwin tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了基于流的World Action Model策略，发现朴素的反事实速度减法因共享传输分量而失效，提出几何校准的动作去偏方法，仅去除任务正交分量，在RoboTwin任务中提升了对指令扰动的鲁棒性。

title: Value function based Reward shaping for safety in quadrupeds
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has progressed from simple control tasks to complex real-world challenges with large state spaces. While RL excels in these tasks, training time remains a limitation. Reward shaping is a popular solution, but existing methods often rely on value functions, which face scalability issues. This paper presents a novel safety-oriented reward-shaping framework inspired by barrier functions, offering simplicity and ease of implementation across various environments and tasks. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed reward formulations, we conduct simulation experiments on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot in Isaacgym. The policy was better than the existing baselines and reduced safety violations from 27% to 0.1% without almost any compromise on the performance.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已从简单的控制任务发展到具有大规模状态空间的复杂现实挑战。尽管强化学习在这些任务中表现出色，但训练时间仍然是其一个限制因素。奖励塑形是一种流行的解决方案，然而现有方法往往依赖于价值函数，这面临着可扩展性问题。本文提出了一种受障碍函数启发的新型面向安全的奖励塑形框架，该框架简单易行，可适用于多种环境和任务。为评估所提奖励公式的有效性，我们在Isaacgym中对宇树Go1四足机器人进行了仿真实验。该策略优于现有基线方法，并将安全违规率从27%降至0.1%，且几乎未对性能造成任何影响。
tldr: This paper proposes a safety-oriented reward-shaping framework based on barrier functions for reinforcement learning, and demonstrates on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot in IsaacGym that it reduces safety violations from 27% to 0.1% with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于障碍函数的安全导向奖励塑形框架，并在IsaacGym中Unitree Go1四足机器人上验证，将安全违规率从27%降至0.1%，且性能损失极小。

title: Policy-intrinsic Demonstration Curation
summary: Fine-tuning a robot policy for a new target task requires target demonstrations, but only a few are available. Demonstrations of other tasks can fill this gap, and demonstration curation selects the useful ones among these candidates. Retrieval-based curation selects the candidates that are most similar to the target demonstrations. Since it does not use the policy, any candidate that looks similar receives a high score. Performance-aware curation therefore estimates the effect of each candidate on the policy. However, this requires training on the candidates and takes a long time. We propose a third branch, policy-intrinsic curation, which uses the policy and still takes little time. It estimates this effect with forward passes of the pretrained policy and needs no training. We instantiate this branch with PICKER (Policy-Intrinsic Curation from Known Errors). It selects the candidates on which the policy makes errors that agree with those on the target demonstrations. PICKER reaches success rates comparable to those of performance-aware curation and takes about as long as retrieval-based curation. Its selection is also stable across seeds.
summary_zh: 微调机器人策略以适应新目标任务需要目标示范，但可获得的示范数量有限。其他任务的示范能够填补这一缺口，而示范筛选则从候选示范中挑选出有用的样本。基于检索的筛选方法会选择与目标示范最为相似的候选样本，由于该方法未考虑策略本身，任何外观相似的候选都会获得高分。因此，性能感知筛选方法会评估每个候选样本对策略的影响，但这种方法需要对候选样本进行训练，耗时较长。我们提出第三种分支——策略内在筛选方法，该方法利用策略本身且耗时极短，通过预训练策略的前向传播来估计候选样本的影响，无需额外训练。我们以PICKER（基于已知错误的策略内在筛选）为例实现了这一分支，该方法选择那些策略在其上产生的错误与目标示范上的错误一致的候选样本。PICKER在成功率上与性能感知筛选方法相当，而耗时与基于检索的筛选方法相近，其筛选结果在不同随机种子下也保持稳定。
tldr: This paper introduces PICKER, a policy-intrinsic demonstration curation method that selects useful demonstrations for robot policy fine-tuning by using forward passes of the pretrained policy to identify candidates whose errors agree with those on target demonstrations, achieving performance comparable to performance-aware curation at a fraction of the time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PICKER，一种策略内在演示选择方法，通过预训练策略的前向传播，选择其错误与目标演示一致的正样本来进行机器人策略微调，在几乎不增加时间开销的情况下达到与性能感知方法相当的性能。

title: HERO: Hierarchical Region-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration is widely used to map unknown environments, yet maintaining both path efficiency and low online computation remains difficult as environment scale increases. Hierarchical planners reduce global search through coarse regional representations but often rely on handcrafted local viewpoint-selection rules. Graph-based reinforcement learning can improve local decisions, but its inference cost grows with the exploration graph and global direction is usually represented only implicitly. To address these limitations, we present HERO, a hierarchical framework that assigns distinct responsibilities to global planning and learned local decision-making, enabling each level to focus on the function it is best suited to perform. To reduce the growing inference cost of graph-based policies, HERO restricts learned target selection to reachable candidates within the current region while using region-level planning to provide long-horizon guidance. To avoid informative targets causing excessive deviation from this global direction, the proposed Dual-Branch Graph Policy balances Frontier Utility with guidance toward the next region, improving both local exploration and global progress. Experiments on unseen 2D maps show the lowest overall mean path length and target-decision cost among the evaluated methods. MARSIM simulations and deployments at three real-world sites further demonstrate the framework's applicability with LiDAR-based mapping and chassis dynamics.
summary_zh: 自主探索被广泛用于未知环境的地图构建，然而随着环境规模的增大，同时保持路径效率与低在线计算成本变得困难。分层规划器通过粗粒度的区域表示来减少全局搜索，但往往依赖于手工设计的局部视点选择规则。基于图的强化学习能够改进局部决策，但其推理成本随探索图的增大而增加，且全局方向通常仅被隐式表示。为解决这些局限，我们提出HERO，一种将全局规划与学习型局部决策分配不同职责的分层框架，使每一层都能专注于其最擅长的功能。为降低基于图的策略不断增长的推理成本，HERO将学习型目标选择限制在当前区域内的可达候选项中，同时利用区域级规划提供长时程引导。为避免信息丰富的目标导致对全局方向的过度偏离，所提出的双分支图策略在前沿效用与朝向下个区域的引导之间取得平衡，从而同时改进局部探索与全局进展。在未见过的二维地图上的实验显示，在所评估的方法中，该方法实现了最低的总体平均路径长度与目标决策成本。MARSIM仿真以及在三个真实场景中的部署进一步验证了该框架在基于激光雷达的地图构建与底盘动力学条件下的适用性。
tldr: HERO introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for autonomous exploration, combining region-level global planning with a dual-branch graph policy for local target selection, demonstrating efficiency in simulations and real-world deployments.
tldr_zh: HERO提出了一种用于自主探索的分层强化学习框架，将区域级全局规划与双分支图策略的局部目标选择相结合，在仿真和真实部署中展示了效率。

title: How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models
summary: World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过预测环境在候选动作下的演变来支持规划。然而，单步预测的准确性本身并不能刻画多步规划的有效性，后者取决于对候选未来状态的区分能力。这自然引出一个问题：潜在转移几何结构如何塑造规划？我们通过动作条件转移场的视角对此展开研究，并以曲率正则化作为受控干预手段。在四个连续控制任务中，适当调优的正则化能够改善规划效果，而过度正则化则可能产生不利影响。通过将转移场分解为仿射分量和非仿射分量，我们发现正则化主要经由非仿射分量降低动作敏感性。为评估其在规划中的作用，我们在冻结模型中直接操控非仿射动作响应，结果表明该分量影响候选选择与闭环成功率。进一步分析显示，曲率总体上使预测的未来状态彼此更接近，同时沿目标方向保留更多差异，这有助于解释规划效果在不同任务间的差异。我们在LeWM上观察到五种基于采样与梯度的求解器呈现大致一致的规划趋势，在DINO-WM上也观察到类似的滚动几何趋势。定性注意力可视化揭示了向任务相关视觉结构的伴随性偏移。综上所述，这些发现阐明了潜在转移几何结构如何影响多步规划。
tldr: This paper investigates how the geometry of latent transitions in world models affects multi-step planning, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention and analyzing its effects on action sensitivity and task-relevant goal-directed future prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过曲率正则化作为受控干预，研究了世界模型中潜变量转移几何如何影响多步规划，并分析了其对动作敏感性和沿目标方向的未来预测的影响。
