To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.
summary_zh: 评估生成视频的物理合理性，对于基于世界模型的可靠机器人规划至关重要。此类视频在实际执行前为动作提案与评估提供依据，因此，未被检测到的物理违例可能导致对动作可行性与安全性产生错误判断。然而，当前的视频生成器常常产生物理上不合理的交互。直接利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）检测此类违例仍具挑战性，因为物理验证需要基于证据的时空推理，这超出了高层语义理解的范畴。我们开发了五项针对特定物理法则的评估指标，通过结合来自分割、跟踪、三维几何或外观比较的时空证据与目标化的VLM推理，来评估物理合理性，具体包括：接触保真度、物体持续性、坚固性、机器人形变以及物体形变。基于这一指标体系，我们进一步提出了RoboProbe，一个智能体化评估框架，用于协调指标执行，并通过受约束的动作选择性地细化评估。为评估机器人世界模型的物理合理性，我们还引入了RP-Bench基准，包含来自12个机器人数据集的239个操作任务的761个带人工标注的生成视频及130个真实演示。在RP-Bench上，所有五项指标的AUROC均超过0.85，且优于所评估的学习型评判器、先前评估器以及仅基于帧的Gemini基线。将这些指标应用于五个视频生成器，揭示了不同模型在违例类型与频率上的显著物理违例模式差异。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework with law-specific metrics to assess the physical plausibility of videos generated by robot world models, along with RP-Bench, a benchmark of human-labeled videos for evaluating these metrics. The framework outperforms existing evaluators on detecting physical violations across five video generators.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了RoboProbe，一个通过特定物理法则指标评估机器人世界模型生成视频物理合理性的代理式评估框架，并构建了包含人工标注视频的RP-Bench基准。该框架在检测五种视频生成器的物理违规方面优于现有评估器。

title: Duo: Towards Spatiotemporal Action Coordination in Bimanual Policies
summary: Bimanual manipulation requires each arm to perform distinct motions while coordinating with the other. Common flow-based robotic policies combine both arms' actions into one token per future timestep, giving attention distinct positions across time but not across arms. We introduce Duo, a simple but effective design that models spatial and temporal dependencies within one shared action head. Specifically, Duo separates both arms into two action tokens per timestep, allowing each arm's motion to interact via cross-arm attention during flow matching. On RoboTwin 2.0, Duo improves the overall success of all four base policies, from 0.45B to 3.62B parameters, with gains of 12.55 and 9.02 percentage points for FLOWER (0.89B) and $π_{0.5}$ (3.62B), respectively. Despite its compact size, FLOWER-Duo achieves the best randomized-generalization, precision, and memory scores on RoboDojo. In real-world tasks, it outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in both success rate and execution speed, while scaling effectively with increasing training data. To provide deeper insight into the design of Duo, we conduct systematic ablations on inter-arm coordination, action grouping, and token granularity, confirming that cross-arm attention drives the improvement while arm-wise interaction offers the best accuracy-compute trade-off.
summary_zh: 双臂操作要求每只手臂在执行不同运动的同时，与另一只手臂进行协调。常见的基于流的机器人策略将双臂动作合并为每个未来时间步的一个令牌，从而使注意力在不同时间位置间分布，但并未在双臂之间进行区分。我们提出Duo，一种简单而有效的设计，在共享动作头内同时建模空间和时间依赖关系。具体而言，Duo将每只手臂在每个时间步分离为两个动作令牌，使得各手臂的运动能够在流匹配过程中通过跨臂注意力进行交互。在RoboTwin 2.0上，Duo将四种基础策略的整体成功率从0.45B参数提升至3.62B参数，其中FLOWER（0.89B）和π₀.₅（3.62B）分别提升了12.55和9.02个百分点。尽管FLOWER-Duo规模紧凑，但在RoboDojo上却取得了最佳的随机泛化、精度和记忆得分。在真实世界任务中，它在成功率和执行速度上均优于π₀.₅，同时随着训练数据的增加表现出有效的扩展能力。为深入理解Duo的设计，我们对臂间协调、动作分组和令牌粒度进行了系统性消融实验，确认跨臂注意力是性能提升的关键驱动因素，而按臂交互则在精度与计算开销之间提供了最佳权衡。
tldr: Duo introduces a shared action head that separates bimanual arm actions into two tokens per timestep, enabling cross-arm attention during flow matching to improve coordination and success rates across multiple policies.
tldr_zh: Duo 提出了一种共享动作头，将双臂动作在每个时间步分解为两个令牌，通过跨臂注意力增强双臂协调，并在多个策略上提升了成功率。

title: Ego2Real: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Visuo-Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation from egocentric human demonstrations offers a scalable path toward robot skill acquisition. Vision alone, however, provides limited information about physical contacts and the demonstrator's force intent, leading to ambiguities in interpreting hand-object interactions. Capturing human touch via tactile sensing is therefore crucial for reliable human-to-robot dexterous skill transfer. We present Ego2Real, a framework that leverages egocentric demonstrations and tactile gloves to transfer bimanual dexterous manipulation skills to robotic hands. Ego2Real incorporates tactile supervision at two complementary stages: (1) tactile-guided hand-object interaction reconstruction, which uses measured tactile signals to refine hand poses and contact geometry; and (2) contact-informed reinforcement learning, which translates human contact patterns into robotic contact rewards. By combining refined motion references with physical contact rewards during training, Ego2Real guides anthropomorphic robotic hands to emulate demonstrated contact behaviors while adapting to their own morphology and actuation. Experiments show that incorporating tactile supervision into both reconstruction and policy learning yields higher manipulation success rates, underscoring the importance of enriching egocentric demonstrations with tactile observations to improve their quality and transferability.
summary_zh: 从自我中心的人类演示中学习灵巧操作，为机器人技能习得提供了一条可扩展的路径。然而，仅依靠视觉对手部接触和演示者的力意图提供的信息有限，导致在手-物交互的解读上存在歧义。因此，通过触觉感知捕捉人类触觉信息，对于实现可靠的人到机器人灵巧技能迁移至关重要。我们提出了Ego2Real框架，该框架利用自我中心演示和触觉手套将双臂灵巧操作技能迁移至机器人手部。Ego2Real在两个互补阶段引入触觉监督：（1）触觉引导的手-物交互重建，利用实测触觉信号细化手部姿态和接触几何；（2）接触信息增强的强化学习，将人类接触模式转化为机器人接触奖励。通过在训练过程中将精细化的运动参考与物理接触奖励相结合，Ego2Real引导拟人机器人手部模仿演示的接触行为，同时适应其自身的形态结构和驱动方式。实验表明，在重建和策略学习两个阶段均引入触觉监督可显著提高操作成功率，这凸显了利用触觉观测丰富自我中心演示以提升其质量和可迁移性的重要性。
tldr: Ego2Real uses egocentric demonstrations and tactile gloves to reconstruct bimanual hand-object interactions and train anthropomorphic robotic hands via contact-informed reinforcement learning, improving dexterous manipulation transfer.
tldr_zh: Ego2Real利用以自我为中心的演示和触觉手套重建双手物体交互，并通过接触信息增强的强化学习训练拟人机器手，提高灵巧操作技能迁移的成功率。

title: ActiveBridge: Scaling Active Prior for Robots through Egocentric Perception-Interaction Modeling
summary: Robotics foundation models are now widely used for manipulation, and egocentric videos offer rich data for scaling. However, existing methods overlook the human active priors captured in egocentric videos, which limits performance in unstructured scenes. They act on given observations instead of actively seeking information as humans do. We propose ActiveBridge, a training framework that learns these human active priors and transfers them to robots through world-action modeling. We design a robot that actively controls its viewpoint through head actions to acquire the visual information needed for manipulation using a single head camera, without wrist cameras. During human training, an instruction-conditioned model jointly predicts future egocentric videos and synchronized head-wrist action trajectories, with head actions providing explicit supervision for active perception. Experiments show that ActiveBridge outperforms baselines on active manipulation tasks, while ablations demonstrate the benefit of joint head-wrist action supervision.
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型现已广泛用于操作任务，而第一人称视频为规模化提供了丰富的数据。然而，现有方法忽视了第一人称视频中捕捉到的人类主动先验，这限制了其在非结构化场景中的表现。它们基于给定的观察进行动作，而非像人类那样主动寻求信息。我们提出ActiveBridge，一种训练框架，用于学习这些人类主动先验，并通过世界-动作建模将其迁移至机器人。我们设计了一种机器人，能够通过头部动作主动控制其视角，利用单个头部摄像头获取操作所需的视觉信息，无需腕部摄像头。在人类训练阶段，一个指令条件模型联合预测未来的第一人称视频以及同步的头部-腕部动作轨迹，其中头部动作提供了对主动感知的显式监督。实验表明，ActiveBridge在主动操作任务上优于基线方法，而消融实验则证明了头部-腕部联合动作监督的益处。
tldr: ActiveBridge is a training framework that learns human active priors from egocentric videos and transfers them to robots via world-action modeling, enabling a single head camera to actively control viewpoint for manipulation tasks. Jointly predicting future videos and synchronized head-wrist action trajectories with explicit head-action supervision improves performance on active manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ActiveBridge 是一种训练框架，通过世界-动作建模从自我中心视频中学习人类主动先验并传递给机器人，使机器人仅用单个头部摄像头主动控制视角以完成操作任务。联合预测未来视频和同步的头-腕动作轨迹，并通过显式头部动作监督，提升了主动操作基准的性能。

title: MARGIN: A Risk-Aware Agent for Robot Program Refinement
summary: Robot-programming agents improve executable control policies through repeated testing and repair, yet binary success saturates while execution risk persists across unseen scenes. We introduce MARGIN, a risk-aware agent that converts successful robot rollouts into actionable evidence for program refinement. Its near-miss margin measures the fraction of the execution budget remaining in the slowest successful development rollout. The agent uses this signal to prioritize fragile programs, guide targeted repairs, and select revisions that preserve development success while increasing execution headroom. An exact safe-racing rule accelerates success-based candidate evaluation. We evaluate MARGIN across LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-90, and Robosuite. In our 80-task LIBERO-Pro reproduction, 78 programs attain perfect development success while accounting for substantial failures on unseen seeds. The near-miss margin predicts held-out failures with an AUC of 0.774, and low-margin programs exhibit 2.97 times higher failure risk. Across two independent evaluation rounds spanning 37 unique LIBERO-Pro tasks, MARGIN reduces executed control steps by 10.7% and 15.0%, with reductions of 18.0-20.0% on LIBERO-90 and Robosuite. Safe racing reduces fixed-sequence candidate-evaluation episodes by 53.5% while retaining identical selections, and paired execution probes improve acceptance decisions by identifying hidden regressions. Together, these results establish near-miss evidence as an effective basis for risk-aware, budget-efficient robot program refinement.
summary_zh: 机器人编程智能体通过反复测试和修复来改进可执行的控制策略，然而，二元成功指标趋于饱和，而执行风险在未见场景中仍然持续存在。我们提出MARGIN，一种风险感知智能体，它将成功的机器人 rollout 转化为可操作的程序改进证据。其“险失裕度”衡量最慢成功开发 rollout 中剩余执行预算的比例。该智能体利用此信号对脆弱程序进行优先级排序、指导针对性修复，并选择既能保持开发成功又能增加执行余量的修订方案。一条精确的“安全竞速”规则加速了基于成功的候选方案评估。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-90 和 Robosuite 上评估了 MARGIN。在我们包含 80 个任务的 LIBERO-Pro 复现中，78 个程序达到了完美的开发成功率，但在未见种子上存在大量失败。险失裕度以 0.774 的 AUC 预测了保留失败，低裕度程序的失败风险高出 2.97 倍。在覆盖 37 个独特 LIBERO-Pro 任务的两轮独立评估中，MARGIN 将执行控制步骤分别减少了 10.7% 和 15.0%，在 LIBERO-90 和 Robosuite 上减少了 18.0%-20.0%。安全竞速使固定序列候选评估轮次减少了 53.5%，同时保持了相同选择结果，而成对执行探针通过识别隐藏回归改进了接受决策。综合来看，这些结果确立了险失证据作为风险感知、预算高效的机器人程序改进的有效基础。
tldr: MARGIN introduces a risk-aware agent that uses execution budget margins from successful robot rollouts to guide program refinement, reducing failures and execution steps across LIBERO and Robosuite benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MARGIN 提出一种风险感知代理，利用成功机器人回滚中的执行预算余量来指导程序优化，在 LIBERO 和 Robosuite 基准上减少了失败和执行步骤。

title: RoboHarness-RL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for VLM-Based Robot Manipulation
summary: Agentic harnesses enable frontier vision-language models (VLMs) to manipulate robots through perception, planning, and control tools, yet achieving comparable performance with compact open-weight VLMs remains challenging. We present RoboHarness-RL, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for improving VLM-based robot manipulation through tool calls. Starting from supervised fine-tuning on successful teacher demonstrations, the VLM further improves through multi-turn reinforcement learning with task-outcome rewards, without relying on vision-language-action models or world action models. To support efficient multi-turn training, we develop LiteHarness, which uses hierarchical memory to keep interaction contexts compact while preserving task performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, RL raises success from 31.2% to 44.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 and from 57.8% to 73.3% on LIBERO-Pro; these gains extend to randomized RoboTwin scenes unseen during training (26.4% to 38.0%). Behavioral analysis further shows that RL reduces repetitive-call rates by up to $4\times$, shortens successful executions, and improves recovery from negative feedback. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/RoboHarness-RL/
summary_zh: 智能体工具框架使前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）能够通过感知、规划和控制工具操纵机器人，然而，让紧凑型开源权重VLM达到同等性能仍具挑战。我们提出RoboHarness-RL，一种基于智能体的强化学习框架，通过工具调用提升基于VLM的机器人操作能力。该方法从在成功教师示范上的监督微调出发，进一步通过多轮强化学习与任务结果奖励相结合来改进VLM，无需依赖视觉-语言-动作模型或世界动作模型。为支持高效的多轮训练，我们开发了LiteHarness，其采用分层记忆机制，在保持任务性能的同时压缩交互上下文。基于Qwen3.5-9B，强化学习在RoboTwin 2.0上将成功率从31.2%提升至44.0%，在LIBERO-Pro上从57.8%提升至73.3%；这些提升同样扩展到训练中未见过的随机化RoboTwin场景（从26.4%提升至38.0%）。行为分析进一步表明，强化学习将重复调用率降低高达4倍，缩短成功执行时间，并改善了从负面反馈中的恢复能力。项目主页：https://aim-uofa.github.io/RoboHarness-RL/
tldr: RoboHarness-RL presents an agentic reinforcement learning framework that fine-tunes compact vision-language models for robot manipulation via tool calls, improving success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Pro benchmarks without relying on VLA or world action models.
tldr_zh: RoboHarness-RL 提出了一种代理式强化学习框架，通过工具调用来微调紧凑型视觉语言模型以进行机器人操作，在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 LIBERO-Pro 基准上提高了成功率，且不依赖 VLA 或世界动作模型。

title: Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型必须处理连续的视觉观察流，由此产生的计算成本限制了机器人的实时控制。令牌剪枝可以降低这一成本，但固定语义尺度的感知表示可能会忽略操作不同阶段所需的信息。我们发现，当选择尺度适应场景不断演变的语义结构时，感知语义可以在不依赖内部注意力的情况下有效指导令牌选择。基于这一观察，我们引入了TauPrune-VLA，一种无需训练的免训练方法，通过单一的感知温度$τ$来控制保留的感知表示的尺度。为了在操作过程中自适应调整该尺度，TauPrune-VLA利用感知语义的趋势在线更新$τ$，并以机器人状态变化和动作幅度来调节调整强度。虽然这些语义在操作过程中不断演变，但它们在相邻帧之间保持相对稳定。这种连续性使得从当前观测计算出的保留索引可以应用于下一次策略调用，从而使令牌选择能够与推理异步运行，并降低剪枝开销。在多种VLA模型和仿真基准上的评估表明，TauPrune-VLA实现了高达$1.86\times$的推理加速，同时保持了接近基准的任务成功率。我们进一步在两个真实机器人平台上验证了其有效性。
tldr: TauPrune-VLA introduces a training-free, scale-adaptive token pruning method for Vision-Language-Action models, achieving up to 1.86x inference speedup with near-baseline task success rates across simulation benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: TauPrune-VLA 提出了一种无需训练的尺度自适应令牌剪枝方法，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，在模拟基准和真实机器人上实现最高1.86倍推理加速，同时保持接近基线的任务成功率。

title: DUALingo: A Dual-Hand Instruction-Guided Dataset for Affordance Grounding on 3D Objects
summary: Affordance grounding localizes where an agent should interact with an object to perform a task. Many everyday manipulation tasks, however, require bimanual affordance, in which two hands assume complementary and cooperative roles to accomplish a shared goal. Existing 3D affordance datasets primarily ground single interaction regions, and manually annotating dual-hand, cooperative contacts does not scale. To address this gap, we introduce DUALingo, a large-scale dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on diverse everyday objects. DUALingo represents each task as two cooperative, hand-agnostic roles, each grounded as a heatmap on the object surface. It contains 271K free-form tasks on 71K objects, generated by a fully automated pipeline of open-weight foundation models without human labeling. Expert ratings and a validated LLM judge confirm the quality of the resulting annotations. Trained on DUALingo, existing 3D affordance models learn to ground both cooperative roles from natural-language instructions, with the best-performing model achieving a more than threefold improvement in aIoU over the zero-shot baseline, from 10.3 to 37.8. Robotic manipulation demonstrations illustrate the actionability of the predicted bimanual affordances in performing cooperative tasks. These results position DUALingo as a scalable foundation for learning everyday bimanual affordances. Project page: https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/
summary_zh: 可供性定位（Affordance grounding）是指确定智能体应如何与物体交互以完成某项任务的位置。然而，许多日常操作任务需要双手可供性（bimanual affordance），即两只手承担互补且协作的角色，以完成共同目标。现有的三维可供性数据集主要标注单一交互区域，而人工标注双手协作接触点难以规模化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DUALingo，一个面向多样化日常物体的大规模数据集，用于任务条件化、角色感知的双手三维可供性定位。DUALingo将每项任务表示为两个协作的、与手部无关的角色，每个角色在物体表面以热力图形式进行标注。该数据集包含71,000个物体上的271,000个自由形式任务，通过全自动流水线由开源基础模型生成，无需人工标注。专家评分及经过验证的LLM评判确认了所生成标注的质量。基于DUALingo训练后，现有三维可供性模型能够从自然语言指令中学习定位两个协作角色，其中最佳模型在aIoU指标上相比零样本基线提升了三倍以上，从10.3提升至37.8。机器人操作演示验证了预测的双手可供性在执行协作任务中的可操作性。上述结果使DUALingo成为学习日常双手可供性的可扩展基础。项目页面：https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/
tldr: DUALingo is a large-scale, automatically generated dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on everyday objects, enabling existing models to learn cooperative dual-hand interactions and improving grounding performance significantly over zero-shot baselines.
tldr_zh: DUALingo 是一个大规模、自动生成的日常物体上双手机器人任务条件与角色感知的3D可交互性定位数据集，使现有模型能够学习协作性双手交互，并显著提升定位性能。

title: Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要在持续获取新操作技能的同时，保持执行先前所学指令的能力。经验回放（ER）能够缓解灾难性遗忘，但每个任务仅保留少量历史专家帧，会导致许多旧指令的响应缺乏直接监督。在有限的回放条件下，我们观察到一种结构化的失败模式：较早的指令可能触发后续学到的、相互竞争的目标。为解决这一问题，我们提出跨指令锚定（XIA）方法，该方法在专家回放的基础上补充了指令条件下的响应保持机制。在每个任务边界处，XIA将先前策略冻结为教师模型，并将其对旧指令与当前观测配对时的响应进行匹配。这将监督范围扩展到了存储的历史样本之外，而无需额外的专家回放数据。在多种VLA架构和三个LIBERO基准套件上的实验表明，在相同的历史专家数据预算下，与ER相比，XIA提高了成功率并减少了遗忘。此外，RoboCasa和真实世界实验进一步验证了XIA的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), a method to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in continual VLA learning by preserving instruction-conditioned responses from a frozen teacher policy, improving success rates and reducing forgetting across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出跨指令锚定（XIA）方法，通过在持续VLA学习中冻结先前策略作为教师并匹配旧指令响应，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在LIBERO、RoboCasa及真实世界实验中提升成功率并减少遗忘。

title: PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models combine action generation with future prediction, allowing visual transitions to serve as supervision for policy learning. Our controlled study of prediction spaces shows that spatially structured semantic features support better overall generalization under visual perturbations and make motion information more readily recoverable from learned predictive representations. Building on these observations, we introduce PreWAM, a world-action model that organizes future supervision around state changes in a prediction space defined by pretrained DINO features. Specifically, Residual World Prediction jointly learns source-relative changes and their resulting future states to emphasize dynamic information while preserving future-state semantics. Temporal-Scale Prediction conditions world queries on temporal distance to capture both short-term local motion and longer-horizon state evolution. These predictive objectives jointly shape a shared vision-language backbone with action supervision during pretraining and downstream policy learning. Experiments across the LIBERO benchmark family, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic manipulation demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved generalization and robustness under diverse distribution shifts.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型将动作生成与未来预测相结合，使得视觉状态转换能够为策略学习提供监督信号。我们对预测空间的受控研究表明，空间结构化的语义特征在视觉扰动下能够支持更好的整体泛化能力，并且使运动信息更容易从学习到的预测表征中恢复。基于这些观察，我们提出了PreWAM，一种世界-动作模型，它以预训练的DINO特征所定义的预测空间中的状态变化为核心来组织未来监督。具体而言，残差世界预测联合学习源相对变化及其产生的未来状态，以强调动态信息同时保留未来状态的语义。时间尺度预测根据时间距离对世界查询进行条件化，以同时捕捉短期局部运动与更长时程的状态演化。这些预测目标在预训练和下游策略学习阶段共同塑造一个共享的视觉-语言骨干网络，并与动作监督相结合。在LIBERO基准系列、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin 2.0以及真实机器人操作上的实验表明，该方法具有强大的操作性能，并在多种分布偏移下展现出改进的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
tldr: PreWAM introduces a world-action model that uses pretrained DINO features and residual temporal-scale prediction to jointly learn action generation and future prediction, demonstrating strong manipulation performance and robustness across simulated and real robot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PreWAM 提出了一种世界动作模型，利用预训练的 DINO 特征和残差时间尺度预测来联合学习动作生成和未来预测，在仿真和真实机器人操作基准上展现出强大的操作性能和鲁棒性。

title: Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.
summary_zh: 行为基础模型（BFMs）已成为一种有前景的范式，通过对大规模行为数据进行预训练，实现通用人形机器人控制。然而，它们在全身协调方面的能力并不能直接迁移到场景交互任务中，这类任务要求动作适应与场景相关的几何约束和接触动力学。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了Ada-BFM，一种针对预训练BFMs进行后训练的框架，使其适应人形机器人的场景交互。Ada-BFM在原有架构基础上引入轻量级适配器，在利用预训练控制能力的同时，实现交互特化的调整。该框架并非为每个任务生成独立的控制器，而是为每个交互领域生成一个共享模型，支持涉及地形或物体交互的多样化任务。在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验表明，Ada-BFM能够实现多样化的场景交互行为，相比从头训练加速了学习过程，并在很大程度上保留了预训练的行为能力。这些发现确立了Ada-BFM作为一种高效且有效的方法，可将BFMs的能力扩展到预训练设置之外，同时保留其在全身控制方面的优势。
tldr: Ada-BFM introduces a post-training framework with a lightweight adapter to adapt pretrained behavior foundation models for humanoid scene interaction, enabling diverse terrain and object interaction tasks while preserving pretrained whole-body control capabilities.
tldr_zh: Ada-BFM提出了一种后训练框架，通过轻量适配器调整预训练行为基础模型，使人体机器人具备场景交互能力，同时保留其全身控制能力。

title: Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty
summary: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).
summary_zh: 反应式机器人操作对同时发生的感知噪声、测量丢失、关节执行误差以及接触参数变化极为敏感。尽管诸如域随机化实例集（DRIS）之类的单帧框架在孤立的不确定性条件下展现出较强的鲁棒性（86.4%），但在感知与驱动不确定性同时出现时（10种耦合应力场景下为27.6%），其性能严重退化，原因在于无记忆编码和固定高刚度PD控制。我们提出了Co-DRIS + SuperMimic，一种感知-动作协同设计框架，其结合了：（i）惯性世界坐标系下基于物理信息的惯性世界模型，将精确的弹道运动学与零初始化接触残差相结合，以向前推算缺失观测，并通过零成本反事实丢弃一致性加速训练；（ii）动作条件下的双流因果GRU置信编码器，以解决去噪与滞后之间的死锁问题；（iii）相位感知的可变阻抗软捕获机制，在力矩层将7自由度Franka Research 3机械臂过渡到过阻尼状态（zeta/zeta0~2.26倍）。在无偏3种子尾部评估中，针对未见过的投掷（每种场景15,360次投掷），我们的方法在标准基准上实现了89.6 ± 0.4%的成功率（在4 sigma噪声下提升至70.5%，相对提升10.5%），在10种耦合/丢弃应力场景下实现了66.6 ± 0.5%的成功率（相对DRIS提升39.0%；在50%丢弃率下相对提升30.4%）。我们进一步验证了阻抗解耦、在+0.65秒飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及跨任务迁移至钢板乒乓球反弹（87.5%至100.0%）和FR3+手爪抓取（在4倍噪声下提升8.4%，峰值冲击力降低6-13%）。
tldr: Co-DRIS couples a physics-informed world model with variable-impedance control and a dual-stream belief encoder to make reactive robotic catching robust under coupled perception and actuation uncertainties, improving success rates on real Franka arms.
tldr_zh: Co-DRIS 将物理信息世界模型与可变阻抗控制及双流信念编码器相结合，使反应式机器人抓取在感知和驱动耦合不确定性下具有鲁棒性，在真实 Franka 机械臂上提升了成功率。

title: Beyond the Benchmark: Localizing Released Autonomous Driving Models to Real Vehicles
summary: Released autonomous-driving models achieve strong benchmark performance, yet deploying them on a new real vehicle remains challenging. We study this deployment gap and find that released models can remain coupled to assumptions from their source sensing, data, and execution processes even after conventional adaptation. We introduce Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology that identifies such source-system coupling and corrects only the affected components while preserving the released model. For data and behavior adaptation, we find that the mismatch between trajectory-level optimization and receding-horizon execution enters through the ego state rather than the observation, and introduce Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL), which corrects it on recorded target driving without the costly rollouts of generative closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). For physical sensor adaptation, R2R localizes and corrects source-dependent spatial and temporal representations with frozen perception weights, requiring neither target annotations nor retraining. HA-RL improves the closed-loop success rate of a released diffusion-based planner from 82.2% to 95.2%, while sensor adaptation across multiple released detectors and three real sensor rigs improves the vehicle mean average precision (mAP) of a released multi-camera detector from 0.041 to 0.420 on a five-camera target rig. These results provide a practical path for preparing released models before deployment on new real vehicles. Our project page is publicly available at https://released-to-real.github.io.
summary_zh: 发布的自动驾驶模型在基准测试中表现优异，但将其部署到新型实车上仍面临挑战。我们研究了这一部署差距，发现已发布模型即使在传统适配之后，仍可能与其源感知、数据和执行过程中的假设存在耦合。我们提出了一种部署定位方法——Released-to-Real (R2R)，用于识别此类源系统耦合，并仅修正受影响的组件，同时保持已发布模型不变。在数据和行为适配方面，我们发现轨迹级优化与滚动时域执行之间的失配是通过自车状态而非观测引入的，并由此提出人类锚定强化学习 (HA-RL)，该方法可利用记录的目标驾驶数据修正该失配，而无需生成式闭环强化学习 (RL) 的高成本 rollout。在物理传感器适配方面，R2R 通过冻结感知权重，定位并修正源依赖的空间和时间表示，既不需要目标标注，也不需要重新训练。HA-RL 将已发布的基于扩散的规划器的闭环成功率从 82.2% 提升至 95.2%，而跨多个已发布检测器和三个真实传感器套件的传感器适配则将已发布的多相机检测器在五相机目标套件上的车辆平均精度 (mAP) 从 0.041 提升至 0.420。这些结果为在新型实车部署前准备已发布模型提供了一条实用路径。我们的项目页面公开发布于 https://released-to-real.github.io。
tldr: This paper introduces Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology to adapt released autonomous-driving models to new real vehicles by correcting source-system coupling in data, behavior, and sensor configurations. R2R's Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL) and frozen-perception sensor adaptation improve closed-loop planning success and detection accuracy on real sensor rigs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Released-to-Real（R2R）部署本地化方法，通过修正源系统耦合的数据、行为和传感器配置，将已发布的自动驾驶模型适配到新实车上。R2R的Human-Anchored强化学习（HA-RL）和冻结感知的传感器适配提升了闭环规划成功率和真实传感器配置下的检测精度。

title: Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on multimodal inputs that capture visual context and non-visual physical interaction cues for precise and coordinated control. To address the challenge of effectively integrating these modalities for policy learning, we propose HiMoDex, a two-stage framework centered on hierarchical multimodal world-state representations. In Stage 1, we pretrain a hierarchical representation network on the collected dataset of 1.19 million synchronized multimodal time steps. The network integrates visual context with tactile, force-torque, and audio cues into unified world-state embeddings. In Stage 2, we freeze the pretrained network and use its embeddings to condition a shared world-action transformer. The transformer jointly learns action generation and action-conditioned future-state prediction. Experiments across five real-world tasks show that HiMoDex achieves an average success rate of 78.7\%, representing an absolute improvement of 32.0\% over the strongest evaluated baseline. Extensive ablations validate the benefits of hierarchical representation learning and two-stage training. Failure analysis helps explain performance differences across variants. Code, data, and demos will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/.
summary_zh: 双臂灵巧操作依赖于多模态输入，这些输入捕捉视觉上下文以及非视觉的物理交互线索，以实现精确且协调的控制。为应对有效整合这些模态以进行策略学习的挑战，我们提出了HiMoDex——一个以层级多模态世界状态表示为核心的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们在收集的119万个同步多模态时间步数据集上预训练一个层级表示网络。该网络将视觉上下文与触觉、力-力矩和音频线索整合为统一的世界状态嵌入。在第二阶段，我们冻结预训练网络，并利用其嵌入来条件化一个共享的世界-动作变换器。该变换器联合学习动作生成和以动作为条件的未来状态预测。在五个真实世界任务上的实验表明，HiMoDex的平均成功率达到78.7%，相比于最强评估基线实现了32.0%的绝对提升。广泛的消融研究验证了层级表示学习和两阶段训练的益处。失败分析有助于解释不同变体间的性能差异。代码、数据和演示将在https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/发布。
tldr: HiMoDex introduces a two-stage framework that pretrains hierarchical multimodal world-state representations on 1.19M synchronized time steps and uses them to condition a shared world-action transformer, achieving 78.7% average success and a 32% absolute improvement over baselines in five real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: HiMoDex 提出了一种两阶段框架，在119万个同步多模态时间步上预训练层级多模态世界状态表示，并用其条件化一个共享的世界-动作变换器，在五个真实世界双臂灵巧操作任务中实现了78.7%的平均成功率和相比基线32%的绝对提升。

title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models
summary: This paper demonstrates an approach for correcting failures of robot foundation models (RFMs) without additional data collection, demonstrations, or training. We apply weight-space programming (WSP), in which a language-model agent directly reads and writes a neural network's parameters, to a large, pre-trained vision-language-action policy. The idea is simple: many policy failures are not random but repeatedly land in the same recognizable stuck state, so if that state is visible in the model's internal activations, a small edit could trigger a corrective movement while leaving the rest of the model's parameters unchanged. A core design choice is where to write the edit: repurposing a few near-silent neurons in the action expert lets the edit switch on in situations associated with the failure and produce a corrective movement, such as lowering the gripper toward the target, that is specified directly rather than learned through training. Empirically, when applied to the pi0.5 policy in simulation, we find that edits to roughly 0.0002% of the parameters can improve success on recurring failures, including for a policy that was already fine-tuned on its task. Reversed and random edits indicate that the gains come from the intended behavior, and the approach works best when the failure situation is recognizable and a simple correction can address it.
summary_zh: 本文展示了一种无需额外数据采集、示范或训练即可纠正机器人基础模型（RFMs）故障的方法。我们将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于一个大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略，在该方法中，语言模型代理直接读取和写入神经网络的参数。其思路很简单：许多策略故障并非随机发生，而是反复陷入相同的可识别停滞状态，因此，如果该状态在模型的内部激活中可见，那么一次小幅编辑即可触发纠正动作，同时保持模型其余参数不变。一个核心设计选择是编辑的写入位置：重新利用动作专家中少数近乎静默的神经元，使编辑在故障相关情境下被激活，并产生直接指定的纠正动作（如将夹爪向目标降低），而非通过训练学习而来。实验结果表明，在仿真环境中应用于pi0.5策略时，对约0.0002%的参数进行编辑即可改善反复出现的故障，包括对于已在任务上微调过的策略也是如此。反向和随机编辑表明，性能提升源于预期行为，且该方法在故障情境可识别且简单纠正即可解决的情况下效果最佳。
tldr: This paper introduces weight-space programming (WSP) to correct robot foundation policy failures by directly editing a small set of parameters, without additional training or data, demonstrating improved success in simulation on a pi0.5 VLA policy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出权重空间编程（WSP），通过直接编辑极少量参数来修复机器人基础策略的失败，无需额外训练或数据，并在pi0.5 VLA策略的仿真中验证了效果。

title: One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/
summary_zh:
摘要：
仿真到现实（Sim-to-real）的强化学习已展现出令人瞩目的机器人行为，但直接从视觉信息部署策略仍具挑战。常见做法是先用基于特权状态观测的强化学习训练教师策略，再通过模仿将其行为蒸馏到基于视觉的学生策略中。然而，学生策略的性能往往明显逊于教师策略。直接使用强化学习训练视觉策略是一种有前景的替代方案，但从头学习任务相关的视觉表征可能样本效率低下，使得单阶段视觉强化学习难以实现。我们提出DRIFT，一种利用测试时可获取的图像观测实现高效单阶段视觉强化学习的简洁方案。我们的关键洞察是使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器，使强化学习能够专注于从已有视觉表征中学习控制。冻结编码器避免了视觉主干网络中的昂贵反向传播，而其预训练表征则支持从快速栅格化仿真渲染中进行真实世界迁移。在匹配的架构、观测和计算预算下，DRIFT优于两阶段蒸馏方法，并在三个操作任务中实现了平均真实世界成功率58.8%的相对提升。受控仿真评估表明，DRIFT的相对优势从分布内场景的约9%增长到分布外偏移下的超过61%，表明更强的泛化能力促成了更优的真实世界迁移效果。项目网站：https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/
tldr: DRIFT proposes a simple one-phase visual RL recipe using frozen pretrained vision encoders to directly train policies from images, outperforming two-phase distillation in sim-to-real transfer across manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: DRIFT提出了一种简单的一阶段视觉强化学习方案，利用冻结的预训练视觉编码器直接从图像训练策略，在模拟到现实的迁移中优于两阶段蒸馏方法。

title: FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator
summary: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment. Redesigned cloth-rigid contact and bidirectional force coupling support interactions among robot arms, fabric, and free rigid objects, allowing a bag to support its contents and transmit their weight to the grippers. In a controlled grasp-hold-release evaluation, our solver succeeds in all 45 trials, compared with none for the tested baseline configurations. Evaluating six representative policies, including vision-language-action models and world action models, reveals substantial remaining challenges: the best policy achieves 77% average success, while no policy exceeds 36% on long-horizon T-shirt folding. Under the most deformed initial T-shirt configurations, success falls to 6-14% across policies, with larger drops than under the evaluated appearance shifts. Zero-shot deployment of $π_{0.5}$ on a real robot largely preserves task difficulty ordering across six tasks (Spearman $ρ=0.94$). These results establish FabricBench as a reproducible testbed for measuring fabric-manipulation capabilities and exposing limitations in configuration generalization. The project website is available at https://fabricbench.github.io/.
summary_zh: 布料操作对机器人策略提出了几何变化、自遮挡和接触等方面的挑战，然而标准化评估仍集中在刚体物体上。我们引入了FabricBench，一个双机械臂布料操作基准，包含涵盖服装、丝绸和袋子的六项任务、10,000个可供仿真使用的资产，以及对形态和外观泛化的受控测试。该基准基于Newton中的开源求解器构建，我们的仿真器通过接触力实现稳定的双臂抓取、握持和释放，无需人为附加约束。重新设计的布料-刚体接触和双向力耦合支持机械臂、布料和自由刚体物体之间的交互，使袋子能够承载其内容物并将其重量传递到夹爪上。在受控的抓取-握持-释放评估中，我们的求解器在全部45次试验中均成功，而所测试的基线配置则全部失败。评估六种代表性策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型和世界动作模型）揭示了仍然存在的重大挑战：最佳策略平均成功率仅为77%，而在长时程T恤折叠任务上，没有任何策略超过36%。在最极端变形的初始T恤形态下，各策略的成功率降至6-14%，其下降幅度大于所评估的外观变化带来的影响。π₀.₅在真实机器人上的零样本部署在六项任务间基本保持了任务难度排序（Spearman ρ = 0.94）。这些结果使FabricBench成为衡量布料操作能力并揭示形态泛化局限性的可复现测试平台。项目网站地址为 https://fabricbench.github.io/。
tldr: FabricBench introduces a standardized benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with a new contact-driven deformable simulator, evaluating six policies including VLA and world action models, revealing significant challenges in configuration generalization.
tldr_zh: FabricBench 提出了一个用于双臂布料操作的标准基准，基于新的接触驱动可变形模拟器，评估了包括 VLA 和世界动作模型在内的六种策略，揭示了配置泛化方面的重大挑战。

title: Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs
summary: Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.
summary_zh: 近期研究显示，在特定持续学习场景下，经过经验回放微调的预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出近乎零遗忘的特性。然而，所学任务在域偏移情况下的鲁棒性尚未得到探索。本研究利用LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准，探究了在分布外（OOD）数据下，结合经验回放微调的Pi0模型的鲁棒性。尽管域内（ID）设置实现了近乎零的灾难性遗忘，但以往任务的OOD性能却迅速崩溃。具体而言，我们发现在持续学习过程中，模型的OOD能力出现退化，且在不同域偏移间呈现出共享的表征模式，这在两个较简单的套件中也在行为层面表现明显。表征分析显示，漂移集中于多模态特征和动作特征。线性探针表明，OOD特征仍保留任务相关信息，但呈现不可读取状态，这与表征错位现象一致。这些发现表明，即使域内稳定性保持不变，严重的OOD遗忘仍可能发生，并在持续学习过程中伴随表征漂移。
tldr: This paper investigates out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness in continual learning of pretrained VLA models, finding that even with near-zero in-domain forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks degrades sharply due to representational drift in multimodal and action features.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了预训练VLA模型在持续学习中的分布外（OOD）鲁棒性，发现即使域内遗忘接近零，先前任务的OOD性能也会因多模态和动作特征的表示漂移而急剧下降。

title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 推理型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中利用思维链（CoT）推理来引导动作生成，但带来了显著的内存和计算开销。本文针对这类模型研究结构化剪枝，重点关注同时保持场景理解与轨迹预测能力。我们对Alpamayo-1.5-10B中泰勒重要性的分析表明，推理目标与轨迹目标对同一视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构赋予了不同的重要性。在动作专家模块中，MLP通道在去噪步骤间的重要性排序比查询头更为稳定，且少量通道贡献了所测得的大部分重要性。基于这些发现，我们提出MoOP方法，该方法结合两个目标的重要性排名进行VLM剪枝，并聚合逐步重要性以选择固定的专家MLP通道子集。在总参数量减少24.0%的情况下，使用MoOP仅对VLM进行剪枝，其驾驶性能与最强基线相当或略优，同时保留了稠密模型LingoQA评分的94.0%，显著高于所有其他方法。在更高的30.0%削减率下，MoOP的性能下降幅度远小于其他所有方法，因为它是唯一一个推理未发生崩塌的方法。移除93.75%的专家MLP通道可将总参数量削减提升至39.4%，与仅进行VLM剪枝相比，开环误差几乎不变，闭环性能具有竞争力。最终模型相比稠密模型实现了1.37倍的端到端推理加速和36.6%的峰值内存降低，且无需剪枝后微调。
tldr: This paper proposes MoOP, a structured pruning method for autonomous driving VLA models that combines importance ranks from reasoning and action objectives to prune the VLM and selects a fixed subset of expert MLP channels, achieving significant parameter reduction, inference speedup, and memory savings while preserving reasoning and trajectory prediction performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出MoOP，一种针对自动驾驶VLA模型的结构化剪枝方法，结合推理和动作目标的重要性排名来剪枝VLM，并选择固定的专家MLP通道子集，在保持推理和轨迹预测性能的同时，实现了显著的参数减少、推理加速和内存节省。

title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
summary: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.
summary_zh: 编码智能体能够在执行过程中构建和修正机器人行为，但若整个机器人仅由一个智能体控制，可能会延误本可独立推进的工作。我们提出了一种异步框架——作为策略的异步编码智能体（ACAP），该框架将一台机器人组织为一个由多个持久智能体组成的团队。每个成员针对可配置的控制组（例如带有夹爪的机械臂，或躯干与底盘）进行推理与行动，从而实现异步推理与执行。然而，机器人不同部件之间往往存在物理依赖关系，需要进行协调。为应对这一挑战，ACAP引入了超智能体（hyper-agent），负责任务分配、依赖关系协调，并在主智能体与成员智能体之间动态分配控制权。这使得独立工作能够并行推进，同时在必要时支持紧密耦合的操作任务。在覆盖25种任务/平台设置、总计72次真实世界部署的实验中，与单智能体直接策略（Direct Policy）相比，ACAP将任务均衡时间成本降低了28.2%，并在完全并行、并行-顺序及协作类型任务中均取得改进。在所有八种协作设置中，ACAP的平均时间成本也低于固定委派（Fixed Delegation）策略——后者仅允许成员智能体控制其分配到的部件。此外，一项包含90次部署的补充实验显示，在全部六项任务中，ACAP在30分钟上限内的平均时间成本均低于直接策略。我们还进一步展示了利用同一成员接口控制底盘与躯干的移动操作能力。本文呈现了该框架，并提供了一个包含观测数据、生成程序、动作及反馈的真实世界部署数据集，以支持关于编码智能体如何在物理世界中推理与行动的研究。
tldr: ACAP organizes a robot as a team of asynchronous coding agents, each controlling a specific component, with a hyper-agent for coordination, reducing task completion time by 28.2% across 72 real-world rollouts.
tldr_zh: ACAP 将机器人组织为一组异步编码代理，每个代理控制特定组件，并由超代理协调，在 72 次真实世界测试中将任务完成时间缩短 28.2%。

title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
summary: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.
summary_zh: 前沿多模态模型在根据观测和指令生成机器人动作方面展现出非凡的泛化能力，这使得一种新范式成为可能——模型可直接作为闭环机器人控制系统中的策略模块。然而，此类控制系统的设计原则及其卓越性能背后的能力基础仍不明确。我们提出Embo-Harness，一个用于系统研究前沿模型即策略控制系统的框架。我们考察了机器人智能体循环的四个组成部分，即提示、规划、动作执行和工具使用，并将六项实证发现提炼为实用的设计指南。该指南优先采用利用模型原生视觉推理和工具使用能力的接口，而非手工设计的规划、技能或动作先验，并确定了动作表示、分块、推理强度、视觉观测、短多动作序列及策略优化方面的有效选择。在RoboLab-120上，Embo-Harness取得了83.3%的成功率，比已报告的最强基线高出26.2个百分点。在四个真实世界操作任务的20次零样本试验中，它也成功完成了15次。除性能表现外，受控干预实验表明，所研究的模型对精确空间目标估计的依赖程度高于对显式低级关节或轨迹生成的依赖。这些结果既为构建强大的前沿模型即策略控制系统提供了实用指南，也对这些系统性能背后的能力给出了更清晰的阐释。
tldr: Embo-Harness systematically studies design choices for using frontier multimodal models directly as closed-loop robot policies, distilling a practical recipe that achieves high success on RoboLab-120 and real-world tasks, and analyzes the capabilities (spatial estimation vs. low-level generation) driving performance.
tldr_zh: Embo-Harness 系统研究了将前沿多模态模型直接用作闭环机器人策略的设计原则，提炼出实用配方，在 RoboLab-120 和真实世界任务中取得高成功率，并分析了驱动性能的关键能力（空间估计 vs 低层轨迹生成）。

title: VITA-WAM: Manifold-Aligned World-Action Modeling for Real-Time Robot Control
summary: World action model (WAM) is a promising paradigm for visuomotor control by jointly modeling world dynamics and actions. Notably, existing WAMs often rely on large generative models and iterative sampling which incur substantial latency for action generation, limiting real-time deployment. In particular, there are two root causes of inefficiency in conventional flow matching or diffusion based action models in WAMs: 1) transporting uninformative Gaussian noise into precise actions necessitating multiple ODE steps, and 2) repeatedly injecting task context through expensive cross-attention modules. Our key insight is that jointly learning and aligning the source and action manifolds streamlines the transport between them, substantially accelerating action generation. Building on this insight, we introduce VITA-WAM, a WAM architecture with manifold-aligned flow-matching (VITA flow matching) that directly transports latent observation representations containing visual, language, and proprioceptive information into latent actions. More specifically, a flow latent alignment (FLA) mechanism is employed to facilitate manifold alignment between latent observation and action representations, enabling accurate generation with few ODE steps. The resulting architecture also eliminates costly attention for observation conditioning during repeated denoising steps. Notably, with a single ODE step, VITA-WAM outperforms 10-step FastWAM by 21.47 pp on LIBERO-Plus and by 1.65 pp on LIBERO, achieving these gains through the FLA objective without distillation, while inferring at 55.67~ms latency, a $2.10\times$ speedup compared to FastWAM.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）是一种通过联合建模世界动态与动作来实现视觉运动控制的前沿范式。值得注意的是，现有WAM通常依赖大型生成模型和迭代采样，导致动作生成延迟显著，限制了实时部署。具体而言，传统基于流匹配或扩散的WAM动作模型存在两个低效根源：1）将无信息的高斯噪声传输为精确动作需要多次常微分方程（ODE）步骤；2）通过昂贵的交叉注意力模块重复注入任务上下文。我们的关键洞见在于，联合学习并对齐源流形与动作流形能够简化两者之间的传输过程，从而大幅加速动作生成。基于这一洞见，我们提出了VITA-WAM，一种采用流形对齐流匹配（VITA流匹配）的WAM架构，可直接将包含视觉、语言和本体感觉信息的潜在观测表示传输为潜在动作。具体而言，我们采用流潜对齐（FLA）机制促进潜在观测表示与动作表示之间的流形对齐，从而以少量ODE步骤实现精确生成。该架构还消除了重复去噪步骤中对观测条件注入所需的高成本注意力计算。值得注意的是，在单步ODE条件下，VITA-WAM在LIBERO-Plus上比10步FastWAM高出21.47个百分点，在LIBERO上高出1.65个百分点，这些性能提升完全通过FLA目标实现，无需蒸馏，同时推理延迟仅为55.67毫秒，相比FastWAM实现了2.10倍的加速。
tldr: VITA-WAM introduces a manifold-aligned flow-matching world-action model that accelerates robot action generation to a single ODE step, achieving faster inference and better performance than prior WAMs.
tldr_zh: VITA-WAM 提出了一种流形对齐的流匹配世界动作模型，将机器人动作生成加速到单步 ODE，在推理速度和性能上均优于先前方法。

title: Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.
summary_zh: 可靠的驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）不仅要能正确回答问题或定位相关场景参与者，还必须能够判断现有视觉证据是否足以支撑其回答。现有评估大多将定位能力与可回答性作为两个独立维度分别衡量，因而难以区分那些证据充分、支撑到位的预测，与那些虽定位到相关对象但证据不足的预测之间的差异。为此，我们提出了DriveAnswer基准，包含七个推理族共20,151个问题，通过匹配的“强证据”与“弱证据”配置来明确刻画这一区别。每一组配置对在保持底层场景事实和语义答案不变的前提下，仅改变观测信息是否足以支撑回答，从而在弱证据情况下，弃答（abstention）成为合理应对。在六族评估中，最强的零样本基线在强证据上的准确率达到67.31%，但在匹配问题中，仅21.55%同时满足正确弃答行为与完整定位要求。经过受控适配后，Gemma-4-12B在该联合能力上达到63.29%，相比其零样本表现提升了近三倍。Qwen3-VL-8B也在证据敏感的回答与定位方面展现出同样广泛的改进。这些结果表明，语义正确性、证据充分性与定位能力是三种相互独立的能力，应进行联合评估。
tldr: DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions for autonomous driving VLMs, jointly evaluates semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding using matched strong- and weak-evidence pairs; results show these are distinct capabilities and that adaptation can greatly improve joint performance.
tldr_zh: DriveAnswer 是一个包含 20,151 个问题的自动驾驶 VLM 基准，通过匹配的强/弱证据对，联合评估语义正确性、证据充分性和接地性；结果表明这些是独立能力，且适配可大幅提升联合性能。

title: Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\% Poisoning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Stage I freezes the policy and uses differentiable rendering and multimodal supervision to optimize a 3D trigger's texture, translation, and scale, strengthening trigger-target associations from limited poisoned demonstrations. Building on the optimized trigger, Stage II applies source-selective dual-LoRA adaptation to decouple clean and backdoor updates and mitigate their interference, followed by learned column-wise calibration and analytic fusion into a unified policy. Experiments on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ across four LIBERO suites show consistent gains over all evaluated attack baselines. With only 1% poisoned data, our method achieves 86.4% target success and 95.2% clean-task success on OpenVLA-OFT in LIBERO-Spatial. Real-robot trials also demonstrate trajectory-level hijacking.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作技术的进步，但其对演示数据的依赖使其面临后门攻击的威胁。在这些威胁中，轨迹级定向后门尤为棘手，且可能比行为破坏型攻击带来更大的安全风险：它不仅会造成任务失败或局部动作偏差，还必须维持闭环重定向以完成攻击者指定的多步任务。为可靠地诱发此类行为，现有方法通常依赖较高的投毒率以获得充足的目标轨迹监督信号。然而，高投毒率可能损害干净任务性能，而低投毒率则导致目标轨迹监督信号稀缺，使后门学习易受占主导地位的干净任务更新的干扰。为解决低投毒率下的这一权衡问题，我们提出了一种由视觉、语言和动作引导的两阶段协同优化框架。第一阶段冻结策略网络，利用可微渲染和多模态监督优化三维触发器的纹理、平移和缩放，从有限的投毒演示中强化触发器与目标之间的关联。在优化触发器的基础上，第二阶段采用源选择性双LoRA适配来解耦干净更新与后门更新并减轻二者间的干扰，随后通过学习得到的逐列校准与解析融合将其整合为统一策略。在四个LIBERO套件上对OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、$π_0$和$π_{0.5}$的实验表明，所提方法在所有被评估的攻击基线中均取得了一致的性能提升。在仅使用1%投毒数据的情况下，我们的方法在LIBERO-Spatial的OpenVLA-OFT上实现了86.4%的目标成功率和95.2%的干净任务成功率。真实机器人实验也验证了轨迹级劫持的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage co-optimization framework for injecting trajectory-level backdoors into VLA models using only 1% poisoned data, achieving high target-task success while maintaining clean-task performance across multiple VLA backbones and real-robot trials.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种两阶段协同优化框架，仅用1%的毒化数据即可在VLA模型中注入轨迹级后门，在多个VLA骨干和真实机器人试验中实现了高目标任务成功率并保持干净任务性能。

title: PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $Δ$Pose over the same horizon. The predicted $Δ$Pose is composed with the current trajectory-level pose to obtain the future pose state, which is recursively propagated throughout navigation, forming a continuous geometric state evolution from past memory to future motion. Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling geometric state evolution, with PoseVLN outperforming the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate, respectively, using only single RGB observations.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在遵循自然语言指令的同时，将过往经验、当前空间状态与未来运动相关联。近期方法通过长时记忆、状态感知推理和未来预测提升了这些能力，然而这些组件往往被单独建模，导致导航状态演化在时间维度上缺乏充分的连贯性。我们认为，相机位姿为连接过去、现在与未来状态提供了一种天然的几何表征。基于这一洞见，我们提出PoseVLN——一种位姿感知的VLN框架，可联合学习导航决策与几何状态演化。PoseVLN将视觉记忆与当前观测组织在情节相对坐标系中，并在同一时间跨度内联合预测接下来的K个导航动作及局部$\Delta$位姿。预测得到的$\Delta$位姿与当前轨迹级位姿复合，从而获得未来位姿状态，该状态在导航过程中递归传播，形成从过去记忆到未来运动的连续几何状态演化。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE验证未见拆分的实验表明，显式建模几何状态演化具有有效性，PoseVLN仅使用单一RGB观测，在成功率上分别比最强基线高出2.6和2.9个百分点。
tldr: PoseVLN introduces a pose-aware framework that jointly predicts navigation actions and geometric pose evolution to improve Vision-Language Navigation in continuous environments.
tldr_zh: PoseVLN 提出了一种位姿感知框架，联合预测导航动作和几何位姿演化，以提升连续环境中的视觉-语言导航。

title: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
summary: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind
summary_zh: 记忆增强的大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体能够复用过往经验，然而，当交通状况发生变化时，先前习得的修正往往难以迁移。一个关键限制在于，现有记忆主要记录已观测到的结果，对备选行为提供的证据很少。我们提出XMind，一个无需训练的框架，使基于LLM的驾驶能够通过跨记忆推理实现“三思而行”。XMind将近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆相整合。智能体首先根据当前语境做出初步决策，然后将其与检索到的历史经验进行交叉核对。若出现冲突，则基于检索到的证据做出第二次决策。为构建可靠的情景记忆，XMind通过在扰动交通条件下的反事实推演评估备选行为，并将验证后的结果存储为结构化风险胶囊。这些胶囊通过联合匹配空间风险模式与场景语义进行检索。在闭环高速公路仿真中，XMind取得了83.3%-93.3%的成功率，平均超过强基线6.6个百分点。在K-Risk上的评估进一步表明，在未见过的真实世界高风险交互中，其决策风险更低。消融研究证实了工作记忆、风险文本检索与反事实验证之间的互补优势。代码可在 https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind 获取。
tldr: XMind is a training-free framework enhancing LLM-based autonomous driving by integrating working and episodic memory, enabling counterfactual cross-memory reasoning to improve decision-making in closed-loop highway simulations and real-world high-risk scenarios.
tldr_zh: XMind是一种无需训练、通过跨记忆推理（结合工作记忆与情景记忆及反事实验证）增强基于LLM的自动驾驶决策的框架，在闭环高速模拟和真实高风险交互中显著提升了成功率并降低了决策风险。

title: Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?
summary: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.
summary_zh: 占用世界模型根据自我动作预测未来的三维场景，然而在反事实动作条件下，其预测可能无法忠实遵循指定轨迹。由于驾驶数据集对每个场景的替代轨迹覆盖稀疏，现有模型隐含地从观测到的场景-轨迹组合中学习自我运动的空间效应，这可能导致动作效应与场景-轨迹相关性相互纠缠。我们提出ReCast，一种自我轨迹引导的 Transformer 架构，基于跨自我中心帧的动作诱导几何对应关系来锚定未来预测。ReCast将历史编码与未来解码解耦，并利用相对自我变换对齐可变形交互，同时保留非刚性场景演化的灵活性。我们还引入了一个涵盖分布内、尾部及分布外轨迹的反事实动作忠实性基准。在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，ReCast在保持具有竞争力的标准预测性能的同时，提升了反事实预测能力，尤其在分布外轨迹下取得了显著改进。
tldr: ReCast is an ego-trajectory-guided transformer for occupancy world models that improves action faithfulness under counterfactual trajectories by decoupling historical encoding from future decoding and aligning deformable interactions with ego transformations, validated on Occ3D-nuScenes.
tldr_zh: ReCast 是一种以自我轨迹引导的 transformer 占用世界模型，通过解耦历史编码与未来解码，并利用自我变换对齐可变形交互，提高了反事实轨迹下的动作忠实度，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上验证。

title: FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment
summary: Model alignment is the primary safety and security mechanism for enforcing refusal of malicious prompts in modern foundation models; yet, existing adversarial evaluations implicitly assume underlying hardware integrity. In this paper, we present FATCAT, the first physical fault-injection attacks capable of eliminating refusal in modern large language and vision-language models. Specifically, we present a non-invasive electromagnetic (EM) fault injection attack targeting GPU-accelerated Systems-on-Chip with physical access, requiring neither software execution privileges nor model-layer access. By leveraging an autonomous Radio Frequency (RF) side-channel trigger to synchronize EM faults to the prompt prefill phase, the attack corrupts safety-critical memory transactions across off-chip LPDDR5 DRAM and on-chip LPDDR physical interfaces without crashing the system while preserving model coherence. Evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and AGX Thor running Llama 3.2 1B and Gemma 3 1B, localized physical faults reliably force models to fulfill restricted requests, demonstrating that model-level alignment provides no robust security guarantees without hardware-level fault tolerance. Finally, we demonstrate the physical-world consequences of this vulnerability on an active 6-DoF robotic manipulator controlled by a SmolVLA vision-language-action policy. Our attack silently corrupts the model forcing the arm into abrupt, hazardous lunges; in two instances the robotic arm attempted to pinch the paper author -- proving that hardware faults can directly translate into real physical harm.
summary_zh: 模型对齐是现代基础模型中强制执行对恶意提示拒绝的主要安全与安保机制；然而，现有的对抗性评估隐含地假定底层硬件具有完整性。在本文中，我们提出了FATCAT，这是首个能够消除现代大型语言模型和视觉语言模型中拒绝行为的物理故障注入攻击。具体而言，我们提出了一种针对具有物理访问权限的GPU加速片上系统的非侵入式电磁（EM）故障注入攻击，该攻击既不需要软件执行权限，也不需要模型层访问权限。通过利用自主射频（RF）侧信道触发器将电磁故障同步到提示预填充阶段，该攻击会破坏跨片外LPDDR5 DRAM和片上LPDDR物理接口的安全关键内存事务，而不会导致系统崩溃，同时保持模型连贯性。在运行Llama 3.2 1B和Gemma 3 1B的NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和AGX Thor上进行的评估表明，局部物理故障能够可靠地迫使模型执行受限请求，从而证明在没有硬件级容错的情况下，模型级对齐无法提供稳健的安全保障。最后，我们在由SmolVLA视觉-语言-动作策略控制的主动6自由度机器人机械臂上展示了这一漏洞的物理世界后果。我们的攻击悄无声息地破坏模型，迫使机械臂发生突然的、危险的前冲动作；在两次实例中，机械臂试图捏住论文作者——这证明硬件故障可以直接转化为真实的身体伤害。
tldr: FATCAT introduces non-invasive electromagnetic fault injection attacks that disable model alignment in multimodal LLMs on edge GPUs, and demonstrates the attack on a real robotic manipulator, causing hazardous physical movements.
tldr_zh: FATCAT 提出了一种非侵入式电磁故障注入攻击，可禁用边缘GPU上多模态大语言模型的对齐机制，并在真实机器人操作臂上验证了该攻击可导致危险物理动作。

title: CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation
summary: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.
summary_zh: 安全关键交互在录制的驾驶数据中较为罕见，导致端到端驾驶规划器在训练过程中对规避行为的接触十分有限。这种关键监督的缺失可能导致不安全行为，并在少数情况下引发碰撞。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CriticalScenes——一种基于重建的框架，可将普通录制的驾驶场景转化为逼真的安全关键交互，并提供相应的碰撞规避监督。在53个重建源场景中，1,060次尝试交互中有979次生成了可行的威胁轨迹（占92.4%），同时插入的威胁主体在5至35米范围内超过95%的无遮挡观测中仍可被检测到。针对两种结构不同的端到端规划器进行的实验表明，所生成的监督能够改善关键场景规划性能，而闭环迁移效果则因规划器架构不同而有所差异。SparseDrive在独立的逼真闭环基准上将碰撞率相对降低了46.5%，而UniAD尽管在开环指标上有显著提升，但闭环改进较为有限。实验结果进一步强调了闭环评估的重要性，因为开环轨迹预测的改进并不一定转化为同等的安全收益。
tldr: CriticalScenes is a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary driving scenes into photorealistic critical interactions with collision-avoidance supervision, improving closed-loop driving safety in end-to-end planners.
tldr_zh: CriticalScenes 是一个基于重建的框架，将普通驾驶场景转换为逼真的关键交互并提供碰撞避免监督，从而提升端到端规划器的闭环驾驶安全性。

title: MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving
summary: Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/
summary_zh: 稀疏世界模型通过少量动态查询表示场景，以高效预测自动驾驶中的未来几何与语义，用于4D语义占用预测。然而，现有稀疏世界模型在利用历史时间证据进行长时预测方面存在瓶颈。它们依赖场景状态隐式携带历史信息，导致误差在连续预测步骤中传播与累积，进而引发几何与语义偏差。为解决该局限，我们提出MemAnchorWorld，一种稀疏占用世界模型，显式检索相关历史几何与语义证据以进行4D语义占用预测。受冯·雷斯托夫效应启发，我们引入了一种预测时间条件的分层双路径记忆锚点检索机制。在历史信息的有效年龄和语义兼容性引导下，该机制结合查询级候选选择与点级记忆锚点检索，为不同预测时间点的稀疏点提供历史证据。为更好地利用记忆锚点与现有特征，一个由任务和预测时间联合门控的点级残差适配器分别控制语义、占用置信度及空间位置的残差修正。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，MemAnchorWorld在1-3秒预测范围内实现了平均mIoU 13.55%和平均IoU 22.84%，在两项指标上均达到最先进性能。项目页面：https://memanchorworld.github.io/
tldr: MemAnchorWorld introduces a sparse world model with a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism, achieving state-of-the-art 4D semantic occupancy forecasting for autonomous driving on Occ3D-nuScenes.
tldr_zh: MemAnchorWorld提出了一种带有预测时间条件分层双路径记忆锚检索机制的稀疏世界模型，在Occ3D-nuScenes上实现了最先进的4D语义占用预测。

title: Knocked Off Course: Tracing Uncommanded Motion from Perception to Action in Embodied VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable simultaneous processing of egocentric video and textual target descriptions to produce action commands for embodied tracking platforms. However, these platforms rarely move exactly as commanded, in part due to unexpected environmental disturbances such as wind, unleveled terrain, and road bumps. Here we study how such models handle uncommanded egomotion. First, we explore performance across diverse disturbances by benchmarking three tracking VLAs on three datasets. We find that models differ in which environmental disturbances hurt them most, but all are sensitive to sudden target loss. Tracing egomotion from pixels to emitted actions, we identify two gaps. In representation, motion is reliably recovered through explicit relations between frames, but aggressive compression of past frames weakens small-motion readouts. In action, large rotations do reach the decision state, yet the decoded direction carries only a few percent of a mirrored rotation's effect on the turn. Targeting both gaps, we fine-tune one model, Uni-NaVid, on data amounting to just 1.7% of its original training set in a ladder of analysis-motivated variants. These gain 5-22 points after target-loss without degrading clean success; after a smooth loss, the best one improves success by 72% (relative), recovering 76% of its gap to clean. We also show that targeted fine-tuning improves recovery partly via a text-mediated action dependency, without new architecture, large-scale data collection or training from scratch.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）能够同时处理自我中心视频和文本目标描述，从而为具身跟踪平台生成动作指令。然而，这些平台在实际运行中很少完全按照指令移动，部分原因在于意外的环境扰动，如风力、不平整的地形以及路面颠簸。本文研究此类模型如何处理非指令性自我运动。首先，我们通过在三个数据集上对三个跟踪VLA模型进行基准测试，探讨模型在不同扰动下的表现差异。研究发现，不同模型受环境扰动影响最大的类型各不相同，但所有模型都对目标的突然丢失高度敏感。通过追踪从像素到输出动作的自我运动过程，我们识别出两个关键缺口。在表征层面，运动可以通过帧间的显式关系可靠恢复，但过去帧的激进压缩会削弱微小运动的读取能力。在动作层面，大幅旋转确实能够到达决策状态，但解码出的方向仅能承载镜像旋转对转向影响效果的百分之几。针对这两个缺口，我们在一个由分析驱动的变体阶梯中对Uni-NaVid模型进行微调，所用数据仅为其原始训练集的1.7%。在目标丢失后，这些变体模型的性能提升了5至22个百分点，且不损害正常运行成功率；在平滑丢失场景下，最佳变体成功率相对提升72%，恢复至其与正常运行之间差距的76%。我们还证明，定向微调部分通过文本介导的动作依赖关系改善恢复能力，而无需新架构、大规模数据采集或从头训练。
tldr: This paper studies how embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) tracking models respond to uncommanded egomotion caused by environmental disturbances, identifies representation and action gaps that amplify errors after target loss, and shows that targeted fine-tuning with minimal data can substantially improve robustness and recovery without architectural changes.
tldr_zh: 本文研究具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）跟踪模型如何在环境扰动导致的非指令自我运动下表现，发现表示和动作层面的缺陷会放大目标丢失后的错误，并证明通过极少量数据的针对性微调即可显著提升鲁棒性和恢复能力，无需改动架构。

title: GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）规划器继承了预训练视觉-语言模型的语义知识，但其推理过程很少基于三维场景结构及其随时间的变化。我们提出GeoVLDrive，一种面向三维时空推理与规划的几何锚定VLA框架。来自三维基础模型的多层特征通过门控交叉注意力增强视觉-语言骨干网络。结构化的潜在思维链（CoT）将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动及元动作组织为有序且分别监督的潜在状态。动作专家从这些状态及多层场景特征中生成轨迹候选，并使用基于场景锚定的交互评分令牌对其进行排序。我们还引入了NAVSIM 3DQA，用于训练和评估度量级三维空间与运动理解。GeoVLDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到91.8 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.9 EPDMS。在NAVSIM 3DQA上，几何锚定骨干网络整体得分为89.2%，比微调后的Qwen3-VL-2B基线高出4.6个百分点。在LingoQA上，该骨干网络达到68.6%的Lingo-Judge准确率。
tldr: GeoVLDrive introduces a geometry-grounded vision-language-action framework for autonomous driving that augments a vision-language backbone with 3D scene features and a structured latent chain of thought, achieving strong performance on NAVSIM and LingoQA benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GeoVLDrive 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的几何接地视觉-语言-动作框架，通过三维场景特征和结构化潜在思维链增强视觉-语言骨干网络，在NAVSIM和LingoQA基准测试中取得了优异性能。

title: ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction
summary: Pedestrian forecasting from ego-view observations is challenging because occlusion, limited visibility, and tracking errors corrupt observed motion histories. Such errors are particularly consequential for autonomous robot navigation. Existing paradigms typically either impute noisy history positions before forecasting or jointly train an auxiliary history reconstruction branch. However, predictors trained on clean histories may be sensitive to residual errors in recovered histories at deployment. Meanwhile, auxiliary reconstruction still computes inter-agent interactions over raw, corrupted coordinates. We investigate conditioning future prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, with progressive training to accommodate imperfect recovery. Building on this insight, we propose ObsBridge, a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework with observation-grounded historical bridging. Specifically, ObsBridge first employs a frozen estimator to recover historical motion from agent-relative and ego-relative positions, image-plane locations, and visibility states. During training, we introduce an agent-wise curriculum that gradually replaces clean teacher histories with complete estimated histories before context encoding. This progressively exposes the predictor to estimated histories during training. Furthermore, we design a residual geometry adapter to fuse the encoded motion with original observation evidence. We aggregate the resulting representations through social attention to condition the flow-based trajectory generator. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ObsBridge outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On EgoTraj-TBD, it reduces minADE@20 by 6.5\% and minFDE@20 by 8.7\%. The code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge.
summary_zh: 从自我视角观察进行行人预测具有挑战性，因为遮挡、有限视野和跟踪误差会破坏观察到的运动历史。此类误差对于自主机器人导航尤为关键。现有范式通常是在预测前对含噪声的历史位置进行插补，或者联合训练一个辅助的历史重建分支。然而，在干净历史上训练的预测器在部署时可能对恢复历史中的残余误差敏感。与此同时，辅助重建仍在原始、含噪声的坐标上计算智能体间的交互。我们研究了将未来预测同时基于恢复的历史状态和原始观测证据，并采用渐进式训练以适应不完美的恢复。基于这一见解，我们提出ObsBridge——一种基于流的轨迹预测框架，具有观测锚定的历史桥接能力。具体而言，ObsBridge首先使用冻结估计器从智能体相对位置、自我相对位置、图像平面坐标和可见性状态中恢复历史运动。在训练过程中，我们引入一种智能体级课程，在上下文编码之前逐步用完整估计历史替换干净教师历史。这使预测器在训练期间逐渐暴露于估计历史中。此外，我们设计了一个残差几何适配器，将编码的运动与原始观测证据融合。我们通过社交注意力聚合所得表示，以条件化基于流的轨迹生成器。跨多个基准的大量实验表明，ObsBridge优于最先进方法。在EgoTraj-TBD上，它使minADE@20降低了6.5%，minFDE@20降低了8.7%。代码将提供于https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge。
tldr: ObsBridge introduces a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework that conditions future pedestrian prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, using progressive training and a residual geometry adapter to improve robustness against noisy ego-view observations for autonomous robot navigation.
tldr_zh: ObsBridge 提出了一种基于流的轨迹预测框架，该框架同时利用恢复的历史状态和原始观测证据进行未来预测，并通过渐进式训练和残差几何适配器来提高对自主机器人导航中噪声观测的鲁棒性。

title: A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds
summary: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates.
