We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).
summary_zh: 视频世界模型能够根据用户动作合成逼真的观测结果，但在长时间交互中难以保持一致。编码智能体和文本到3D模型则生成显式3D世界，其几何和状态通过构造方式持续存在，但外观远不及照片级逼真度。近期方法通过将此类世界渲染为粗略代理（coarse proxies）来引导视频模型，从而结合两者优势。然而，由于这些代理仅指定物体所处位置，渲染器在探索世界时需自行创造物体外观，且任何被遗忘的内容都会在表面重新出现时被重新生成。我们的关键洞察在于：网格（mesh）能够跨帧、跨视角识别每个像素所对应的表面，即使物体移动时亦然，从而可作为渲染器生成内容的地址。我们提出M2R（Mesh to Remember），一种少步因果视频渲染器，将自身特征存储于其所描绘的表面之上（以各物体自身坐标系存储），并当这些表面重新进入视野时，通过光栅化网格将其检索出来。由此，外观随物体移动而迁移，跨多次回访持续存在，并被所有观测它的智能体共享，同时记忆随所见的表面增长，而非随帧数增长。M2R仅使用合成数据训练，即可零样本迁移至真实室内扫描场景及编码智能体生成的数字世界。在静态、动态及多智能体基准测试中，它在一致性方面超越现有最优方法，物体持久性提升一倍以上，跨智能体一致性提升近一倍，同时能够实时（40 FPS）渲染720p视频。
tldr: M2R is a video world model that uses meshes from interactive 3D worlds as persistent spatial addresses, storing and retrieving renderer-generated features on object surfaces to achieve temporally and cross-view consistent appearance for long-horizon interactive video synthesis.
tldr_zh: M2R 是一种视频世界模型，利用交互式 3D 世界中的网格作为持久空间地址，在物体表面上存储和检索渲染器生成的特征，从而在长时间交互式视频合成中实现时间和跨视图一致的外观。

title: NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶需要语义理解与细粒度场景感知，以实现精确的动作预测。视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）继承了语义先验知识，但低维动作标签提供的结构化监督有限。一些研究通过视觉生成任务扩展VLA，或采用基于视频的世界-动作模型（WAMs），但这两种方法都引入了与规划相关性较弱的外观重建开销。原生多模态模型提供了一种在同一骨干网络内统一理解与生成的替代方案。在此基础上，我们提出了NativeDrive，一种原生无编码器多模态驾驶框架，将统一骨干网络适配于策略学习，并引入了一项专为驾驶设计的密集监督任务。Native Action Interface复用理解专家的令牌预测接口来处理离散策略，并适配生成专家来处理连续策略。Driving Semantic Editing在训练期间复用生成专家的编辑能力，以提供密集场景结构监督，而推理时仅运行所选的规划策略。在NAVSIM v1和v2上，NativeDrive在统一理解与生成模型中取得了具有竞争力的规划性能，消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。代码将予以发布。
tldr: NativeDrive introduces a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework that unifies understanding and generation, with a dense supervision task (Driving Semantic Editing) for planning and competitive results on NAVSIM v1 and v2.
tldr_zh: NativeDrive 提出了一种原生无编码器多模态驾驶框架，统一了理解与生成，并通过密集监督任务（驾驶语义编辑）提升规划性能，在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 上取得了有竞争力的结果。

title: GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation requires predicting how robot-object interactions evolve over time, encompassing both visual appearance and scene geometry. In multi-camera settings, such predictions need to capture the evolving 3D scene consistently across viewpoints, while supporting controllable generation under different robot actions and camera configurations. Existing video generation models provide strong priors for visual appearance and motion but typically lack explicit geometric modeling. Meanwhile, recent advances in geometry-aware and multi-view generation have explored joint appearance-geometry modeling and cross-view consistency, yet generating temporally coherent appearance and geometry across multiple viewpoints under robotic manipulation conditions remains challenging. In this work, we propose GeoMVGen, a framework for joint multi-view RGB and pointmap video generation in robotic manipulation. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework employs modality-specific adaptation modules to capture the distinct characteristics of appearance and geometry, while using cross-modal residual connections to facilitate information exchange between the two modalities. To establish geometric correspondences across viewpoints, we further introduce a cross-view projection mechanism with complementary geometric supervisions, combining pointmap consistency with geometry foundation model-guided feature alignment. These designs enable controllable generation of temporally evolving multi-view observations with coherent appearance and geometrically consistent scene structures. Extensive experiments on 4D video generation dataset comprising simulated and real-world robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate that GeoMVGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in video quality, geometric accuracy, and cross-view consistency.
summary_zh: 机器人操纵需要对机器人与物体之间的交互随时间的演变进行预测，涵盖视觉外观和场景几何结构两个方面。在多摄像头设置中，此类预测需要从不同视角一致地捕捉动态演化的三维场景，同时支持在不同机器人动作和摄像头配置下进行可控生成。现有的视频生成模型为视觉外观和运动提供了强大的先验知识，但通常缺乏显式的几何建模。与此同时，几何感知和多视角生成领域的最新进展探索了外观与几何的联合建模以及跨视角一致性，但在机器人操纵条件下生成跨多个视角、时间上连贯的外观和几何结构仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了GeoMVGen，一个用于机器人操纵中多视角RGB和点图视频联合生成的框架。该框架基于视频扩散Transformer，采用模态特定的适配模块来捕捉外观和几何的不同特征，同时利用跨模态残差连接促进两种模态之间的信息交换。为了建立跨视角的几何对应关系，我们进一步引入了一种带互补几何监督的跨视角投影机制，将点图一致性与几何基础模型引导的特征对齐相结合。这些设计使得能够可控地生成时间上动态演化的多视角观测，同时具备连贯的外观和几何一致的场景结构。在包含仿真和真实机器人操纵场景的4D视频生成数据集上进行的大量实验表明，GeoMVGen在视频质量、几何精度和跨视角一致性方面均优于现有最先进方法。
tldr: GeoMVGen is a framework that jointly generates multi-view RGB videos and pointmap videos for robotic manipulation, using a video diffusion transformer with cross-modal and cross-view consistency mechanisms to improve visual quality, geometric accuracy, and viewpoint coherence.
tldr_zh: GeoMVGen 是一个面向机器人操作的多视角RGB视频和点图视频联合生成框架，通过视频扩散变压器及跨模态/跨视角一致性机制，提升了视频质量、几何精度和视角一致性。

title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测行动结果来实现目标导向的规划。基于梯度的规划器通过优化行动以降低预测的目标代价，但持续优化可能会在执行不再改善后利用预测误差。比较不同的规划方案需要具有信息量的相对得分；改进这些得分同样需要可靠的更新方向。精确状态执行表明，即使冻结的层次化世界模型在长时间梯度搜索输出的排序中缺乏信息量，它仍能对目标条件下的候选方案进行排序。有效的规划将目标导向的候选方案与能够区分其结果的预测相结合。我们提出了CriticJEPA，该方法从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件下的流式候选方案，并在每个层次级别使用冻结的展开结果进行筛选。前向选择构成完整的规划器；短时锚定更新在筛选前对候选方案进行细化。在视觉导航和操作任务中，CriticJEPA以极低的规划计算成本提升了成功率，并在独立训练的模型、不同层次深度及未见任务间迁移共享设置，同时保持所有世界模型权重固定不变。
tldr: CriticJEPA proposes a hierarchical world-model-based planner that uses frozen rollouts to select among goal-conditioned flow proposals, achieving higher success rates at lower compute for visual navigation and manipulation without updating world-model weights.
tldr_zh: CriticJEPA 提出了一种基于分层世界模型的规划器，通过冻结的 rollout 在目标条件流提议中进行选择，在视觉导航和操作任务中以更低的计算成本取得更高成功率，且无需更新世界模型权重。

title: ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models
summary:
Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. We resolve this tension with \textbf{ReJEPA}, a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, instantiated simply via the element-wise $\log\cosh$ loss.
  As a drop-in training replacement across Temporal Straightening, LeWorldModel, and V-JEPA~2.1, $\log\cosh$ consistently outperforms $L_2$, a curvature-matched quadratic control, $L_1$, and Smooth-$L_1$ baselines without altering architectures or inference procedures. Notably, the gains grow with environmental complexity, scaling from simple navigation to contact-rich manipulation and real-world autonomous driving on NAVSIM. Probing and geometric analyses confirm that relaxing the penalty on extreme errors yields representations that better capture physical states and align with the true planning cost landscape.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过在抽象嵌入空间中预测未来状态而非重构原始像素来学习表征。然而，在多帧序列训练过程中，并非所有帧和空间区域都具有同等的信息量或可预测性。我们认为，强制世界模型最小化每一个预测误差可能既无必要又有害。在标准$L_2$损失下，无界梯度迫使编码器和预测器过度拟合噪声帧或瞬态帧，从而牺牲核心物理结构，同时放大与表征正则化器之间的梯度冲突。相反，$L_1$损失虽能限制大梯度，但其在零附近的恒定梯度幅度破坏了规划所需的局部平滑性。我们通过提出\textbf{ReJEPA}——一种有界预测正则化原则——来解决这一矛盾，该原则对大误差提供有界梯度，同时在零附近保持平滑的二次行为，其实现方式仅为逐元素的$\log\cosh$损失。作为时间拉直、LeWorldModel和V-JEPA~2.1中的即插即用训练替代方案，$\log\cosh$在架构和推理流程不变的情况下，持续优于$L_2$、曲率匹配的二次控制、$L_1$以及Smooth-$L_1$基线。值得注意的是，性能提升随环境复杂度增加而增大，从简单导航扩展到接触丰富的操作任务以及NAVSIM上的真实世界自动驾驶。探测与几何分析证实，放宽对极端误差的惩罚能够产生更准确地捕捉物理状态、并与真实规划代价景观对齐的表征。
tldr: ReJEPA proposes a bounded predictive regulation principle using log-cosh loss for latent world models, improving representation learning and planning performance across navigation, manipulation, and autonomous driving tasks.
tldr_zh: ReJEPA 提出了基于 log-cosh 损失的有界预测调节原理，用于潜在世界模型，在导航、操作和自动驾驶任务中提升了表征学习和规划性能。

title: From Safety-Driven Redundancy to Value-Driven Architecture: An ODD-Based Rationalization Framework for Level 4 Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Level 4 autonomous vehicles require fault-tolerant architectures that preserve critical driving functions under sensing, computing, communication, power, and actuation failures. As these systems progress toward industrial scalability, architectural complexity, validation burden, integration effort, and lifecycle cost become increasingly relevant. This study proposes an Operational Design Domain (ODD)-based, safety-constrained systems-engineering framework for architecture rationalization. ODD-specific capabilities, physical fault assumptions, post-fault operational policies, and spatial sensing requirements are propagated through an integrated safety-feasibility gate. Architecture transformations, including removal, relocation, functional reassignment, and consolidation, are evaluated only within the resulting safety-feasible design space, followed by lifecycle-cost sensitivity and robust multiobjective Pareto analysis. A generic, synthetically parameterized Level 4 architecture is used as a demonstrative computational case study. Within this modeled design space, direct ablation showed limited rationalization potential, whereas directional redistribution and functional consolidation generated a broader set of safety-feasible candidates. Under the illustrative lifecycle-cost model, the best nominal candidate achieved a 5.55% normalized cost reduction and remained cost-reducing across all 5,000 sampled points in the prescribed uncertainty domain. The analysis identified 15 non-dominated architecture-policy solutions representing seven physical transformations. The results support capability-based, policy-conditioned, and lifecycle-aware architecture rationalization under the stated assumptions, with safety retained as a non-compensatory feasibility constraint. The reported transformations are design candidates rather than validated production architectures.
summary_zh: 四级自动驾驶车辆要求采用容错架构，以在传感、计算、通信、动力和执行器故障情况下维持关键驾驶功能。随着这些系统迈向工业化规模应用，架构复杂性、验证负担、集成工作量及生命周期成本变得日益重要。本研究提出一种基于运行设计域（ODD）且受安全约束的系统工程框架，用于架构合理化。ODD特定能力、物理故障假设、故障后运行策略及空间感知需求通过集成的安全可行性门限进行传播。架构变换，包括移除、重新定位、功能重新分配和整合，仅在由此产生的安全可行设计空间内进行评估，随后进行生命周期成本敏感性分析和鲁棒多目标帕累托分析。本研究采用一个通用的、综合参数化的四级自动驾驶架构作为示范性计算案例。在该建模设计空间内，直接消融分析显示合理化潜力有限，而定向重新分配和功能整合则产生了更广泛的安全可行候选方案。在示例性生命周期成本模型下，最优标称候选方案实现了5.55%的归一化成本降低，并且在指定不确定性域内的全部5，000个采样点上均保持成本降低效果。分析识别出15个非支配的架构-策略解决方案，涵盖七种物理变换。研究结果支持在所述假设条件下，基于能力、策略条件约束及生命周期感知的架构合理化，同时将安全性作为不可补偿的可行性约束予以保留。所报告的变换属于设计候选方案，而非经过验证的量产架构。
tldr: This paper introduces an ODD-based systems-engineering framework for rationalizing Level 4 autonomous vehicle architectures, balancing safety constraints with lifecycle cost through multiobjective Pareto analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于ODD的系统工程框架，用于L4级自动驾驶架构合理化，在安全约束下通过多目标帕累托分析平衡生命周期成本。

title: Self-Sensing Compliant Anthropomorphic Hand for Speed-Dictated Shared Force Control in Teleoperation
summary: In vision-based teleoperation of robotic hands, the operator receives no haptic feedback and therefore struggles to regulate the grasp force, while adding tactile sensors to the fingers increases wiring, cost and integration complexity. Compliant hands offer an alternative, as their mechanical compliance, usually treated only as a passive property for safe and adaptive grasping, can also serve as a source of information. Here, we show that the elastic transmission of a compliant, tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand can itself act as the sensor for shared-control telemanipulation. Series springs in the tendon routing are read by potentiometers in a forearm-mounted motor box, from which the hand estimates its joint states and finger forces without any external sensors. Building on this self-sensing, we develop a contact-aware shared-control framework for VR-based teleoperation. The robot hand is controlled through a mapping from the operator's hand kinematics until a contact is detected proprioceptively. Control then switches to a finger-level force controller whose set point is determined by the operator's grasping speed, and control authority can be allocated to individual fingers. Experiments validate the system's force estimation and increased grasp success rate compared with direct teleoperation for fragile and heavy objects. These results show that compliance can serve not only for passive adaptation but also as an intrinsic sensing resource for physical human-robot collaboration.
summary_zh: 在基于视觉的机器人手部遥操作过程中，操作者无法获得触觉反馈，因此难以调节抓取力，而将触觉传感器集成至手指则会增加布线复杂度、成本及集成难度。柔顺手提供了一种替代方案，其机械柔顺性通常仅被视为实现安全自适应抓取的被动属性，但亦可作为信息源加以利用。本文表明，一种柔顺的、腱驱动拟人手的弹性传动机构本身即可充当共享控制遥操作的传感器。腱绳路径中的串联弹簧由安装在前臂的电机箱内的电位器读取，机器手无需任何外部传感器即可据此估计其关节状态及手指力。在此基础上，我们开发了一种基于自感知的接触感知共享控制框架，用于基于虚拟现实的遥操作。在手部运动学映射的控制下，机器人手持续运动，直至通过本体感知检测到接触；随后控制切换至手指级力控制器，其设定值由操作者的抓取速度决定，且控制权可分配至各个手指。实验验证了该系统在力和抓取成功率方面的性能，与直接遥操作相比，在抓取易碎和重物时成功率显著提高。这些结果表明，柔顺性不仅可用于被动适应，还可作为物理人机协作中的内在感知资源。
tldr: This paper presents a self-sensing compliant anthropomorphic hand that uses its elastic tendon transmission as proprioceptive sensors for force estimation, enabling a shared force control framework in VR teleoperation that improves grasping success for fragile and heavy objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种自感知柔顺拟人手，利用其弹性腱传动作为本体感觉传感器进行力估计，并在VR遥操作中实现共享力控制框架，提高了对易碎和重物的抓取成功率。

title: MRBench: Benchmarking Physical Necessity Reasoning in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in multi-robot manipulation have shown how robots can collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, successful coordination does not reveal which robots are actually needed. The same task may require different teams as robot capabilities change, resources become unavailable, or objects replace robotic support. We argue that reliable multi-robot manipulation requires physical necessity reasoning: understanding what a task demands, which resources can fulfill those demands, and which are truly necessary. We introduce MRBench, a benchmark for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation. It comprises eight tasks with distinct concurrency and reach constraints, each evaluated under five configurations that change the required resources while preserving the task goal. Our evaluation reveals that existing coordination agents perform well with reference teams but struggle when robot embodiments change or passive objects can replace robotic support. To address this gap, we propose MRScissors, which separates task requirements from measured physical capabilities and identifies minimal feasible teams through constrained search. Across two model backbones, MRScissors achieves 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 9.5 points, respectively. Together, these findings expose a critical gap between coordinating robots and understanding their physical necessity.
summary_zh: 近年来，多机器人操控领域的进展表明，机器人能够协作完成复杂任务。然而，成功的协调并不能揭示哪些机器人实际上是必需的。随着机器人能力的变化、资源变得不可用，或物体取代了机器人支撑，同一任务可能需要不同的团队组合。我们认为，可靠的多机器人操控需要物理必要性推理：理解任务要求什么、哪些资源能够满足这些要求，以及哪些资源是真正必需的。为此，我们提出了MRBench，一个用于异构多机器人操控中物理必要性推理的基准测试平台。该基准包含八项具有不同并发性和可达性约束的任务，每项任务在五种配置下进行评估，这些配置在保持任务目标不变的前提下改变所需资源。我们的评估显示，现有的协调智能体在参考团队下表现良好，但当机器人形态发生变化或被动物体能够取代机器人支撑时，它们则难以应对。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了MRScissors方法，它将任务要求与实测物理能力分离，并通过约束搜索识别最小可行团队。在两个模型骨干网络上，MRScissors的团队选择准确率分别达到85.4%和91.2%，超出最强基线10.4和9.5个百分点。综上，这些发现揭示了协调机器人与理解其物理必要性之间的关键差距。
tldr: MRBench introduces a benchmark and method (MRScissors) for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation, showing that existing coordination agents fail when required resources change, while MRScissors improves team-selection accuracy.
tldr_zh: MRBench 提出了一个异构多机器人操作中的物理必要性推理基准和方法 MRScissors，表明现有协调代理在所需资源变化时表现不佳，而 MRScissors 提高了团队选择准确率。

title: Keypose or Dense? A Controlled Comparison of Action Representations for Stage-Structured Manipulation
summary: Most imitation policies that predict chunks of future actions use the dense action representation, in which the chunk holds one control target per step. In stage-structured manipulation, where a task can be divided into stages with definable endpoints, the keypose action representation instead sets each step of the chunk to the endpoint of the stage that step belongs to, and a speed-capped servo supplies the motion. We compare the two in several simulated manipulation tasks and on a real robot, with the same chunk length and matched demonstrations, observations, policy architectures and update budgets; in simulation, each one's execution rule is selected on tuning scenes. When the simulated demonstrations are slowed, paused and rerouted, dense success falls sharply while keypose stays roughly level, across three policy architectures and with endpoints extracted from the recorded demonstrations; keypose also leads under object-size and position shift. With clean demonstrations, keypose leads only when they are scarce and is otherwise close to or behind dense across the simulated tasks, provided that the demonstrations and execution rule suit its executor; when they do not, it falls far below dense. The same dependence on the executor appeared on a real robot learning to open a drawer from human demonstrations: dense succeeded more often, and keypose improved substantially only after its executor's rotation and forward speed were adjusted to the demonstrations. These results suggest that keypose trades sensitivity to such variation in the demonstrations for sensitivity to execution that departs from them.
summary_zh: 大多数预测未来动作片段的模仿策略采用密集动作表示，其中每个时间步的片段包含一个控制目标。在阶段结构化操作中，任务可以被划分为具有可定义端点的阶段，关键姿态动作表示则将片段的每一步设置为该步所属阶段的端点，并由限速伺服提供运动。我们在多个模拟操作任务和真实机器人上进行了比较，使用相同的片段长度和匹配的演示、观测、策略架构以及更新预算；在模拟中，每种执行规则都在调优场景中进行选择。当模拟演示被减速、暂停和重新规划路径时，密集策略的成功率急剧下降，而关键姿态策略在三种策略架构下保持大致稳定，且端点从记录的演示中提取；关键姿态在物体尺寸和位置偏移下也表现更优。在清晰演示条件下，关键姿态仅在演示样本稀缺时领先，在其他模拟任务中则接近或落后于密集策略，前提是演示和执行规则适合其执行器；若不匹配，则其表现远低于密集策略。在真实机器人从人类演示学习打开抽屉的任务中，也出现了对执行器的类似依赖：密集策略成功频率更高，而关键姿态仅在其执行器的旋转速度和前向速度调整到与演示匹配后才显著提升。这些结果表明，关键姿态将对演示中此类变化的敏感性转化为对偏离演示的执行行为的敏感性。
tldr: This paper compares keypose and dense action representations for stage-structured manipulation, showing that keypose is more robust to demonstration variations but depends on executor settings, while dense excels with clean demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了阶段化操作中的关键姿态和密集动作表示，发现关键姿态对演示变化更鲁棒，但依赖执行器设置，而密集在干净演示下表现更好。

title: LaWanle: Why Can't Leading Driving Models Make a Simple Turn?
summary: We were surprised to find that leading end-to-end driving models across major paradigms, despite scoring close to human drivers on NAVSIM, cannot reliably make a simple 90-degree turn in photorealistic closed-loop simulators. To investigate why, we build LaWanle, a benchmark of turns drawn from three such simulators. Driving each turn from several starts, we find that the same model passes it from one start and fails it from another, and that the two drives look alike until they enter the junction. Rotating the car by a few degrees at the junction entry can fail a turn it otherwise passes. Conversely, a slight heading correction to the plans can rescue about half of the failed turns we tested. Such errors arise when a model drives by itself, so we post-train an open-source lane-keeping model with closed-loop DAgger on its lateral path. Training 5% of its parameters is enough to raise its turn pass rate from 19% to 76%. The gain transfers to the two other benchmarks, where the policy also scores among the leading models. Further fine-tuning on recovery data repairs the deviations it is trained on but, against a control trained equally long, improves turns on none of the three benchmarks, and every variant stays far below a human driver.
summary_zh: 我们惊讶地发现，在NAVSIM上得分接近人类驾驶员的主流端到端驾驶模型，在照片级逼真的闭环模拟器中，却无法可靠地完成一个简单的90度转弯。为探究其原因，我们构建了LaWanle基准测试，其中包含来自三个此类模拟器的转弯场景。从多个起点分别驾驶每个转弯场景，我们发现同一模型从某个起点能够通过，而从另一起点却会失败，且两次驾驶在进入交叉口前的轨迹几乎相同。在交叉口入口处将车辆旋转几度，就可能导致原本可以通过的转弯失败。相反，对规划路径进行轻微的航向修正，则能挽救我们所测试的约一半失败转弯。这类错误在模型自主驾驶时出现，因此我们使用闭环DAgger算法对开源车道保持模型进行横向路径的后训练。仅训练其5%的参数，即可将转弯通过率从19%提升至76%。这一提升可迁移至另外两个基准测试，该策略的得分也位列领先模型之中。进一步在恢复数据上进行微调，能够修复训练中遇到的偏差，但与经过同等时长训练的对照组相比，在三个基准测试的转弯表现均无提升，且所有变体的表现仍远低于人类驾驶员。
tldr: This paper introduces LaWanle, a benchmark of turns in photorealistic closed-loop driving simulators, revealing that leading end-to-end driving models fail simple 90-degree turns due to heading sensitivity, and shows that closed-loop DAgger fine-tuning of a small fraction of model parameters can significantly improve turn pass rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LaWanle基准，用于在逼真闭环驾驶模拟器中测试转弯能力，发现主流端到端驾驶模型因对航向敏感而无法完成简单的90度转弯，并展示了通过闭环DAgger微调少量模型参数可显著提高转弯成功率。

title: RoboRecast: Intent-Preserving Demonstration Augmentation via Diagnosis-Driven Optimization
summary: Collecting diverse real-world manipulation demonstrations is costly, motivating the use of simulation to augment existing demonstrations for robot policy learning. When objects, layouts, or robots change, transferring motions from a source demonstration can produce behavior that is semantically implausible or physically infeasible in the new setting. We introduce RoboRecast, an agentic optimization framework that preserves the interactions required by the source task while jointly optimizing the simulated scene and robot motion to make those interactions executable in the target setting. When an interaction fails, the agent uses simulation feedback to diagnose the cause, revise the relevant scene or motion parameters, and test whether the revision resolves the failure. This flexibility allows RoboRecast to generate synthetic data from both human and robot demonstrations and to adapt them to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments. When target demonstrations are available, adding RoboRecast data improves policy success on both real-world single-arm and simulated bimanual tasks. Even without demonstrations in the target configuration, RoboRecast adapts source demonstrations to support policy learning with new objects or robot embodiments.
summary_zh: 收集多样化的真实世界操作演示成本高昂，这促使人们利用仿真来扩充现有演示数据，以支持机器人策略学习。当物体、布局或机器人发生变化时，从源演示中迁移运动可能会在新环境中产生语义上不合理或物理上不可行的行为。我们提出RoboRecast，一个智能体优化框架，它在保留源任务所需交互的同时，联合优化仿真场景和机器人运动，使这些交互在目标环境中可执行。当交互失败时，智能体利用仿真反馈诊断失败原因，修改相关场景或运动参数，并测试修改是否解决了问题。这种灵活性使RoboRecast能够从人类和机器人演示中生成合成数据，并将其适应于新的布局、物体和机器人本体。当目标演示可用时，加入RoboRecast数据能够提高真实世界单臂任务和仿真双臂任务中的策略成功率。即使在目标配置中没有演示数据，RoboRecast也能适应源演示，以支持新物体或新机器人本体下的策略学习。
tldr: RoboRecast is an agentic optimization framework that augments robot manipulation demonstrations by jointly optimizing simulated scenes and motions to preserve task intent when transferring to new layouts, objects, or embodiments, improving policy learning in both single-arm real-world and simulated bimanual tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboRecast 是一个智能体优化框架，通过联合优化模拟场景和运动，在将操作演示迁移到新布局、物体或机器人时保留任务意图，从而增强策略学习，在真实单臂和模拟双臂任务上均提升了成功率。

title: An XR-Based System for Enhanced Spatial Awareness in Mobile Robot Teleoperation
summary: Teleoperation of mobile robots represents a critical capability for operations in hazardous environments, yet maintaining adequate situational awareness remains challenging without effective visualization and control interfaces. This work presents a multi-modal extended reality (XR) system for robot teleoperation and scene exploration that integrates immersive visual and haptic feedback modalities. To address motion sickness commonly induced by 360-degree camera feeds in head-mounted displays (HMDs), the system employs a fixed dual-camera configuration: a forward-facing camera for primary navigation and a rear-facing camera for enhanced situational awareness without operator discomfort. For navigation in confined or low-visibility conditions, a 16-channel Velodyne LiDAR generates real-time 2D occupancy grid maps, which are converted into vibrational haptic feedback on handheld controllers to provide intuitive, non-visual obstacle detection. User evaluation with 20 participants demonstrates that this haptic modality significantly reduces the cognitive load associated with obstacle avoidance during teleoperation.
summary_zh: 移动机器人遥操作在危险环境作业中具有关键能力，然而，若缺乏有效的可视化与控制界面，维持充分的态势感知仍具挑战性。本研究提出一种用于机器人遥操作与场景探索的多模态扩展现实（XR）系统，该系统集成了沉浸式视觉与触觉反馈模态。为缓解头戴式显示器（HMDs）中360度摄像头画面常引发的晕动症，系统采用固定双摄像头配置：前置摄像头用于主要导航，后置摄像头用于增强态势感知，同时避免操作者不适。针对狭窄或低能见度环境下的导航需求，16通道Velodyne LiDAR实时生成二维占据栅格地图，并将其转换为手持控制器上的振动触觉反馈，以提供直观的非视觉障碍物检测。基于20名参与者的用户评估表明，该触觉模态显著降低了遥操作过程中与避障相关的认知负荷。
tldr: This paper presents an XR-based teleoperation system for mobile robots that uses a fixed dual-camera setup and LiDAR-generated haptic feedback to improve spatial awareness and reduce cognitive load during obstacle avoidance, as demonstrated in a user study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于XR的移动机器人遥操作系统，采用固定双摄像头和激光雷达生成的触觉反馈，以增强空间感知并降低避障时的认知负荷，用户研究验证了其有效性。

title: Design, Control, and Teleoperation of a Dexterous Robotic Hand with Soft-Rigid Hybrid Fingers
summary:
Adding compliance to robot hands results in higher grasp quality and robust contact with the environment. Soft hands are inherently compliant, but are typically more complex to control and model than rigid equivalents.
  We extend prior work on soft-rigid hybrid robot fingers into a five-fingered dexterous gripper --- an integrated tendon-driven hand that is highly compliant and controllable. Structural compliance combined with a rigid skeleton, when realized in a five-fingered hand, allow us to use linear control to achieve soft-grasping generality. We evaluate the use of this hand in a variety of teleoperated manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of the overall mechanical design and control strategy. Our contributions include: (1) Mechanical design of the a five-fingered Soft-Rigid Hybrid Hand, composed of 12 active degrees of freedom, demonstrating a high degree on generalization enabled by the soft-rigid architecture, with our gripper, able to complete 28 of the 33 (84.8\%) grasp postures in the human range. (2) Precise, high bandwidth (up to 1432deg/s extension speed, compared with 700deg/s for the equivalent human joint). (3) Position and task space controllers for the soft-rigid hybrid finger and whole hand. (4) A teleoperation framework for control of this hand, as well as demonstrations of its efficacy in a variety of grasping and manipulation tasks
  Further tests illustrate the hand's advantages in completing non-rigid manipulation tasks, such as picking up thin deformable objects (such as a dollar bill or folding cloth) as well as in interfacing with soft or delicate targets.
summary_zh: 增加机器人手的柔性可以实现更高的抓取质量和与环境鲁棒接触。软手本质上是柔顺的，但通常比刚性手更难以控制与建模。本文将先前关于软-刚混合机器人手指的研究扩展为五指灵巧夹爪——一种集成腱驱动的高度柔顺且可控的手。结构柔性与刚性骨架相结合，在五指手中得以实现，使我们能够使用线性控制来实现软抓取的普适性。我们评估了该手在多种遥操作操控任务中的表现，验证了整体机械设计与控制策略的有效性。我们的贡献包括：（1）设计了一种包含12个主动自由度的五指软-刚混合手，展示了软-刚结构带来的高度泛化能力，该夹爪能够完成人类33种抓取姿态中的28种（84.8%）。（2）实现高带宽的精确运动（伸展速度高达1432度/秒，而对应人类关节为700度/秒）。（3）提出了针对软-刚混合手指及整手的位置控制器和任务空间控制器。（4）建立了一套用于操控该手的遥操作框架，并展示了其在多种抓取与操控任务中的效能。进一步测试表明，该手在完成非刚性操控任务中具有优势，例如拾取薄形可变形物体（如纸币或折叠布料），以及在与柔软或易碎目标交互方面表现突出。
tldr: This paper presents a five-fingered dexterous robotic hand with soft-rigid hybrid fingers, demonstrating high compliance, fast speed, and effective teleoperated manipulation in various tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种具有软硬混合手指的五指灵巧机器人手，展示了高柔顺性、高速度以及在多种遥操作任务中的有效性。

title: Follow-Bench 2.0: An End-to-End 3D Benchmark for Socially-Aware Robot Person Following
summary: Socially-aware robot person following (RPF) requires a mobile robot to follow a designated person in dynamic human environments while maintaining target identity, avoiding obstacles and pedestrians, and preserving socially comfortable formations. Existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this coupled problem: embodied visual tracking benchmarks emphasize target visibility with limited social interaction, person re-identification benchmarks study perception without closed-loop control, and motion-planning benchmarks often assume ground-truth target and pedestrian states. We introduce Follow-Bench 2.0, an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware RPF under coupled perception--planning challenges. Built in Unreal Engine, Follow-Bench 2.0 provides difficulty-leveled scenarios with diverse pedestrian flows, lighting and weather conditions, cluttered layouts, bottlenecks, queueing behaviors, distractors, and temporary target occlusions. The benchmark supports modular perception--planning pipelines, end-to-end visual policies, and foundation-model-based active trackers under a unified closed-loop protocol. It further evaluates both back- and side-following configurations and reports safety--comfort metrics covering task success, target visibility, target recovery, social-space intrusion, following formation, and motion smoothness. Experiments show that RPF-oriented modular pipelines substantially outperform current end-to-end visual policies on close and socially comfortable following, but also reveal that socially-aware RPF remains far from solved in interaction-heavy environments and especially in side-following. Follow-Bench 2.0 therefore provides a diagnostic platform for studying how perception errors, occlusions, crowd interactions, and following configurations jointly affect robot person following.
summary_zh: 社交感知型机器人跟随（RPF）要求移动机器人在动态人类环境中跟随指定人员，同时保持目标身份、避开障碍物和行人，并维持符合社交礼仪的编队姿态。现有基准测试仅部分评估了这一耦合问题：具身视觉跟踪基准侧重于目标可见性且社交交互有限，行人重识别基准研究感知但缺乏闭环控制，运动规划基准则通常假设目标和行人的状态为真值已知。我们提出了Follow-Bench 2.0，一个端到端的3D基准测试平台，用于在感知-规划耦合挑战下评估社交感知型机器人跟随。该基准基于虚幻引擎构建，提供难度分级场景，涵盖多样化人流、光照与天气条件、杂乱布局、瓶颈区域、排队行为、干扰物以及目标临时遮挡等情况。该基准支持模块化感知-规划流水线、端到端视觉策略以及基于基础模型的主动跟踪器，并采用统一的闭环协议。进一步地，它同时评估后方跟随和侧方跟随两种配置，并报告涵盖任务成功率、目标可见性、目标恢复、社交空间侵入、跟随编队和运动平滑性在内的安全-舒适度指标。实验表明，面向RPF的模块化流水线在近距离和社交舒适的跟随任务上显著优于当前的端到端视觉策略，但同时也揭示出社交感知型RPF在交互密集环境中，尤其是侧方跟随场景下，仍远未得到充分解决。因此，Follow-Bench 2.0为研究感知误差、遮挡、人群交互和跟随配置如何共同影响机器人人员跟随提供了诊断平台。
tldr: Follow-Bench 2.0 is an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware robot person following, providing difficulty-leveled scenarios and unified metrics to assess perception-planning coupling and social compliance.
tldr_zh: Follow-Bench 2.0 是一个端到端 3D 基准，用于评估具有社会意识的机器人跟随任务，提供难度分级场景和统一指标以评估感知-规划耦合及社交合规性。

title: EmbodiedStudio: A Task-Driven Simulation Generation Platform for Embodied Learning and Evaluation
summary: Training and evaluating robots across diverse tasks requires a supply of simulation environments suited to those tasks. While recent scene and task generators offer a promising way to expand this supply, delivering a usable task environment still faces two practical gaps: generated scenes that look plausible in appearance often fail to support the intended task interactions or remain physically stable in simulation, and generated scoring programs frequently attempt task conditions without implementing them faithfully. We present EmbodiedStudio, a task-driven simulation generation platform that bridges these gaps by jointly authoring scene, task, robot-behavior, and rubric programs under closed-loop simulation feedback and independent review. Crucially, as the coding agent iteratively debugs scenes, behaviors, and stateful rubrics in simulation, this closed-loop process natively yields both forward construction experience for learning to build environments and physical execution experience for policy learning, all bound to frozen environment revisions for repeatable evaluation. Across scene generation, rubric evaluation, ablations, and learning studies, EmbodiedStudio substantially improves task readiness and rubric faithfulness while improving physical stability and retaining actionable supervision signals for layout authoring and policy adaptation.
summary_zh: 训练和评估机器人完成多样化任务，需要提供与这些任务相适应的仿真环境。尽管近期的场景生成器和任务生成器为扩充这一供给提供了有前景的途径，但交付可用的任务环境仍面临两个实际缺口：生成的场景在外观上看似合理，却往往无法支持预期的任务交互，或在仿真中难以保持物理稳定性；同时，生成的评分程序常常尝试设定任务条件，却未能忠实地实现这些条件。我们提出了EmbodiedStudio，一个任务驱动的仿真生成平台，通过在闭环仿真反馈和独立审查下联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为和评分规则程序，弥合了上述缺口。关键在于，随着编码代理在仿真中迭代调试场景、行为和带有状态的评分规则，这一闭环过程天然地同时生成了用于学习构建环境的前向构建经验，以及用于策略学习的物理执行经验，且所有经验均绑定到固定的环境修订版本上，以确保可重复的评估。在场景生成、评分规则评估、消融实验和学习研究中，EmbodiedStudio显著提升了任务就绪度和评分规则的忠实度，同时改善了物理稳定性，并为布局编写和策略适应保留了可操作的监督信号。
tldr: EmbodiedStudio jointly authors scenes, tasks, robot behaviors, and rubrics under closed-loop simulation feedback, yielding physically stable and task-ready embodied simulation environments with faithful evaluation programs.
tldr_zh: EmbodiedStudio 在闭环仿真反馈下联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为和评分程序，生成物理稳定且任务就绪的具身仿真环境，并确保评估程序忠实可靠。

title: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
summary: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.
summary_zh: 视觉-惯性-腿部（VIL）状态估计为腿式机器人提供了经济高效的自定位方案，仅需在机载惯性测量单元和关节编码器的基础上增加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿部里程计受限于其监督方式：在仿真中训练的网络面临仿真到现实差距的问题，而真实世界标签则要么需要昂贵的传感器，要么继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AirLeg，一个自监督的VIL同步定位与建图（SLAM）系统，在该系统中视觉与腿部本体感觉从训练到部署阶段相互提升。我们在仿真中预训练腿部里程计网络，并通过命令式学习在无真值情况下使其适应机器人，其中多传感器束调整利用腿部里程计优化视觉地图，而优化后的视觉地图反过来监督网络训练。在部署阶段，融合估计结果在线自适应调整网络。为提升定位精度及上述监督效果，我们设计了一个双窗口估计器，融合视觉、惯性测量单元和腿部里程计，通过变形感知约束将支撑脚与视觉重建地形相关联，并利用方差分量估计对各约束进行加权。AirLeg完成了全部17条GrandTour序列，在19种方法中取得了最低的平均误差（0.19米）。在一台低成本四足机器人上，仅使用0.5小时无标注数据，在嵌入式计算机上实时运行时，实现了最低漂移率（0.6%）。
tldr: AirLeg presents a self-supervised visual-inertial-leg SLAM system for legged robots, where vision and leg proprioception mutually improve each other through imperative learning, achieving robust and accurate localization without ground truth.
tldr_zh: AirLeg 提出了一种用于腿式机器人的自监督视觉-惯性-腿 SLAM 系统，通过命令学习使视觉和腿部本体感觉相互改进，在无真值的情况下实现鲁棒且准确的定位。

title: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
summary: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
summary_zh: 异构移动机械臂协同运输重载有效载荷需要在载荷运动、力分布和柔顺物理交互方面实现协调。本文提出MRCT，一种面向物体的两层级多机器人运输控制架构。在物体层级，模型预测控制器生成载荷的协调接触力参考。在机器人层级，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪与阻抗力矩融合来实现该参考。该融合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，并在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪性能下降时增加柔顺性。仿真与硬件实验采用包含单臂和双臂移动机械臂的异构团队运输近额定载重的桌面载荷，结果表明该系统实现了精确的物体跟踪、受控的接触力以及稳定的载荷姿态。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步验证了MRCT在所评估条件下实现可靠协同运输的有效性。
tldr: MRCT introduces an object-centric two-layer control architecture combining MPC at the object level with whole-body impedance control at the robot level for cooperative heavy-payload transportation by heterogeneous mobile manipulators, validated in simulations and hardware.
tldr_zh: MRCT提出了一种以物体为中心的两层控制架构，将物体层的模型预测控制与机器人层的全身阻抗控制相结合，用于异构移动机械臂协同搬运重型载荷，并在仿真和硬件上得到验证。

title: CoFiNav: VLM-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Semantic Navigation for Open-Ended Last-Mile UAV Delivery
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) delivery is an important application of the low-altitude economy, enhancing the flexibility and accessibility of last-mile logistics. Existing UAV delivery methods generally rely on precise terminal coordinates, predefined terminal specifications, or task-specific localization procedures, limiting the scope and flexibility of delivery. As UAV logistics becomes more intelligent, open-ended semantic descriptions offer a new paradigm for specifying terminal destinations. However, conventional aerial navigation methods have limited ability to generalize to delivery scenarios that require open-vocabulary terminal navigation. To enable this broader delivery paradigm, we propose CoFiNav, a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine UAV semantic navigation framework that progressively grounds relation-defined terminal destinations through hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation. Given a task description, a coarse prior map from OpenStreetMap (OSM), and accumulated observations, CoFiNav uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine which unresolved entity or spatial relation should be verified next. A geometry-aware module converts the semantic observation request into feasible viewpoints using RGB images and LiDAR, while conventional motion planning handles safe execution. Experiments across multiple urban environments show that CoFiNav outperforms representative adapted baselines in success rate while requiring shorter flight paths and fewer observations.
summary_zh: 无人机配送是低空经济的重要应用，能够提升末端物流的灵活性与可达性。现有无人机配送方法通常依赖精确的目标坐标、预设的着陆点规格或针对特定任务的位置识别流程，这限制了配送的范围和灵活性。随着无人机物流日益智能化，开放式语义描述为指定配送终点提供了一种新的范式。然而，传统空中导航方法在面对需要开放词汇终点导航的配送场景时，泛化能力有限。为实现这一更广泛的配送范式，我们提出了CoFiNav——一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的无人机由粗到精语义导航框架，通过层次化语义搜索与主动三维观测，逐步定位由关系定义的配送终点。给定任务描述、来自OpenStreetMap（OSM）的粗粒度先验地图以及累积观测信息，CoFiNav利用视觉语言模型判断下一步应验证哪个未解析实体或空间关系。几何感知模块利用RGB图像和LiDAR将语义观测请求转换为可行视角，而传统运动规划负责安全执行。在多个城市环境中的实验表明，CoFiNav在成功率上优于具有代表性的改编基线方法，同时所需飞行路径更短、观测次数更少。
tldr: CoFiNav proposes a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine framework for open-ended semantic UAV delivery navigation, using hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation to ground relation-defined destinations in urban environments. It improves success rate and flight efficiency over adapted baselines.
tldr_zh: CoFiNav 提出了一种由 VLM 引导的由粗到细的无人机语义导航框架，通过层级语义搜索和主动 3D 观测来定位关系定义的终点，在城市场景中提升了成功率与飞行效率。

title: ViTacLab: Physically Consistent Visuo-Tactile Simulation, Benchmarking, and Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but existing visuo-tactile simulators trade physical fidelity for scalability, and benchmarks largely focus on two-finger grippers. We present ViTacLab, a framework comprising ViTacSim, ViTacBench, and ViTacPolicy. ViTacSim uses a tri-modal tactile primitive: a global sparse contact-force lattice, a local dense force array, and tactile images. Anchored to PhysX contact-solver outputs, it corrects normal inconsistency through local stiffness alignment and reconstructs tangential forces under decoupled slip-stick regimes while preserving GPU parallelism. A joint projection preserves the sparse wrench and enforces local friction cones. ViTacBench spans parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems, with tasks ranging from vision-dominant to tactile-dominant regimes. ViTacPolicy aggregates variable numbers of heterogeneous tactile inputs using spatial-pose embeddings and a Transformer, and aligns force-array and tactile-image modalities through a two-stream VQ-VAE with a shared codebook. Controlled Hertzian-reference indentation and real-sensor sliding tests reduce normal and tangential force RMSE from 2.31 and 1.85 N to 0.42 and 0.53 N, respectively. Throughput reaches 2,482.9 tactile-pipeline FPS at 256 parallel environments. Simulation and real-world experiments show gains on several contact-rich tasks, while low absolute success on tactile-dominant tasks highlights the remaining difficulty of purely tactile control.
summary_zh: 触觉感知对于接触密集的机器人操作至关重要，但现有的视觉-触觉模拟器在物理保真度与可扩展性之间难以兼顾，且相关基准测试主要集中在双指夹爪上。我们提出了ViTacLab框架，包含ViTacSim、ViTacBench和ViTacPolicy三个模块。ViTacSim采用三模态触觉基元：全局稀疏接触力晶格、局部密集力阵列以及触觉图像。以PhysX接触求解器输出为锚点，通过局部刚度对齐校正法向不一致性，并在解耦的滑移-粘滞机制下重建切向力，同时保持GPU并行性。联合投影保留了稀疏力旋量并施加局部摩擦锥约束。ViTacBench覆盖平行夹爪、灵巧手和双臂系统，任务范围从视觉主导到触觉主导不等。ViTacPolicy利用空间位姿嵌入和Transformer聚合可变数量的异构触觉输入，并通过共享码本的双流VQ-VAE对齐力阵列与触觉图像模态。受控赫兹参考压痕实验和真实传感器滑动测试将法向和切向力的均方根误差分别从2.31 N和1.85 N降至0.42 N和0.53 N。在256个并行环境中，吞吐量达到每秒2，482.9帧触觉处理流水线。仿真与真实世界实验表明，在多项接触密集任务上均有性能提升，而触觉主导任务上的绝对成功率较低，凸显了纯触觉控制的剩余挑战。
tldr: ViTacLab introduces a physically consistent visuo-tactile simulation framework, benchmark, and policy representation learning method for contact-rich robotic manipulation, improving force accuracy and enabling policy learning across diverse grippers.
tldr_zh: ViTacLab 提出了一个物理一致的视觉-触觉仿真框架、基准测试和策略表征学习方法，用于接触丰富的机器人操作，提高了力精度并支持多种夹爪的策略学习。

title: Motion Chain of Thought: Disentangling Motion Semantics from Visual Appearance for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding action generation. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion chain-of-thought (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, supporting data-efficient real-robot adaptation with reduced demonstration sets.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）旨在构建一个能够理解世界状态演化并指导行动生成的统一架构。然而，现有的视觉分支侧重于预测静态视觉观察，而非反映能够捕捉运动交互下世界状态演化的潜在转移信息。这导致了行动模型中高层物理状态演化与低层动作轨迹生成之间的表征纠缠，形成了结构性瓶颈，同时削弱了世界演化建模对行动生成的预测能力。我们提出了PILOT（面向潜在优化轨迹的物理推理），其核心的表征演绎（RD）机制通过将运动思维链（CoT）指导作为模型的原生能力来弥合这一差距。具体而言，RD旨在鼓励行动分支显式建模潜在状态转移标记，这些标记作为CoT保留在推理空间中，以指导细粒度的运动轨迹。实验表明，RD不仅提升了WAMs在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率和泛化能力，还通过将高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节解耦，增强了模型的物理可解释性。此外，RD引入的丰富状态转移监督信号有效缓解了行动生成中的稀疏监督问题，支持在减少示范集的情况下实现数据高效的现实机器人自适应。
tldr: PILOT introduces a Representational Deduction approach that integrates motion chain-of-thought guidance into World Action Models, so the action branch explicitly models potential state transition tokens to decouple high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details, improving success rate, generalization, and data efficiency in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: PILOT 提出了一种表征演绎方法，将运动思维链指导集成到世界动作模型中，使动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移标记，以将高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节解耦，从而提升机器人操作的成功率、泛化能力和数据效率。

title: Roboclock: A Unified Benchmark for Time-Aware Robotic Intelligence
summary: Time is a fundamental dimension of robotic intelligence: a robot may fail despite physically correct actions if it acts outside a valid time window, responds too slowly to an event, or fails to meet required throughput. Yet existing robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize spatial correctness and logical task completion, largely overlooking the temporal constraints of real-world applications. We present RoboClock, a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation featuring 60 tasks across five application domains. Mirroring these failure modes, RoboClock structures tasks around three types of temporal constraints: Temporal Window, Event-Reactive, and Throughput. Furthermore, RoboClock incorporates a Latency-Aligned evaluation protocol that continuously advances environment time during model inference and control-interface delays, paired with time-sensitive metrics. Evaluating over 30 methods, we find that the best-performing approach is the trained VLA, yet it achieves only 8.3% temporal success even on Easy-level tasks, with persistent challenges in generalization and transfer. These findings reveal fundamental limitations in current robotic systems and highlight the need to jointly optimize physical competence, temporal reasoning, and execution latency.
summary_zh: 时间是机器人智能的一个基本维度：即使机器人在物理动作上完全正确，如果它在有效时间窗口之外行动、对事件响应过慢或未能达到所需的吞吐量，仍然可能失败。然而，现有的机器人基准测试主要强调空间正确性和逻辑任务完成，在很大程度上忽视了实际应用中的时间约束。我们提出了RoboClock，一个面向时间感知机器人操作的统一基准测试，涵盖五个应用领域的60项任务。对应于上述失败模式，RoboClock围绕三类时间约束组织任务：时间窗口、事件响应和吞吐量。此外，RoboClock引入了一种延迟对齐的评估协议，该协议在模型推理和控制系统接口延迟期间持续推进环境时间，并配套使用时间敏感型指标。在对30多种方法进行评估后，我们发现表现最佳的方法是经过训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，但即使是在简单级别任务上，其时间成功率也仅为8.3%，且在泛化和迁移方面仍面临持续挑战。这些发现揭示了当前机器人系统的根本性局限，并凸显了联合优化物理能力、时间推理和执行延迟的必要性。
tldr: RoboClock introduces a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation, evaluating over 30 methods across 60 temporally constrained tasks and finding that even the best VLA only achieves 8.3% temporal success, highlighting critical limitations in current robotic systems.
tldr_zh: RoboClock 提出了一个面向时间感知机器人操作的综合基准，涵盖60个受时间约束的任务，并评估了30多种方法，发现即使最强的 VLA 模型也仅达到8.3%的时间成功率，揭示了当前机器人系统的关键局限。

title: OVOK: A Recursive Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Video-Based Articulated Robot State Estimation
summary: Recovering articulated robot state from video supports metric spatial sensing for manipulation, scene reconstruction, and action planning. Yet the problem is ill-posed: different intrinsics, camera-to-robot poses, and joint angles can explain similar observations. Prior task-specific regressors typically assume known intrinsics, fit one robot through laborious data collection and robot-specific training, and still transfer poorly across scenes. Foundation models apply to any robot zero-shot, but their estimates have large errors. We present OVOK (One Video to Kinetics), a recursive self-improving agentic framework for this task. Under a human-authored protocol, an agentic initializer constructs robot-specific OVOK-4k; a proposer--executor--verifier loop then jointly evolves tools and executable workflows from feedback. Updated tools and workflows are accepted only when the verifier judges a positive improvement. The retained workflow is frozen for accurate inference. Experiments demonstrate that the evolved workflow achieves state-of-the-art results on DREAM-V and RoboKeyGen-V, delivering robust and accurate estimates.
summary_zh: 从视频中恢复关节型机器人的状态，有助于实现对操作、场景重建和动作规划的度量级空间感知。然而，该问题具有不适定性：不同的内参、相机与机器人之间的位姿以及关节角度，可能解释相似的观测结果。先前的任务特定回归器通常假设内参已知，需要通过繁琐的数据采集和针对特定机器人的训练来适配单一机器人，且在不同场景间的泛化能力较差。基础模型可以零样本应用于任意机器人，但其估计误差较大。我们提出了OVOK（One Video to Kinetics），一种用于该任务的递归自改进智能体框架。在人类编写的协议指导下，一个智能体初始化器构建面向特定机器人的OVOK-4k；随后，一个“提议-执行-验证”循环在反馈驱动下联合演进工具与可执行工作流。仅当验证器判定改进为正向时，更新的工具与工作流才被采纳。保留的工作流将被冻结以用于精确推理。实验表明，演进后的工作流在DREAM-V和RoboKeyGen-V上达到了最先进的结果，提供稳健且精确的估计。
tldr: OVOK is a recursive self-improving agentic framework that jointly evolves tools and workflows to estimate articulated robot state from video, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on DREAM-V and RoboKeyGen-V benchmarks.
tldr_zh: OVOK 是一个递归自改进的代理框架，通过协同进化工具和工作流来从视频中估计铰接机器人状态，在 DREAM-V 和 RoboKeyGen-V 基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: CALVIN-MAX: When Does a Mid-Execution Change Hurt a Robot Policy?
summary: Robots must often keep working after the world changes, as when a block moves or the camera shifts while the robot still acts on what it saw before. Recent work showed that one change during a task lowers success for every policy tested, but did not separate the effect of its timing from the cost of the changed world, or measure what it costs afterwards. We introduce CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases on CALVIN's five-instruction chains, each with one change to the objects, the camera, the robot, or the instruction. Each case compares three runs that are identical until the affected instruction begins: one without the change, one with it in place from that moment, and one in which it arrives while the robot is moving. The second run against the first gives the cost of the changed world, and the third against the second the effect of meeting it mid-motion. On 1,526 held-out cases per policy, with hypotheses fixed in advance, each of ten released policies loses 4.4 to 9.9 percentage points on the affected instruction over the eight core changes. Whether timing matters depends on the change: one that alters what the robot sees costs 5.4 points less mid-motion than from the start, whereas a change to the scene itself or to the robot shows no detectable effect. Rewinding the robot to the start of the instruction removes the benefit for every policy; the stricter test we fixed in advance, that the rewound run then matches the second run, passes for three. The cost also outlasts the affected instruction: the change stays in place, and a policy that still completes that instruction is 5.0 to 16.8 points less likely to complete the next one.
summary_zh: 机器人必须在世界发生变化后继续工作，例如当一个方块移动或相机移位时，机器人仍然基于之前的观察采取行动。近期研究显示，任务过程中的一次变化会降低所有被测试策略的成功率，但该研究未将变化发生的时间点与变化后世界本身的代价区分开来，也未衡量变化之后所带来的影响。我们引入了CALVIN-MAX，一个包含7，828个案例的基准测试，基于CALVIN的五指令链，每个案例涉及对物体、相机、机器人或指令的一次变化。每个案例对比三种运行方式，这三种方式在受影响指令开始前完全相同：一种无变化，一种从该时刻起变化已生效，另一种是变化在机器人运动过程中出现。第二种运行与第一种运行对比，得出变化后世界本身的代价；第三种运行与第二种运行对比，得出机器人在运动中途遇到变化的影响。在每种策略的1，526个保留案例上，预先设定假设，十个已发布的策略在八个核心变化中，受影响指令上的成功率下降了4.4到9.9个百分点。时间点是否重要取决于变化的类型：改变机器人所见内容的变化，在运动中途出现比从一开始就存在少损失5.4个百分点，而场景本身或机器人的变化则未显示出可检测的影响。将机器人倒回到指令开始处会消除所有策略的上述优势；我们预先设定的更严格测试，即倒回后的运行需与第二种运行一致，结果只有三种策略通过。该代价还会延续到受影响指令之后：变化持续存在，且仍能完成该指令的策略，完成下一条指令的可能性会降低5.0到16.8个百分点。
tldr: This paper introduces CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases with mid-execution changes to objects, camera, robot, or instruction on CALVIN, and measures the impact of change timing and post-change costs across ten robot policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CALVIN-MAX基准，包含7,828个在CALVIN上的中途变更案例（对象、相机、机器人或指令），并衡量了变更时机和变更后成本对十种机器人策略的影响。

title: BendGS: Observation-Conditioned Gaussian Self-Modeling for Continuum Robots
summary: Visual self-models learn from images how a robot moves under motor commands. Continuum robots need them even more, as they bend continuously without measured joint angles or fixed link geometry. Existing continuum self-models predict point clouds, image-space curves, or future images, but not the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose together from an observed body. 3D Gaussians offer a renderable representation of shape and appearance, yet articulated Gaussian self-models rely on joint angles to drive deformation. In this work, we propose BendGS, which uses a virtual backbone estimated from observation to drive command-conditioned Gaussian deformation, enabling next-state prediction for continuum robots without measured joint angles. In Gaussian modeling, a feed-forward network reconstructs the robot as 3D Gaussians from multi-view images, and the backbone, a chain of coordinate frames, is fitted to back-projected depth points to estimate the bending state. In transition, a network predicts its change under a relative motor command to deform the bound Gaussians. The deformed Gaussians render the next images and the 3D shape, and the distal frame gives the tip pose. Training losses use RGB-D images and masks, without bending or tip labels. On simulated and real robots, BendGS achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, best image quality, and lowest tip errors among the compared methods.
summary_zh: 视觉自模型通过图像学习机器人在电机指令下的运动方式。连续体机器人对此类模型的需求更为迫切，因为它们在无测量关节角度或固定连杆几何的情况下连续弯曲。现有连续体自模型可预测点云、图像空间曲线或未来图像，但无法同时从观测到的机体预测下一个三维形状、外观和末端姿态。三维高斯提供了一种可渲染的形状与外观表示，然而铰接式高斯自模型依赖关节角度驱动形变。在本工作中，我们提出BendGS，它利用从观测中估计的虚拟骨架来驱动指令条件化的高斯形变，从而实现在无测量关节角度情况下对连续体机器人的下一状态预测。在高斯建模中，前馈网络从多视角图像中将机器人重建为三维高斯，骨架作为坐标系链，拟合至反投影深度点以估计弯曲状态。在状态转移中，网络预测其在相对电机指令下的变化，以形变绑定的高斯。形变后的高斯渲染出下一图像和三维形状，末端坐标系给出末端姿态。训练损失使用RGB-D图像和掩膜，无需弯曲或末端标签。在仿真和真实机器人上，BendGS在对比方法中取得了最低的Chamfer距离、最佳的图像质量和最低的末端误差。
tldr: BendGS introduces a Gaussian self-model for continuum robots that estimates a virtual backbone from observations to drive command-conditioned deformation, predicting the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose from multi-view images without joint angle labels.
tldr_zh: BendGS 提出了一种用于连续体机器人的高斯自模型，通过从观测中估计虚拟骨架来驱动命令条件下的变形，从而在无需关节角度标签的情况下，从多视图图像预测下一个三维形状、外观和末端姿态。

title: VG-GP: Uncertainty-Gated Visuo-Geometric Memory for Negative-Transfer-Resistant Grasp Adaptation
summary: Pretrained antipodal grasping networks generalize well to canonical shapes but frequently fail zero-shot on novel objects with irregular mass distributions, thin rims, or unfamiliar handles. While episodic experience memory adapts a frozen base policy without retraining, naive retrieval suffers from visual appearance bias, negative transfer from overriding working base grasps, and degenerate closed-loop acquisition. We present VG-GP, a plug-and-play Visuo-Geometric Gaussian Process memory framework for closed-loop $SE(2)$ residual grasp transfer. First, we fuse color-invariant surface-normal DINOv2 features, canonical $SE(2)$ gripper-aligned 3D local heightmaps, and contact-geometry descriptors under a product kernel with Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) lengthscales learned strictly on source objects. Second, we model the joint posterior over the base grasp and candidate $SE(2)$ alternatives, overriding the base policy only when the joint-covariance Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) clears a risk-sensitive threshold. Third, an online counterfactual curation gate using single-record necessity and sufficiency interventions quarantines source experiences causing negative transfer. Fourth, we close the acquisition loop via Bayesian Expected Improvement (EI) over equal-budget $SE(2)$ probes. Across 42 disjoint YCB objects in ManiSkill3 (20 source, 12 development, 10 held-out test), VG-GP wraps a pretrained GR-ConvNet base policy and raises physical lift rate across all 22 unseen objects from 38.6% (34/88) to 53.4% (47/88) with zero regressions (+13 rescues, 0 losses; object-clustered 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%], exact McNemar $p = 0.00024$). On the 10 held-out objects, EI active acquisition reaches 45.0% (18/40 vs. 32.5% base, 5/7 of oracle headroom), achieves 55.0% probe divergence over passive fallback, and monotonically reduces epistemic uncertainty.
summary_zh:
摘要：
预训练的对掌抓取网络在典型形状上具有良好的泛化能力，但在面对质量分布不规则、薄边缘或不熟悉把手的新型物体时，零样本抓取常常失败。尽管情节经验记忆可以在不重新训练的情况下适配冻结的基础策略，但朴素检索存在视觉外观偏差、覆盖有效基础抓取导致的负迁移以及闭环采集退化等问题。我们提出VG-GP，一种即插即用的视觉-几何高斯过程记忆框架，用于闭环$SE(2)$残差抓取迁移。首先，我们在乘积核下融合颜色不变的表面法向DINOv2特征、规范的$SE(2)$夹爪对齐三维局部高度图及接触几何描述符，并采用仅在源物体上学习的自动相关性确定（ARD）长度尺度。其次，我们对基础抓取与候选$SE(2)$替代方案的联合后验进行建模，仅当联合协方差下置信界（LCB）超过风险敏感阈值时才覆盖基础策略。第三，在线反事实筛选门控利用单记录必要性与充分性干预，隔离导致负迁移的源经验。第四，我们通过等预算$SE(2)$探测的贝叶斯期望改进（EI）闭环采集过程。在ManiSkill3中42个不相交的YCB物体上（20个源物体、12个开发物体、10个保留测试物体），VG-GP包装预训练的GR-ConvNet基础策略，将全部22个未见物体的物理提升率从38.6%（34/88）提升至53.4%（47/88），且无任何回退（+13次成功救援，0次损失；物体聚类95%置信区间[+6.8%，+22.7%]，精确McNemar检验$p = 0.00024$）。在10个保留测试物体上，EI主动采集达到45.0%（18/40，对比基础策略的32.5%，占理想性能余量的5/7），相较于被动回退实现55.0%的探测发散率，并单调降低认知不确定性。
tldr: VG-GP introduces a plug-and-play visuo-geometric Gaussian Process memory framework that adapts pretrained antipodal grasping policies to novel objects in closed-loop SE(2) residual grasp transfer, demonstrating significant lift-rate improvements in simulation with zero regressions.
tldr_zh: VG-GP 提出了一个即插即用的视觉-几何高斯过程记忆框架，用于在闭环 SE(2) 残差抓取迁移中适配预训练的对掌抓取策略，并在仿真中显著提升了抓取成功率且无回退。

title: CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agentic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence
summary: A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. At eleven generations per decision against one, it was significantly cheaper than a direct prompt, a cost-aware prompt and an unguarded agent in all 18 household comparisons (mean loss per item 0.28 against 0.57-0.83), in 9 of 18 in the new domains and in 10 of 18 on TRUST-NAV (Holm per set), and never significantly costlier. It executed none of the 142 unsafe test instructions. On a unanimous vote, the minimum-expected-loss rule reduces calibration to one loss-derived threshold, so for two of six model configurations a gate on the vote alone never executed a clear instruction, costing 0.49 per item on TRUST-NAV against CATWAY's 0.13 and 0.09; the fused estimate avoided this on every set.
summary_zh: 语言模型机器人智能体必须决定是执行、质疑还是拒绝一条指令，而不安全执行的代价远高于不必要的质疑。此前的机器人门控机制没有一种是从错误代价中推导出所有阈值的，也没有一种基于校准概率运行，更没有一种在某一领域完成拟合后，未经修改便能在另一领域进行评估。我们提出了CATWAY，一种代价敏感的三向决策门控机制：一个覆盖四种指令情形（清晰、模糊、不可行、不安全）的损失矩阵，在概率单纯形上划定执行、质疑和拒绝区域，其中质疑是信息收集步骤。其概率融合了十次样本投票与逻辑回归对模糊性、不可行性和风险的分级评分。CATWAY在家庭指令上完成拟合后被冻结，并在三个小模型的文本级决策任务中进行了域内测试，同时应用于两个新的机器人领域以及外部TRUST-NAV基准测试。在每次决策生成十一次而非一次的条件下，CATWAY在所有18项家庭指令比较中显著优于直接提示、代价感知提示和无防护智能体（每项平均损失为0.28，对比0.57至0.83），在新领域的18项比较中9项胜出，在TRUST-NAV上18项中10项胜出（每组采用Holm校正），且从未在统计上显著更差。它未执行142条不安全测试指令中的任何一条。在一致投票情况下，最小期望损失规则将校准简化为一个由损失推导出的阈值，因此在六种模型配置中，有两种仅依赖投票的门控机制从未执行过清晰指令，在TRUST-NAV上每项损失为0.49，而CATWAY分别为0.13和0.09；融合估计在每一组上都避免了这一问题。
tldr: CATWAY proposes a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate for language-model robot agents, deriving execute/ask/refuse thresholds from a loss matrix and calibrated probabilities, and shows improved cost-effectiveness across multiple domains.
tldr_zh: CATWAY 提出了一种成本敏感的三向决策门控机制，用于语言模型机器人代理，从损失矩阵和校准概率中推导出执行/询问/拒绝的阈值，并在多个领域中展示了成本效益的改进。

title: Exteroceptive Sensor Faults in Autonomous Vehicles: A Cross-Modal Taxonomy and Fault Injection Toolkit
summary: Autonomous vehicles rely on cameras, LiDAR, and radar to perceive their surroundings, yet these exteroceptive sensors can be degraded by hardware aging, environmental interference, miscalibration, embedded software errors, and combinations of these causes, with direct consequences for perception quality and safety. Existing surveys and benchmarks mostly address individual sensors, isolated conditions, or vehicle-level consequences, and no common vocabulary relates fault origins across the three modalities. This paper reviews the literature on exteroceptive sensor faults and proposes a cross-modal, origin-driven taxonomy that organizes them into five categories, namely hardware, environmental, calibration, software, and synergistic faults, mapping each entry to its physical or logical mechanism, observable manifestation, and affected subsystem, and relating the categories to the safety analyses of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448. To make the taxonomy operational, we release an open-source fault injection toolkit with 94 symptom-level routines (41 camera, 27 LiDAR, and 26 radar), four graded severity levels, reproducible burst scheduling, and per-frame labels recording the fault category, affected subsystem, and severity. Examples on the Boreas dataset illustrate how each category alters camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and radar scans. Together, the taxonomy and the toolkit provide a shared reference and a controlled testbed for studying sensor reliability, developing and benchmarking fault detection and diagnosis methods, and building fault-annotated datasets for the safety validation of perception systems. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/davidepossenti/AV-SensorFault-Toolkit.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶汽车依赖摄像头、激光雷达和雷达来感知周围环境，然而这些外部感知传感器可能因硬件老化、环境干扰、标定误差、嵌入式软件错误以及上述因素的组合而性能退化，直接影响感知质量与安全性。现有综述和基准研究大多针对单一传感器、孤立条件或整车层面的后果展开，尚未形成一种通用术语体系来跨三种传感器模态关联故障成因。本文回顾了有关外部感知传感器故障的文献，并提出了一种跨模态、以原因为导向的分类体系，将其归纳为五类，即硬件类、环境类、标定类、软件类和协同类故障，同时将每一类映射至其物理或逻辑机理、可观测表现及受影响的子系统，并将各分类与ISO 26262和ISO 21448的安全分析相关联。为使该分类体系具备可操作性，我们发布了一套开源故障注入工具包，内含94个症状级程序（其中摄像头41个、激光雷达27个、雷达26个）、四个分级严重度等级、可复现的突发调度机制，以及逐帧标签用于记录故障类别、受影响子系统和严重程度。在Boreas数据集上的示例展示了每类故障如何改变摄像头图像、激光雷达点云和雷达扫描数据。综合而言，该分类体系和工具包为研究传感器可靠性、开发和评估故障检测与诊断方法，以及构建用于感知系统安全验证的故障标注数据集，提供了共同的参考框架和受控测试平台。该工具包公开获取地址为：https://github.com/davidepossenti/AV-SensorFault-Toolkit。
tldr: This paper proposes a cross-modal taxonomy of exteroceptive sensor faults in autonomous vehicles and releases an open-source fault injection toolkit with 94 routines to support safety validation and benchmarking of perception systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了自动驾驶汽车外部传感器故障的跨模态分类法，并发布了一个包含94个例程的开源故障注入工具包，以支持感知系统的安全验证和基准测试。

title: Collision Rendering: GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Planning on Sparse Voxel Radiance Fields with Risk-Bounded Collision Checking
summary: Although radiance fields provide detailed scene representations for robotics, they remain underexplored for trajectory planning, without a widely agreed-upon way to translate learned spatial primitives into reliable collision criteria. To bridge this gap, we introduce Collision Rendering, the first trajectory planning framework on sparse voxel radiance fields (SVR), which supports GPU-accelerated, risk-bounded collision checking and a differentiable collision cost. Our key insight is that the structured volumetric density of SVR allows its rendering pipeline to serve as a fast numerical approximator of collision probability. We approximate the robot with collision spheres and place a coinciding spherical camera at each sphere. Under a probabilistic collision model, we derive an upper bound on each sphere's maximum directional collision probability from the camera's rendering pipeline. Evaluating this bound on the GPU yields a modular collision checker that integrates with established sampling-based planners without an auxiliary geometric map or changes to the learned representation. We further compute a collision cost and its gradients from rendered opacities through the same pipeline, extending the framework to trajectory optimization. Experiments demonstrate millisecond collision checking time on a consumer-grade GPU and collision-free trajectories in all queries, outperforming other radiance field-based planners.
summary_zh: 虽然辐射场为机器人技术提供了详细的场景表示，但在轨迹规划中的应用仍未充分探索，缺乏一种广泛认可的方法来将学习到的空间基元转化为可靠的碰撞判据。为弥合这一空白，我们提出了碰撞渲染（Collision Rendering），这是首个基于稀疏体素辐射场（SVR）的轨迹规划框架，支持GPU加速、风险有界的碰撞检测以及可微碰撞代价。我们的关键洞察在于，SVR的结构化体积密度使其渲染管线能够作为碰撞概率的快速数值近似器。我们用碰撞球体近似表示机器人，并在每个球体位置放置一个重合的球形相机。在概率性碰撞模型下，我们从相机的渲染管线推导出每个球体最大方向碰撞概率的上界。在GPU上评估该上界，可得到一个模块化的碰撞检测器，能够与基于采样的既有规划器集成，而无需辅助几何地图或修改已学习的表示。我们还通过同一管线从渲染的不透明度计算碰撞代价及其梯度，从而将框架扩展到轨迹优化。实验表明，在消费级GPU上可实现毫秒级碰撞检测时间，且所有查询均生成无碰撞轨迹，性能优于其他基于辐射场的规划器。
tldr: The paper introduces Collision Rendering, a GPU-accelerated trajectory planning framework that leverages sparse voxel radiance fields for risk-bounded collision checking, enabling fast and collision-free robot motion planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了碰撞渲染框架，利用稀疏体素辐射场实现GPU加速、风险有界的碰撞检测，从而实现快速且无碰撞的机器人轨迹规划。

title: Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control. Critically, many VLA pipelines offer limited ways to express and audit what a robot must not do, making it difficult to provide assurance in safety-critical settings. These limitations constrain scalability, maintainability, and trust when robots move beyond controlled demonstrations. We propose Embodied Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI: a deployment-oriented paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning and control with explicit, machine-readable background knowledge and formal constraints. By combining knowledge-guided perception, constraint-aware symbolic planning, and hybrid learning, Embodied NeSy AI enables robots to reason about their environment, adapt to new tasks, and provide auditable, machine-checkable compliance with safety and operational requirements, thus supporting scalable, trustworthy robot deployment.
summary_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）端到端系统推动了机器人学习的重大进展，但在实际部署中仍面临持续性障碍。在实践中，这些模型在分布偏移（即新物体、布局、光照或接触条件）下往往表现出脆弱的泛化能力，物理与因果推理能力有限，且细粒度电机控制不一致。关键问题是，许多VLA流程在表达和审计机器人“不可为”的行为方面手段有限，这使得在安全关键环境中提供保障变得困难。这些局限限制了机器人超越受控演示场景后的可扩展性、可维护性和可信度。我们提出具身神经符号（NeSy）人工智能：一种面向部署的范式，将学习感知、规划与控制同显式、机器可读的背景知识和形式化约束相结合。通过融合知识引导的感知、约束感知的符号规划以及混合学习，具身NeSy AI使机器人能够推理其环境、适应新任务，并提供可审计、机器可核查的安全与操作合规性，从而支持可扩展、可信赖的机器人部署。
tldr: This paper proposes an embodied neuro-symbolic AI paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning, and control with explicit, machine-readable knowledge and formal constraints to improve the auditability, safety, and scalability of robot deployment, addressing VLA models' brittleness and lack of compliance mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种具身神经符号AI范式，将学习感知、规划与控制同显式、机器可读的背景知识和形式化约束相结合，以提升机器人部署的可审计性、安全性和可扩展性，解决VLA模型的脆弱性和合规机制缺乏问题。

title: Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences
summary: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's latent reward. We construct post-intervention preferences by comparing corrected behavior with the behavior it replaces, and pre-intervention preferences from temporal relationships among states leading up to an intervention. We evaluate the learned value representations through two downstream tasks: goal inference and correction forecasting. Our results show that post-intervention preferences are particularly effective for goal inference, while pre-intervention preferences provide strong correction-forecasting performance. Combining both sources of information performs strongly across both tasks, even when generalizing to participants unseen during training. These findings demonstrate that both when and how humans correct provide complementary information for learning value representations from corrective interactions.
summary_zh: 当人们介入纠正机器人时，他们不仅通过如何纠正其行为提供信息，还通过选择介入的时机传达信息。现有的“从纠正中学习”方法侧重于将新轨迹与机器人原本意图的行为进行比较，从而未能充分利用介入前机器人行为的背景信息。在本研究中，我们探讨了如何将介入前和介入后的行为转化为偏好对，以学习逼近人类潜在奖励的价值函数。我们通过将纠正后的行为与它所替代的行为进行比较来构建介入后偏好，并根据导致介入的状态间的时间关系构建介入前偏好。我们通过两个下游任务评估学到的价值表示：目标推断和纠正预测。结果表明，介入后偏好在目标推断方面尤其有效，而介入前偏好在纠正预测方面表现出色。将两种信息来源结合起来，在两项任务中均表现优异，即使泛化到训练中未见过的参与者时也是如此。这些发现表明，人类纠正的时机和方式为从纠正性交互中学习价值表示提供了互补的信息。
tldr: This paper proposes learning value functions from human corrective feedback by constructing preference pairs from both post-intervention corrected behavior and pre-intervention temporal relationships, showing that combining both sources improves goal inference and correction forecasting.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出通过从干预后的纠正行为和干预前的时间关系中构建偏好对来从人类纠正反馈中学习价值函数，并证明结合两种信息源能改进目标推断和纠正预测。

title: Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking
summary: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过预测未来环境状态来支持具身决策。在具身视觉跟踪中，目标运动的不确定性以及机器人自身位姿变化共同影响视觉观测，使得未来状态预测具有挑战性。我们提出一种运动条件化世界建模方法，将预测的目标运动分布与机器人自身运动融入潜在状态转移中。几何-进度模块通过共享运动模式和路径条件化进度分布，联合建模几何路径与单步行进距离。该公式在保留路径选择与运动进度之间依赖关系的同时，捕捉其不确定性。动作引起的坐标变换将预测路径表达至下一机器人坐标系中，为未来视觉状态预测提供几何上有依据的条件。未来视觉特征重建通过条件化转移分支对运动预测器进行监督，将显式运动表征与后续观测联系起来。该模型联合优化运动似然、特征重建和专家动作监督，使跟踪策略能够融合视觉上下文与预测性运动线索。在三个具身跟踪基准上的实验表明，该模型在轻量级$0.5$B骨干网络下提升了跟踪性能与跨环境泛化能力。
tldr: This paper proposes Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which integrates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent world model transitions, using future visual feature reconstruction to train the motion predictor and policy for embodied visual tracking, achieving improved performance and cross-environment generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出运动条件世界建模，将预测的目标运动分布和机器人自身运动融入潜在状态转移，通过未来视觉特征重建训练运动预测器和策略，用于具身视觉跟踪，在多个基准上提升了性能并增强了跨环境泛化能力。

title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
summary: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型能够从离线视觉数据中实现目标导向的规划，但仅靠预测并不足以明确其表示应保留哪些与动作相关的区分信息。逆动力学提供了辅助监督，然而平方误差动作回归仅通过条件动作均值的变化来奖励额外信息。我们提出对比动作识别方法（CIA），该方法在基于历史条件的动作提案所采样的候选中识别实际执行的动作。在同一情境下比较可能合理的动作，可以针对下一隐状态相对于历史所提供的额外信息进行优化。在精确行为匹配的条件下，我们证明CIA能够奖励那些在最优逆回归误差不变的情况下仍提供动作信息的内容，并通过一个受控学习实例验证了这一区别。在不修改规划器的情况下，CIA在五个视觉控制基准上相较于基础世界模型和回归逆动力学基线，实现了更高的规划器平均成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), a method for improving latent world models by training them to identify the executed action among alternatives, which enhances goal-directed planning and achieves higher success rates across visual control benchmarks without modifying the planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出对比动作识别（CIA），通过让潜在世界模型识别执行的动作来提升目标导向规划，在不修改规划器的情况下，在多个视觉控制基准上取得了更高的成功率。

title: EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See?
summary: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-40% of runs, against 76%-94% under L, and the strongest agent under G scores below each of them under L. In two models, removing only the line-of-sight test closes 93%-96% of the score gap, and loading state only inside tools recovers 70%-98%, so safeguards on observations and queries leave most of the leak open. In open-ended acquisition, the gain from L concentrates in items that depend on buried resources or mobs. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft
summary_zh: 在Minecraft这一具身智能体常用测试平台中，语义工具（如mineBlock）直接从模拟器加载的世界状态中选取目标，而不进行可见性检测，因此智能体从未见过的埋藏矿石也能被一步获取，评分无法反映智能体是否进行了搜索。我们将这一缺失的要求形式化为证据封闭性：智能体系统的每一个决策，包括其工具内部的决策，只能通过智能体持有证据的事实来依赖世界。EviCraft是一个运行时与基准测试平台，在智能体之下强制实施封闭性，并将准入规则设为实验变量：基于感知的规则（G）仅允许视线内或由智能体自身行动返回的内容，而基于加载状态的规则（L）复现标准工具栈，同时保持智能体、工具和世界不变。在Survival任务中，规则效应超过了最强智能体的领先优势：在G规则下，三个中等规模的智能体在32%-40%的回合中到达钻石，而在L规则下为76%-94%，且G规则下最强的智能体得分低于L规则下每一个中等规模智能体。在两个模型中，仅移除视线检测就弥合了93%-96%的得分差距，而仅在工具内部加载状态则恢复了70%-98%的差距，这表明对观测和查询的防护措施仍留下了大部分泄漏。在开放式采集任务中，L规则带来的增益集中在依赖埋藏资源或生物的物品上。代码和基准测试平台见https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft。
tldr: EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces evidence closure in Minecraft agents, showing that standard loaded-state tools significantly inflate task success scores compared to perception-grounded decision-making, and that removing only visibility checks or loading state in tools does not close the gap. It formalizes and measures the role of agent-visible evidence in embodied decision-making within a common testbed.
tldr_zh: EviCraft 是一个在 Minecraft 智能体中强制证据封闭性的运行时和基准，表明标准的加载状态工具会显著虚高任务成功率，而仅移除可见性检查或在工具中加载状态并不能弥合差距。它形式化并衡量了体内决策中智能体可见证据的作用。

title: Verify then Steer: Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in an unseen 3D environment. However, existing methods still struggle to recover from route deviations at test time. We investigate this limitation through the lens of instruction progress, and trace it to a phenomenon we term progress hallucination: agents misinterpret off-route observations as evidence of task progress, causing their internal instruction progress to advance beyond the actual task stage and hindering recovery based on earlier sub-instructions. To address this failure mode, we propose PHAR (Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery), a test-time recovery framework following a verify-then-steer paradigm.
