The verifier examines residual-stream representations of the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify mismatch of cross-modal evidence along the trajectories, and uses split conformal calibration to control false alarms. When an alarm is raised, the steering module uses a contextual bandit to adaptively select the rewind extent of instruction progress for online recovery. Through extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, our framework enhances the reliability of multiple state-of-the-art vision-language navigation methods at test time.
summary_zh: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求智能体依据语言指令在未见过的三维环境中到达目标位置。然而，现有方法在测试阶段遇到路线偏离时，仍难以有效恢复。我们通过指令进展的视角来探究这一局限，并将其追溯至一种我们称之为“进展幻觉”的现象：智能体将偏离路线的观测误判为任务进展的证据，导致其内部指令进展超前于实际任务阶段，从而阻碍了基于较早子指令的恢复。为解决这一失效模式，我们提出PHAR（进展幻觉感知恢复），一种遵循“先验证后引导”范式的测试时恢复框架。验证器检查视觉语言模型（VLM）的残差流表示，以识别轨迹中跨模态证据的不匹配，并采用分割共形校准来控制误报率。当触发警报时，引导模块利用上下文赌博机自适应地选择指令进展的回退程度，以实现在线恢复。通过在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验，我们的框架在测试时显著提升了多种最先进视觉语言导航方法的可靠性。
tldr: This paper introduces PHAR, a test-time recovery framework for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) that addresses 'progress hallucination' by verifying cross-modal evidence in VLM representations and using a contextual bandit to rewind instruction progress for recovery, improving success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 PHAR，一种用于视觉-语言导航（VLN）的测试时恢复框架，通过验证 VLM 表示中的跨模态证据并利用上下文赌博机回退指令进度来应对‘进度幻觉’，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上提升了导航成功率。

title: DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.
summary_zh: 摘要：准确高效的单目3D手部姿态估计是具身人机交互和灵巧操作中的重要感知能力。近年来，基于扩散的方法通过对3D关节坐标进行迭代去噪来建模姿态不确定性。然而，直接对最终关节进行扩散要求生成过程同时探索合理的姿态并恢复精确的坐标，通常依赖于额外的去噪步骤或多假设方案，从而增加了推理成本。在本工作中，我们提出了DiffAnchor，一种少步锚点空间扩散框架，该框架对锚点而非关节进行扩散。我们的关键洞察在于，随机探索无需直接作用于最终输出，而是通过扩散搜索信息丰富的中间锚点作为局部3D回归器，同时通过锚点到关节的偏移预测和加权聚合实现精确的关节定位。具体而言，固定上下文锚点提供稳定的全局参考，而带噪声的动态锚点通过迭代细化向信息丰富的关节区域收敛。此外，重要性引导的锚点选择与补充机制能够保留有效锚点、移除无效锚点，并探索覆盖不足的区域。该设计降低了扩散过程的精度负担，使得仅需少量去噪步骤和单一假设即可实现精确预测。在HO-3D V2、NYU、ICVL和InterHand2.6M上的大量实验表明，本方法在前三个基准上达到了最先进的性能，在具有挑战性的交互手估计任务上也表现出具有竞争力的性能，同时保持了与确定性回归基线相当的推理效率。
tldr: DiffAnchor proposes a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework for monocular 3D hand pose estimation, where diffusion refines intermediate anchors instead of final joints, enabling accurate and efficient prediction with a single hypothesis.
tldr_zh: DiffAnchor 提出了一种少步锚空间扩散框架，用于单目 3D 手部姿态估计，其中扩散过程优化中间锚点而非最终关节，从而以单假设实现准确且高效的预测。

title: OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution
summary: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.
summary_zh: 基于动作的条件世界模型在机器人和自动驾驶领域发挥着至关重要的作用，然而现有的视频扩散模型在维持动态物体持续性方面存在不足。当相机转离后又返回时，视野外的运动实体无法在潜在空间中合理演化，往往因有限的视角范围而发生变异或完全消失。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OmniPersist，一个统一框架，在单阶段扩散模型中将透视视频生成与全景演化相结合，无需依赖辅助模型或初始全景输入。为保持效率，我们以较低的帧率建模全景流，并通过几何锚定（GeoAnch）实现空间对应，通过时间补偿（TemComp）实现时间聚合，从而在空间和时间上桥接两个视角。OmniPersist与相机控制架构无关，支持潜在层级和注意力层级的条件控制。在新构建的动态基准上，针对图像到视频和视频延续任务的大量实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、相机可控性、重访一致性和动态持续性方面均取得了一致的提升。
tldr: OmniPersist proposes a single-stage diffusion framework coupling perspective video generation with lower-frame-rate panoramic evolution to maintain dynamic object persistence across camera re-visits, improving revisit consistency and dynamic persistence in action-conditioned world models.
tldr_zh: OmniPersist 提出一种单阶段扩散框架，将透视视频生成与低帧率全景演化耦合，以在相机返回时保持动态物体的持续性，提升重访一致性和动态持久性。

title: Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation
summary: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.
summary_zh: 激光雷达重建支持闭环自动驾驶仿真，但每场景数小时的优化使得大型资产库的构建与维护成本高昂。我们提出Instant LiDAR，一种前馈式流水线，能在数分钟内将多次激光雷达扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产，无需逐场景优化。激光雷达测量提供了强大的几何先验，但直接从中初始化高斯体会因非均匀采样和有限视场导致重建质量不佳。稀疏回波导致表面存在间隙，而合并扫描虽扩大了覆盖范围，却引入了冗余基元。为应对这些挑战，Instant LiDAR结合了测量锚定高斯预测、采样感知高斯尺度以及多帧整合。预测器对锚定于记录回波的属性进行优化，尺度则根据激光雷达采样调整空间支撑范围。多帧整合将重叠预测合并为覆盖整个驾驶日志的紧凑资产。与NuRec相比，Instant LiDAR在Physical AI（PAI）上场景重建速度提升约46倍，在Waymo上提升约70倍，同时在Waymo上实现了相当的下游3D检测精度。
tldr: Instant LiDAR is a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs LiDAR scans into reusable Gaussian assets for closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, achieving 46-70x faster reconstruction than prior methods while maintaining downstream detection accuracy.
tldr_zh: Instant LiDAR 是一种前馈式 LiDAR 重建方法，可将激光雷达扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产，用于闭环自动驾驶仿真，重建速度比现有方法快 46-70 倍，同时保持下游检测精度。

title: Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling
summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.
summary_zh: 潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过将帧对推断与潜在条件预测相结合，从未标记的视频中学习类似动作的潜在变量，从而实现策略与世界模型的预训练。然而，潜在变量必须解释的内容取决于用于动作推断和转移预测的表示空间。当该空间将智能体不断演化的物理状态与视觉背景（如背景和持久的智能体外观）纠缠在一起时，推断出的潜在变量可能编码与智能体动作无关的信息。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了智能体状态潜在动作模型（Agent-State LAM），该模型联合学习一个紧凑的智能体状态表示及其转移的潜在动作建模。紧凑状态将密集的视觉特征聚合到一个共享空间中，用于动作推断和前向预测。为了引导该状态所保留的内容，我们引入了空间匹配的时间判别（SMTD），该机制通过空间灵活的匹配与冻结的局部视觉特征，训练状态区分其来源帧与邻近帧。SMTD并非比较全局帧表示，而是通过强调每帧在空间位置上的最强局部特征匹配来对其进行评分。这种评分允许背景和持久的智能体外观即使发生位移也能在各帧之间保持匹配，使得这些共享线索在识别来源帧时信息量降低，从而鼓励表示捕捉智能体不断演化的物理状态。在干扰控制任务和六个真实机器人视频数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在动作恢复、下游控制及世界模型预测方面均有所改进。代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces Agent-State LAM, a latent action model that learns a compact agent-state representation with spatially matched temporal discrimination to improve action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction from unlabeled video.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Agent-State LAM，通过联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示和潜在动作，并引入空间匹配时间判别方法，提升了从无标签视频中恢复动作、下游控制及世界模型预测的性能。

title: EmbodiSafety: Benchmarking Risk Understanding and Response in Embodied AI
summary: Progress in embodied foundation models is largely measured by task success, while the physical safety of their decisions remains underexamined. Safety evaluations centered on rule following and binary judgments do not adequately assess whether embodied models understand environmental hazards and make safe decisions. We introduce EmbodiSafety, comprising 1,092 snapshot tasks and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios to assess safety over short and long horizons. Six response modes cover direct execution, refusal, clarification, constrained execution, autonomous recovery, and human escalation. Distinguishing recovery from human intervention makes the boundary of safe autonomy an explicit evaluation target. Our protocol assesses mode correctness, risk identification, and actionable handling, with complete decision accuracy requiring all applicable checks to pass. Claude-Opus-5.5 achieves the highest complete decision accuracy among reference models, reaching 56.1% on snapshots and 61.5% on trajectories. We further develop a data construction pipeline and curate 40k examples for safety alignment. Supervised training on this corpus raises the complete decision accuracy of Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B.
summary_zh: 体现基础模型的进展主要依据任务成功率来衡量，而其决策的物理安全性仍缺乏充分审视。以规则遵循和二元判断为核心的安全评估，无法充分判断体现模型是否理解环境危害并做出安全决策。我们提出EmbodiSafety，包含1,092个快照任务和540个轨迹任务，覆盖844个视觉场景，用以评估短时与长时范围内的安全性。六种响应模式涵盖直接执行、拒绝、澄清、受限执行、自主恢复和人工升级。将恢复与人工干预加以区分，使安全自主的边界成为明确的评估目标。我们的协议评估模式正确性、风险识别和可操作处理，完整决策准确率要求所有适用检查均通过。参考模型中，Claude-Opus-5.5在完整决策准确率上表现最佳，快照任务达56.1%，轨迹任务达61.5%。我们进一步构建数据生成流水线，并整理4万条样本用于安全对齐。基于该语料库的监督训练将Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3.5-4B的完整决策准确率显著提升。
tldr: This paper introduces EmbodiSafety, a benchmark for evaluating risk understanding and safe decision-making in embodied AI systems, with 1,092 snapshot and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios, and shows that safety-alignment training on 40k examples improves the safety decision accuracy of small language models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 EmbodiSafety，一个用于评估具身 AI 系统风险理解和安全决策的基准，包含 844 个视觉场景中的 1,092 个快照任务和 540 个轨迹任务，并展示了基于 4 万个示例的安全对齐训练能提升小型语言模型的安全决策准确率。

title: At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies
summary: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.
summary_zh: 自主漂移要求在轮胎力饱和及高度非线性车辆动力学条件下仍具备敏捷控制能力。我们提出了一种面向流策略的在线强化学习方法，该方法将随机微分方程（SDE）采样用于探索，并结合基于值的策略优化。该方法既支持从零开始训练，也支持对在专家演示上预训练的策略进行微调。训练完成后，控制动作既可基于随机微分方程生成，也可基于常微分方程（ODE）生成。在F1TENTH数字孪生平台上进行的圆形及“8”字形漂移实验表明，两种训练策略均能实现有效的实时漂移控制，具有更紧致的轨迹跟踪、更高的成功率，并在噪声条件下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines SDE sampling with value-based optimization, enabling autonomous vehicle drifting on circular and figure-eight paths in simulation. The method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning from demonstrations, achieving real-time drift control with improved tracking, success rates, and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在线强化学习方法，结合SDE采样和基于价值的策略优化，在仿真中实现自动驾驶车辆漂移控制，支持从零训练和从演示微调，提高跟踪精度和鲁棒性。

title: CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning
summary: Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) used in robot task planning to derive assembly procedures from existing manuals may correctly interpret individual assembly actions yet confuse exact part identities, predict unsupported Part IDs, or produce inconsistent parts across assembly steps. Thus, we propose CAPER (Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement), a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that enables VLMs to generate assembly procedures with two modules--PartGround and PlanRefine. PartGround aligns step-level manual evidence with product-specific inventory and part-reference information to identify exact Part IDs and quantities, transforming free-form hardware prediction into evidence-guided assignments represented in a shared Assembly Intermediate Representation (Assembly IR). PlanRefine audits PartGround assignments against finite inventory by removing the lowest-confidence assignments. Uncertain identity cases remain marked for review in the Assembly IR. We evaluate CAPER on the IKEA Assembly in the Wild (IAW) dataset. Experiment results show that CAPER reaches a Finite-inventory Consistency Rate of 83.33% and produces zero observed out-of-inventory Part-ID occurrences. At the plan level, PlanRefine removes all observed inventory-overuse pairs (9 -> 0) and excess units (51 -> 0). Overall, the results indicate that PartGround and PlanRefine improve part reliability, while also enhancing finite-inventory consistency and local prediction accuracy. Project page and video: https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人任务规划中用于从现有手册推导装配程序时，可能能够正确解释单个装配动作，却容易混淆具体的零件身份，预测出不存在的零件编号，或在装配步骤之间生成不一致的零件。为此，我们提出了CAPER（容量感知的零件定位与证据细化），一种基于手册引导的机器人装配框架，通过两个模块——PartGround和PlanRefine——使VLMs能够生成装配程序。PartGround将步骤级手册证据与产品特定库存及零件参考信息对齐，以识别确切的零件编号和数量，将自由形式的硬件预测转化为由证据引导的分配结果，并以统一的装配中间表示（Assembly IR）呈现。PlanRefine通过移除置信度最低的分配结果，对照有限库存审计PartGround的分配结果。身份不确定的情况仍在Assembly IR中标记以供复核。我们在野外宜家装配（IAW）数据集上评估了CAPER。实验结果表明，CAPER的有限库存一致性率达到83.33%，并且观测到的超出库存的零件编号出现次数为零。在规划层面，PlanRefine消除了所有观测到的库存超用配对（从9降至0）及多余单元（从51降至0）。总体而言，结果表明PartGround和PlanRefine提高了零件的可靠性，同时增强了有限库存一致性及局部预测准确性。项目页面和视频：https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/
tldr: CAPER introduces PartGround and PlanRefine modules that use visual-language models with inventory-aware grounding to reliably generate assembly procedures from manuals, reducing part-ID errors and inventory inconsistencies in robotic assembly planning.
tldr_zh: CAPER 通过 PartGround 和 PlanRefine 模块，利用视觉语言模型结合库存感知的部件匹配，从手册中可靠生成装配流程，减少部件 ID 错误和库存不一致问题。

title: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
summary: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.
summary_zh: 我们提出DOPER，一种RGB姿态估计框架，该框架在目标检测、分割和关键点预测之间共享视觉主干网络，通过透视n点（Perspective-n-Point）方法恢复已知物体的6D姿态。从合成训练出发，DOPER利用部分监督适应真实观测，同时保留合成关键点标签。标定后的多视角观测为关键点监督提供几何约束。在推理阶段，可选的热图细化直接将刚体姿态拟合到预测的关键点分布上，无需深度输入或学习式姿态精化器即可解决模糊对应问题。从欠限定的CAD模型开始，DOPER逐步优化物体表示和姿态估计器。在SPEED+和SHIRT上的实验结果进一步证明了该方法对光照变化的有效适应性和准确的时间姿态估计能力。在评估的单视角和多视角配置中，DOPER在仅使用RGB且实时运行（单块GB300上每个物体模型35 Hz）的条件下，在HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D和T-LESS上取得了最先进的检测AP结果。这些结果验证了联合学习检测与姿态关键点的有效性，并展示了真实观测与几何约束的协同作用。
tldr: DOPER presents an RGB-based 6D object pose estimation framework that jointly learns detection, segmentation, and keypoints with a shared backbone, using synthetic training, partial real supervision, and geometric multi-view constraints, achieving real-time state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DOPER 提出了一种基于 RGB 的 6D 物体姿态估计框架，通过共享骨干网络联合学习检测、分割和关键点，结合合成训练、部分真实监督和多视图几何约束，在多个基准上实现了实时最先进性能。

title: Semidefinite Programming for Cold-Start GNSS Doppler-Based Alignment: A Comparison with Nonlinear Least Squares
summary: Initial attitude alignment between local navigation frames and the Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame is a critical prerequisite for multi-sensor integrated navigation, such as Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)/inertial/odometry fusion, before global and local measurements can be jointly processed. While GNSS Doppler-based alignment eliminates the need for carrier-phase ambiguity resolution or multi-antenna hardware, solving this non-convex problem via local nonlinear least squares (NLS) suffers from local minima, whereas direct semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation incurs high latency and omits local covariance outputs. This study systematically compares NLS and SDP on a unified maximum-likelihood Doppler objective across Monte Carlo simulations and three real-world driving datasets. We demonstrate that attaching a modular dual SDP certifier to a standard manifold NLS solver recovers the global accuracy of direct SDP within 0.001 degrees, reduces real-world 95th-percentile yaw errors from over 86 degrees down to 2.88 degrees to 4.70 degrees, and cuts median solve times by up to an order of magnitude while preserving native Jacobian covariances. We conclude that candidate-driven certification bridges local estimation and global optimization due to two structural advantages: (1) our theoretical comparison reveals that SDP relaxation enlarges the feasible region while preserving the lifted cost, allowing Lagrangian duality to verify whether a fixed NLS candidate attains the global lower bound without invoking a full SDP solver, and (2) the candidate-driven architecture acts as a non-intrusive module that plugs directly into existing navigation pipelines without replacing the local estimator, preserving native tangent-space covariance outputs and low typical latency.
summary_zh: 初始导航坐标系与地心地固坐标系之间的姿态对准是多传感器组合导航（如全球导航卫星系统/惯性/里程计融合）在全球与局部测量联合处理之前的关键前提。尽管基于全球导航卫星系统多普勒的对准方法无需载波相位模糊度解算或多天线硬件，但通过局部非线性最小二乘求解该非凸问题易陷入局部极小值，而直接采用半定规划松弛则存在高延迟且无法输出局部协方差。本研究在统一的最大似然多普勒目标函数下，系统比较了非线性最小二乘与半定规划在蒙特卡洛仿真及三组真实驾驶数据集中的表现。我们证明，在标准流形非线性最小二乘求解器上附加模块化双半定规划验证器，可在0.001度精度范围内恢复直接半定规划的全局精度，将真实场景中第95百分位航向误差从超过86度降至2.88度至4.70度，并将中位求解时间缩短至多一个数量级，同时保留原生雅可比协方差。我们得出结论，基于候选解的验证方法之所以能够弥合局部估计与全局优化之间的鸿沟，得益于两项结构性优势：（1）理论比较揭示，半定规划松弛在保持提升代价的同时扩大了可行域，使得拉格朗日对偶性能够在不调用完整半定规划求解器的情况下验证固定非线性最小二乘候选解是否达到全局下界；（2）候选驱动架构作为一种非侵入式模块，可直接嵌入现有导航流程而无需替换局部估计器，从而保留原生切空间协方差输出并维持较低典型延迟。
tldr: This paper compares semidefinite programming (SDP) and nonlinear least squares (NLS) for GNSS Doppler-based initialization of attitude alignment in integrated navigation, showing that a modular SDP certifier can recover global accuracy at lower latency and preserving covariance outputs for real-world driving datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了半定规划（SDP）和非线性最小二乘（NLS）在GNSS多普勒初始化姿态对齐中的应用，表明模块化SDP认证器能以较低延迟恢复全局精度，并保留协方差输出，适用于真实驾驶数据集。

title: A Face Robot which Imitates Human Musculoskeletal Skin System and Its Evaluation on Basic Movement of Facial Expression
summary: Facial robots require many coordinated, smallamplitude motions, but accommodating these motions in a compact face remains difficult. This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial-robot platform that reproduces the layered organization of the human facial musculoskeletal system. The platform comprises bone, muscle, and skin components whose geometry, shape, and attachment locations are derived from three-dimensional anatomical data. Wire-driven, compliant muscle components are routed through PTFE tubes, allowing actuation to be placed away from the face. We describe the selection and fabrication of 65 muscles (34 muscle types) required to reproduce the 47 target action units (AUs) in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). We then evaluate the reproducibility of individual AUs in two stages: muscle actuation without skin and actuation after the silicone skin is attached. Forty of the 47 target AUs were reproduced with the muscle components, and 30 were reproduced after skin attachment. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reproducing a broad range of FACS facial expressions using an anatomically inspired musculoskeletal structure. The proposed platform provides a foundation for the systematic development and evaluation of future anatomically inspired facial robots
summary_zh: 面部机器人需要大量协调的小幅度运动，但在紧凑的面部结构中实现这些运动仍具挑战。本文提出了一种基于解剖学启发的面部机器人平台，可再现人类面部肌肉骨骼系统的分层组织结构。该平台由骨骼、肌肉和皮肤组件构成，其几何形状、形态及附着位置均依据三维解剖数据确定。线驱动、柔顺的肌肉组件穿过聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）管进行布线，使得驱动装置可远离面部放置。我们描述了为复现面部动作编码系统（FACS）中47个目标动作单元（AUs）所需的65块肌肉（34种肌肉类型）的选取与制作过程，并在两个阶段评估了各动作单元的可复现性：无皮肤状态下的肌肉驱动，以及硅胶皮肤贴合后的驱动。结果显示，47个目标动作单元中，有40个可通过肌肉组件复现，皮肤贴合后有30个可复现。这些结果证明了利用解剖学启发的肌肉骨骼结构复现FACS中广泛面部表情的可行性。所提出的平台为未来系统化开发与评估解剖学启发式面部机器人奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial robot replicating human musculoskeletal layers with 65 wire-driven muscles to reproduce FACS action units, achieving 30 of 47 AUs after skin attachment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种解剖学启发的面部机器人，复制人体肌肉骨骼分层结构，使用65条线驱动肌肉复现FACS动作单元，在皮肤附着后实现47个AU中的30个。

title: Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study
summary: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand. In this work, we test whether providing particular research papers as context improves the LLM-written navigation code for the Go2 quadruped, with the LLM (Claude Opus 5) and locomotion policy frozen. Specifically, we compare the navigation controllers the LLM writes when provided with and without particular papers across three settings: behavior trees, navigators edited from a shared base, and controllers written from scratch. When a maze's shortest route is blocked mid-episode, 2 of 8 controllers written with the context of an incremental-replanning paper complete all four trips under Isaac Sim physics, against 7 of 8 without it (two-sided Fisher's exact test, p = 0.041). This difference appears only under physics: in an idealized kinematic simulator, the controllers written with and without the paper are indistinguishable. We hypothesize that an LLM provided research papers as context tends to overweight both their content and their goals -- in this case, the efficiency of incremental replanning -- negatively affecting the fulfillment of the main task and leading to less robust code.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型能够编写出胜任的机器人导航代码，但相关研究不断推进的同时，模型也可能因文献数量庞大而无法回忆起相关发现并将其应用于当前任务。在本研究中，我们测试了将特定研究论文作为上下文提供给模型，是否能改进针对Go2四足机器人所生成的LLM导航代码，其中LLM（Claude Opus 5）和运动策略均保持固定不变。具体而言，我们在三种设置下比较了LLM在提供和不提供特定论文时所编写的导航控制器：行为树、从共享基础版本修改而来的导航器，以及从零编写的控制器。当迷宫的最短路径在运行中途被阻断时，在提供增量重规划论文上下文的情况下，8个控制器中有2个能够在Isaac Sim物理仿真下完成全部四次行程，而在未提供该论文的情况下，这一数字为8个中的7个（双尾Fisher精确检验，p = 0.041）。这一差异仅在物理仿真条件下出现：在理想化的运动学仿真器中，有无论文上下文所编写的控制器之间没有显著区别。我们推测，当LLM获得研究论文作为上下文时，往往会过度强调论文的内容及其目标——在本案例中即为增量重规划的效率——从而对主要任务的完成产生负面影响，并导致生成的代码鲁棒性下降。
tldr: This paper tests whether providing research papers as context improves LLM-generated quadruped navigation code, finding that it can hurt robustness under physics simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文测试了将研究论文作为上下文是否有助于提升LLM生成的四足机器人导航代码，发现物理仿真下可能降低鲁棒性。

title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
summary: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.
summary_zh: 全景相机能够在单帧图像中捕获近乎完整的球面视野。然而，全景覆盖范围与激光雷达视场之间的不匹配，给依赖激光雷达深度先验的全景高斯溅射SLAM带来了巨大挑战。我们提出了GOLD-SLAM，一种高斯溅射全向激光雷达深度SLAM系统，它将高质量渲染与精确的几何重建相结合。该系统在球面域中进行跟踪与建图，并利用激光雷达未覆盖区域中的跟踪视觉特征来改善位姿估计。为了解决增量建图过程中新观测表面覆盖不足及漂浮伪影的问题，我们引入了深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）方法。为了进行更广泛的评估，我们使用无人机平台收集了一个新数据集WHOLE，涵盖弱几何、高动态、全向、低光照和简单场景。在公开基准和WHOLE数据集上的大量实验表明，与透视系统相比，GOLD-SLAM在渲染质量和几何精度方面均具有竞争力。与现有的全景基线方法相比，GOLD-SLAM将平均PSNR提升了5.56-9.10 dB，并将平均深度L1误差降低了71.9-83.9%。为了评估在无人机等资源受限平台上的部署可行性，我们在Jetson Orin NX（16 GB）上对GOLD-SLAM的嵌入式配置进行了评测，结果表明其能够以牺牲重建质量为代价实现在线运行。
tldr: GOLD-SLAM is a Gaussian-splatting SLAM system that uses panoramic cameras and LiDAR depth to achieve high-quality rendering and accurate geometric reconstruction, with new methods for mapping in spherical domains and a dataset for evaluation.
tldr_zh: GOLD-SLAM 是一个利用全景相机和 LiDAR 深度的高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统，在球面域进行跟踪和建图，实现了高质量的渲染和精确的几何重建，并引入了新方法和数据集。

title: Effect-Driven Skill Abstractions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: We seek to learn discrete skill abstractions to facilitate long-horizon, goal-conditioned reinforcement-learning (RL) tasks. Recent approaches have shown success by quantizing actions via clustering or reconstruction. However, these objectives lead to skills that are not directly related to what the current state affords or what the goal requires. Instead, we argue that goal-directed skills should be driven by \emph{how they affect the state} of the agent. To realize this, we introduce a novel quantization method for action chunks that optimizes next-state predictions conditioned on the current state and action. This objective encourages skills to be distinguished by the future states they lead to, resulting in a vocabulary that spans diverse outcomes reachable from a given state. Our framework can easily be paired with common offline RL methods by replacing their continuous actor head with a discrete one that selects among the learned skills. We can execute these skills in the environment by converting them back to continuous actions using a trained low-level controller. Experiments on benchmark navigation and manipulation tasks largely show substantial and consistent improvements over both the continuous-actor baselines and reconstruction-based discretizations. Our project page can be found at: https://burcukilic.github.io/projects/effect-driven-skill-abstractions/.
summary_zh: 我们旨在学习离散的技能抽象，以促进长时程、目标条件的强化学习任务。近期的方法通过聚类或重构对动作进行量化，已取得一定成功。然而，这些目标所生成的技能与当前状态所允许的行为或目标所要求的行为并无直接关联。相反，我们认为目标导向的技能应基于其如何影响智能体的状态来驱动。为实现这一点，我们提出了一种新的动作块量化方法，该方法在给定当前状态和动作的条件下优化下一状态的预测。这一目标促使技能根据其带来的未来状态进行区分，从而形成一种涵盖从给定状态可达到的多样化结果的词汇表。我们的框架可以轻松地与常见的离线强化学习方法结合使用，只需将其连续动作头替换为在所学技能中进行选择的离散动作头。通过使用训练好的低级控制器，我们可以将这些技能转换回连续动作，从而在环境中执行。在基准导航与操作任务上的实验表明，相较于连续动作基线和基于重构的离散化方法，我们的方法普遍取得了显著且一致的改进。我们的项目页面见：https://burcukilic.github.io/projects/effect-driven-skill-abstractions/。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel skill abstraction method for offline RL that clusters action chunks based on their effects on the state, enabling better long-horizon goal-conditioned control, and demonstrates improvements in navigation and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种新的技能抽象方法，基于动作对状态的影响对动作块进行聚类，以改进离线RL中的长时程目标条件控制，并在导航和操作任务中展示了改进。

title: POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control
summary: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial state displacements. It employs a saddle-free curvature metric and reward-scale-consistent scaling while leaving the actor unchanged. On six continuous control tasks with TD3, POISE reduces the smoothness score on every task by $5.9\times$ on average ($4.5\times$ geometric mean), compared with $2.2\times$ ($1.9\times$) for the strongest baseline, and achieves the lowest score on five tasks. Paired return intervals include zero on four tasks, with a 14% increase on Ant and an 11% decrease on Hopper.
summary_zh: 演员-评论家方法在机器人控制中取得了高回报，然而训练得到的演员会出现高频动作振荡。大多数平滑方法对演员进行约束，而PAVE则通过对动作梯度变化进行单独惩罚并鼓励负动作曲率来正则化评论家。然而，相同的梯度变化在评论家较为平坦的区域会使评论家偏好的动作移动得更远，而单独的惩罚无法衡量这种移动。我们通过贪婪位移来刻画这一移动，该位移在局部凹性条件下近似贪婪动作在状态转移间的一阶变化。由于位移本身并不反映其评论家值的后果，进一步的分析表明，位移的曲率加权能量近似于保留先前贪婪动作所损失价值的二阶量。基于这一关系，POISE沿时间和空间状态位移对曲率加权能量进行正则化。它采用无鞍点曲率度量和奖励尺度一致的缩放，同时保持演员不变。在六个连续控制任务上，与TD3结合时，POISE在每个任务上的平滑度得分平均降低了$5.9\times$（几何平均$4.5\times$），而最强基线的降幅为$2.2\times$（几何平均$1.9\times$），并在五个任务上取得了最低得分。成对回报区间在四个任务上包含零，其中Ant任务增加14%，Hopper任务减少11%。
tldr: POISE is a curvature-aware critic regularization method for actor-critic control that reduces high-frequency action oscillations in continuous control tasks by penalizing the curvature-weighted energy of greedy-action shifts, improving smoothness over baselines without modifying the actor.
tldr_zh: POISE 是一种针对演员-评论家控制的曲率感知批评者正则化方法，通过惩罚贪心动作位移的曲率加权能量来减少连续控制任务中的高频动作振荡，在不修改演员的情况下优于基线方法的平滑性。

title: Interactive Neural Computers
summary: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.
summary_zh: 计算机及其界面通常被视为固定不变的，因此一个人，或日益增多的AI智能体，必须适应操作系统所提供的任何界面。当用户需要不同的工作流程，或需要一个适合免提操作或残障人士使用的界面时，这种固定性便成为限制。我们探索了一个被忽视的替代方案。与其训练一个智能体去操作现有计算机，我们训练一个生成模型本身作为计算机，根据过去的屏幕画面以及用户的鼠标和键盘操作，预测下一帧屏幕。将桌面视为一个交互式世界模型，会引发自然视频世界模型在很大程度上回避的问题。由于没有相机位姿来索引记忆，模型必须记住已离开屏幕的内容，而没有任何几何线索。终端中的算术运算必须精确无误，而不仅仅是看似合理。小号界面文本也必须在交互帧率下保持清晰可读。我们的交互式神经计算机，其结构类似于神经图灵机，并通过三个端到端训练（从像素和操作到输出）的模块开始解决这些问题。一个由潜在下一帧预测（MEMORY-JEPA）监督的、带有惊喜门控的槽记忆模块，负责存储屏幕外的内容。一个探索性查询桥接模块引入预训练视觉语言模型的推理能力，而一个残差渲染器仅预测帧之间的潜在变化。在长时间的闭环 rollout（自回归生成）中，我们的模型在64.2%的试验中能回忆起被遮挡的文件（随机概率为33.3%），而循环网络和滑动窗口基线模型的最高准确率为56.0%。该模型还将终端文本的OCR准确率从1.3%提升至50.1%。最后，由于记忆是显式的，可以在测试时进行移植，从而因果性地改变模型所渲染的内容。
tldr: The paper proposes an Interactive Neural Computer, a generative world model that predicts screens from user actions, using surprise-gated slot memory, VLM-based reasoning, and residual rendering to improve recall and text accuracy in long rollouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出交互式神经计算机，一种从用户操作预测屏幕的生成式世界模型，利用惊喜门控槽记忆、VLM推理和残差渲染，在长时程交互中提高离线内容回忆和文本精度。

title: ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型从离线轨迹中学习紧凑的循环动态，然而部署的模拟器可能保留后门触发器或来自过时物理机制的状态转换。现有的遗忘方法在自回归物理场景中失效：梯度更新扭曲潜流形并加剧展开漂移，简单的输出置零在触发启动时抑制有效的控制响应，而单步删除则会在循环隐藏状态中留下污染。我们提出解析动力学切除（ADE），一种确定性的、零训练的闭环遗忘算法，用于潜在世界模型。仅利用缓存的预训练矩，ADE通过单遍矩阵降阶更新恢复保留协方差，无需原始保留数据，并将闭环编辑级联应用于输入瓶颈、隐藏状态和下游头部。将正交切除与白化循环阻尼及均值保持仿射校准相结合，可中和流形外后门并重新对齐流形内偏移，而不会导致方差坍缩。在三个MuJoCo基准的四种场景中，ADE在DreamerV1上优于七个调优基线，消除HalfCheetah和Hopper速度翻转触发器的速度比微调快$4.4\times$，并零样本迁移至DreamerV3。
tldr: This paper proposes ADE, a zero-training closed-form unlearning method for latent world models, which removes backdoor triggers and stale transitions by analytically downdating covariances and cascading edits across the model, outperforming baselines on MuJoCo benchmarks and transferring to DreamerV3.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ADE，一种针对潜在世界模型的零训练闭式遗忘方法，通过分析协方差降阶和级联编辑消除后门触发和过时转移，在MuJoCo基准上优于基线并迁移至DreamerV3。

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
summary: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis
summary_zh: 外科场景理解受限于数据稀缺和长尾类别不平衡的问题，因为标注手术视频需要稀缺的临床专业知识，而罕见的手术事件在数据中始终代表性不足。我们通过数据生成来应对这一挑战，提出了SurgGenesis——一个生成式手术世界模型，该模型在潜在空间中从视觉观察和文本手术流程描述中学习未来手术状态的转换，可作为可扩展的手术数据引擎。为了在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下将大规模视频扩散模型适应于数据稀缺的手术领域，我们引入了一种三阶段渐进式LoRA策略，逐步注入内窥镜视觉先验、手术流程语义和空间运动线索。我们不仅以视觉保真度来评判生成结果，还沿着两条将世界模型与通用生成器区分开来的轴线验证SurgGenesis：(i) 未来感知性，通过将预测的未来与真实未来进行比较，采用GT潜在预测差距和时间跨度分析；(ii) 动作忠实的有用性，通过检查生成的片段是否包含指令所要求的手术三元组，以及使用这些片段来重新平衡长尾事件并驱动下游理解任务（分割、三元组识别、三维重建）是否能够带来动作特定的性能提升。因此，条件化的未来生成与传统长尾采样形成了互补。代码：https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis
tldr: SurgGenesis is a generative surgical world model that predicts future surgical states from video and text via a three-stage progressive LoRA diffusion approach, and demonstrates usefulness through future-awareness metrics and action-faithful downstream task gains.
tldr_zh: SurgGenesis 是一种生成式手术世界模型，通过三阶段渐进式 LoRA 扩散方法从视频和文本预测未来手术状态，并通过未来感知指标和下游任务增益验证其有效性。

title: SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation
summary: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/
summary_zh: 生成具有物理合理动态的视频尽管在视觉质量方面取得了进展，仍然具有挑战性。潜在世界模型为评估物理合理性提供了预测信号，但预测与观察特征之间更高的一致性可能反映的是更容易预测的场景内容，而非更合理的动态。我们提出**自参考物理对齐奖励**（**SPAR**），该框架利用世界模型的预测进行推理时的物理对齐。SPAR将每个视频的预测误差与由重复其自身帧构建的静态片段的预测误差进行比较，为评估生成的动态提供内容匹配的参考。为了考虑物理交互在空间和时间分布上的不均匀性，我们引入了一种统一的**时空奖励精细化**策略。**空间精细化**强调局部预测差异，而**时间精细化**则缓和短暂误差峰值，并用预测与观察特征变化之间的一致性补充预测误差。跨多个基准的评估表明，SPAR提升了**文本到视频生成**和**图像到视频延续**的物理合理性，使生成的动态更贴近支配真实世界事件的物理规律。更多结果和资源请访问 https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/。
tldr: SPAR introduces a self-referenced world-model reward framework that aligns video generation dynamics with physical plausibility by comparing prediction errors against static frame repetitions, enhancing text-to-video and image-to-video generation quality.
tldr_zh: SPAR提出了一种自参考世界模型奖励框架，通过将预测误差与静态帧重复的误差进行比较，使视频生成动态更符合物理合理性，从而提升文本到视频和图像到视频的生成质量。

title: DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval
summary: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型支持动作和相机控制的探索，但在重新访问先前探索过的位置时，难以保持一致的空间几何结构和外观。历史KV缓存有助于自回归视频扩散模型维持长期一致性，但随着历史增长，其检索和注意力计算会引入显著延迟。我们提出DraftKV，一种无需训练的框架，基于几何锚定和查询条件相关性检索历史KV缓存，同时将CPU卸载与分块流式注意力相结合，以降低GPU内存使用和推理延迟。理论上，我们证明草稿相关性能够精确重现全分辨率块相关性的均值分支，因此其偏差仅局限于β加权最大值分支，并基于实测的Top-K选择重叠度界定了检索效用的损失。进一步，我们证明草稿相关性无法区分具有相似池化描述符的块（无论相机姿态如何），这促使在细化之前引入几何锚定。随后，我们提出流式CG-Attention，通过分块流式将CPU到GPU的KV传输与注意力计算重叠，在保持GPU内存使用有界的同时隐藏传输延迟。跨多种模型家族的实验表明，DraftKV在生成质量和一致性上均表现优越，与其他CPU卸载的KV缓存检索方法相比，实现了$3.27\times$的端到端加速和42.2%的峰值GPU内存缩减。值得注意的是，DraftKV使得在单个H100 GPU上使用SolarWM-33B能够实现高质量的历史KV检索交互式世界生成。
tldr: DraftKV is a training-free framework that improves long-term consistency in interactive video world models by retrieving historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query relevance, using CPU offloading and tile-wise streaming attention to reduce latency and GPU memory.
tldr_zh: DraftKV 是一种无需训练的框架，通过基于几何基础和查询相关性的历史 KV 缓存检索，并结合 CPU 卸载与分块流式注意力，提升了交互式视频世界模型的长期一致性，同时降低了延迟和 GPU 内存。

title: TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation
summary: For endoscopic robotic surgery, accurate dense depth perception serves as a foundational capability, which enables navigation, instrument localization, and tissue interaction. However, endoscopic video lacks reliable metric depth, while metric measurements obtained via tracking, time-of-flight sensing, or instrument contact only cover a small fraction of pixels in each frame, rendering sparse depth completion an urgent and unsolved challenge. In this work, we propose Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory (TANDEM), a causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic video. It adopts a lightweight design and leverages the video stream: past measurements re-projected into the current view recover the metric evidence unavailable within a single sparse frame. To keep this evidence interpretable, accurate, and efficient, an explicit memory scores each re-projected measurement with analytic re-observation, age, and motion-parallax factors without overriding current measurements. A compact network then reconstructs depth via reliability-weighted gradient integration and a frequency-gated reference prior. We evaluate TANDEM on the C3VD colonoscopy and StereoMIS laparoscopy datasets. With only 5.58 M parameters, TANDEM reduces the root mean square error by 11.7% and 32.0%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. It also remains accurate under pose errors of the magnitude reported for endoscopic pose estimation. Code will be released at https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 对于内窥镜机器人手术而言，准确的密集深度感知是一项基础能力，它为导航、器械定位和组织交互提供了支持。然而，内窥镜视频缺乏可靠的度量深度信息，而通过追踪、飞行时间传感或器械接触获得的度量测量结果仅覆盖每帧中极少数的像素，这使得稀疏深度补全成为一个紧迫且尚未解决的挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种名为TANDEM（时间锚点致密化与可靠性感知记忆）的因果稀疏深度补全框架，专用于内窥镜视频。该框架采用轻量级设计，并充分利用视频流：将过去的测量值重新投影至当前视角，以恢复单帧稀疏数据中无法获得的度量证据。为使这些证据保持可解释性、准确性和高效性，显式记忆机制为每个重新投影的测量值评分，综合考虑解析性重观测、时效和运动视差等因素，且不会覆盖当前测量值。随后，一个紧凑型网络通过可靠性加权梯度积分和频率门控参考先验来重建深度。我们在C3VD结肠镜数据集和StereoMIS腹腔镜数据集上对TANDEM进行了评估。仅用558万个参数，TANDEM相比最强基线将均方根误差分别降低了11.7%和32.0%，达到了当前最优精度。在内窥镜姿态估计所报告的幅度的位姿误差下，该框架仍能保持准确性。代码将在论文被接收后于https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM发布。
tldr: TANDEM is a lightweight causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic robotic navigation that densifies metric depth evidence over time using reliability-aware memory, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with 5.58M parameters.
tldr_zh: TANDEM 是一种用于内窥镜机器人导航的轻量级因果稀疏深度补全框架，通过可靠性感知记忆随时间加密度量深度证据，以 5.58M 参数达到最先进精度。

title: SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.
summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型逐帧生成可导航的世界，但一个持久化的世界要求当用户离开后再返回时，先前观察到的场景仍然可以被恢复。然而，现有的记忆评估往往侧重于已见视角的重访和完整轨迹展开，导致跨视角场景恢复研究不足，同时又将记忆与轨迹跟随误差及生成退化累积问题混为一谈。我们提出了SceneMemBench，一个用于交互式视频世界模型中场景记忆评估的基准。它评估两个互补维度：已见视角回忆与新颖视角恢复，以及受控诊断与端到端交互。我们引入了从共享的真实观测历史出发的持续展开（Continued Rollout），以及覆盖完整模型生成交互的全轨迹展开（Full Rollout）。SceneMemBench包含跨越33个虚幻引擎场景的600条受控轨迹和60个全轨迹展开案例，覆盖了八个具有代表性的开源和闭源模型。我们从主体一致性、外观保真度和几何一致性三个方面评估场景恢复效果。结果表明，新颖视角恢复通常比已见视角回忆更具挑战性，而受控历史条件下的模型表现可能与完整交互中观察到的结果存在显著差异。综上，这些发现揭示了仅通过已见视角重访或端到端展开所掩盖的互补性失败模式。
tldr: SceneMemBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating scene memory in interactive video world models, distinguishing seen-view recall from novel-view recovery and controlled diagnosis from full interaction, revealing that novel-view recovery is more challenging and that model performance profiles differ between settings.
tldr_zh: SceneMemBench 为交互式视频世界模型中的场景记忆评估引入了一个基准，区分了已见视角回忆与新视角恢复、受控诊断与完整交互，并发现新视角恢复更具挑战性，且模型表现特征在两种设置下有所不同。

title: Support2Sim: Visually Faithful Real2Sim with Stable Object Supports
summary: Reconstructing a scene for physics simulation requires recovering its spatial layout and the support relationships that govern its behavior. We present Support2Sim, a Real2Sim system that reconstructs simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image. Our design objective is to maximize source fidelity, support realization, and stability within a practical time budget for scene generation. Support2Sim infers a support graph, which a contact-guided pose initializer uses to propose poses for objects with multiple supports. The initializer generates and ranks candidates by geometric fit and source-image agreement. A coarse-to-fine refiner allocates a fixed search budget across supported objects and evaluates pose updates with physics rollouts. After an accepted update, it searches from the new pose at a finer translation and rotation scale. We benchmark our method on 50 scenes spanning four datasets. Compared with the strongest baseline, Support2Sim improves source-mask IoU after 10 seconds by 21.4 pp, realizes 87.1% versus 73.2% of intended supports, and reduces mean object drift from 79.6 to 45.3 mm. See our project page at https://support2sim.github.io for more details.
tldr: Support2Sim recovers simulation-ready 3D scenes with support relationships from a single RGB image, improving source fidelity, support realization, and stability over baselines.
tldr_zh: Support2Sim从单张RGB图像重建可用于物理仿真的3D场景及其支撑关系，在源保真度、支撑实现率和稳定性上优于现有基线。

title: ROVO: Robust Rotation-Only Visual Odometry for UAVs at Low and Moderate Altitudes
summary: Image noise can confound rotation and translation estimates in monocular visual navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at low and moderate altitudes, where even small perturbations may cause large errors in translation direction. Inspired by angular cues in long-range visual perception, we propose rotation-only visual odometry (ROVO) for monocular aerial imagery. ROVO estimates pairwise rotations from matched images, robustly averages them over overlapping windows, and aligns consecutive windows through shared frames. By retaining only orientation in the trajectory state, it prevents uncertain landmark depth from propagating to later estimates. In trajectory simulation, sliding-window ROVO achieved a mean orientation error just 10.7% as large as that of the conventional SLAM baseline. On real flight data, ROVO achieved rotation accuracy comparable to ORB-SLAM3 and DPVO under the original Bell412 settings. With a narrower FoV or at higher flight altitude, ROVO reduced relative rotation RMSE by 19.7--69.4% compared with the next-best method in each comparison. Code and simulation tools are available at https://github.com/sssxxxkkkk/ROVO.
tldr: ROVO is a monocular rotation-only visual odometry method for UAVs that improves orientation accuracy by averaging pairwise rotations over sliding windows and preventing landmark-depth error propagation, outperforming SLAM baselines on real flight data at low/moderate altitudes.
tldr_zh: ROVO 是一种用于无人机的单目仅旋转视觉里程计方法，通过滑动窗口平均成对旋转并避免地标深度误差传播，提升方向精度，在真实飞行数据上优于SLAM基线。

title: Delay-Tolerant Formation Tracking for Multi-AGV Systems via Reference-Shift Coupling
summary: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) that transport a load together must keep a formation while each vehicle tracks its own reference, and they coordinate over wireless links with link-dependent, time-varying and jumping delays. We propose a cascade design for differential-drive AGVs modelled as kinematic unicycles: delayed data from the neighbours drive only a second-order filter that shifts each vehicle's own reference, and an unmodified gain-scheduled tracking law follows the shifted reference. A saturation keeps the shifted reference feasible, and the feed-forward is exact, so the tracking loop never sees the network. We prove that tracking and formation errors remain bounded for arbitrary delays and converge for every bounded delay and every directed, possibly switching, graph. We also construct a strict Lyapunov function with explicit constants and prove exponential convergence and a local input-to-state estimate with delay-independent gains. On undirected graphs, the coupling attenuates the formation error caused by persistent local errors by at least the factor lambda/(lambda+Lambda*lambda_2(L)) (leak lambda, coupling gain Lambda, algebraic connectivity lambda_2(L)), for any delay. Every inequality is verified with an event-driven, error-controlled simulation. A robustness study on a high-fidelity AGV model (drive dynamics, slip, localisation errors, clock offsets, lossy Wi-Fi) comprises 4,894 runs, including paired comparisons against tuned baselines. The cascade never failed, with latencies up to 4 s, 90% packet loss and up to 12 vehicles, whereas a direct delayed coupling failed when its gain saturated the drives. Coupling reduced the formation error after traction losses by 21-32% and after safety stops by up to 47%, at the price of tracking accuracy. Localisation bias and clock offsets, which no coupling law can observe, limit the achievable accuracy.
tldr: This paper proposes a cascade control design for multi-AGV formation tracking that is robust to arbitrary, time-varying, and jumping delays in wireless coordination, with theoretical guarantees and extensive high-fidelity simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种多AGV编队跟踪的级联控制设计，对无线协调中的任意、时变和跳变延迟具有鲁棒性，并提供了理论保证和大量高保真仿真验证。

title: View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS
summary: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.
tldr: This paper improves online 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM by progressively adding non-keyframe views, using edge-guided initialization for Gaussian placement, and applying Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization to suppress spurious Gaussians, enhancing appearance and geometry within real-time budgets.
tldr_zh: 本文通过渐进式添加非关键帧视图、边缘引导的高斯初始化以及自参考不透明度正则化，在实时预算内提升了在线3D高斯泼溅SLAM的地图外观和几何质量。

title: A Self-Organizing Swarm Control Model for Underwater Robots Based on Turing-Type Reaction-Diffusion Principles
summary: In underwater environments, Global Positioning System (GPS) signals and high-speed radio communication are unavailable, and severe constraints exist on communication bandwidth and visibility; consequently, applying conventional swarm formation methods, such as the Boids model, which require the relative positions and velocity vectors of neighboring vehicles, is difficult. This study proposes a decentralized swarm control model that operates without a leader or absolute coordinates, relying solely on the number of received signals from two communication channels with different transmission ranges (inner and outer neighborhoods). The proposed model extends a cellular automaton model based on Turing pattern formation principles to continuous space and is grounded in the fundamental concept that swarms form as robots move toward regions of higher potential calculated from the difference in received signal counts. Specifically, stable behavior is determined through temporal averaging of potential values, hysteresis-based state evaluation, stepwise turning based on temporal differences, and vector composition with an external directional command. Two-dimensional simulation results demonstrated that autonomous swarm formation and control of swarm spatial dispersion via a morphological parameter are achievable, confirming robustness in maintaining swarms and high polarization even under communication dropouts where the communication success rate decreases to approximately 0.7.
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized swarm control model for underwater robots that uses Turing-type reaction-diffusion principles and only relies on received signal counts from two communication channels, eliminating the need for GPS, relative positions, or velocity vectors. Simulations demonstrate robust swarm formation and spatial dispersion control, even under communication dropouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于图灵反应扩散原理的水下机器人分布式集群控制模型，仅利用两个通信信道的信号数量来实现集群形成与空间分布控制，无需GPS或相对位置信息，并在通信丢失情况下保持鲁棒性。

title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -> Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R->T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.
tldr: This paper introduces PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled JEPA architecture that adapts LLMs to mmWave radar for physical scene understanding, improving cross-modal retrieval while preserving physical prediction accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PhysRF-WorldJEPA，一种流形解耦的JEPA架构，将LLM适配至毫米波雷达物理场景理解，在保持物理预测精度的同时提升跨模态检索性能。

title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.
tldr: ICLWorld is an online benchmark that evaluates in-context learning of frontier agents in computer use and robot use environments, revealing that agents perform well on digital tasks but poorly on physical robot tasks, and often identify rules without acting on them.
tldr_zh: ICLWorld是一个在线基准测试，评估前沿智能体在计算机使用和机器人使用环境中的上下文学习能力，结果显示智能体在数字任务上表现良好，但在物理机器人任务上表现不佳，且常常能识别规则却无法执行。

title: Self-supervised quality evaluation of grid maps without ground truth
summary: Maps are widely used in the robotics community for localization and path planning and the ability to identify incorrect or inaccurate regions of a map is an area of active research interest. For large environments, manual edits of the map can be very time consuming and a tool which can assist a map editor is needed. With this paper, we contribute to robot introspection through self-assessment of map quality, using only a given map as input to be independent of the underlying mapping algorithm. Current methods for map quality assessment rely on ground-truth or labelled information for training classifiers, both of which can be difficult to obtain. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised learning approach to map quality assessment of 2D occupancy grid maps which identifies regions of a map that require further investigation. We leverage an autoencoder for patches extracted from the map to capture the dominant structure of the map. By evaluating the reconstruction loss of a patch reconstructed with the learned model, we can evaluate whether it contains an unusual structure, which indicates the need of further investigation. We evaluate our method on the outcome of state-of-the-art grid mapping methods using benchmark datasets as well as maps from warehouse environments, highlighting the application to more complex environments. We show that the method identifies regions with sparse data, clutter, and misregistrations.
tldr: This paper presents a self-supervised method for assessing the quality of 2D occupancy grid maps by using an autoencoder to detect unusual structures, requiring only the map itself and no ground truth.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自监督的二维占据栅格地图质量评估方法，利用自动编码器检测异常结构，仅需地图本身，无需真值。

title: Putting a Robot on a Phone Call: Layered Signaling, Bounded Occupancy and Turn Arbitration over WebRTC
summary: We put a Thor robot on a browser voice call, with speech sent from Safari, answers played through the robot's loudspeaker and transcripts returned to the phone. We separate HTTPS signaling, relayed WebRTC media and speech generation into independently observable routes. The browser prefetches relay credentials and allows a 500 ms window after its first relay candidate. The backend starts speech and WebRTC-answer preparation concurrently within a 55 s deadline. A session slot and a non-blocking speaker lock coordinate calls with local voice access. A 2 s gate gives the controller an opportunity to suppress chat before playback. Fifteen of sixteen first dials reached ready-to-speak, comprising seven of eight Wi-Fi calls with a median of 5.57 s and eight of eight cellular calls with a median of 6.76 s. All twenty scored occupancy and recovery scenarios admitted a later call. During five 60 s outages, the backend released the line while the phone remained offline. Across 40 controlled replays, enabling the gate suppressed chat when the controller decided at 1 s. At 3 s, chat and controller feedback both played in sequence, with no overlapping output in any trace. Two additional boundary traces exposed a receipt naming a later feedback item and a new call's query returning its predecessor's feedback. These measurements cover application events on one platform and simulated controller decisions, with acoustic output and task correctness outside their scope.
tldr: This paper presents a system for putting a Thor robot on a browser voice call via WebRTC, focusing on layered signaling, bounded occupancy, and turn arbitration to enable remote human-robot interaction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过WebRTC将Thor机器人接入浏览器语音通话的系统，重点研究分层信令、有限占用和轮次仲裁，以实现远程人机交互。

title: Wind-Aware Trajectory Planning for Deformable Aerial Formations
summary: Coordinated aerial transport in dense urban environments requires drone formations to navigate confined spaces and adapt to spatially varying winds around buildings. Formation deformation enables passage through narrow spaces but changes individual drone velocities and the local winds they encounter, coupling formation motion with aerodynamic effects. We propose Family-Air, a wind-aware trajectory-family planner that constructs a virtual tube as shared collision-free flight space and jointly optimizes formation-center motion, deformation, and timing. A shared affine transformation represents a continuous trajectory family, incorporating spatially varying wind and deformation-induced velocities into a unified air-relative motion objective. The optimization enforces virtual-tube containment, inter-drone separation, and kinematic feasibility. Simulations across four urban wind-field scenarios demonstrate the importance of local wind-deformation coupling. Flight simulations further show improvements in trajectory tracking accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of wind-aware trajectory-family planning for coordinated aerial transport in complex urban environments.
tldr: This paper introduces Family-Air, a wind-aware trajectory-family planner for deformable aerial formations transporting payloads in urban environments, jointly optimizing formation-center motion, deformation, and timing under spatially varying winds and kinematic constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Family-Air，一种用于城市环境中可变形空中编队运输的风感知轨迹族规划器，在空间变化风场和运动学约束下联合优化编队中心运动、变形和时序。

title: Learning When a Robot Should Ask For Help: Adaptive Intervention Requests in Human-Robot Teaming
summary: Robots operating in complex environments occasionally encounter situations where autonomous navigation fails. Requesting and receiving a timely intervention from their human supervisor can be critical for failure prevention or recovery. However, requesting help too frequently or at inappropriate times can increase operator workload and reduce team efficiency, while delayed requests may lead to prolonged downtime or unrecoverable failures. In addition to alert timing, the human, robot and task context also influences the intervention outcomes. This paper proposes an algorithm for learning to generate adaptive human intervention requests during human-robot teaming. A help-seeking policy is trained via offline reinforcement learning based on past intervention helpfulness and autonomous progress. This learned alert policy enables a robot to selectively request human help when the intervention outcome is likely to be beneficial. We evaluate the proposed policy in different task environments and user expertise levels in simulation, followed by evaluation in a physical user study. Our findings demonstrate that the learned policy improves exploration efficiency, reduces unnecessary alerts, and enhances novice user support without compromising expert performance in real-time human-robot teaming missions.
tldr: This paper proposes an offline reinforcement learning approach for training a help-seeking policy that enables a robot to selectively request human intervention when beneficial during human-robot teaming, improving exploration efficiency and reducing unnecessary alerts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于离线强化学习的求助策略训练方法，使机器人在人机协作中仅在有益时请求人类干预，从而提高探索效率并减少不必要的警报。

title: DAA for an Autonomous Delivery Drone: Maneuver Selection Policies for Near-Collision Risk Avoidance
summary:
Detect-and-avoid (DAA) systems for autonomous drones operating in shared airspace must select avoidance maneuvers under conditions that differ markedly from those assumed by conventional DAA architectures designed for crewed aircraft. Limited on-board sensing capabilities restrict detection of collision risk to near distances (sub-km), the time available for decision-making is severely limited, uncertainty in the predicted closest point of approach (CPA) and the time to reach it is substantial, and the maneuver envelope of a small uncrewed aircraft at low altitude is tightly constrained.
  This paper presents and compares two maneuver-selection strategies that address these challenges: (1) a purely geometric approach, steering in the direction away from the intruder at CPA, and (2) a method that also takes into account the known sources of uncertainty in the intruder's location, and steers away from a plane expected to contain the intruder's location distribution at CPA.
  Performance is evaluated using the risk ratio metric on a large dataset of simulated near-collision encounters with crewed intruders. Results indicate that both strategies are feasible (i.e., computable in closed form from an onboard track estimate), and that the second strategy substantially outperforms the first.
tldr: This paper proposes and evaluates two maneuver-selection strategies for detect-and-avoid (DAA) systems on autonomous delivery drones, showing that accounting for uncertainty in the intruder's position substantially improves near-collision risk avoidance in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出并评估了自主投递无人机检测与规避（DAA）系统的两种机动选择策略，证明在模拟中考虑入侵者位置不确定性可显著提高近碰撞风险规避性能。

title: Exact Collision Gradients for Ellipsoids in Differentiable Simulation
summary: Differentiable simulation enables gradient-based optimization in learning and control problems involving collisions, but its gradients are least reliable at the moment of impact, when the velocities jump. A fixed-step simulator detects a collision only after the bodies overlap, and some differentiable simulators correct for this with a linear estimate of the time of impact. In this paper, we study impacts between ellipsoids. We show that the gradient error of this estimate grows with the obliqueness of the collision, the curvature at contact, and the time step, and that ignoring spin adds a further error. Subsequently, we find the time of impact with continuous collision detection on the Perram Wertheim contact function and differentiate through the touching condition rather than the search. This gives exact gradients at any step size. We demonstrate our method on an optimal control problem and a system identification problem. In both, exact gradients recover the optimal control and the true parameters, while the linear estimate does not, even when it accounts for spin.
tldr: This paper derives exact collision gradients for ellipsoid contacts in differentiable simulation using continuous collision detection and differentiation through the touching condition, improving gradient accuracy for optimization and system identification.
tldr_zh: 本文通过连续碰撞检测并在接触条件上求导，为椭球碰撞在可微仿真中推导了精确梯度，提高了优化和系统辨识的梯度准确性。

title: The cyborg fly: reflexes survive engineered actuators, coordination needs stand-ins
summary: Two wiring diagrams now cover the whole central nervous system of an adult fruit fly: one female, one male. Can such a diagram, run as a network of spiking neurons, drive a body? And if we swap the body's muscles for engineered actuators, what survives? We ran both connectomes, BANC and MaleCNS, as leaky integrate-and-fire networks of about 160,000 neurons each, and closed the loop through simulated sensors, actuators and bodies for walking and flight. The actuators are port-Hamiltonian, so energy is audited at every step, and swapping one for another changes only a configuration file. Null networks shuffled at five levels, from the whole nervous system to synapse counts, test whether a result depends on the wiring. The wiring produced specific functions: sugar on the labellum drove the proboscis motor neuron, leg joints resisted imposed movement, leg circuits oscillated, a looming disc drove a take-off signal on its side (in MaleCNS), and descending neurons throttled and steered flight. The resistance reflex survived 20 of 20 actuator settings in MaleCNS and 19 of 20 in BANC, including a Hill-type muscle pair and a geared DC motor; the actuator set walking speed and energy cost instead. Coordinated six-leg walking, flight stability and the correction of perturbations did not emerge. Each needed a labelled engineered stand-in, which the connectome could command. Such stand-ins can also manufacture an apparent dependence on wiring: in a rebuild of a published closed loop, odour navigation came from a hand-written rule, and the network entered only through one valence number. The two animals differed on some functions, and the differences traced to wiring, such as a haltere drive of the flight power muscles found only in MaleCNS. A whole-CNS connectome, embodied, gives reflexes, rhythms and command signals, but not the coordination that turns them into behaviour.
tldr: The paper simulates the entire Drosophila central nervous system connectomes as spiking neural networks in closed-loop with simulated bodies and engineered actuators, finding that reflexes and command signals arise from wiring, but coordinated behaviors require engineered stand-ins.
tldr_zh: 该论文将果蝇全中枢神经系统连接组模拟为脉冲神经网络，并与模拟身体和工程执行器闭环，发现反射和命令信号源于布线，但协调行为需要工程替代。

title: Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
summary: Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a $\underline{D}\text{istributed}$ $\underline{S}\text{ampling-based}$ $\underline{T}\text{rajectory}$ $\underline{O}\text{ptimization} \ \text{(DS-TO)}$ architecture built on a splitting mechanism tailored to sampling. Under this splitting, each agent samples only in its own control space, independent of neighborhood size, while still remaining exposed to both the constraint-induced non-convexity and the decisions of other agents. The resulting algorithm is fully decentralized, requiring only neighborhood communication, with all local updates executed in parallel across agents. Efficient variations, including parallel Jacobi updates within each agent's subproblem and single-step constraint linearization, further reduce computation. Experiments on 2D and 3D tasks with up to 1024 agents demonstrate improved exploration and constraint satisfaction over state-of-the-art derivative-based distributed optimization, and superior scalability to existing distributed sampling methods.
